===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\config\BridgeKeyFilter.java =====
// src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/config/BridgeKeyFilter.java
//
// NEW FILE. Lets the Windows companion (which has no JWT) call the local-SIM
// device-bridge endpoints by sending   X-Bridge-Key: <bridge.api-key>
//
//   GET  /api/local-sim/calls/bridge/next?deviceId=...&agentUsername=...
//   POST /api/local-sim/calls/{requestId}/status
//
// Add to application.properties (use a long random value, same one goes into
// the companion's config.json as "bridgeKey"):
//   bridge.api-key=PUT-A-LONG-RANDOM-SECRET-HERE

package com.indocrm.indocrm.config;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;

import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

@Component
public class BridgeKeyFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {

    private static final String HEADER = "X-Bridge-Key";
    private static final String PREFIX = "/api/local-sim/calls/";

    @Value("${bridge.api-key:}")
    private String bridgeApiKey;

    @Override
    protected boolean shouldNotFilter(HttpServletRequest request) {
        String path = request.getRequestURI();
        if (!path.startsWith(PREFIX)) return true;

        // companion polling endpoint
        if (path.startsWith(PREFIX + "bridge/")) return false;

        // companion status report
        return !("POST".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getMethod()) && path.endsWith("/status"));
    }

    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request,
                                    HttpServletResponse response,
                                    FilterChain chain)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String provided = request.getHeader(HEADER);

        // No bridge key -> not the companion. Let JWT / Spring Security decide
        // (a logged-in CRM user may legitimately POST a status too).
        if (provided == null || provided.isBlank()) {
            chain.doFilter(request, response);
            return;
        }

        if (bridgeApiKey == null || bridgeApiKey.isBlank()) {
            reject(response, "bridge.api-key is not configured on the server");
            return;
        }

        boolean ok = MessageDigest.isEqual(
                provided.trim().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
                bridgeApiKey.trim().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

        if (!ok) {
            reject(response, "Invalid bridge key");
            return;
        }

        UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken auth =
                new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
                        "windows-companion", null,
                        List.of(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_BRIDGE")));
        SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(auth);

        chain.doFilter(request, response);
    }

    private void reject(HttpServletResponse response, String message) throws IOException {
        response.setStatus(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED);
        response.setContentType("application/json");
        response.getWriter().write("{\"message\":\"" + message + "\"}");
    }
}

                    allowed = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

        // This allows credentials (cookies, Authorization headers) to work

        response.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, OPTIONS");

            "Upgrade, Connection, Sec-WebSocket-Key, Sec-WebSocket-Version, " +
            "Sec-WebSocket-Extensions, ngrok-skip-browser-warning");
        response.setHeader("Access-Control-Expose-Headers", "Authorization, Content-Disposition");
        response.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", "true");
        response.setHeader("Access-Control-Max-Age", "3600");

        // Handle preflight OPTIONS request
        if ("OPTIONS".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getMethod())) {
            response.setStatus(HttpServletResponse.SC_OK);
            return;
        }
        
        chain.doFilter(req, response);
    }

    @Override
    public void init(FilterConfig filterConfig) throws ServletException {}

    @Override
    public void destroy() {}
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.config;

import jakarta.annotation.PostConstruct;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.MongoTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.index.Index;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.*;

@Configuration
public class DatabaseIndexConfig {

    private final MongoTemplate mongo;

    public DatabaseIndexConfig(MongoTemplate mongo) { this.mongo = mongo; }

    @PostConstruct
    public void ensureIndexes() {
        // Leads — most queried
        mongo.indexOps(Lead.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("district", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Lead.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("assignedTo", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Lead.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("status", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Lead.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("mobile", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Lead.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("createdAt", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.DESC));
        mongo.indexOps(Lead.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("district", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC).on("assignedTo", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));

        // Calls
        mongo.indexOps(Call.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("agentUsername", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Call.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("leadId", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Call.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("startedAt", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.DESC));
        mongo.indexOps(Call.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("callStatus", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Call.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("agentUsername", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC).on("startedAt", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.DESC));

        // Payments
        mongo.indexOps(Payment.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("createdBy", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Payment.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("leadId", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Payment.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("status", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Payment.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("createdAt", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.DESC));

        // Quotations
        mongo.indexOps(Quotation.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("createdBy", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Quotation.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("status", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Quotation.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("createdAt", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.DESC));

        // Agreements
        mongo.indexOps(Agreement.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("createdBy", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Agreement.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("status", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Agreement.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("createdAt", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.DESC));

        // Communications — VERY important, polled every 2s
        mongo.indexOps(CommunicationMessage.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("recipientType", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC).on("createdAt", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(CommunicationMessage.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("senderUsername", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC).on("recipientUsername", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(CommunicationMessage.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("attachmentId", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));

        // Attendance
        mongo.indexOps(AttendanceRecord.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("date", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.DESC));
        mongo.indexOps(AttendanceSession.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("username", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC).on("connected", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.DESC));

        // Telecallers
        mongo.indexOps(Telecaller.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("districts", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
        mongo.indexOps(Telecaller.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("assignedPhoneNumber", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));

        // Leave/Permission
        mongo.indexOps(LeavePermissionRequest.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("username", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC).on("submittedAt", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.DESC));
        mongo.indexOps(LeavePermissionRequest.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("status", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));

        // Demo
        mongo.indexOps(Demo.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("createdBy", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC).on("createdAt", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.DESC));

        // Calendar
        mongo.indexOps(CalendarEvent.class).ensureIndex(new Index().on("date", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC).on("active", org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Direction.ASC));
    }
}

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\config\DataSeeder.java =====
// src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/config/DataSeeder.java

package com.indocrm.indocrm.config;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.boot.CommandLineRunner;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.User;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.UserRepository;

@Configuration
public class DataSeeder {

    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DataSeeder.class);

    private static final String SUPERADMIN_USERNAME = "superadmin";
    private static final String SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD = "super123"; // change after first login
    private static final String SUPERADMIN_ROLE = "SUPER_ADMIN";

    @Bean
    public CommandLineRunner seedSuperAdmin(
            UserRepository userRepository,
            PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder,
            // Set  app.superadmin.reset-password=true  in application.properties for ONE
            // start-up to force the password back to super123, then remove the line.
            @Value("${app.superadmin.reset-password:false}") boolean resetPassword) {

        return args -> {
            User admin = userRepository.findByUsername(SUPERADMIN_USERNAME).orElse(null);

            if (admin == null) {
                admin = new User();
                admin.setUsername(SUPERADMIN_USERNAME);
                admin.setPassword(passwordEncoder.encode(SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD));
                admin.setFullName("Super Admin");
                admin.setEmail("superadmin@indocrm.com");
                admin.setRole(SUPERADMIN_ROLE);
                admin.setEnabled(true);
                userRepository.save(admin);
                log.info("Seeded Super Admin (username: {} / password: {}). Change it after first login.",
                        SUPERADMIN_USERNAME, SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD);
                return;
            }

            // ---- The account already exists: REPAIR it instead of silently skipping. ----
            // The old seeder did nothing here, so a "superadmin" row created earlier by the
            // public /register endpoint (role USER, or a plain-text / wrong password) stayed
            // broken forever and the real Super Admin could never log in.
            boolean changed = false;

            boolean isSuperAdmin = false;
            for (GrantedAuthority a : admin.getAuthorities()) {
                if ("ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN".equals(a.getAuthority())) {
                    isSuperAdmin = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!isSuperAdmin) {
                log.warn("'{}' had role '{}' - restoring {}", SUPERADMIN_USERNAME, admin.getRole(), SUPERADMIN_ROLE);
                admin.setRole(SUPERADMIN_ROLE);
                changed = true;
            }

            if (!admin.isEnabled()) {
                log.warn("'{}' was disabled - enabling", SUPERADMIN_USERNAME);
                admin.setEnabled(true);
                changed = true;
            }

            String pw = admin.getPassword();
            boolean looksHashed = pw != null && pw.matches("^\\$2[aby]?\\$\\d{2}\\$.{53}$");
            if (resetPassword || !looksHashed) {
                log.warn("'{}' password {} - resetting to default", SUPERADMIN_USERNAME,
                        resetPassword ? "reset requested" : "was not a valid BCrypt hash");
                admin.setPassword(passwordEncoder.encode(SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD));
                changed = true;
            }

            if (changed) {
                userRepository.save(admin);
                log.info("Super Admin account repaired.");
            }
        };
    }
}

// FILE: src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/config/ExotelProperties.java
// Reads Exotel credentials from application.properties (DON'T hardcode them in code / DON'T commit to git)

package com.indocrm.indocrm.config;

import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;

@Configuration
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "exotel")
public class ExotelProperties {

    // Your Exotel Account SID (from Exotel dashboard -> Settings -> API Settings)
    private String sid;

    // API Key acts as username for Basic Auth
    private String apiKey;

    // API Token acts as password for Basic Auth
    private String apiToken;

    // Your purchased Exophone / virtual number shown as Caller ID to the customer
    // Format Exotel expects, e.g. "01141234567" or "+91XXXXXXXXXX" - check your Exotel dashboard
    private String exophone;

    // Exotel API base url - most accounts use api.exotel.com, some regions use api.in.exotel.com
    // Check "API Settings" page on your Exotel dashboard for the exact subdomain assigned to you
    private String apiBaseUrl = "https://api.exotel.com";

    // Publicly reachable base URL of THIS backend, used for Exotel status callbacks
    // e.g. https://yourdomain.com  (must be public, not 192.168.x.x - use ngrok while testing locally)
    private String callbackBaseUrl;

    // Whether to record calls (Exotel charges extra per recording minute - keep false if not needed)
    private boolean recordCalls = false;

    public String getSid() { return sid; }
    public void setSid(String sid) { this.sid = sid; }

    public String getApiKey() { return apiKey; }
    public void setApiKey(String apiKey) { this.apiKey = apiKey; }

    public String getApiToken() { return apiToken; }
    public void setApiToken(String apiToken) { this.apiToken = apiToken; }

    public String getExophone() { return exophone; }
    public void setExophone(String exophone) { this.exophone = exophone; }

    public String getApiBaseUrl() { return apiBaseUrl; }
    public void setApiBaseUrl(String apiBaseUrl) { this.apiBaseUrl = apiBaseUrl; }

    public String getCallbackBaseUrl() { return callbackBaseUrl; }
    public void setCallbackBaseUrl(String callbackBaseUrl) { this.callbackBaseUrl = callbackBaseUrl; }

    public boolean isRecordCalls() { return recordCalls; }
    public void setRecordCalls(boolean recordCalls) { this.recordCalls = recordCalls; }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.config;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.MongoTemplate;

import com.mongodb.ConnectionString;
import com.mongodb.MongoClientSettings;
import com.mongodb.client.MongoClient;
import com.mongodb.client.MongoClients;

/**
 * Explicit MongoClient/MongoTemplate configuration.
 *
 * Why this exists:
 *   Spring Boot's autoconfiguration will build a MongoTemplate
 *   eagerly and (with auto-index-creation=true, the default)
 *   will immediately try to talk to the database during
 *   context refresh. If that first handshake hits a transient
 *   network blip, the whole application fails to start with
 *   a misleading "Cannot resolve reference to bean
 *   'mongoTemplate'" error.
 *
 *   By declaring the MongoClient ourselves and disabling
 *   auto-index-creation in application.properties, we defer
 *   all real database traffic until the first request.
 *
 *   If Atlas is genuinely unreachable, you'll get a clean
 *   "Timed out while waiting for a server" error at first
 *   use instead of an opaque bootstrap failure.
 */
@Configuration
public class MongoConfig {

    private static final Logger log =
            LoggerFactory.getLogger(MongoConfig.class);

    @Value("${spring.data.mongodb.uri}")
    private String mongoUri;

    @Bean
    public MongoClient mongoClient() {
        ConnectionString connectionString =
                new ConnectionString(mongoUri);

        MongoClientSettings settings = MongoClientSettings.builder()
                .applyConnectionString(connectionString)
                // Fail fast on a bad Atlas URI. If this throws,
                // the exception will name the URI problem
                // instead of surfacing later as "Socket closed".
                .applyToClusterSettings(b ->
                        b.serverSelectionTimeout(
                                30, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                .build();

        log.info("Creating MongoClient for hosts {}",
                connectionString.getHosts());
        return MongoClients.create(settings);
    }

    @Bean
    public MongoTemplate mongoTemplate(MongoClient mongoClient) {
        // No database name in the URI -> fall back to "indocrm".
        ConnectionString cs = new ConnectionString(mongoUri);
        String dbName = cs.getDatabase();
        if (dbName == null || dbName.isBlank()) {
            dbName = "indocrm";
        }
        return new MongoTemplate(mongoClient, dbName);
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.config;

import java.util.Arrays;

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationProvider;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.dao.DaoAuthenticationProvider;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.authentication.configuration.AuthenticationConfiguration;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.method.configuration.EnableMethodSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableWebSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfiguration;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfigurationSource;
import org.springframework.web.cors.UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.security.JwtAuthenticationFilter;

@Configuration
@EnableWebSecurity
@EnableMethodSecurity
public class SecurityConfig {

    private final JwtAuthenticationFilter jwtAuthFilter;
    private final UserDetailsService userDetailsService;
    private final WebSocketSecurityFilter webSocketSecurityFilter;
    private final BridgeKeyFilter bridgeKeyFilter;

    public SecurityConfig(
            JwtAuthenticationFilter jwtAuthFilter,
            UserDetailsService userDetailsService,
            WebSocketSecurityFilter webSocketSecurityFilter,
            BridgeKeyFilter bridgeKeyFilter) {

        this.jwtAuthFilter = jwtAuthFilter;
        this.userDetailsService = userDetailsService;
        this.webSocketSecurityFilter = webSocketSecurityFilter;
        this.bridgeKeyFilter = bridgeKeyFilter;
    }

    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http)
            throws Exception {

        http

            /*
             * WebSocket security filter
             */
            .addFilterBefore(
                webSocketSecurityFilter,
                UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class
            )

            /*
             * CSRF disabled because this application
             * uses JWT authentication.
             */
            .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())

            /*
             * CORS - THIS IS THE CRITICAL FIX
             */
            .cors(cors -> cors.configurationSource(corsConfigurationSource()))

            /*
             * Authorization
             */
            .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth

                /*
                 * ==========================================
                 * PUBLIC APIs
                 * ==========================================
                 */
                // Registration is NOT public any more (it let anyone create an account
                // that could then read every "authenticated()" endpoint).
                .requestMatchers("/api/auth/register")
                .hasAnyRole("SUPER_ADMIN", "ADMIN")

                .requestMatchers(
                    "/api/auth/**",
                    "/api/public/**",
                    "/api/google-meet/oauth/callback",
                    "/error"
                )
                .permitAll()

                /*
                 * ==========================================
                 * WEBSOCKET / BRIDGE
                 * ==========================================
                 */
                .requestMatchers(
                    "/ws/**",
                    "/bridge/**",
                    "/ws",
                    "/bridge"
                )
                .permitAll()

                .requestMatchers("/app/**")
                .permitAll()

                .requestMatchers("/topic/**")
                .permitAll()

                .requestMatchers("/user/**")
                .permitAll()

                /*
                 * ==========================================
                 * LOCAL-SIM DEVICE BRIDGE (Windows companion)
                 * ==========================================
                 * The companion has no JWT. It authenticates with the
                 * X-Bridge-Key header (see BridgeKeyFilter), which grants
                 * ROLE_BRIDGE. Only the polling endpoint is restricted to it;
                 * POST /{id}/status accepts BRIDGE or a normal logged-in user.
                 */
                .requestMatchers("/api/local-sim/calls/bridge/**")
                .hasRole("BRIDGE")

                /*
                 * ==========================================
                 * SUPER ADMIN APIs
                 * ==========================================
                 */
                .requestMatchers("/api/super-admin/**")
                .hasAnyRole(
                    "SUPER_ADMIN",
                    "ADMIN"
                )

                /*
                 * ==========================================
                 * LEAVE PERMISSION ADMIN APIs
                 * ==========================================
                 */
                .requestMatchers(
                    "/api/leave-permissions/admin/**"
                )
                .hasAnyRole(
                    "SUPER_ADMIN",
                    "ADMIN"
                )

                .requestMatchers(
                    "/api/leave-permissions/*/status"
                )
                .hasAnyRole(
                    "SUPER_ADMIN",
                    "ADMIN"
                )

                /*
                 * ==========================================
                 * QUOTATION ADMIN APIs
                 * ==========================================
                 */
                .requestMatchers(
                    "/api/quotations/admin/**"
                )
                .hasAnyRole(
                    "SUPER_ADMIN",
                    "ADMIN"
                )

                .requestMatchers(
                    "/api/quotations/*/review"
                )
                .hasAnyRole(
                    "SUPER_ADMIN",
                    "ADMIN"
                )

                /*
                 * ==========================================
                 * ALL OTHER APIs
                 * ==========================================
                 */
                .anyRequest()
                .authenticated()
            )

            /*
             * ==========================================
             * SESSION MANAGEMENT
             * ==========================================
             */
            .sessionManagement(session ->
                session.sessionCreationPolicy(
                    SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS
                )
            )

            /*
             * Not logged in / expired token  -> 401  (frontends then go to the login page)
             * Logged in but wrong role       -> 403  (frontends show "no permission")
             * Spring's default answered 403 for BOTH, so an expired token looked like a
             * permission problem and the apps behaved randomly.
             */
            .exceptionHandling(ex -> ex.authenticationEntryPoint((req, res, e) -> {
                res.setStatus(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED);
                res.setContentType("application/json");
                res.getWriter().write("{\"message\":\"Authentication required\",\"error\":\"Authentication required\"}");
            }))

            /*
             * ==========================================
             * AUTHENTICATION PROVIDER
             * ==========================================
             */
            .authenticationProvider(
                authenticationProvider()
            )

            /*
             * ==========================================
             * JWT FILTER
             * ==========================================
             */
            .addFilterBefore(
                jwtAuthFilter,
                UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class
            )

            /*
             * Bridge-key filter for the Windows companion (no JWT)
             */
            .addFilterBefore(
                bridgeKeyFilter,
                UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class
            );

        return http.build();
    }

    /*
     * ==========================================
     * CORS CONFIGURATION - SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH
     * ==========================================
     */
   @Bean
public CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource() {

    CorsConfiguration configuration = new CorsConfiguration();

    configuration.setAllowedOriginPatterns(
        Arrays.asList(
            "http://localhost:*",
            "http://127.0.0.1:*",
            "http://192.168.0.*:*",
            "http://192.168.1.*:*",
            "http://192.168.*.*:*",

            "https://thespian-impulse-glorious.ngrok-free.dev",
            "https://*.ngrok-free.dev",
            "https://*.trycloudflare.com",
            "https://*.cfargotunnel.com"
        )
    );

    configuration.setAllowedMethods(
        Arrays.asList(
            "GET",
            "POST",
            "PUT",
            "DELETE",
            "PATCH",
            "OPTIONS"
        )
    );

    configuration.setAllowedHeaders(
        Arrays.asList(
            "*"
        )
    );

    configuration.setExposedHeaders(
        Arrays.asList(
            "Authorization",
            "Content-Disposition"
        )
    );

    configuration.setAllowCredentials(true);

    configuration.setMaxAge(3600L);

    UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source =
        new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();

    source.registerCorsConfiguration(
        "/**",
        configuration
    );

    return source;
}
    /*
     * ==========================================
     * AUTHENTICATION PROVIDER
     * ==========================================
     */
    @Bean
    public AuthenticationProvider authenticationProvider() {

        DaoAuthenticationProvider authProvider =
            new DaoAuthenticationProvider();

        authProvider.setUserDetailsService(
            userDetailsService
        );

        authProvider.setPasswordEncoder(
            passwordEncoder()
        );

        return authProvider;
    }

    /*
     * ==========================================
     * AUTHENTICATION MANAGER
     * ==========================================
     */
    @Bean
    public AuthenticationManager authenticationManager(
            AuthenticationConfiguration config)
            throws Exception {

        return config.getAuthenticationManager();
    }

    /*
     * ==========================================
     * PASSWORD ENCODER
     * ==========================================
     */
    @Bean
    public PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder() {

        return new BCryptPasswordEncoder();
    }
}

// src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/config/WebSocketConfig.java

package com.indocrm.indocrm.config;

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.messaging.simp.config.MessageBrokerRegistry;
import org.springframework.scheduling.concurrent.ThreadPoolTaskScheduler;
import org.springframework.web.socket.config.annotation.EnableWebSocketMessageBroker;
import org.springframework.web.socket.config.annotation.StompEndpointRegistry;
import org.springframework.web.socket.config.annotation.WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurer;

@Configuration
@EnableWebSocketMessageBroker
public class WebSocketConfig implements WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurer {

    private static final String[] ALLOWED_ORIGINS = {
        "http://localhost:5173",
        "http://localhost:5174",
        "http://localhost:5175",
        "http://127.0.0.1:5173",
        "http://127.0.0.1:5174",
        "http://127.0.0.1:5175",
        "http://192.168.0.128:5173",
        "http://192.168.0.128:5174",
        "http://192.168.0.128:5175",
        "http://192.168.0.101:5173",
        "http://192.168.0.101:5174",
        "http://192.168.0.101:5175",
        "https://thespian-impulse-glorious.ngrok-free.dev"

    };

    @Override
public void configureMessageBroker(MessageBrokerRegistry config) {
    ThreadPoolTaskScheduler ts = new ThreadPoolTaskScheduler();
    ts.setPoolSize(1);
    ts.setThreadNamePrefix("ws-heartbeat-");
    ts.initialize();

    config.enableSimpleBroker("/topic", "/queue", "/user")
          .setHeartbeatValue(new long[]{10000, 10000})
          .setTaskScheduler(ts);
    config.setApplicationDestinationPrefixes("/app");
    config.setUserDestinationPrefix("/user");
}

    @Override
    public void registerStompEndpoints(StompEndpointRegistry registry) {
        registry.addEndpoint("/ws")
                .setAllowedOrigins(ALLOWED_ORIGINS)
                .withSockJS()
                .setClientLibraryUrl("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sockjs-client@1/dist/sockjs.min.js");

        registry.addEndpoint("/ws")
                .setAllowedOrigins(ALLOWED_ORIGINS);
    }
}

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\config\WebSocketSecurityFilter.java =====
package com.indocrm.indocrm.config;

import java.io.IOException;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;

import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

@Component
public class WebSocketSecurityFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {

    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request, 
                                   HttpServletResponse response, 
                                   FilterChain filterChain) 
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        
        String path = request.getRequestURI();
        
        // Allow WebSocket handshake requests without authentication
        // CORS is already handled by SecurityConfig.corsConfigurationSource()
        if (path.startsWith("/ws") || path.startsWith("/bridge") || 
            path.startsWith("/app") || path.startsWith("/topic") || 
            path.startsWith("/user")) {
            
            // Only handle WebSocket-specific headers if needed
            // The main CORS headers are set by SecurityConfig
            
            if ("OPTIONS".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getMethod())) {
                response.setStatus(HttpServletResponse.SC_OK);
                return;
            }
        }
        
        filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.AgreementCategoryService;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/agreement-categories")
public class AgreementCategoryController {

    private final AgreementCategoryService s;

    public AgreementCategoryController(AgreementCategoryService s) {
        this.s = s;
    }

    @GetMapping
    public List<Map<String, Object>> list() {
        return s.list();
    }

    @GetMapping("/{key}")
    public ResponseEntity<?> get(@PathVariable String key) {
        return call(() -> s.get(key));
    }

    @PutMapping("/{key}")
    public ResponseEntity<?> save(@PathVariable String key, @RequestBody Map<String, String> body) {
        return call(() -> s.save(key, body.get("contentHtml")));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{key}/reset")
    public ResponseEntity<?> reset(@PathVariable String key) {
        return call(() -> s.reset(key));
    }

    private ResponseEntity<?> call(java.util.function.Supplier<Object> x) {
        try {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(x.get());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("message", e.getMessage() == null ? "Request failed" : e.getMessage()));
        }
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;
import java.io.File;
import java.util.*;
import org.springframework.core.io.FileSystemResource;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.AgreementRequest;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Agreement;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.AgreementService;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/agreements")
public class AgreementController {

    private final AgreementService s;

    public AgreementController(AgreementService x) { s = x; }

    @GetMapping
    public List<Agreement> list(@RequestParam(required = false) String status,
                                 @RequestParam(required = false) String telecaller,
                                 @RequestParam(required = false) String leadId) {
        return s.list(status, telecaller, leadId);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public Agreement get(@PathVariable String id) {
        return s.get(id);
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<?> create(@RequestBody AgreementRequest r) {
        return call(() -> s.create(r));
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<?> update(@PathVariable String id, @RequestBody AgreementRequest r) {
        return call(() -> s.update(id, r));
    }

    /**
     * NEW: renders the merged agreement (content + pricing) without saving
     * anything — backs the "Preview Agreement" step on the Add Agreement form.
     */
    @PostMapping("/preview")
    public ResponseEntity<?> preview(@RequestBody AgreementRequest r) {
        return call(() -> s.preview(r));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/submit")
    public ResponseEntity<?> submit(@PathVariable String id) {
        return call(() -> s.submit(id));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/approve")
    public ResponseEntity<?> approve(@PathVariable String id, @RequestBody(required = false) Map<String, String> b) {
        return call(() -> s.approve(id, b == null ? null : b.get("remark")));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/reject")
    public ResponseEntity<?> reject(@PathVariable String id, @RequestBody Map<String, String> b) {
        return call(() -> s.reject(id, b.get("reason")));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/send")
    public ResponseEntity<?> send(@PathVariable String id, @RequestBody(required = false) Map<String, String> b) {
        return call(() -> s.send(id, b == null ? "WhatsApp" : b.getOrDefault("channel", "WhatsApp")));
    }

    /** NEW: download / print the generated PDF (generated on demand if missing). */
    @GetMapping("/{id}/pdf")
    public ResponseEntity<?> pdf(@PathVariable String id) {
        try {
            Agreement a = s.get(id);
            File file = s.pdfFile(id);
            String fileName = a.getGeneratedPdfFileName() != null ? a.getGeneratedPdfFileName() : "Agreement.pdf";
            return ResponseEntity.ok()
                    .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_PDF)
                    .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
                            ContentDisposition.inline().filename(fileName).build().toString())
                    .body(new FileSystemResource(file));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("message", e.getMessage() == null ? "PDF not available" : e.getMessage()));
        }
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<?> remove(@PathVariable String id) {
        return call(() -> { s.delete(id); return Map.of("success", true); });
    }

    private ResponseEntity<?> call(Supplier x) {
        try {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(x.get());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("message", e.getMessage() == null ? "Request failed" : e.getMessage()));
        }
    }

    @FunctionalInterface
    interface Supplier { Object get() throws Exception; }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.AttendanceAuditLog;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.AttendanceSession;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.AttendanceService;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/attendance")
public class AttendanceController {
    private final AttendanceService service;
    public AttendanceController(AttendanceService service){this.service=service;}

    @PostMapping("/login")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TELECALLER')")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> login(Authentication auth, HttpServletRequest request,
                                                     @RequestBody(required=false) Map<String,Object> body){

// src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/controller/AuthController.java

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.AuthRequest;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.AuthResponse;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Employee;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Telecaller;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.User;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.TelecallerRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.UserRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.security.JwtUtil;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.AttendanceService;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.DisabledException;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.LockedException;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.AuthenticationException;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/auth")
public class AuthController {

    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AuthController.class);

    private final AuthenticationManager authenticationManager;
    private final JwtUtil jwtUtil;
    private final UserDetailsService userDetailsService;
    private final UserRepository userRepository;
    private final TelecallerRepository telecallerRepository;
    private final PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;
    private final AttendanceService attendanceService;

    public AuthController(AuthenticationManager authenticationManager,
                          JwtUtil jwtUtil,
                          UserDetailsService userDetailsService,
                          UserRepository userRepository,
                          TelecallerRepository telecallerRepository,
                          PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder,
                          AttendanceService attendanceService) {
        this.authenticationManager = authenticationManager;
        this.jwtUtil = jwtUtil;
        this.userDetailsService = userDetailsService;
        this.userRepository = userRepository;
        this.telecallerRepository = telecallerRepository;
        this.passwordEncoder = passwordEncoder;
        this.attendanceService = attendanceService;
    }

    private static ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> fail(HttpStatus status, String message) {
        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("message", message);   // read by both frontends (error.message)
        body.put("error", message);
        body.put("status", status.value());
        return ResponseEntity.status(status).body(body);
    }

    @PostMapping("/login")
    public ResponseEntity<?> login(@RequestBody AuthRequest request) {

        // Usernames are stored trimmed; a stray space typed/pasted in the login box
        // used to make a correct login fail.
        final String username = request.getUsername() == null ? "" : request.getUsername().trim();
        final String password = request.getPassword() == null ? "" : request.getPassword();

        if (username.isEmpty() || password.isEmpty()) {
            return fail(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Username and password are required");
        }

        try {
            authenticationManager.authenticate(
                    new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(username, password));
        } catch (DisabledException | LockedException e) {
            log.warn("Login blocked for '{}': account disabled/locked", username);
            return fail(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "Your account is disabled. Please contact your administrator.");
        } catch (AuthenticationException e) {
            log.warn("Login failed for '{}': {}", username, e.getClass().getSimpleName());
            return fail(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "Invalid username or password");
        }

        final UserDetails userDetails = userDetailsService.loadUserByUsername(username);
        final String jwt = jwtUtil.generateToken(userDetails);

        String fullName = userDetails.getUsername();
        String role = "USER";
        Telecaller telecaller = null;

        if (userDetails instanceof User u) {
            fullName = u.getFullName() != null ? u.getFullName() : u.getUsername();
            role = u.getRole() != null ? u.getRole() : "USER";
        } else if (userDetails instanceof Telecaller t) {
            telecaller = t;
            fullName = t.getFullName() != null ? t.getFullName() : t.getUsername();
            role = t.getRole() != null ? t.getRole() : "Telecaller";
        } else if (userDetails instanceof Employee e) {
            fullName = e.getFullName() != null ? e.getFullName() : e.getUsername();
            role = e.getRole() != null ? e.getRole() : "EMPLOYEE";
            // Legacy: a telecaller that only matched through its employee mirror.
            telecaller = telecallerRepository.findByUsername(username).orElse(null);
        }

        AuthResponse response = new AuthResponse();
        response.setToken(jwt);
        response.setUsername(userDetails.getUsername());
        response.setFullName(fullName);
        response.setRole(role);

        if (telecaller != null) {
            response.setDistricts(telecaller.getDistricts());
            // Login is also the attendance check-in event. It must NEVER block the login
            // itself - a failure here used to turn a correct password into a failed login.
            try {
                attendanceService.login(telecaller.getUsername(), null, null);
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                log.error("Attendance check-in failed for '{}' (login still allowed): {}",
                        username, ex.getMessage());
            }
        }

        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    // Registration is now restricted to ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN in SecurityConfig.
    // Role is intentionally NOT taken from the request body - every account created here
    // is a plain USER. Elevated roles are created by seeding / the admin UI only.
    @PostMapping("/register")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> register(@RequestBody AuthRequest request) {
        if (request.getUsername() == null || request.getUsername().isBlank() ||
            request.getPassword() == null || request.getPassword().isBlank()) {
            return fail(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Username and password are required");
        }

        String username = request.getUsername().trim();

        if (userRepository.findByUsername(username).isPresent()
                || telecallerRepository.existsByUsername(username)) {
            return fail(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Username already exists");
        }

        User newUser = new User();
        newUser.setUsername(username);
        newUser.setPassword(passwordEncoder.encode(request.getPassword()));
        newUser.setFullName(request.getFullName() != null ? request.getFullName() : username);
        newUser.setEmail(request.getEmail());
        newUser.setRole("USER");
        newUser.setEnabled(true);
        userRepository.save(newUser);

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("message", "User registered successfully");
        response.put("username", newUser.getUsername());
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(response);
    }

    @GetMapping("/validate")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> validateToken() {
        // The JWT filter already validated the token before reaching this endpoint.
        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("valid", true);
        response.put("message", "Token is valid");
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.CalendarEvent;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.CalendarService;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/calendar")
public class CalendarController {

    private final CalendarService calendarService;

    public CalendarController(
            CalendarService calendarService
    ) {
        this.calendarService =
                calendarService;
    }

    @GetMapping
    public List<Map<String, Object>> getCalendarEvents(

            @RequestParam(required = false)
            @DateTimeFormat(
                    iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE
            )
            LocalDate from,

            @RequestParam(required = false)
            @DateTimeFormat(
                    iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE
            )
            LocalDate to,

            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        LocalDate today =
                LocalDate.now();

        if (from == null) {
            from =
                    today.withDayOfMonth(1);
        }

        if (to == null) {
            to =
                    from.withDayOfMonth(
                            from.lengthOfMonth()
                    );
        }

        if (from.isAfter(to)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "From date cannot be after to date"
            );
        }

        return calendarService.getEvents(
                from,
                to,
                authentication
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/events")
    public List<Map<String, Object>> getEvents(

            @RequestParam(required = false)
            @DateTimeFormat(
                    iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE
            )
            LocalDate from,

            @RequestParam(required = false)
            @DateTimeFormat(
                    iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE
            )
            LocalDate to,

            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        LocalDate today =
                LocalDate.now();

        if (from == null) {
            from =
                    today.withDayOfMonth(1);
        }

        if (to == null) {
            to =
                    from.withDayOfMonth(
                            from.lengthOfMonth()
                    );
        }

        return calendarService.getEvents(
                from,
                to,
                authentication
        );
    }

    @PostMapping
    public CalendarEvent createEvent(

            @RequestBody CalendarEvent event,

            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        return calendarService.create(
                event,
                authentication
        );
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public CalendarEvent updateEvent(

            @PathVariable String id,

            @RequestBody CalendarEvent event,

            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        return calendarService.update(
                id,
                event,
                authentication
        );
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    public Map<String, Object> deleteEvent(

            @PathVariable String id,

            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        calendarService.delete(
                id,
                authentication
        );

        return Map.of(
                "success",
                true,

                "message",
                "Calendar event deleted successfully"
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/telecallers")
    public List<Map<String, String>>
    getTelecallers(
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        return calendarService.telecallerOptions(
                authentication
        );
    }
}

// src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/controller/CallBridgeController.java

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.messaging.handler.annotation.MessageMapping;
import org.springframework.messaging.handler.annotation.Payload;
import org.springframework.messaging.simp.SimpMessagingTemplate;
import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.BridgeCallRequest;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.BridgeCallStatus;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.CallBridgeService;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.TelecallerAccessService;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/bridge")
public class CallBridgeController {

    @Autowired
    private SimpMessagingTemplate messagingTemplate;

    @Autowired
    private CallBridgeService callBridgeService;

    @Autowired
    private TelecallerAccessService accessService;

    @Autowired
    private ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    // ============================================================
    // WebRTC Signaling Storage (FREE - In-memory, no TURN needed)
    // ============================================================
    private final Map<String, String> pendingSDP = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, String> pendingICE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    @MessageMapping("/bridge/call")
    public void initiateCall(@Payload Map<String, Object> payload) {
        System.out.println("📨 Received bridge call request: " + payload);
        
        try {
            Map<String, Object> data;
            if (payload.containsKey("body")) {
                String bodyStr = (String) payload.get("body");
                data = objectMapper.readValue(bodyStr, Map.class);
            } else {
                data = payload;
            }
            
            if (data.containsKey("type") && "bridge_call".equals(data.get("type"))) {
                data = (Map<String, Object>) data.get("data");
            }
            
            BridgeCallRequest request = new BridgeCallRequest();
            request.setDeviceId((String) data.get("deviceId"));
            request.setLeadId((String) data.get("leadId"));
            request.setLeadName((String) data.get("leadName"));
            request.setPhoneNumber((String) data.get("phoneNumber"));
            request.setCallerNumber((String) data.get("callerNumber"));
            request.setAgentUsername((String) data.get("agentUsername"));
            request.setAgentName((String) data.get("agentName"));
            request.setCallMethod((String) data.get("callMethod"));
            request.setAudioMode((String) data.get("audioMode"));

            String registeredUsername = callBridgeService.getDeviceUsername(request.getDeviceId());
            if (registeredUsername == null || !registeredUsername.equals(request.getAgentUsername())) {
                throw new AccessDeniedException("Device is not registered for this telecaller");
            }
            if (accessService.isTelecaller()) {
                accessService.requireLeadAccess(request.getLeadId());
            } else {
                com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Telecaller tc = accessService.currentTelecallerByUsername(request.getAgentUsername());
                if (tc.getDistricts() == null || request.getLeadId() == null) {
                    throw new AccessDeniedException("Lead access denied");
                }
                accessService.requireLeadAccessForUsername(request.getAgentUsername(), request.getLeadId());
            }
            request.setTimestamp(System.currentTimeMillis());
            
            System.out.println("📞 Forwarding call to device: " + request.getDeviceId());
            
            messagingTemplate.convertAndSendToUser(
                request.getDeviceId(),
                "/queue/call",
                request
            );
            
            messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/call-requests", request);
            
            BridgeCallStatus status = new BridgeCallStatus();
            status.setDeviceId(request.getDeviceId());
            status.setLeadId(request.getLeadId());
            status.setLeadName(request.getLeadName());
            status.setPhoneNumber(request.getPhoneNumber());
            status.setStatus("initiating");
            status.setCallMethod("android_sim_pc_headset");
            status.setAudioRoute("webrtc_p2p");
            status.setTimestamp(System.currentTimeMillis());
            
            messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/call-status", status);
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("❌ Failed to process bridge call: " + e.getMessage());
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    @MessageMapping("/bridge/status")
    public void handleBridgeStatus(@Payload BridgeCallStatus status) {
        System.out.println("📊 Received bridge status: " + status.getStatus());
        System.out.println("📊 Device: " + status.getDeviceId());
        System.out.println("📊 Lead: " + status.getLeadName());
        System.out.println("📊 Phone: " + status.getPhoneNumber());
        System.out.println("📊 Audio Route: " + status.getAudioRoute());
        System.out.println("📊 Call Method: " + status.getCallMethod());
        
        if (status.getAudioRoute() == null) status.setAudioRoute("webrtc_p2p");
        if (status.getCallMethod() == null) status.setCallMethod("android_sim_pc_headset");
        
        callBridgeService.saveCallStatus(status);
        
        messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/call-status", status);
        messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/call/" + status.getDeviceId(), status);
    }

    @MessageMapping("/bridge/register")
    public void registerDevice(@Payload Map<String, String> payload) {
        String deviceId = payload.get("deviceId");
        String username = payload.get("username");
        String deviceType = payload.get("deviceType");
        
        System.out.println("📱 Device registered: " + deviceId + " by " + username + " (type: " + deviceType + ")");
        callBridgeService.registerDevice(deviceId, username, deviceType);
        
        messagingTemplate.convertAndSendToUser(
            deviceId,
            "/queue/register",
            Map.of("status", "success", "deviceId", deviceId, "deviceType", deviceType)
        );
    }

    // ============================================================
    // FREE WebRTC Signaling Endpoints - No TURN server needed!
    // ============================================================

    @MessageMapping("/webrtc/signal")
    public void handleWebRTCSignal(@Payload Map<String, Object> payload) {
        System.out.println("🎧 WebRTC signal: " + payload);

        String deviceId = (String) payload.get("deviceId");
        String type = (String) payload.get("type");

        if (deviceId == null) {
            System.err.println("❌ No deviceId in WebRTC signal");
            return;
        }

        if ("sdp".equals(type)) {
            String sdp = (String) payload.get("sdp");
            System.out.println("🎧 SDP from " + deviceId + ": " + sdp.substring(0, Math.min(100, sdp.length())));

            pendingSDP.put(deviceId, sdp);

            // Forward to web UI if it's from Android
            messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/webrtc/sdp", Map.of(
                "deviceId", deviceId,
                "sdp", sdp,
                "type", "sdp"
            ));
            System.out.println("📤 SDP forwarded to web");
        }

        if ("ice".equals(type)) {
            String ice = (String) payload.get("ice");
            System.out.println("🎧 ICE from " + deviceId + ": " + ice);

            pendingICE.put(deviceId, ice);

            // Forward to web UI if it's from Android
            messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/webrtc/ice", Map.of(
                "deviceId", deviceId,
                "ice", ice,
                "type", "ice"
            ));
            System.out.println("📤 ICE forwarded to web");
        }
    }

    // WebRTC endpoints for web to fetch SDP/ICE from Android
    @GetMapping("/webrtc/sdp/{deviceId}")
    public Map<String, String> getSDPForDevice(@PathVariable String deviceId) {
        String sdp = pendingSDP.get(deviceId);
        return Map.of("sdp", sdp != null ? sdp : "");
    }

    @GetMapping("/webrtc/ice/{deviceId}")
    public Map<String, String> getICEForDevice(@PathVariable String deviceId) {
        String ice = pendingICE.get(deviceId);
        return Map.of("ice", ice != null ? ice : "");
    }

    @GetMapping("/devices")
    public Map<String, Object> getActiveDevices() {
        return callBridgeService.getActiveDevices();
    }
}

// BACKEND: src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/controller/CallController.java

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.CallRequest;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.CallResponse;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.CallStatsResponse;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.CallService;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.TelecallerAccessService;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.Date;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/calls")
@CrossOrigin(origins = {
    "http://localhost:5173",
    "http://localhost:5174",
    "http://127.0.0.1:5173",
    "http://127.0.0.1:5174",
    "http://192.168.0.107:5173",
    "http://192.168.0.107:5174",
    "https://*.trycloudflare.com"
}, allowCredentials = "true")
public class CallController {

    private final CallService callService;
    private final TelecallerAccessService accessService;

    public CallController(CallService callService, TelecallerAccessService accessService) {
        this.callService = callService;
        this.accessService = accessService;
    }

    @PostMapping
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'EMPLOYEE', 'TELECALLER')")
    public ResponseEntity<CallResponse> createCall(@RequestBody CallRequest request) {
        String username = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication().getName();
        if (accessService.isTelecaller()) accessService.requireLeadAccess(request.getLeadId());
        request.setAgentUsername(username);
        
        CallResponse response = callService.createCall(request);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(response);
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'EMPLOYEE', 'TELECALLER')")
    public ResponseEntity<CallResponse> updateCall(@PathVariable String id, @RequestBody CallRequest request) {
        if (accessService.isTelecaller()) {
            CallResponse existing = callService.getCallById(id);
            accessService.requireLeadAccess(existing.getLeadId());
        }
        CallResponse response = callService.updateCall(id, request);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    @PatchMapping("/{id}/status")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'EMPLOYEE', 'TELECALLER')")
    public ResponseEntity<CallResponse> updateCallStatus(@PathVariable String id, @RequestBody Map<String, String> payload) {
        if (accessService.isTelecaller()) { accessService.requireLeadAccess(callService.getCallById(id).getLeadId()); }
        String status = payload.get("status");
        if (status == null || status.isEmpty()) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().build();
        }
        CallRequest request = new CallRequest();
        request.setCallStatus(status);
        CallResponse response = callService.updateCall(id, request);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    @PatchMapping("/{id}/outcome")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'EMPLOYEE', 'TELECALLER')")
    public ResponseEntity<CallResponse> updateCallOutcome(@PathVariable String id, @RequestBody Map<String, String> payload) {
        if (accessService.isTelecaller()) { accessService.requireLeadAccess(callService.getCallById(id).getLeadId()); }
        String outcome = payload.get("outcome");
        if (outcome == null || outcome.isEmpty()) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().build();
        }
        CallRequest request = new CallRequest();
        request.setOutcome(outcome);
        CallResponse response = callService.updateCall(id, request);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'EMPLOYEE', 'TELECALLER')")
    public ResponseEntity<CallResponse> getCall(@PathVariable String id) {
        if (accessService.isTelecaller()) {
            CallResponse existing = callService.getCallById(id);
            accessService.requireLeadAccess(existing.getLeadId());
        }
        CallResponse response = callService.getCallById(id);

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.core.io.Resource;
import org.springframework.http.ContentDisposition;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.CommunicationMessage;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.CommunicationService;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/communications")
public class CommunicationController {

    private final CommunicationService service;

    public CommunicationController(
            CommunicationService service) {

        this.service = service;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // PARTICIPANTS
    // ============================================================

    @GetMapping("/participants")
    public ResponseEntity<?> participants() {

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                service.getParticipants()
        );
    }

    // ============================================================
    // MESSAGES
    // ============================================================

    @GetMapping("/messages")
    public ResponseEntity<List<CommunicationMessage>> messages(
            @RequestParam(
                    defaultValue = "GROUP-ALL"
            )
            String chatId) {

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                service.getMessages(chatId)
        );
    }

    // ============================================================
    // SEND MESSAGE
    // ============================================================

    @PostMapping("/messages")
    public ResponseEntity<CommunicationMessage> send(
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        String recipientType =
                stringValue(
                        body.get("recipientType")
                );

        String recipientUsername =
                stringValue(
                        body.get("recipientUsername")
                );

        String text =
                stringValue(
                        body.get("text")
                );

        String type =
                stringValue(
                        body.get("type")
                );

        String attachmentId =
                stringValue(
                        body.get("attachmentId")
                );

        String attachmentName =
                stringValue(
                        body.get("attachmentName")
                );

        String attachmentContentType =
                stringValue(
                        body.get("attachmentContentType")
                );

        Integer durationSeconds =
                integerValue(
                        body.get("durationSeconds")
                );

        Long attachmentSizeBytes =
                longValue(
                        body.get("attachmentSizeBytes")
                );

        CommunicationMessage message =
                service.send(
                        recipientType,
                        recipientUsername,
                        text,
                        type,
                        attachmentId,
                        attachmentName,
                        attachmentContentType,
                        durationSeconds,
                        attachmentSizeBytes
                );

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                message
        );
    }

    // ============================================================
    // ANNOUNCEMENT
    // ============================================================

    @PostMapping("/announcements")
    public ResponseEntity<CommunicationMessage> announcement(
            @RequestBody Map<String, String> body) {

        CommunicationMessage message =
                service.announcement(
                        body.get("text")
                );

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                message
        );
    }

    // ============================================================
    // MONITOR TELECALLER DIRECT CHATS
    // ============================================================

    @GetMapping("/monitor/conversations")
    public ResponseEntity<?> monitorConversations() {

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                service.getMonitorConversations()
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/monitor/messages")
    public ResponseEntity<List<CommunicationMessage>> monitorMessages(
            @RequestParam String firstUsername,
            @RequestParam String secondUsername) {

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                service.getMonitorMessages(
                        firstUsername,
                        secondUsername
                )
        );
    }

    // ============================================================
    // MARK READ
    // ============================================================

    @PatchMapping("/messages/{id}/read")
    public ResponseEntity<CommunicationMessage> markRead(
            @PathVariable String id) {

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                service.markRead(id)
        );
    }

    // ============================================================
    // FILE / VOICE UPLOAD
    // ============================================================

    @PostMapping(
            value = "/attachments",
            consumes = MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA_VALUE
    )
    public ResponseEntity<?> upload(
            @RequestParam("file")
            MultipartFile file) {

        try {

            if (file == null || file.isEmpty()) {

                return ResponseEntity
                        .badRequest()
                        .body(
                                Map.of(
                                        "message",
                                        "Uploaded file is empty"
                                )
                        );
            }

            return ResponseEntity.ok(
                    service.upload(file)
            );

        } catch (Exception e) {

            return ResponseEntity
                    .badRequest()
                    .body(
                            Map.of(
                                    "message",
                                    e.getMessage() != null
                                            ? e.getMessage()
                                            : "File upload failed"
                            )
                    );
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // FILE / VOICE DOWNLOAD
    // ============================================================

    @GetMapping("/attachments/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Resource> attachment(
            @PathVariable String id) {

        CommunicationService.AttachmentData data =
                service.getAttachment(id);

        MediaType mediaType;

        try {

            String contentType =
                    data.getContentType();

            if (contentType == null ||
                    contentType.isBlank()) {

                mediaType =
                        MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM;

            } else {

                mediaType =
                        MediaType.parseMediaType(
                                contentType
                        );
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {

            mediaType =
                    MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM;
        }

        String fileName =
                data.getFileName() != null &&
                !data.getFileName().isBlank()
                        ? data.getFileName()
                        : "attachment";

        ResponseEntity.BodyBuilder response =
                ResponseEntity.ok()
                        .contentType(mediaType)
                        .header(
                                HttpHeaders.ACCEPT_RANGES,
                                "bytes"
                        )
                        .header(
                                HttpHeaders.CACHE_CONTROL,
                                "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0"
                        )
                        .header(
                                HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
                                ContentDisposition
                                        .inline()
                                        .filename(fileName)
                                        .build()
                                        .toString()
                        );

        /*
         * IMPORTANT:
         *
         * getSizeBytes() does NOT throw IOException.
         * Therefore there must NOT be:
         *
         * catch (IOException ...)
         *
         * here.
         */

        long contentLength =
                data.getSizeBytes();

        if (contentLength >= 0) {

            response.contentLength(
                    contentLength
            );
        }

        return response.body(
                data.getResource()
        );
    }

    // ============================================================
    // LONG VALUE
    // ============================================================

    private Long longValue(
            Object value) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        try {

            return Long.valueOf(
                    String.valueOf(value)
            );

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {

            return null;
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // INTEGER VALUE
    // ============================================================

    private Integer integerValue(
            Object value) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        try {

            return Integer.valueOf(
                    String.valueOf(value)
            );

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {

            return null;
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // STRING VALUE
    // ============================================================

    private String stringValue(
            Object value) {

        return value == null
                ? null
                : String.valueOf(value);
    }
}

    "http://localhost:5173",

}, allowCredentials = "true")
