===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\controller\ExotelCallController.java =====
// FILE: src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/controller/ExotelCallController.java
//
// Two endpoints:
//   1) POST /api/exotel/call             <- Frontend calls this when telecaller clicks "Call"
//   2) POST /api/exotel/webhook/status   <- Exotel calls this (public URL) as the call progresses
//
// NOTE: /api/exotel/webhook/status must be reachable by Exotel's servers - add it to your
// Spring Security "permitAll" list (same place "/bridge/**" was permitted before), since
// Exotel won't send your JWT.

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.messaging.simp.SimpMessagingTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.CallRequest;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.CallResponse;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Telecaller;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.TelecallerRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.CallService;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.ExotelService;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.TelecallerAccessService;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/exotel")
public class ExotelCallController {

    @Autowired private ExotelService exotelService;
    @Autowired private CallService callService;
    @Autowired private TelecallerRepository telecallerRepository;
    @Autowired private TelecallerAccessService accessService;
    @Autowired private SimpMessagingTemplate messagingTemplate;

    public static class ClickToCallRequest {
        public String leadId;
        public String leadName;
        public String leadMobile;
        public String agentUsername;
    }

    /**
     * Telecaller clicks "Call" on a lead -> frontend POSTs here instead of the old
     * STOMP "/app/bridge/call" message.
     */
    @PostMapping("/call")
    public Map<String, Object> makeCall(@RequestBody ClickToCallRequest req) {
        if (accessService.isTelecaller()) {
            accessService.requireLeadAccess(req.leadId);
        }

        Telecaller agent = telecallerRepository.findByUsername(req.agentUsername)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new RuntimeException("Telecaller not found: " + req.agentUsername));

        if (agent.getMobile() == null || agent.getMobile().isBlank()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Telecaller has no mobile number saved - add it in Telecaller profile first");
        }

        // 1. Create the Call record up-front in "ringing" state, same as the old flow did
        CallRequest callReq = new CallRequest();
        callReq.setLeadId(req.leadId);
        callReq.setLeadName(req.leadName);
        callReq.setLeadMobile(req.leadMobile);
        callReq.setCalledNumber(req.leadMobile);
        callReq.setCallerNumber(agent.getMobile());
        callReq.setCallMethod("exotel_click_to_call");
        callReq.setCallStatus("ringing");
        callReq.setAgentUsername(agent.getUsername());
        callReq.setAgentName(agent.getFullName());
        CallResponse savedCall = callService.createCall(callReq);

        // 2. Ask Exotel to ring the agent's phone, then bridge to the customer
        String exotelCallSid = exotelService.initiateClickToCall(agent.getMobile(), req.leadMobile, savedCall.getId());

        // 3. Tell the frontend (same topic it already listens to from the old bridge flow)
        Map<String, Object> status = new HashMap<>();
        status.put("callId", savedCall.getId());
        status.put("exotelCallSid", exotelCallSid);
        status.put("leadId", req.leadId);
        status.put("leadName", req.leadName);
        status.put("phoneNumber", req.leadMobile);
        status.put("status", "initiating");
        status.put("callMethod", "exotel_click_to_call");
        status.put("timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis());
        messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/call-status", status);

        Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
        result.put("callId", savedCall.getId());
        result.put("exotelCallSid", exotelCallSid);
        result.put("message", "Ringing your phone first, then will connect to customer");
        return result;
    }

    /**
     * Exotel posts here as the call progresses. Public endpoint - no JWT, Exotel can't send one.
     * Typical fields Exotel sends: CallSid, Status (e.g. completed/busy/failed/no-answer),
     * DialCallDuration, RecordingUrl, From, To.
     */
    @PostMapping("/webhook/status")
    public String handleStatusCallback(@RequestParam Map<String, String> payload,
                                        @RequestParam(required = false) String leadId) {
        String exotelStatus = payload.getOrDefault("Status", payload.get("DialCallStatus"));
        String durationStr = payload.getOrDefault("DialCallDuration", payload.get("Duration"));
        String callSid = payload.get("CallSid");
        String recordingUrl = payload.get("RecordingUrl");

        // Map Exotel's status vocabulary to whatever your Call.callStatus already uses
        String mappedStatus = mapStatus(exotelStatus);

        Map<String, Object> status = new HashMap<>();
        status.put("exotelCallSid", callSid);
        status.put("leadId", leadId);
        status.put("status", mappedStatus);
        status.put("duration", durationStr);
        status.put("recordingUrl", recordingUrl);
        status.put("callMethod", "exotel_click_to_call");
        status.put("timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis());

        // Push live update to whoever is watching this call in the CRM UI
        messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/call-status", status);

        // TODO: also persist final duration/outcome onto the saved Call record here via
        // callService.updateCall(...) once you decide how you want to look the Call back up
        // (e.g. store exotelCallSid on the Call model when you create it, then query by that).

        return "OK"; // Exotel expects a 200 response, body content doesn't matter
    }

    private String mapStatus(String exotelStatus) {
        if (exotelStatus == null) return "unknown";
        switch (exotelStatus.toLowerCase()) {
            case "completed": return "completed";
            case "busy": return "busy";
            case "no-answer":
            case "noanswer": return "no_answer";
            case "failed": return "failed";
            case "in-progress":
            case "in progress": return "in_progress";
            default: return exotelStatus;
        }
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.InvoiceAsset;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.InvoiceAssetService;

/**
 * Fixes the 404 on:
 *   POST /api/payments/admin/invoice-assets/logo | signature | thank-you
 *   GET  /api/payments/invoice-assets/data
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/payments")
public class InvoiceAssetController {

    private final InvoiceAssetService service;

    public InvoiceAssetController(InvoiceAssetService service) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    @PostMapping(value = "/admin/invoice-assets/{type}", consumes = MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA_VALUE)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('SUPER_ADMIN','ADMIN')")
    public ResponseEntity<?> upload(@PathVariable String type, @RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file) {
        try {
            InvoiceAsset a = service.save(type, file);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("id", a.getId(), "type", a.getType(),
                    "fileName", String.valueOf(a.getFileName())));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("message", String.valueOf(e.getMessage())));
        }
    }

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import java.util.ArrayList;

import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.DateUtil;
import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Row;
import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Sheet;
import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Workbook;

    // ============================================================
    // EXCEL IMPORT
    //
    // THIS IS THE IMPORTANT ENDPOINT
    // ============================================================

    @PostMapping(
            value = "/import-excel",
            consumes = {
                    "multipart/form-data"
            }
    )
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN')")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> importExcel(
            @RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file) {

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();

        try {

            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // Validate file
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            if (file == null || file.isEmpty()) {

                response.put(
                        "success",
                        false
                );

                response.put(
                        "message",
                        "Please upload an Excel file."
                );

                return ResponseEntity
                        .badRequest()
                        .body(response);
            }

            String originalFilename =
                    file.getOriginalFilename();

            if (originalFilename == null ||
                    originalFilename.trim().isEmpty()) {

                response.put(
                        "success",
                        false
                );

                response.put(
                        "message",
                        "Invalid file name."
                );

                return ResponseEntity
                        .badRequest()
                        .body(response);
            }

            String lowerName =
                    originalFilename.toLowerCase();

            if (!lowerName.endsWith(".xlsx") &&
                    !lowerName.endsWith(".xls")) {

                response.put(
                        "success",
                        false
                );

                response.put(
                        "message",
                        "Only .xlsx and .xls files are supported."
                );

                return ResponseEntity
                        .badRequest()
                        .body(response);
            }

            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // Parse complete Excel
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                    parseExcelFile(file);

            if (rows == null || rows.isEmpty()) {

                response.put(
                        "success",
                        false
                );

                response.put(
                        "message",
                        "No records found in the Excel file."
                );

                return ResponseEntity
                        .badRequest()
                        .body(response);
            }

            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // Import into MongoDB
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            Map<String, Object> result =
                    leadService.importExcel(rows);

            result.put(
                    "success",
                    true
            );

            result.put(
                    "fileName",
                    originalFilename
            );

            result.put(
                    "totalRows",
                    rows.size()
            );

            return ResponseEntity.ok(result);

        } catch (Exception e) {

            e.printStackTrace();

            response.put(
                    "success",
                    false
            );

            response.put(
                    "message",
                    "Excel import failed."
            );

            response.put(
                    "error",
                    e.getMessage()
            );

            return ResponseEntity
                    .status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST)
                    .body(response);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // COMPLETE EXCEL PARSER
    //
    // IMPORTANT:
    // We keep every Excel column.
    // We don't throw away unknown columns.
    // ============================================================

    private List<Map<String, Object>> parseExcelFile(
            MultipartFile file) throws Exception {

        List<Map<String, Object>> result =
                new ArrayList<>();

        try (
                InputStream inputStream =
                        file.getInputStream();

                Workbook workbook =
                        WorkbookFactory.create(inputStream)
        ) {

            if (workbook.getNumberOfSheets() == 0) {
                throw new RuntimeException(
                        "Excel workbook contains no sheets."
                );
            }

            Sheet sheet =
                    workbook.getSheetAt(0);

            if (sheet == null ||
                    sheet.getPhysicalNumberOfRows() == 0) {

                throw new RuntimeException(
                        "Excel sheet is empty."
                );
            }

            DataFormatter formatter =
                    new DataFormatter();

            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // Find header row.
            //
            // We use the first non-empty row as the header.
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            int headerRowIndex = -1;

            for (
                    int rowIndex = 0;
                    rowIndex <= sheet.getLastRowNum();
                    rowIndex++
            ) {

                Row row =
                        sheet.getRow(rowIndex);

                if (row == null) {
                    continue;
                }

                boolean hasValue = false;

                for (
                        int col = 0;
                        col < row.getLastCellNum();
                        col++
                ) {

                    Cell cell =
                            row.getCell(col);

                    String value =
                            getCellValue(
                                    cell,
                                    formatter
                            );

                    if (value != null &&
                            !value.trim().isEmpty()) {

                        hasValue = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (hasValue) {
                    headerRowIndex = rowIndex;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (headerRowIndex == -1) {

                throw new RuntimeException(
                        "Could not find Excel header row."
                );
            }

            Row headerRow =
                    sheet.getRow(headerRowIndex);

            int lastColumn =
                    headerRow.getLastCellNum();

            if (lastColumn <= 0) {

                throw new RuntimeException(
                        "Excel header row is empty."
                );
            }

            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // Read column names exactly
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            List<String> headers =
                    new ArrayList<>();

            for (
                    int col = 0;
                    col < lastColumn;
                    col++
            ) {

                Cell cell =
                        headerRow.getCell(col);

                String header =
                        getCellValue(
                                cell,
                                formatter
                        );

                if (header == null) {
                    header = "";
                }

                header = header.trim();

                // Empty Excel column names need a unique name
                if (header.isEmpty()) {

                    header =
                            "Column_" + (col + 1);
                }

                headers.add(header);
            }

            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // Read every Excel row
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            for (
                    int rowIndex = headerRowIndex + 1;
                    rowIndex <= sheet.getLastRowNum();
                    rowIndex++
            ) {

                Row excelRow =
                        sheet.getRow(rowIndex);

                if (excelRow == null) {
                    continue;
                }

                Map<String, Object> rowData =
                        new HashMap<>();

                boolean hasAnyValue = false;

                for (
                        int col = 0;
                        col < headers.size();
                        col++
                ) {

                    Cell cell =
                            excelRow.getCell(col);

                    String value =
                            getCellValue(
                                    cell,
                                    formatter
                            );

                    if (value == null) {
                        value = "";
                    }

                    if (!value.trim().isEmpty()) {
                        hasAnyValue = true;
                    }

                    /*
                     * IMPORTANT:
                     *
                     * We store the ORIGINAL header as the key.
                     * We do not rename the Excel column here.
                     */
                    rowData.put(
                            headers.get(col),
                            value
                    );
                }

                // Completely empty row -> ignore
                if (!hasAnyValue) {
                    continue;
                }

                // ------------------------------------------------
                // Add internal metadata
                //
                // This does NOT replace Excel data.
                // It is used only by the backend to identify
                // the source row.
                // ------------------------------------------------

                rowData.put(
                        "__excelRowNumber",
                        rowIndex + 1
                );

                result.add(rowData);
            }

            return result;
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // EXCEL CELL VALUE
    // ============================================================

    private String getCellValue(
            Cell cell,
            DataFormatter formatter) {

        if (cell == null) {
            return "";
        }

        try {

            if (cell.getCellType() ==
                    CellType.FORMULA) {

                return formatter.formatCellValue(cell);
            }

            if (cell.getCellType() ==
                    CellType.NUMERIC) {

                if (DateUtil.isCellDateFormatted(cell)) {

                    return formatter.formatCellValue(cell);
                }
            }

            return formatter.formatCellValue(cell);

        } catch (Exception e) {

            return "";
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // DELETE LEAD
    // ============================================================

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.LocalSimCallService;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;


@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/local-sim/calls")
public class LocalSimCallController {

    private final LocalSimCallService localSimCallService;

    public LocalSimCallController(LocalSimCallService localSimCallService) {
        this.localSimCallService = localSimCallService;
    }

    

    private static Authentication auth() {
        Authentication a = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
        return (a != null && a.isAuthenticated() && a.getName() != null
                && !"anonymousUser".equals(a.getName())) ? a : null;
    }

    private static boolean hasRole(Authentication a, String role) {
        return a != null && a.getAuthorities().stream().anyMatch(g -> role.equals(g.getAuthority()));
    }

    private static boolean isBridge(Authentication a) { return hasRole(a, "ROLE_BRIDGE"); }

    private static boolean isAdmin(Authentication a) {
        return hasRole(a, "ROLE_ADMIN") || hasRole(a, "ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN");
    }

    /** The CRM user (null for the companion / anonymous). */
    private static String crmUser(Authentication a) {
        return (a == null || isBridge(a)) ? null : a.getName();
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<?> createCommand(@RequestBody(required = false) Map<String, Object> request) {
        try {
            Authentication a = auth();
            String user = crmUser(a);
            boolean admin = isAdmin(a);

            if (request != null && user != null) {
                request = new HashMap<>(request);
                Object existing = request.get("agentUsername");
                boolean blank = existing == null || String.valueOf(existing).isBlank();
                // A telecaller can only ever place calls on THEIR OWN companion; the
                // username always comes from the login token, never from the browser.
                if (!admin || blank) request.put("agentUsername", user);
            }

            return ResponseEntity.accepted().body(localSimCallService.createCommand(request, user, admin));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("message", ex.getMessage()));
        } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
            // companion offline / phone not connected
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CONFLICT).body(Map.of("message", ex.getMessage()));
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                    .body(Map.of("message", "Could not create local SIM command."));
        }
    }

    /** GET /api/local-sim/calls/companion-status[?agentUsername=] */
    @GetMapping("/companion-status")
    public ResponseEntity<?> companionStatus(@RequestParam(required = false) String agentUsername) {
        Authentication a = auth();
        String user = crmUser(a);
        String target = (user != null && !isAdmin(a)) ? user
                : (agentUsername != null && !agentUsername.isBlank() ? agentUsername : user);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(localSimCallService.companionStatus(target));
    }

    /** GET /api/local-sim/calls/{requestId} */
    @GetMapping("/{requestId}")
    public ResponseEntity<?> getCommand(@PathVariable String requestId) {
        Map<String, Object> command = localSimCallService.getCommand(requestId);
        if (command.isEmpty() || !mayAccess(command)) {
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).body(Map.of("message", "Command not found."));
        }
        return ResponseEntity.ok(command);
    }

   
   @GetMapping("/bridge/next")
public ResponseEntity<?> claimNextPendingCommand(
        @RequestParam String deviceId,
        @RequestParam String agentUsername,
        @RequestParam(name = "btConnected", defaultValue = "true") String btConnectedRaw) {
    try {
        boolean btConnected = parseBool(btConnectedRaw, true);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                localSimCallService.claimNextPendingCommand(deviceId, agentUsername, btConnected));
    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
        return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("message", ex.getMessage()));
    }
}

private static boolean parseBool(String raw, boolean fallback) {
    if (raw == null || raw.isBlank()) return fallback;
    String v = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
    if ("true".equals(v) || "1".equals(v) || "yes".equals(v)) return true;
    if ("false".equals(v) || "0".equals(v) || "no".equals(v)) return false;
    return fallback;
}

 @PostMapping("/{requestId}/status")
    public ResponseEntity<?> updateStatus(
            @PathVariable String requestId,
            @RequestBody(required = false) Map<String, Object> request) {
        String status = request == null || request.get("status") == null
                ? null : String.valueOf(request.get("status"));
        String message = request == null || request.get("message") == null
                ? "" : String.valueOf(request.get("message"));
        Integer duration = null;
        if (request != null && request.get("duration") instanceof Number) {
            duration = ((Number) request.get("duration")).intValue();
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> existing = localSimCallService.getCommand(requestId);
            if (!existing.isEmpty() && !mayAccess(existing)) {
                return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).body(Map.of("message", "Command not found."));
            }

            Map<String, Object> updated = localSimCallService.updateStatus(requestId, status, message, duration);
            if (updated.isEmpty()) {
                return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).body(Map.of("message", "Command not found."));
            }
            return ResponseEntity.ok(updated);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("message", ex.getMessage()));
        }
    }

   
    private boolean mayAccess(Map<String, Object> command) {
        Authentication a = auth();
        if (a == null || isBridge(a) || isAdmin(a)) return true;
        return a.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(String.valueOf(command.get("agentUsername")));
    }
}

    @PostMapping("/{id}/send")

        String fileName = "Invoice_" + (p.getInvoiceId() != null ? p.getInvoiceId() : p.getId()) + ".xlsx";
        return ResponseEntity.ok()
                .contentType(MediaType.parseMediaType("application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"))
                .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
                        ContentDisposition.attachment().filename(fileName).build().toString())
                .body(new FileSystemResource(file));
    }

    private ResponseEntity<FileSystemResource> pdfResponse(File file, Payment p) {
        String fileName = "Invoice_" + (p.getInvoiceId() != null ? p.getInvoiceId() : p.getId()) + ".pdf";
        return ResponseEntity.ok()
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_PDF)
                .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
                        ContentDisposition.attachment().filename(fileName).build().toString())
                .body(new FileSystemResource(file));
    }

 *   GET    /api/quotation-branding
 *   POST   /api/quotation-branding/{logo|letterpad}   (multipart "file")

 *   PUT    /api/quotation-branding/settings           {showBrandText, phone, website, address}

@RequestMapping("/api/quotation-branding")

        catch (Exception e) { return bad(e); }

    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('SUPER_ADMIN','ADMIN')")
    public ResponseEntity<?> upload(@PathVariable String type, @RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file) {
        try { return ResponseEntity.ok(service.save(type, file)); }
        catch (Exception e) { return bad(e); }
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{type}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('SUPER_ADMIN','ADMIN')")
    public ResponseEntity<?> remove(@PathVariable String type) {
        try { return ResponseEntity.ok(service.delete(type)); }
        catch (Exception e) { return bad(e); }
    }

    @PutMapping("/settings")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('SUPER_ADMIN','ADMIN')")
    public ResponseEntity<?> settings(@RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        try { return ResponseEntity.ok(service.saveSettings(body)); }
        catch (Exception e) { return bad(e); }
    }

    private ResponseEntity<?> bad(Exception e) {
        return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("message", String.valueOf(e.getMessage())));
    }
}

            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("message", e.getMessage()));
        }
    }

    @PostMapping(consumes = MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA_VALUE)
    public ResponseEntity<?> upload(@RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file,
                                    @RequestParam(value = "name", required = false) String name) {

            return ResponseEntity.ok(service.upload(file, name, access.currentUsername()));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("message", e.getMessage()));
        }
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}/fields")
    public ResponseEntity<?> saveFields(@PathVariable String id, @RequestBody QuotationTemplateFieldsRequest req) {
        try { return ResponseEntity.ok(service.saveFields(id, req.getFields())); }
        catch (Exception e) { return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("message", e.getMessage())); }
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}/design")
    public ResponseEntity<?> saveDesign(@PathVariable String id, @RequestBody QuotationTemplateDesignRequest req) {
        try {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(service.saveDesign(id, req.getName(), req.getDesign(), req.getFields()));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("message", e.getMessage()));
        }
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}/preview")
    public ResponseEntity<FileSystemResource> preview(@PathVariable String id) throws Exception {
        File file = service.previewFile(id);
        if (!file.exists()) return ResponseEntity.notFound().build();

                .header(HttpHeaders.CACHE_CONTROL, "no-cache")
                .body(new FileSystemResource(file));

    public ResponseEntity<?> delete(@PathVariable String id) {
        service.delete(id, access.currentUsername());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("success", true));
    }

    @PostMapping("/import-leads")
    public ResponseEntity<UploadHistory> importLeads(
            @RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file,
            @RequestParam("uploadedBy") String uploadedBy,
            @RequestParam(value = "district", required = false) String district) {

        System.out.println("📁 Received import request: " + file.getOriginalFilename() + " by " + uploadedBy);
        
        try {
            // Validate file
            if (file.isEmpty()) {
                throw new RuntimeException("File is empty");
            }
            
            String fileName = file.getOriginalFilename();
            if (fileName == null) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Invalid file name");
            }
            
            String lowerName = fileName.toLowerCase();
            if (!lowerName.endsWith(".xlsx") && !lowerName.endsWith(".xls")) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Please upload .xlsx or .xls file only. Received: " + fileName);
            }
            
            List<Map<String, Object>> leadData = parseExcelFile(file);
            
            if (leadData.isEmpty()) {
                throw new RuntimeException("No data found in file. Please check the file format.");
            }
            
            Map<String, Object> importData = new HashMap<>();
            importData.put("leads", leadData);
            importData.put("district", district);
            
            Authentication authentication = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
            String actualUploadedBy = uploadedBy;
            if (authentication != null && authentication.isAuthenticated()
                    && authentication.getName() != null
                    && !"anonymousUser".equalsIgnoreCase(authentication.getName())) {
                actualUploadedBy = authentication.getName();
            }

            UploadHistory history = superAdminService.importLeadsFromExcel(
                    importData,
                    file.getOriginalFilename(),
                    actualUploadedBy
            );
            return ResponseEntity.ok(history);
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("❌ Import failed: " + e.getMessage());
            e.printStackTrace();
            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to process file: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    // ==================== HELPER METHODS ====================

    private List<Map<String, Object>> parseExcelFile(MultipartFile file) throws Exception {
        List<Map<String, Object>> data = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> headers = new ArrayList<>();

        try (InputStream is = file.getInputStream(); Workbook workbook = WorkbookFactory.create(is)) {
            Sheet sheet = workbook.getSheetAt(0);
            if (sheet.getPhysicalNumberOfRows() == 0) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Excel file is empty");
            }

            // Parse headers from first row
            Row headerRow = sheet.getRow(0);
            if (headerRow == null) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Header row not found in Excel file");
            }

            for (Cell cell : headerRow) {
                String headerValue = getCellStringValue(cell);
                if (headerValue != null && !headerValue.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    headers.add(headerValue.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", ""));
                }
            }

            System.out.println("📋 Found headers: " + headers);

            // Check for required columns
            boolean hasSchool = headers.stream().anyMatch(h -> h.contains("school"));
            boolean hasMobile = headers.stream().anyMatch(h -> h.contains("mobile"));

            if (!hasSchool || !hasMobile) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Missing required columns: 'School' and/or 'Mobile'. Found headers: " + headers);
            }

            // Find column indices
            int schoolCol = findColumnIndex(headers, "school");
            int mobileCol = findColumnIndex(headers, "mobile");

            // Parse data rows
            for (int r = 1; r <= sheet.getLastRowNum(); r++) {
                Row row = sheet.getRow(r);
                if (row == null) continue;

                Map<String, Object> rowMap = new HashMap<>();
                boolean hasData = false;

                for (int c = 0; c < headers.size(); c++) {
                    Cell cell = row.getCell(c);
                    String value = cell != null ? getCellStringValue(cell) : "";
                    if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) hasData = true;
                    rowMap.put(headers.get(c), value);
                }

                if (hasData) {
                    // Ensure school and mobile are present
                    String school = schoolCol >= 0 ? (String) rowMap.get(headers.get(schoolCol)) : "";
                    String mobile = mobileCol >= 0 ? (String) rowMap.get(headers.get(mobileCol)) : "";
                    
                    if (school == null || school.trim().isEmpty()) {
                        rowMap.put("school", "Unknown School");
                    }
                    if (mobile == null || mobile.trim().isEmpty()) {
                        rowMap.put("mobile", "");
                    }
                    
                    data.add(rowMap);
                }
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("❌ Excel parsing error: " + e.getMessage());
            e.printStackTrace();
            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to parse Excel file: " + e.getMessage());
        }

        System.out.println("✅ Parsed " + data.size() + " rows from Excel file");
        return data;
    }

    private int findColumnIndex(List<String> headers, String keyword) {
        for (int i = 0; i < headers.size(); i++) {
            if (headers.get(i).contains(keyword)) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private static final DateTimeFormatter EXCEL_DATE_CELL_FORMAT = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd-MM-yyyy");

    private String getCellStringValue(Cell cell) {
        if (cell == null) return "";
        try {
            switch (cell.getCellType()) {
                case STRING:
                    return cell.getStringCellValue().trim();
                case NUMERIC:
                    if (DateUtil.isCellDateFormatted(cell)) {
                        LocalDate localDate = cell.getDateCellValue()
                                .toInstant()
                                .atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault())
                                .toLocalDate();
                        return localDate.format(EXCEL_DATE_CELL_FORMAT);
                    }
                    double num = cell.getNumericCellValue();
                    if (num == Math.floor(num) && !Double.isInfinite(num)) {
                        return String.valueOf((long) num);
                    }
                    return String.valueOf(num);
                case BOOLEAN:
                    return String.valueOf(cell.getBooleanCellValue());
                case FORMULA:
                    try {
                        return cell.getStringCellValue().trim();
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        return String.valueOf(cell.getNumericCellValue());
                    }
                case BLANK:
                    return "";
                default:
                    return "";
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Telecaller;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.TelecallerService;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/telecallers")
public class TelecallerController {

    @Autowired
    private TelecallerService telecallerService;

    // NEW: self-service profile lookup for the currently logged-in telecaller.
    // Unlike the other endpoints here (which are for admins managing telecallers),
    // this one is meant to be called BY the telecaller's own app so it can refresh
    // its assigned districts (e.g. after a Super Admin reassigns a district)
    // without forcing the telecaller to log out and back in.
    @GetMapping("/me")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TELECALLER')")
    public ResponseEntity<Telecaller> getMyProfile() {
        Authentication auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
        if (auth == null || auth.getName() == null) {
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED).build();
        }
        return telecallerService.getTelecallerByUsername(auth.getName())
                .map(tc -> {
                    // never leak the password hash to the client
                    tc.setPassword(null);
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(tc);
                })
                .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
    }

    @GetMapping
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN')")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Telecaller>> getAllTelecallers() {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(telecallerService.getAllTelecallers());
    }

    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN')")
    public ResponseEntity<Telecaller> getTelecaller(@PathVariable String id) {
        return telecallerService.getTelecallerById(id)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
    }

    @GetMapping("/username/{username}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN')")
    public ResponseEntity<Telecaller> getTelecallerByUsername(@PathVariable String username) {
        return telecallerService.getTelecallerByUsername(username)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
    }

    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN')")

        return telecallerService.findByAssignedPhoneNumber(phoneNumber)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .orElse(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
    }

    @GetMapping("/employee/{employeeId}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN')")
    public ResponseEntity<Telecaller> getTelecallerByEmployeeId(@PathVariable String employeeId) {

                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)

    }

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\controller\TelecallerLeadController.java =====
package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageImpl;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.MongoTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query.Criteria;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query.Query;
import org.springframework.data.web.PageableDefault;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.LeadResponse;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Lead;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Telecaller;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.LeadRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.TelecallerAccessService;

/**
 * PERFORMANCE FIX
 * ---------------
 * Old version called leadRepository.findAll() on EVERY request, loaded the whole
 * leads collection (including the heavy excelData + activityHistory fields),
 * filtered in Java and only then paged. That is what made the Call Panel slow
 * (and sometimes never finish through ngrok).
 *
 * New version:
 *   1. filters by the telecaller's districts INSIDE MongoDB (uses the district index)
 *   2. pages inside MongoDB (skip/limit)
 *   3. does NOT load excelData / activityHistory / callHistory for list calls
 *      (activity history is fetched per lead via /api/leads/{id}/history)
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/telecaller")
@PreAuthorize("hasRole('TELECALLER')")
public class TelecallerLeadController {

    private final TelecallerAccessService accessService;
    private final LeadRepository leadRepository;
    private final MongoTemplate mongoTemplate;

    public TelecallerLeadController(TelecallerAccessService accessService,
                                    LeadRepository leadRepository,
                                    MongoTemplate mongoTemplate) {
        this.accessService = accessService;
        this.leadRepository = leadRepository;
        this.mongoTemplate = mongoTemplate;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ profile
    @GetMapping("/profile")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> profile() {
        Telecaller tc = accessService.currentTelecaller();
        Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
        result.put("id", tc.getId());
        result.put("employeeId", tc.getEmployeeId());
        result.put("username", tc.getUsername());
        result.put("fullName", tc.getFullName());
        result.put("role", tc.getRole());
        result.put("districts", accessService.assignedDistricts());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- districts
    @GetMapping("/leads/districts")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> districts() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String district : accessService.assignedDistricts()) {
            Map<String, Object> item = new HashMap<>();
            item.put("name", district);
            item.put("district", district);
            // case-insensitive count so it matches what the lead list returns
            item.put("leadCount", mongoTemplate.count(
                    new Query(Criteria.where("district").regex(exactIgnoreCase(district))), Lead.class));
            result.add(item);
        }
        return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
    }

    @GetMapping("/leads/district/{district}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<LeadResponse>> districtLeads(@PathVariable String district) {
        accessService.requireDistrictAccess(district);
        Query q = new Query(Criteria.where("district").regex(exactIgnoreCase(district)));
        q.with(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.DESC, "createdAt"));
        applyLightProjection(q);
        List<LeadResponse> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Lead l : mongoTemplate.find(q, Lead.class)) result.add(toResponse(l));
        return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------- single lead
    @GetMapping("/leads/{leadId}")
    public ResponseEntity<LeadResponse> lead(@PathVariable String leadId) {
        // single lead -> full document (with history) is fine
        return ResponseEntity.ok(toResponse(accessService.requireLeadAccess(leadId)));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- main call-panel list
    @GetMapping("/leads")
    public ResponseEntity<Page<LeadResponse>> leads(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String category,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status,
            @PageableDefault(size = 20, sort = "createdAt", direction = Sort.Direction.DESC) Pageable pageable) {

        List<String> districts = accessService.assignedDistricts();
        if (districts.isEmpty()) return ResponseEntity.ok(Page.empty(pageable));

        // 1) district filter (case-insensitive, still index friendly because it is anchored)
        List<Object> districtMatchers = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String d : districts) districtMatchers.add(exactIgnoreCase(d));

        List<Criteria> and = new ArrayList<>();
        and.add(Criteria.where("district").in(districtMatchers));

        // 2) optional filters
        if (notBlank(search)) {
            Pattern p = Pattern.compile(Pattern.quote(search.trim()), Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);
            and.add(new Criteria().orOperator(
                    Criteria.where("leadId").regex(p),
                    Criteria.where("name").regex(p),
                    Criteria.where("mobile").regex(p),
                    Criteria.where("phoneNumber").regex(p),
                    Criteria.where("school").regex(p),
                    Criteria.where("email").regex(p),
                    Criteria.where("district").regex(p)));
        }
        if (notBlank(category) && !"All Categories".equalsIgnoreCase(category)) {
            and.add(Criteria.where("category").regex(exactIgnoreCase(category.trim())));
        }
        if (notBlank(status) && !"All Status".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
            and.add(Criteria.where("status").regex(exactIgnoreCase(status.trim())));
        }

        Query countQuery = new Query(new Criteria().andOperator(and.toArray(new Criteria[0])));
        long total = mongoTemplate.count(countQuery, Lead.class);

        Query dataQuery = new Query(new Criteria().andOperator(and.toArray(new Criteria[0])));
        // never trust an arbitrary sort from the client; default = newest first
        dataQuery.with(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.DESC, "createdAt").and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.DESC, "_id")));
        dataQuery.skip(pageable.getOffset());
        dataQuery.limit(pageable.getPageSize());
        applyLightProjection(dataQuery);

        List<LeadResponse> content = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Lead l : mongoTemplate.find(dataQuery, Lead.class)) content.add(toResponse(l));

        return ResponseEntity.ok(new PageImpl<>(content, pageable, total));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
    /** Leave out the heavy fields. They are only needed on the single-lead screens. */
    private void applyLightProjection(Query q) {
        q.fields().exclude("excelData").exclude("activityHistory").exclude("callHistory");
    }

    private Pattern exactIgnoreCase(String value) {
        return Pattern.compile("^" + Pattern.quote(value.trim()) + "$", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);
    }

    private boolean notBlank(String s) { return s != null && !s.isBlank(); }

    private LeadResponse toResponse(Lead l) {
        LeadResponse r = new LeadResponse();
        r.setId(l.getId()); r.setLeadId(l.getLeadId()); r.setName(l.getName()); r.setMobile(l.getMobile());
        r.setPhoneNumber(l.getPhoneNumber()); r.setEmail(l.getEmail()); r.setCategory(l.getCategory()); r.setCampaign(l.getCampaign());
        r.setStatus(l.getStatus()); r.setAssignedTo(l.getAssignedTo()); r.setSource(l.getSource()); r.setLastContact(l.getLastContact());
        r.setNotes(l.getNotes()); r.setDistrict(l.getDistrict()); r.setArea(l.getArea()); r.setUploadBatch(l.getUploadBatch());
        r.setAssignedDate(l.getAssignedDate()); r.setSlNo(l.getSlNo()); r.setSchool(l.getSchool()); r.setSchoolAddress(l.getSchoolAddress());
        r.setSchoolCurrentLocation(l.getSchoolCurrentLocation()); r.setNoNumber(l.getNoNumber()); r.setNotExistNumber(l.getNotExistNumber());
        r.setNotAnswering(l.getNotAnswering()); r.setTotalNumberOfAnswering(l.getTotalNumberOfAnswering()); r.setAfternoonCallFollowup(l.getAfternoonCallFollowup());
        r.setConveyForHeadOffice(l.getConveyForHeadOffice()); r.setAlreadySoftwareUsers(l.getAlreadySoftwareUsers()); r.setShareProfile(l.getShareProfile());
        r.setTcNextRefollowupDate(l.getTcNextRefollowupDate()); r.setMeNextVisitDate(l.getMeNextVisitDate()); r.setFiftyPercentSubscription(l.getFiftyPercentSubscription());
        r.setNewSchoolFound(l.getNewSchoolFound()); r.setDemoScheduling(l.getDemoScheduling()); r.setAcceptedSubscription(l.getAcceptedSubscription());
        r.setRejected(l.getRejected()); r.setSchoolClosed(l.getSchoolClosed()); r.setNumberOfNoNeed(l.getNumberOfNoNeed());
        r.setCmoVisitWithMarketingExecutive(l.getCmoVisitWithMarketingExecutive()); r.setNextAcademyYearFollowup(l.getNextAcademyYearFollowup());
        r.setIcInstalled(l.getIcInstalled()); r.setAppointmentSecured(l.getAppointmentSecured()); r.setDirectVisit(l.getDirectVisit());
        r.setUp1(l.getUp1()); r.setUp2(l.getUp2()); r.setUp3(l.getUp3()); r.setUp4(l.getUp4()); r.setUp5(l.getUp5());
        r.setCreatedAt(l.getCreatedAt()); r.setUpdatedAt(l.getUpdatedAt()); r.setUpdates(l.getUpdates());
        r.setExcelData(l.getExcelData());
        r.setActivityHistory(l.getActivityHistory());
        return r;

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\controller\TelecallerPaymentController.java =====
package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.core.io.FileSystemResource;
import org.springframework.core.io.Resource;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.PaymentRequest;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Payment;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.PaymentService;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/telecaller/payments")
@PreAuthorize("hasRole('TELECALLER')")
public class TelecallerPaymentController {

    private final PaymentService paymentService;

    public TelecallerPaymentController(PaymentService paymentService) {
        this.paymentService = paymentService;
    }

    /**
     * Get all payment records created by the currently logged-in telecaller.
     */
    @GetMapping
    public List<Payment> all() {
        return paymentService.listForCurrentTelecaller();
    }

    /**
     * Create a new payment record.
     */
    @PostMapping
    public Payment create(@RequestBody PaymentRequest request) {
        return paymentService.create(request);
    }

    /**
     * Update a payment record.
     */
    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public Payment update(
            @PathVariable String id,
            @RequestBody PaymentRequest request) {

        return paymentService.update(id, request);
    }

    /**
     * Get one payment record.
     */
    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public Payment get(@PathVariable String id) {
        return paymentService.get(id);
    }

    /**
     * Download/view the generated invoice PDF.
     */
    @GetMapping("/{id}/invoice/pdf")
    public ResponseEntity<Resource> invoicePdf(@PathVariable String id) {

        File file = paymentService.invoicePdfFileForTelecaller(id);
        Resource resource = new FileSystemResource(file);

        if (!resource.exists()) {
            return ResponseEntity.notFound().build();
        }

        return ResponseEntity.ok()
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_PDF)
                .header(
                        HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
                        "inline; filename=\"" + file.getName() + "\""
                )
                .body(resource);
    }

    /**
     * Send payment details to the client.
     */
    @PostMapping("/{id}/send-payment-details")
    public Payment sendPaymentDetails(
            @PathVariable String id,
            @RequestParam String channel) {

        return paymentService.recordPaymentDetailsSent(id, channel);
    }

    /**
     * Send the Super Admin generated invoice to the client.
     */
    @PostMapping("/{id}/send-invoice")
    public Payment sendInvoice(
            @PathVariable String id,
            @RequestParam String channel) {

        return paymentService.sendInvoiceToClient(id, channel);
    }
}


===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\controller\WebSocketController.java =====
// FILE: src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/controller/WebSocketController.java

package com.indocrm.indocrm.controller;

import org.springframework.messaging.handler.annotation.MessageMapping;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.service.TelecallerAccessService;
import org.springframework.messaging.handler.annotation.Payload;
import org.springframework.messaging.simp.SimpMessagingTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Controller;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

@Controller
public class WebSocketController {

    private final SimpMessagingTemplate messagingTemplate;
    private final Map<String, String> activeDevices = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    @Autowired
    private TelecallerAccessService accessService;

    public WebSocketController(SimpMessagingTemplate messagingTemplate) {
        this.messagingTemplate = messagingTemplate;
    }

    @MessageMapping("/register-device")
    public void registerDevice(@Payload Map<String, String> payload) {
        String deviceId = payload.get("deviceId");
        String username = payload.get("username");
        activeDevices.put(deviceId, username);
        messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/devices", 
            Map.of("type", "device_registered", "deviceId", deviceId, "username", username));
    }

    @MessageMapping("/make-call")
    public void makeCall(@Payload Map<String, Object> payload) {
        String deviceId = (String) payload.get("deviceId");
        String number = (String) payload.get("number");
        String leadId = (String) payload.get("leadId");
        String registeredUsername = activeDevices.get(deviceId);
        if (registeredUsername == null) throw new AccessDeniedException("Device is not registered");
        accessService.requireLeadAccessForUsername(registeredUsername, leadId);
        
        messagingTemplate.convertAndSendToUser(deviceId, "/queue/calls", 
            Map.of("type", "incoming_call", "number", number, "leadId", leadId));
        
        messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/call-status", 
            Map.of("type", "call_initiated", "leadId", leadId, "status", "ringing"));
    }

    @MessageMapping("/call-status")
    public void callStatus(@Payload Map<String, Object> payload) {
        String leadId = (String) payload.get("leadId");
        String status = (String) payload.get("status");
        
        messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/call-status", 
            Map.of("type", "call_status_update", "leadId", leadId, "status", status));
    }

    @MessageMapping("/end-call")
    public void endCall(@Payload Map<String, Object> payload) {
        String deviceId = (String) payload.get("deviceId");
        String leadId = (String) payload.get("leadId");
        String registeredUsername = activeDevices.get(deviceId);
        if (registeredUsername == null) throw new AccessDeniedException("Device is not registered");
        accessService.requireLeadAccessForUsername(registeredUsername, leadId);
        
        messagingTemplate.convertAndSendToUser(deviceId, "/queue/calls", 
            Map.of("type", "end_call", "leadId", leadId));
        
        messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/call-status", 
            Map.of("type", "call_ended", "leadId", leadId, "status", "ended"));
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.dto;

import java.util.List;

public class PageResponse<T> {
    private List<T> content;
    private int page;
    private int size;
    private long totalElements;
    private int totalPages;
    private boolean last;

    public PageResponse() {}

    public PageResponse(List<T> content, int page, int size, long totalElements, int totalPages, boolean last) {
        this.content = content;
        this.page = page;
        this.size = size;
        this.totalElements = totalElements;
        this.totalPages = totalPages;
        this.last = last;
    }

    public List<T> getContent() { return content; }
    public void setContent(List<T> content) { this.content = content; }
    public int getPage() { return page; }
    public void setPage(int page) { this.page = page; }

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\exception\GlobalExceptionHandler.java =====
// FILE: src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.java
// REPLACES existing with better error handling

package com.indocrm.indocrm.exception;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.BadCredentialsException;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UsernameNotFoundException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MaxUploadSizeExceededException;

@RestControllerAdvice
public class GlobalExceptionHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(UsernameNotFoundException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> handleUserNotFound(UsernameNotFoundException ex) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED)
                .body(Map.of("error", "Invalid username or password"));
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(BadCredentialsException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> handleBadCredentials(BadCredentialsException ex) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED)
                .body(Map.of("error", "Invalid username or password"));
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(AccessDeniedException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> handleAccessDenied(AccessDeniedException ex) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN)
                .body(Map.of("error", "You don't have permission to perform this action"));
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(MaxUploadSizeExceededException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> handleMaxUploadSizeExceeded(MaxUploadSizeExceededException ex) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE)
                .body(Map.of("error", "File size exceeds the maximum allowed limit"));
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(RuntimeException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> handleRuntimeException(RuntimeException ex) {
        String msg = ex.getMessage() != null ? ex.getMessage() : "Something went wrong";
        HttpStatus status;
        
        if (msg.toLowerCase().contains("not found")) {
            status = HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND;
        } else if (msg.toLowerCase().contains("permission") || msg.toLowerCase().contains("access")) {
            status = HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN;
        } else if (msg.toLowerCase().contains("already exists") || msg.toLowerCase().contains("duplicate")) {
            status = HttpStatus.CONFLICT;
        } else {
            status = HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST;
        }
        
        Map<String, String> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("error", msg);
        response.put("status", String.valueOf(status.value()));
        
        return ResponseEntity.status(status).body(response);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> handleGenericException(Exception ex) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                .body(Map.of("error", "An unexpected error occurred: " + ex.getMessage()));
    }
}

// FILE: src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/model/AgreementCategory.java
// NEW FILE — the 5 agreement categories shown in Super Admin → Agreement Templates.
package com.indocrm.indocrm.model;

import java.util.List;

public enum AgreementCategory {

    ADMIN_DASHBOARD("Admin Dashboard", "DIGITAL_MARKETING",
            "Admission management dashboard agreement (per-admission fee model)",
            "agreement-templates/ADMIN_DASHBOARD.html", FieldSet.SERVICE),

    DIGITAL_MARKETING("Digital Marketing", "DIGITAL_MARKETING",
            "Digital marketing services + admission dashboard agreement",
            "agreement-templates/DIGITAL_MARKETING.html", FieldSet.SERVICE),

    ERP_PRO("ERP – Pro", "ERP",
            "School ERP / web dashboard agreement — Pro plan",
            "agreement-templates/ERP_PRO.html", FieldSet.ERP),

    ERP_PRO_PLUS("ERP – Pro Plus", "ERP",
            "School ERP / web dashboard agreement — Pro Plus plan",
            "agreement-templates/ERP_PRO_PLUS.html", FieldSet.ERP),

    ERP_PRO_MAX("ERP – Pro Max", "ERP",
            "School ERP / web dashboard agreement — Pro Max plan",
            "agreement-templates/ERP_PRO_MAX.html", FieldSet.ERP);

    /** Merge fields AgreementService can fill for each agreement type. */
    public enum FieldSet {
        SERVICE(List.of("agreement_date", "signature_date", "client_name", "client_address", "pincode",
                "authorized_person_name", "authorized_person_designation",
                "plan_name", "yearly_fee", "discount_amount", "net_payable", "gst_percent")),
        ERP(List.of("agreement_date", "signature_date", "client_name", "client_address", "pincode",
                "authorized_person_name", "authorized_person_designation",
                "plan_name", "student_strength", "subscription_fee", "gst_percent", "gst_amount", "total_payable"));

        public final List<String> fields;
        FieldSet(List<String> f) { fields = f; }
    }

    public final String label;
    public final String agreementType;   // "ERP" or "DIGITAL_MARKETING" (drives plans/pricing in AgreementService)
    public final String description;
    public final String resource;        // classpath default content
    public final FieldSet fieldSet;

    AgreementCategory(String label, String agreementType, String description, String resource, FieldSet fieldSet) {
        this.label = label;
        this.agreementType = agreementType;
        this.description = description;
        this.resource = resource;
        this.fieldSet = fieldSet;
    }

    public static AgreementCategory of(String key) {
        if (key == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Category is required");
        try {
            return valueOf(key.trim().toUpperCase());
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown agreement category: " + key);
        }
    }
}

// NEW FILE
package com.indocrm.indocrm.model;

import java.time.Instant;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.Id;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.index.Indexed;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.mapping.Document;

/**
 * A selectable plan/price-point for an agreement.
 *
 * agreementType is either "ERP" or "DIGITAL_MARKETING". The Add Agreement
 * form loads plans filtered by the agreement type the user picked, and the
 * selected plan's price is what gets merged into the PDF — pricing is never
 * hard-coded in PDF generation code.
 *
 * For ERP plans, minStudentStrength/maxStudentStrength let the UI suggest a
 * tier automatically once the telecaller enters the school's student count
 * (nullable = "no bound" e.g. maxStudentStrength null = unlimited).
 *
 * For Digital Marketing plans, discountAmount is optional (0 = no discount).
 */
@Document(collection = "agreement_plans")
public class AgreementPlan {

    @Id
    private String id;

    @Indexed
    private String agreementType; // "ERP" | "DIGITAL_MARKETING"

    private String planName;
    private String description;

    private double feeAmount;         // yearly professional fee (DM) / subscription fee (ERP)
    private double discountAmount;    // DM only; 0 if not applicable
    private double gstPercent = 18.0; // applies to both

    private Integer minStudentStrength; // ERP only, inclusive, null = no lower bound
    private Integer maxStudentStrength; // ERP only, inclusive, null = no upper bound

    private int displayOrder;
    private boolean active = true;
    private boolean systemPlan; // seeded default, shown as reference — still editable by admin

    private Instant createdAt;
    private Instant updatedAt;

    public String getId() { return id; }
    public void setId(String v) { id = v; }
    public String getAgreementType() { return agreementType; }
    public void setAgreementType(String v) { agreementType = v; }
    public String getPlanName() { return planName; }
    public void setPlanName(String v) { planName = v; }
    public String getDescription() { return description; }
    public void setDescription(String v) { description = v; }
    public double getFeeAmount() { return feeAmount; }
    public void setFeeAmount(double v) { feeAmount = v; }
    public double getDiscountAmount() { return discountAmount; }
    public void setDiscountAmount(double v) { discountAmount = v; }
    public double getGstPercent() { return gstPercent; }
    public void setGstPercent(double v) { gstPercent = v; }
    public Integer getMinStudentStrength() { return minStudentStrength; }
    public void setMinStudentStrength(Integer v) { minStudentStrength = v; }
    public Integer getMaxStudentStrength() { return maxStudentStrength; }
    public void setMaxStudentStrength(Integer v) { maxStudentStrength = v; }
    public int getDisplayOrder() { return displayOrder; }
    public void setDisplayOrder(int v) { displayOrder = v; }
    public boolean isActive() { return active; }
    public void setActive(boolean v) { active = v; }
    public boolean isSystemPlan() { return systemPlan; }
    public void setSystemPlan(boolean v) { systemPlan = v; }
    public Instant getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
    public void setCreatedAt(Instant v) { createdAt = v; }
    public Instant getUpdatedAt() { return updatedAt; }
    public void setUpdatedAt(Instant v) { updatedAt = v; }

// BACKEND: src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/model/CallAttempt.java

package com.indocrm.indocrm.model;

public class CallAttempt {
    private String number;
    private String status;
    private String time;
    private Integer duration;
    
    public CallAttempt() {}
    
    public CallAttempt(String number, String status, String time) {
        this.number = number;
        this.status = status;

package com.indocrm.indocrm.model;

public class CallHistory {
    private int totalCalls;
    private int connected;
    private int missed;
    private int busy;
    private int switchedOff;
    private int wrongNumber;

    public CallHistory() {
        this.totalCalls = 0;
        this.connected = 0;
        this.missed = 0;
        this.busy = 0;
        this.switchedOff = 0;
        this.wrongNumber = 0;
    }

    public CallHistory(int totalCalls, int connected, int missed, int busy, int switchedOff, int wrongNumber) {
        this.totalCalls = totalCalls;
        this.connected = connected;
        this.missed = missed;
        this.busy = busy;
        this.switchedOff = switchedOff;
        this.wrongNumber = wrongNumber;
    }

    // Getters and Setters
    public int getTotalCalls() { return totalCalls; }
    public void setTotalCalls(int totalCalls) { this.totalCalls = totalCalls; }
    
    public int getConnected() { return connected; }
    public void setConnected(int connected) { this.connected = connected; }
    
    public int getMissed() { return missed; }
    public void setMissed(int missed) { this.missed = missed; }
    
    public int getBusy() { return busy; }
    public void setBusy(int busy) { this.busy = busy; }
    
    public int getSwitchedOff() { return switchedOff; }
    public void setSwitchedOff(int switchedOff) { this.switchedOff = switchedOff; }
    
    public int getWrongNumber() { return wrongNumber; }
    public void setWrongNumber(int wrongNumber) { this.wrongNumber = wrongNumber; }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "CallHistory{" +
                "totalCalls=" + totalCalls +
                ", connected=" + connected +
                ", missed=" + missed +
                ", busy=" + busy +
                ", switchedOff=" + switchedOff +
                ", wrongNumber=" + wrongNumber +
                '}';
    }
}
