package com.indocrm.indocrm.model;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.data.annotation.CreatedDate;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.Id;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.LastModifiedDate;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.mapping.Document;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.mapping.Field;

@Document(collection = "payments")
public class Payment {

    // ============================================================
    // MAIN WORKFLOW STATUS
    // ============================================================

    public static final String STATUS_RECORDED = "Recorded";
    public static final String STATUS_VERIFIED = "Verified";
    public static final String STATUS_INVOICE_GENERATED = "Invoice Generated";
    public static final String STATUS_INVOICE_SENT_TO_TELECALLER =
            "Invoice Sent to Telecaller";
    public static final String STATUS_COMPLETED = "Completed";
    public static final String STATUS_FULLY_PAID = "Fully Paid";

    // ============================================================
    // PAYMENT TYPES
    // ============================================================

    public static final String TYPE_FULL = "Full";
    public static final String TYPE_PARTIAL = "Partial";
    public static final String TYPE_ADVANCE = "Advance";

    // ============================================================
    // PAYMENT IDENTITY
    // ============================================================

    @Id
    private String id;

    private String leadId;

    // ============================================================
    // CLIENT DETAILS
    // ============================================================

    private String organizationName;
    private String address;
    private String phone;
    private String email;

    // ============================================================
    // PAYMENT DETAILS
    // ============================================================

    private String paymentType = TYPE_FULL;

    /**
     * Total amount agreed for this client.
     */
    private Double totalAmount = 0.0;

    /**
     * Sum of all payment history records.
     */
    private Double amountPaid = 0.0;

    /**
     * totalAmount - amountPaid
     */
    private Double balanceAmount = 0.0;

    private String paymentDate;
    private String notes;

    // ============================================================
    // PAYMENT HISTORY
    // ============================================================

    private List<PaymentRecord> paymentHistory = new ArrayList<>();

    // ============================================================
    // MAIN PAYMENT STATUS
    // ============================================================

    /**
     * Recorded / Verified / Invoice Generated /
     * Invoice Sent to Telecaller / Completed / Fully Paid
     */
    private String status = STATUS_RECORDED;

    /**
     * Pending / Verified
     */
    private String verificationStatus = "Pending";

    /**
     * Not Generated / Draft / Finalized /
     * Sent to Telecaller / Sent to Client
     */
    private String invoiceStatus = "Not Generated";

    // ============================================================
    // OWNERSHIP
    // ============================================================

    private String createdBy;

    private String telecallerName;

    // ============================================================
    // PAYMENT VERIFICATION
    // ============================================================

    private String verifiedBy;

    private Instant verifiedAt;

    // ============================================================
    // PAYMENT REQUEST SEND DETAILS
    // ============================================================

    private String lastSentChannel;

    private Instant lastSentAt;

    // ============================================================
    // INVOICE
    // ============================================================

    private String invoiceId;

    // ============================================================
    // TIMELINE
    // ============================================================

    private List<TimelineEntry> timeline = new ArrayList<>();

    // ============================================================
    // AUDIT FIELDS
    // ============================================================

    @CreatedDate
    @Field("createdAt")
    private Instant createdAt;

    @LastModifiedDate
    @Field("updatedAt")
    private Instant updatedAt;

    // ============================================================
    // PAYMENT RECORD
    // ============================================================

    public static class PaymentRecord {

        private String id;

        private Double amount = 0.0;

        private String paymentType;

        private String paymentDate;

        private String paymentMethod;

        private String transactionReferenceNumber;

        private String notes;

        private String status = "Paid";

        private String recordedBy;

        private Instant recordedAt;

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // ID
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        public String getId() {
            return id;
        }

        public void setId(String id) {
            this.id = id;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // AMOUNT
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        public Double getAmount() {
            return amount;
        }

        public void setAmount(Double amount) {
            this.amount = amount;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // PAYMENT TYPE
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        public String getPaymentType() {
            return paymentType;
        }

        public void setPaymentType(String paymentType) {
            this.paymentType = paymentType;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // PAYMENT DATE
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        public String getPaymentDate() {
            return paymentDate;
        }

        public void setPaymentDate(String paymentDate) {
            this.paymentDate = paymentDate;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // PAYMENT METHOD
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        public String getPaymentMethod() {
            return paymentMethod;
        }

        public void setPaymentMethod(String paymentMethod) {
            this.paymentMethod = paymentMethod;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // TRANSACTION REFERENCE
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        public String getTransactionReferenceNumber() {
            return transactionReferenceNumber;
        }

        public void setTransactionReferenceNumber(
                String transactionReferenceNumber) {
            this.transactionReferenceNumber =
                    transactionReferenceNumber;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // NOTES
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        public String getNotes() {
            return notes;
        }

        public void setNotes(String notes) {
            this.notes = notes;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // RECORD STATUS
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        public String getStatus() {
            return status;
        }

        public void setStatus(String status) {
            this.status = status;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // RECORDED BY
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        public String getRecordedBy() {
            return recordedBy;
        }

        public void setRecordedBy(String recordedBy) {
            this.recordedBy = recordedBy;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // RECORDED AT
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        public Instant getRecordedAt() {
            return recordedAt;
        }

        public void setRecordedAt(Instant recordedAt) {
            this.recordedAt = recordedAt;
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // TIMELINE ENTRY

package com.indocrm.indocrm.model;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.data.annotation.CreatedDate;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.LastModifiedDate;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.mapping.Document;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.mapping.Field;

@Document(collection = "quotations")
public class Quotation {
    private String id;
    private String quotationNo;            // e.g. ICTPL/QTN/2026/073
    private String leadId;
    private String templateId;

    private String clientName;
    private String organization;
    private String email;
    private String phone;

    private String subject;
    private String serviceType;
    private String address;
    private Double amount;
    private String currency = "\u20B9";
    private String validTill;
    private String status = "Draft";
    private String notes;

    // Values the telecaller typed into each template field, keyed by
    // TemplateField.id. Auto-filled from the lead where a field's `mapsTo`
    // matches, then freely editable before generating the PDF.
    private Map<String, String> fieldValues = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    private String generatedPdfPath;   // absolute path on disk
    private String generatedPdfFileName;

    private String createdBy;              // telecaller username who owns this quotation

    // ── Approval workflow ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // status now also carries: "Draft", "Pending Approval", "Approved",
    // "Rejected", "Revision Required", "Sent" (in addition to any legacy
    // values already stored).
    private String telecallerName;         // display name, snapshotted at submit time
    private Instant submittedAt;           // when the telecaller submitted for approval
    private Instant reviewedAt;            // when the super admin approved/rejected
    private String reviewedBy;             // super admin username who reviewed
    private String rejectionReason;        // set when status == Rejected
    private String revisionNotes;          // set when status == Revision Required (Super Admin's requested changes)
    private Instant sentAt;                // when the telecaller sent the approved quotation to the lead
    private String sentChannel;            // "whatsapp" | "email" | "message" etc.

    private List<TimelineEntry> timeline = new ArrayList<>();

    @CreatedDate @Field("createdAt") private Instant createdAt;
    @LastModifiedDate @Field("updatedAt") private Instant updatedAt;

    public static class TimelineEntry {
        private String action, time, icon, bg, color;
        public TimelineEntry() {}
        public TimelineEntry(String action, String time, String icon, String bg, String color) { this.action=action;this.time=time;this.icon=icon;this.bg=bg;this.color=color; }
        public String getAction(){return action;} public void setAction(String v){action=v;}
        public String getTime(){return time;} public void setTime(String v){time=v;}
        public String getIcon(){return icon;} public void setIcon(String v){icon=v;}
        public String getBg(){return bg;} public void setBg(String v){bg=v;}
        public String getColor(){return color;} public void setColor(String v){color=v;}
    }

    public String getId(){return id;} public void setId(String v){id=v;}
    public String getQuotationNo(){return quotationNo;} public void setQuotationNo(String v){quotationNo=v;}
    public String getLeadId(){return leadId;} public void setLeadId(String v){leadId=v;}
    public String getTemplateId(){return templateId;} public void setTemplateId(String v){templateId=v;}
    public String getClientName(){return clientName;} public void setClientName(String v){clientName=v;}
    public String getOrganization(){return organization;} public void setOrganization(String v){organization=v;}
    public String getEmail(){return email;} public void setEmail(String v){email=v;}
    public String getPhone(){return phone;} public void setPhone(String v){phone=v;}
    public String getSubject(){return subject;} public void setSubject(String v){subject=v;}
    public String getServiceType(){return serviceType;} public void setServiceType(String v){serviceType=v;}
    public String getAddress(){return address;} public void setAddress(String v){address=v;}
    public Double getAmount(){return amount;} public void setAmount(Double v){amount=v;}
    public String getCurrency(){return currency;} public void setCurrency(String v){currency=v;}
    public String getValidTill(){return validTill;} public void setValidTill(String v){validTill=v;}
    public String getStatus(){return status;} public void setStatus(String v){status=v;}
    public String getNotes(){return notes;} public void setNotes(String v){notes=v;}
    public Map<String, String> getFieldValues(){return fieldValues;} public void setFieldValues(Map<String, String> v){fieldValues=v;}
    public String getGeneratedPdfPath(){return generatedPdfPath;} public void setGeneratedPdfPath(String v){generatedPdfPath=v;}
    public String getGeneratedPdfFileName(){return generatedPdfFileName;} public void setGeneratedPdfFileName(String v){generatedPdfFileName=v;}
    public String getCreatedBy(){return createdBy;} public void setCreatedBy(String v){createdBy=v;}
    public String getTelecallerName(){return telecallerName;} public void setTelecallerName(String v){telecallerName=v;}
    public Instant getSubmittedAt(){return submittedAt;} public void setSubmittedAt(Instant v){submittedAt=v;}
    public Instant getReviewedAt(){return reviewedAt;} public void setReviewedAt(Instant v){reviewedAt=v;}
    public String getReviewedBy(){return reviewedBy;} public void setReviewedBy(String v){reviewedBy=v;}
    public String getRejectionReason(){return rejectionReason;} public void setRejectionReason(String v){rejectionReason=v;}
    public String getRevisionNotes(){return revisionNotes;} public void setRevisionNotes(String v){revisionNotes=v;}
    public Instant getSentAt(){return sentAt;} public void setSentAt(Instant v){sentAt=v;}
    public String getSentChannel(){return sentChannel;} public void setSentChannel(String v){sentChannel=v;}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.model;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonIgnoreProperties;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonProperty;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.security.RoleUtil;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.Id;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.index.Indexed;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.mapping.Document;
import org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;

import java.util.*;

@Document(collection = "telecallers")
@JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = true)
public class Telecaller implements UserDetails {

    @Id
    private String id;

    @Indexed(unique = true)
    private String employeeId;

    @Indexed(unique = true)
    private String username;

    // WRITE_ONLY: the BCrypt hash is accepted from the admin UI (create / reset) but is
    // NEVER sent back to the browser. Previously GET /api/telecallers leaked every hash.
    @JsonProperty(access = JsonProperty.Access.WRITE_ONLY)
    private String password;
    private String fullName;
    private String mobile;
    private String email;
    private String role;
    private List<String> districts = new ArrayList<>();
    private List<String> categories = new ArrayList<>();
    private String joiningDate;
    private String status;
    private int target;

    // NEW: Assigned Twilio Phone Number
    private String assignedPhoneNumber;
    private String phoneNumberStatus; // Active, Inactive, Blocked

    // Permissions
    private Map<String, Map<String, Boolean>> permissions = new HashMap<>();

    // Performance metrics
    private Map<String, Object> performance = new HashMap<>();

    // Work timings
    private WorkTiming workTiming;

    private Date createdAt;
    private Date updatedAt;
    private boolean enabled = true;

    public Telecaller() {}

    // Getters and Setters for all fields

    public String getId() { return id; }
    public void setId(String id) { this.id = id; }

    public String getEmployeeId() { return employeeId; }
    public void setEmployeeId(String employeeId) { this.employeeId = employeeId; }

    public void setUsername(String username) { this.username = username; }

    public String getPassword() { return password; }
    public void setPassword(String password) { this.password = password; }

    public String getFullName() { return fullName; }
    public void setFullName(String fullName) { this.fullName = fullName; }

    public String getMobile() { return mobile; }
    public void setMobile(String mobile) { this.mobile = mobile; }

    public String getEmail() { return email; }
    public void setEmail(String email) { this.email = email; }

    public String getRole() { return role; }
    public void setRole(String role) { this.role = role; }

    public List<String> getDistricts() { return districts; }
    public void setDistricts(List<String> districts) { this.districts = districts; }

    public List<String> getCategories() { return categories; }
    public void setCategories(List<String> categories) { this.categories = categories; }

    public String getJoiningDate() { return joiningDate; }
    public void setJoiningDate(String joiningDate) { this.joiningDate = joiningDate; }

    public String getStatus() { return status; }
    public void setStatus(String status) { this.status = status; }

    public int getTarget() { return target; }
    public void setTarget(int target) { this.target = target; }

    public String getAssignedPhoneNumber() { return assignedPhoneNumber; }
    public void setAssignedPhoneNumber(String assignedPhoneNumber) { this.assignedPhoneNumber = assignedPhoneNumber; }

    public String getPhoneNumberStatus() { return phoneNumberStatus; }
    public void setPhoneNumberStatus(String phoneNumberStatus) { this.phoneNumberStatus = phoneNumberStatus; }

    public Map<String, Map<String, Boolean>> getPermissions() { return permissions; }
    public void setPermissions(Map<String, Map<String, Boolean>> permissions) { this.permissions = permissions; }

    public void setPerformance(Map<String, Object> performance) { this.performance = performance; }

    public WorkTiming getWorkTiming() { return workTiming; }
    public void setWorkTiming(WorkTiming workTiming) { this.workTiming = workTiming; }

    public Date getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
    public void setCreatedAt(Date createdAt) { this.createdAt = createdAt; }

    public Date getUpdatedAt() { return updatedAt; }
    public void setUpdatedAt(Date updatedAt) { this.updatedAt = updatedAt; }

    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.enabled = enabled; }

    // A telecaller whose status is "Inactive" must not be able to log in
    // ("Disable Login" in the admin UI only flips the status text).
    @Override
    public boolean isEnabled() {
        return enabled && !"Inactive".equalsIgnoreCase(status == null ? "" : status.trim());
    }

    @Override
    public Collection<? extends GrantedAuthority> getAuthorities() {
        return RoleUtil.authorities(role, "TELECALLER");
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAccountNonExpired() { return true; }

    @Override
    public boolean isAccountNonLocked() { return true; }

    @Override
    public boolean isCredentialsNonExpired() { return true; }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.model;

import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.data.annotation.Id;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.index.Indexed;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.mapping.Document;

import org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;

@Document(collection = "users")
public class User implements UserDetails {

    @Id
    private String id;

    @Indexed(unique = true)
    private String username;

    private String password;

    private String fullName;

    private String email;

    private String role;

    private boolean enabled = true;

    public User() {
    }

    public String getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public void setId(String id) {
        this.id = id;
    }

    public String getUsername() {
        return username;
    }

    public void setUsername(String username) {
        this.username = username;
    }

    public String getPassword() {
        return password;
    }

    public void setPassword(String password) {
        this.password = password;
    }

    public String getFullName() {
        return fullName;
    }

    public void setFullName(String fullName) {
        this.fullName = fullName;
    }

    public String getEmail() {
        return email;
    }

    public void setEmail(String email) {
        this.email = email;
    }

    public String getRole() {
        return role;
    }

    public void setRole(String role) {
        this.role = role;
    }

    public boolean isEnabled() {
        return enabled;
    }

    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
        this.enabled = enabled;
    }

    /*
     * IMPORTANT:
     *
     * Converts:
     *
     * SUPER_ADMIN
     * Super Admin
     * super admin
     * ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN
     *
     * into:
     *
     * ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN
     */
    @Override
    public Collection<? extends GrantedAuthority> getAuthorities() {

        String normalizedRole = normalizeRole(role);

        return List.of(
            new SimpleGrantedAuthority(
                "ROLE_" + normalizedRole
            )
        );
    }

    private String normalizeRole(String value) {

        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return "USER";
        }

        String normalized = value
            .trim()
            .toUpperCase()
            .replace("-", "_")
            .replace(" ", "_");

        if (normalized.startsWith("ROLE_")) {
            normalized = normalized.substring(5);
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAccountNonExpired() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAccountNonLocked() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isCredentialsNonExpired() {
        return true;
    }

   
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.repository;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.MongoRepository;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.Query;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.CommunicationMessage;

public interface CommunicationMessageRepository
        extends MongoRepository<CommunicationMessage, String> {

    List<CommunicationMessage> findByRecipientTypeOrderByCreatedAtAsc(String recipientType);

    @Query("""
        {
          '$or': [
            { 'senderUsername': ?0, 'recipientUsername': ?1, 'recipientType': 'DIRECT' },
            { 'senderUsername': ?1, 'recipientUsername': ?0, 'recipientType': 'DIRECT' }
          ]
        }
        """)
    List<CommunicationMessage> findDirectConversation(String firstUsername, String secondUsername);

    Optional<CommunicationMessage> findByAttachmentId(String attachmentId);

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // NEW: single-query unread counts (replaces loading every message)
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** Unread direct messages sent TO `reader` FROM `sender`. */
    @Query(value = """
        {
          'recipientType': 'DIRECT',
          'senderUsername': ?0,
          'recipientUsername': ?1,
          'readBy': { '$ne': ?1 }
        }
        """, count = true)
    long countUnreadDirect(String sender, String reader);

    /** Unread group messages not yet read by `reader` and not sent by them. */
    @Query(value = """
        {
          'recipientType': 'GROUP',
          'senderUsername': { '$ne': ?0 },
          'readBy': { '$ne': ?0 }
        }
        """, count = true)
    long countUnreadGroup(String reader);
}

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\security\JwtAuthenticationFilter.java =====
package com.indocrm.indocrm.security;

import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;
import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.WebAuthenticationDetailsSource;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.List;

@Component
public class JwtAuthenticationFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {

    private final JwtUtil jwtUtil;
    private final UserDetailsService userDetailsService;

    public JwtAuthenticationFilter(
            JwtUtil jwtUtil,
            UserDetailsService userDetailsService) {

        this.jwtUtil = jwtUtil;
        this.userDetailsService = userDetailsService;
    }

    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            FilterChain filterChain)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String path = request.getRequestURI();

        /*
         * ==========================================
         * LOGIN
         * ==========================================
         */
        if (path.equals("/api/auth/login")) {
            filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
            return;
        }

        /*
         * ==========================================
         * GET AUTHORIZATION HEADER
         * ==========================================
         */
        final String authHeader =
                request.getHeader("Authorization");

        if (authHeader == null ||
            !authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")) {

            /*
             * No JWT.
             *
             * Let Spring Security decide whether
             * the endpoint requires authentication.
             */
            filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
            return;
        }

        /*
         * ==========================================
         * EXTRACT JWT
         * ==========================================
         */
        final String jwt =
                authHeader.substring(7);

        try {

            final String username =
                    jwtUtil.extractUsername(jwt);

            /*
             * ==========================================
             * LOAD USER
             * ==========================================
             */
            if (username != null &&
                SecurityContextHolder
                    .getContext()
                    .getAuthentication() == null) {

                UserDetails userDetails =
                        userDetailsService
                            .loadUserByUsername(username);

                /*
                 * ==========================================
                 * VALIDATE TOKEN
                 * ==========================================
                 */
                if (jwtUtil.validateToken(
                        jwt,
                        userDetails)) {

                    /*
                     * ==========================================
                     * NORMALIZE AUTHORITIES
                     * ==========================================
                     *
                     * Spring's hasRole("ADMIN") expects:
                     *
                     * ROLE_ADMIN
                     *
                     * Spring's hasRole("SUPER_ADMIN") expects:
                     *
                     * ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN
                     */
                    Collection<SimpleGrantedAuthority>
                            authorities =
                            normalizeAuthorities(
                                userDetails
                                    .getAuthorities()
                            );

                    /*
                     * DEBUG LOG
                     */
                    System.out.println(
                        "===================================="
                    );

                    System.out.println(
                        "JWT USER: " + username
                    );

                    System.out.println(
                        "JWT AUTHORITIES: " + authorities
                    );

                    System.out.println(
                        "REQUEST: "
                        + request.getMethod()
                        + " "
                        + request.getRequestURI()
                    );

                    System.out.println(
                        "===================================="
                    );

                    /*
                     * ==========================================
                     * CREATE AUTHENTICATION
                     * ==========================================
                     */
                    UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken
                            authToken =
                            new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
                                userDetails,
                                null,
                                authorities
                            );

                    authToken.setDetails(
                        new WebAuthenticationDetailsSource()
                            .buildDetails(request)
                    );

                    SecurityContextHolder
                        .getContext()
                        .setAuthentication(authToken);
                }
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {

            /*
             * Invalid JWT should not crash the request.
             */
            System.out.println(
                "JWT authentication failed: "
                + e.getMessage()
            );

            SecurityContextHolder
                .clearContext();
        }

        filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
    }

    /*
     * ==========================================
     * NORMALIZE AUTHORITIES
     * ==========================================
     */
    private Collection<SimpleGrantedAuthority>
    normalizeAuthorities(
            Collection<? extends org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority>
                    existingAuthorities) {

        List<SimpleGrantedAuthority> authorities =
                new ArrayList<>();

        if (existingAuthorities == null) {
            return authorities;
        }

        for (
            org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority authority
            : existingAuthorities
        ) {

            if (authority == null ||
                authority.getAuthority() == null) {

                continue;
            }

            String role =
                    authority.getAuthority().trim();

            if (role.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            /*
             * Remove existing ROLE_ prefix first.
             */
            if (role.startsWith("ROLE_")) {
                role = role.substring(5);
            }

            /*
             * Normalize common role names.
             */
            role = role.toUpperCase();

            /*
             * Add ROLE_ prefix.
             */
            String normalizedRole =
                    "ROLE_" + role;

            /*
             * Avoid duplicates.
             */
            boolean alreadyExists =
                    authorities.stream()
                        .anyMatch(
                            a -> a.getAuthority()
                                .equals(normalizedRole)
                        );

            if (!alreadyExists) {

                authorities.add(
                    new SimpleGrantedAuthority(
                        normalizedRole
                    )
                );
            }
        }

        return authorities;
    }
}

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\security\JwtUtil.java =====
package com.indocrm.indocrm.security;

import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts;
import io.jsonwebtoken.SignatureAlgorithm;
import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.Key;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Function;

@Component
public class JwtUtil {

    @Value("${jwt.secret}")
    private String secret;

    @Value("${jwt.expiration-ms}")
    private Long expirationMs;

    private volatile Key signingKey;

    /**
     * Accepts a Base64 secret (same key as before, so existing tokens stay valid) AND
     * also a plain-text secret. Previously a plain-text jwt.secret (or one with a stray
     * space / newline) made Base64.decode() throw on every login -> HTTP 500 -> nobody
     * could log in.
     */
    private Key getSigningKey() {
        Key key = signingKey;
        if (key == null) {
            synchronized (this) {
                if (signingKey == null) {
                    signingKey = buildKey();
                }
                key = signingKey;
            }
        }
        return key;
    }

    private Key buildKey() {
        String s = secret == null ? "" : secret.trim();
        byte[] keyBytes;
        try {
            keyBytes = Base64.getDecoder().decode(s);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException notBase64) {
            keyBytes = s.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        }
        if (keyBytes.length < 32) {
            // HS256 needs >= 256 bits; stretch short secrets deterministically.
            try {
                keyBytes = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(keyBytes);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot build JWT signing key", e);
            }
        }
        return Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(keyBytes);
    }

    public String extractUsername(String token) {
        return extractClaim(token, Claims::getSubject);
    }

    public Date extractExpiration(String token) {
        return extractClaim(token, Claims::getExpiration);
    }

    public <T> T extractClaim(String token, Function<Claims, T> claimsResolver) {
        final Claims claims = extractAllClaims(token);
        return claimsResolver.apply(claims);
    }

    private Claims extractAllClaims(String token) {
        return Jwts.parserBuilder()
                .setSigningKey(getSigningKey())
                .build()
                .parseClaimsJws(token)
                .getBody();
    }

    private Boolean isTokenExpired(String token) {
        return extractExpiration(token).before(new Date());
    }

    public String generateToken(UserDetails userDetails) {
        Map<String, Object> claims = new HashMap<>();
        return createToken(claims, userDetails.getUsername());
    }

    private String createToken(Map<String, Object> claims, String subject) {
        return Jwts.builder()
                .setClaims(claims)
                .setSubject(subject)
                .setIssuedAt(new Date(System.currentTimeMillis()))
                .setExpiration(new Date(System.currentTimeMillis() + expirationMs))
                .signWith(getSigningKey(), SignatureAlgorithm.HS256)
                .compact();
    }

    public Boolean validateToken(String token, UserDetails userDetails) {
        final String username = extractUsername(token);
        return (username.equals(userDetails.getUsername()) && !isTokenExpired(token));
    }
}

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\security\RoleUtil.java =====
package com.indocrm.indocrm.security;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;

/**
 * Single place that turns a free-text role ("Telecaller", "Senior Telecaller",
 * "Team Lead", "Super Admin", "ROLE_ADMIN" ...) into Spring authorities.
 *
 * Why this exists:
 *   Telecaller.getAuthorities() used to do  "ROLE_" + role.toUpperCase()
 *   - NPE when role was null
 *   - "Senior Telecaller" became "ROLE_SENIOR TELECALLER" (with a space), so every
 *     hasRole('TELECALLER') endpoint answered 403 for Senior Telecallers / Team Leads.
 */
public final class RoleUtil {

    private RoleUtil() {}

    public static String normalize(String role, String defaultRole) {
        if (role == null || role.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return defaultRole;
        }
        String normalized = role.trim()
                .toUpperCase()
                .replace("-", "_")
                .replace(" ", "_");
        if (normalized.startsWith("ROLE_")) {
            normalized = normalized.substring(5);
        }
        return normalized.isEmpty() ? defaultRole : normalized;
    }

    /** True for every role that belongs to the telecaller portal. */
    public static boolean isTelecallerFamily(String normalizedRole) {
        return normalizedRole != null
                && (normalizedRole.contains("TELECALLER")
                    || normalizedRole.contains("TELE_CALLER")
                    || normalizedRole.equals("TEAM_LEAD"));
    }

    /**
     * ROLE_<NORMALIZED> and, for the telecaller family, also ROLE_TELECALLER so the
     * existing hasRole('TELECALLER') checks keep working for every telecaller role.
     */
    public static List<GrantedAuthority> authorities(String role, String defaultRole) {
        String normalized = normalize(role, defaultRole);
        List<GrantedAuthority> list = new ArrayList<>();
        list.add(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_" + normalized));
        if (isTelecallerFamily(normalized) && !normalized.equals("TELECALLER")) {
            list.add(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_TELECALLER"));
        }
        return list;
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.StringReader;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import javax.xml.XMLConstants;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;

import org.springframework.core.io.ClassPathResource;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.xml.sax.InputSource;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.AgreementCategory;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.AgreementTemplate;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.AgreementTemplateRepository;

@Service
public class AgreementCategoryService {

    /** Bump when you change a file under resources/agreement-templates/ — un-edited system copies self-heal on boot. */
    static final int DEFAULT_VERSION = 1;
    private static final int MAX_HTML_CHARS = 1_500_000;

    private final AgreementTemplateRepository repo;

    public AgreementCategoryService(AgreementTemplateRepository repo) {
        this.repo = repo;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ read

    public List<Map<String, Object>> list() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (AgreementCategory c : AgreementCategory.values()) {
            out.add(toMap(c, find(c), false));
        }
        return out;
    }

    public Map<String, Object> get(String key) {
        AgreementCategory c = AgreementCategory.of(key);
        return toMap(c, find(c), true);
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- write

    /** Saves the edited agreement. A hand-edited template is never overwritten by the boot seeder again. */
    public Map<String, Object> save(String key, String html) {
        AgreementCategory c = AgreementCategory.of(key);
        validate(html);
        AgreementTemplate t = find(c);
        if (t == null) t = create(c, defaultHtml(c));
        t.setContentHtml(html);
        t.setSystemTemplate(false);          // customised → protect from the seeder
        t.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        return toMap(c, repo.save(t), true);
    }

    /** Restores the original agreement text (from the PDF the company supplied). */
    public Map<String, Object> reset(String key) {
        AgreementCategory c = AgreementCategory.of(key);
        AgreementTemplate t = find(c);
        if (t == null) t = create(c, defaultHtml(c));
        t.setContentHtml(defaultHtml(c));
        t.setSystemTemplate(true);
        t.setTemplateVersion(DEFAULT_VERSION);
        t.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        return toMap(c, repo.save(t), true);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ boot

    public void seedAll() {
        for (AgreementCategory c : AgreementCategory.values()) {
            AgreementTemplate t = find(c);
            if (t == null) {
                create(c, defaultHtml(c));
            } else if (t.isSystemTemplate() && t.getTemplateVersion() < DEFAULT_VERSION) {
                t.setContentHtml(defaultHtml(c));
                t.setTemplateVersion(DEFAULT_VERSION);
                t.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
                repo.save(t);
            }
        }
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

    private AgreementTemplate find(AgreementCategory c) {
        return repo.findFirstByCategoryAndActiveTrue(c.name()).orElse(null);
    }

    private AgreementTemplate create(AgreementCategory c, String html) {
        AgreementTemplate t = new AgreementTemplate();
        t.setName(c.label + " Agreement");
        t.setCategory(c.name());
        t.setAgreementType(c.agreementType);
        t.setContentHtml(html);
        t.setContentType("text/html");
        t.setSourceType("SYSTEM");
        t.setSystemTemplate(true);
        t.setTemplateVersion(DEFAULT_VERSION);
        t.setCreatedBy("SYSTEM");
        t.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());
        t.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        return repo.save(t);
    }

    private String defaultHtml(AgreementCategory c) {
        try (InputStream in = new ClassPathResource(c.resource).getInputStream()) {
            return new String(in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Default agreement file missing: " + c.resource, e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Agreement PDFs are rendered by openhtmltopdf, which parses the HTML as strict XML.
     * Reject anything that would later break PDF generation instead of discovering it at approval time.
     */
    private void validate(String html) {
        if (html == null || html.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Agreement content cannot be empty");
        if (html.length() > MAX_HTML_CHARS) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Agreement content is too large");
        String lower = html.toLowerCase();
        if (lower.contains("<script") || lower.contains("javascript:") || lower.matches("(?s).*\\son\\w+\\s*=.*")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Scripts and inline event handlers are not allowed in an agreement");
        }
        String xml = "<root>" + html
                .replace("&nbsp;", "&#160;").replace("&ldquo;", "&#8220;").replace("&rdquo;", "&#8221;")
                .replace("&lsquo;", "&#8216;").replace("&rsquo;", "&#8217;").replace("&ndash;", "&#8211;")
                .replace("&mdash;", "&#8212;").replace("&hellip;", "&#8230;") + "</root>";
        try {
            DocumentBuilderFactory f = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();
            f.setFeature(XMLConstants.FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING, true);
            f.setFeature("http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl", true);
            f.newDocumentBuilder().parse(new InputSource(new StringReader(xml)));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Agreement HTML is not well-formed (" + e.getMessage() + "). "
                    + "Close every tag, e.g. <br/> instead of <br>.");
        }
    }

    private Map<String, Object> toMap(AgreementCategory c, AgreementTemplate t, boolean withHtml) {
        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        m.put("key", c.name());
        m.put("label", c.label);
        m.put("description", c.description);
        m.put("agreementType", c.agreementType);
        m.put("fields", c.fieldSet.fields);
        m.put("templateId", t == null ? null : t.getId());
        m.put("customized", t != null && !t.isSystemTemplate());
        m.put("updatedAt", t == null ? null : t.getUpdatedAt());
        if (withHtml) m.put("contentHtml", t == null ? defaultHtml(c) : t.getContentHtml());
        return m;
    }
}

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\service\AgreementPdfService.java =====
// FILE: src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/service/AgreementPdfService.java
// REPLACES existing file.
//
// Agreement PDFs now use the SAME letterhead the Super Admin uploads for Quotations
// (Quotations page -> Letterpad / Logo / Footer, stored by QuotationBrandingService):
//   - letterpad : full-page A4 background (uploaded one, else the bundled default)
//   - logo      : uploaded logo, same position/size as on quotations
//   - footer    : phone / website / address with round icons (text editable by Super Admin)
// If nothing is uploaded it falls back to the old built-in IndoCampas letterhead.
//
// The letterhead is stamped on EVERY page with PDFBox after openhtmltopdf renders the body.
// (Drawing it with negative-offset position:fixed HTML boxes was being clipped -> no logo.)
package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.awt.Color;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.Map;

import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPage;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPageContentStream;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.common.PDRectangle;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.font.PDFont;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.font.PDType1Font;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.graphics.image.PDImageXObject;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Agreement;
import com.openhtmltopdf.outputdevice.helper.BaseRendererBuilder.FontStyle;
import com.openhtmltopdf.pdfboxout.PdfRendererBuilder;

@Service
public class AgreementPdfService {

    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AgreementPdfService.class);

    /** points per millimetre */
    private static final float MM = 72f / 25.4f;

    private static final Color BRAND = new Color(0x7B, 0x11, 0x13);
    private static final Color INK = new Color(0x11, 0x18, 0x27);
    private static final Color LINK = new Color(0x1D, 0x4E, 0xD8);
    private static final Color ADDR = new Color(0xC8, 0x10, 0x2E);

    private final QuotationBrandingService branding;

    @Value("${agreement.storage.dir:./storage/agreements}")
    private String storageDirProp;

    public AgreementPdfService(QuotationBrandingService branding) {
        this.branding = branding;
    }

    private Path outputDir() throws Exception {
        Path dir = Paths.get(storageDirProp, "generated");
        Files.createDirectories(dir);
        return dir;
    }

    public String generate(Agreement a) throws Exception {
        Path outPath = outputDir().resolve(safeName(a.getId()) + ".pdf");
        String fullHtml = wrap(a);

        byte[] pdf;
        try (ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
            PdfRendererBuilder builder = new PdfRendererBuilder();
            builder.useFastMode();
            registerFonts(builder);
            builder.withHtmlContent(fullHtml, null);
            builder.toStream(buffer);
            builder.run();
            pdf = buffer.toByteArray();
        }

        if (isDocMode(a)) {
            pdf = stampLetterhead(pdf);
        }

        try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(outPath.toFile())) {
            fos.write(pdf);
        }
        return outPath.toAbsolutePath().toString();
    }

    public void deleteQuietly(String path) {
        if (path == null) return;
        try { Files.deleteIfExists(Paths.get(path)); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- fonts
    private void registerFonts(PdfRendererBuilder b) {
        font(b, "LiberationSerif-Regular.ttf", "Liberation Serif", 400, FontStyle.NORMAL);
        font(b, "LiberationSerif-Bold.ttf", "Liberation Serif", 700, FontStyle.NORMAL);
        font(b, "LiberationSerif-Italic.ttf", "Liberation Serif", 400, FontStyle.ITALIC);
        font(b, "LiberationSerif-BoldItalic.ttf", "Liberation Serif", 700, FontStyle.ITALIC);
        font(b, "DejaVuSans.ttf", "DejaVu Sans", 400, FontStyle.NORMAL);
        font(b, "DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", "DejaVu Sans", 700, FontStyle.NORMAL);
    }

    private void font(PdfRendererBuilder b, String file, String family, int weight, FontStyle style) {
        String path = "/fonts/" + file;
        if (getClass().getResource(path) == null) return;      // font missing -> fall back silently
        b.useFont(() -> getClass().getResourceAsStream(path), family, weight, style, true);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- html
    private boolean isDocMode(Agreement a) {
        return a.getContentHtml() != null && a.getContentHtml().contains("id=\"agr-doc\"");
    }

    private String wrap(Agreement a) {
        String body = normalizeEntities(a.getContentHtml());
        if (isDocMode(a)) {
            // letterhead is stamped afterwards by stampLetterhead(); the @page margins just leave room for it.
            return "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset=\"UTF-8\"/><style>" + DOC_CSS + "</style></head><body>"
                    + body + "</body></html>";
        }
        return "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset=\"UTF-8\"/><style>" + CSS + "</style></head><body>"
                + normalizeEntities(a.getHeaderHtml()) + body + normalizeEntities(a.getFooterHtml()) + "</body></html>";
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- letterhead (PDFBox)

    private byte[] stampLetterhead(byte[] pdfBytes) {
        try (PDDocument doc = PDDocument.load(pdfBytes);
             ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {

            // ---- Super Admin branding (shared with quotations) ----
            byte[] padBytes = branding.letterpadBytes();   // uploaded letterpad, else bundled default (may be null)
            byte[] logoBytes = branding.logoBytes();       // uploaded logo (may be null)
            Map<String, Object> f = branding.footerSettings();

            PDImageXObject pad = imageFromBytes(doc, padBytes, "letterpad");
            PDImageXObject logo = imageFromBytes(doc, logoBytes, "logo");
            PDImageXObject iconPhone = imageFromBytes(doc, QuotationIcons.png("phone"), "icon-phone");
            PDImageXObject iconGlobe = imageFromBytes(doc, QuotationIcons.png("globe"), "icon-globe");
            PDImageXObject iconPin = imageFromBytes(doc, QuotationIcons.png("pin"), "icon-pin");

            // ---- legacy built-in assets, only used when the Super Admin has uploaded nothing ----
            PDImageXObject oldRibbonTop = pad == null ? classpathImage(doc, "ribbon-top.png") : null;
            PDImageXObject oldRibbonBottom = pad == null ? classpathImage(doc, "ribbon-bottom.png") : null;
            PDImageXObject oldLogo = logo == null ? classpathImage(doc, "logo.png") : null;

            for (PDPage page : doc.getPages()) {
                PDRectangle box = page.getMediaBox();
                float w = box.getWidth();
                float h = box.getHeight();

                // 1) letterpad goes BEHIND the text
                if (pad != null) {
                    try (PDPageContentStream bg = new PDPageContentStream(
                            doc, page, PDPageContentStream.AppendMode.PREPEND, true, true)) {
                        bg.drawImage(pad, 0f, 0f, w, h);
                    }
                }

                // 2) logo + footer on top
                try (PDPageContentStream cs = new PDPageContentStream(
                        doc, page, PDPageContentStream.AppendMode.APPEND, true, true)) {

                    if (oldRibbonTop != null) drawOldRibbonTop(cs, w, h, oldRibbonTop);
                    if (oldRibbonBottom != null) drawOldRibbonBottom(cs, oldRibbonBottom);

                    float textX = 0.094f * w;
                    if (logo != null) {
                        textX = drawLogo(cs, w, h, logo);
                    } else if (oldLogo != null) {
                        drawOldBrandHeader(cs, h, oldLogo);
                    }
                    if (logo != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(f.get("showBrandText"))) {
                        drawBrandText(cs, w, h, textX);
                    }

                    drawFooter(cs, w, h, iconPhone, iconGlobe, iconPin,
                            str(f.get("phone")), str(f.get("website")), str(f.get("address")));
                }
            }

            doc.save(out);
            return out.toByteArray();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Letterhead stamping failed, returning PDF without letterhead: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
            return pdfBytes;
        }
    }

    /** Same box as quotations: x=9.4% , top=2.8%, max 46% x 10.5% of the page, centred vertically. Returns x for text after it. */
    private float drawLogo(PDPageContentStream cs, float w, float h, PDImageXObject logo) throws Exception {
        float boxW = 0.46f * w, boxH = 0.105f * h;
        float s = Math.min(boxW / logo.getWidth(), boxH / logo.getHeight());
        float lw = logo.getWidth() * s, lh = logo.getHeight() * s;
        float x = 0.094f * w;
        float topFromTop = 0.028f * h + (boxH - lh) / 2f;
        cs.drawImage(logo, x, h - topFromTop - lh, lw, lh);
        return x + lw + 0.02f * w;
    }

    private void drawBrandText(PDPageContentStream cs, float w, float h, float textX) throws Exception {
        text(cs, "CAMPAS TECH", PDType1Font.HELVETICA, 24f, BRAND, textX, h - (0.045f * h + 0.025f * h + 8f));
        text(cs, "Private Limited", PDType1Font.TIMES_ROMAN, 14f, BRAND, textX, h - (0.098f * h + 0.0175f * h + 5f));
    }

    /** Footer exactly like quotations: round icons + text, bottom-left. */
    private void drawFooter(PDPageContentStream cs, float w, float h,
                            PDImageXObject iconPhone, PDImageXObject iconGlobe, PDImageXObject iconPin,
                            String phone, String web, String address) throws Exception {
        float iconS = 19f;
        float ix = 0.14f * w, tx = 0.185f * w;
        PDFont font = PDType1Font.HELVETICA;
        float size = 10f;

        // icon (top y fraction) and text baseline derived from the same boxes used on quotations
        footerLine(cs, iconPhone, font, size, INK, ix, tx, iconS, h, 0.842f, 0.838f, phone);
        footerLine(cs, iconGlobe, font, size, LINK, ix, tx, iconS, h, 0.880f, 0.876f, web);

        if (iconPin != null) cs.drawImage(iconPin, ix, h - 0.914f * h - iconS, iconS, iconS);
        String[] lines = address.split("\\r?\\n");
        float firstBaseline = h - (0.910f * h + 1f + 9f);
        for (int i = 0; i < lines.length && i < 3; i++) {
            text(cs, lines[i], font, size, ADDR, tx, firstBaseline - i * 12f);
        }
    }

    private void footerLine(PDPageContentStream cs, PDImageXObject icon, PDFont font, float size, Color color,
                            float ix, float tx, float iconS, float h, float iconTopFrac, float textTopFrac,
                            String value) throws Exception {
        if (icon != null) cs.drawImage(icon, ix, h - iconTopFrac * h - iconS, iconS, iconS);
        float textBoxH = 0.028f * h;
        float baseline = h - (textTopFrac * h + textBoxH / 2f + size * 0.3f);
        text(cs, value, font, size, color, tx, baseline);
    }

    // ---- legacy (only when nothing has been uploaded) ----
    private void drawOldRibbonTop(PDPageContentStream cs, float w, float h, PDImageXObject img) throws Exception {
        float s = Math.min(34f * MM / img.getWidth(), 40f * MM / img.getHeight());
        float iw = img.getWidth() * s, ih = img.getHeight() * s;
        cs.drawImage(img, w - iw, h - ih, iw, ih);
    }

    private void drawOldRibbonBottom(PDPageContentStream cs, PDImageXObject img) throws Exception {
        float s = Math.min(36f * MM / img.getWidth(), 31f * MM / img.getHeight());
        cs.drawImage(img, 0f, 0f, img.getWidth() * s, img.getHeight() * s);
    }

    private void drawOldBrandHeader(PDPageContentStream cs, float h, PDImageXObject logo) throws Exception {
        float x = 10f * MM;
        float lh = 20f * MM;
        float lw = lh * logo.getWidth() / logo.getHeight();
        cs.drawImage(logo, x, h - 9f * MM - lh, lw, lh);

        PDFont bold = PDType1Font.TIMES_BOLD, reg = PDType1Font.TIMES_ROMAN;
        Color c = new Color(0x6e, 0x1f, 0x2b);
        float indoX = x + lw + 3f * MM;
        text(cs, "INDO", bold, 34f, c, indoX, h - 23f * MM);
        float campasX = indoX + bold.getStringWidth("INDO") / 1000f * 34f + 3f * MM;
        text(cs, "CAMPAS TECH", reg, 20f, c, campasX, h - 16.5f * MM);
        text(cs, "Private Limited", reg, 13f, c, campasX + 8f, h - 24f * MM);
    }

    // ---- helpers ----
    private void text(PDPageContentStream cs, String s, PDFont font, float size, Color color,
                      float x, float y) throws Exception {
        String safe = winAnsi(font, s);
        if (safe.isEmpty()) return;
        cs.beginText();
        cs.setFont(font, size);
        cs.setNonStrokingColor(color);
        cs.newLineAtOffset(x, y);
        cs.showText(safe);
        cs.endText();
    }

    /** Standard-14 fonts only support WinAnsi - replace anything they cannot encode so PDF never fails. */
    private String winAnsi(PDFont font, String s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (char ch : s.toCharArray()) {
            if (ch == '\n' || ch == '\r') continue;
            try { font.encode(String.valueOf(ch)); sb.append(ch); } catch (Exception e) { sb.append('?'); }
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static String str(Object o) { return o == null ? "" : String.valueOf(o); }

    private PDImageXObject imageFromBytes(PDDocument doc, byte[] bytes, String name) {
        if (bytes == null || bytes.length == 0) return null;
        try {
            return PDImageXObject.createFromByteArray(doc, bytes, name);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Unable to load letterhead image {}: {}", name, e.getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }

    private PDImageXObject classpathImage(PDDocument doc, String name) {
        try (InputStream in = getClass().getResourceAsStream("/agreement-brand/" + name)) {
            if (in == null) return null;
            return PDImageXObject.createFromByteArray(doc, in.readAllBytes(), name);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private String safeName(String id) { return id == null ? "agreement" : id.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]", "_"); }
    private String safe(String v) { return v == null ? "" : v; }

    private String normalizeEntities(String html) {
        return safe(html)
                .replace("&nbsp;", "&#160;").replace("&ldquo;", "&#8220;").replace("&rdquo;", "&#8221;")
                .replace("&lsquo;", "&#8216;").replace("&rsquo;", "&#8217;").replace("&ndash;", "&#8211;")
                .replace("&mdash;", "&#8212;").replace("&hellip;", "&#8230;");
    }

    // Margins leave room for the quotation letterhead: logo ends ~39.5mm from top, footer starts ~249mm from top.
    private static final String DOC_CSS = """
        @page { size: A4; margin: 42mm 20mm 52mm 20mm; }
        body { font-family: 'Liberation Serif', 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 11pt; color: #111; }
        h3, h4 { page-break-after: avoid; }
        li, p { page-break-inside: avoid; }
        """;

    private static final String CSS = """
        @page { size: A4; margin: 22mm 18mm; }
        body { font-family: 'Liberation Serif', 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 11.5pt; color: #1a1a1a; line-height: 1.45; }
        .agreement-letterhead { border-bottom: 2px solid #8a1f2b; padding-bottom: 8px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
        .agreement-brand { font-size: 20pt; font-weight: bold; color: #8a1f2b; }
        .agreement-brand span { font-size: 12pt; color: #444; display: block; font-weight: normal; }
        .agreement-contact { font-size: 9pt; color: #444; margin-top: 4px; }
        .agreement-title { text-align: center; font-size: 14pt; margin: 10px 0 18px; }
        h3 { font-size: 12.5pt; margin: 14px 0 6px; }
        h4 { font-size: 11.5pt; margin: 10px 0 4px; }
        p { margin: 4px 0; text-align: justify; }
        ul { margin: 4px 0 8px 20px; }
        li { margin: 2px 0; }
        table.agreement-fee-table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; margin: 10px 0 14px; }
        table.agreement-fee-table td { border: 1px solid #999; padding: 6px 10px; }
        table.agreement-fee-table caption { text-align: left; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 6px; }
        .agreement-signatures { width: 100%; margin-top: 40px; }
        .agreement-signature-block { display: inline-block; vertical-align: top; width: 46%; }
        .agreement-signature-block + .agreement-signature-block { margin-left: 4%; }
        .agreement-signature-block p { margin: 2px 0; }
        """;
}

// FILE: src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/service/AgreementPlanService.java
package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.boot.context.event.ApplicationReadyEvent;
import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener;
import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.AgreementPlanRequest;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.AgreementPlan;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.AgreementPlanRepository;

@Service
public class AgreementPlanService {

    private static final Logger log =
            LoggerFactory.getLogger(AgreementPlanService.class);

    public static final String TYPE_ERP = "ERP";
    public static final String TYPE_DIGITAL_MARKETING = "DIGITAL_MARKETING";

    private final AgreementPlanRepository repo;

    public AgreementPlanService(AgreementPlanRepository repo) {
        this.repo = repo;
        // NOTE: Do NOT seed in the constructor. If Mongo is not yet
        // reachable at context-refresh time, a seeding query will
        // abort startup with the exact "Cannot resolve reference to
        // bean 'mongoTemplate'" error we're fixing. Seeding happens
        // in onApplicationReady() below.
    }

    /**
     * Runs once the Spring context is fully up and the Mongo
     * connection has been validated. Any failure here is logged
     * but does NOT stop the application — the app can still serve
     * requests, and seeding will be retried on the next restart.
     */
    @EventListener(ApplicationReadyEvent.class)
    public void onApplicationReady() {
        try {
            seedDefaultsIfEmpty();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("AgreementPlan seeding skipped (Mongo not ready yet): {}",
                    e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private boolean admin() {
        return SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication()
                .getAuthorities().stream()
                .anyMatch(a -> a.getAuthority().equals("ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN")
                        || a.getAuthority().equals("ROLE_ADMIN"));
    }

    private void requireAdmin() {
        if (!admin()) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException(
                    "Only Super Admin can manage agreement plans");
        }
    }

    public List<AgreementPlan> listByType(String agreementType) {
        if (agreementType == null || agreementType.isBlank()) {
            return repo.findAllByOrderByAgreementTypeAscDisplayOrderAsc();
        }
        return repo.findByAgreementTypeAndActiveTrueOrderByDisplayOrderAsc(
                agreementType.trim().toUpperCase());
    }

    public AgreementPlan get(String id) {
        return repo.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Plan not found"));
    }

    public AgreementPlan create(AgreementPlanRequest r) {
        requireAdmin();
        validate(r);
        AgreementPlan p = new AgreementPlan();
        apply(p, r);
        p.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());
        p.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        return repo.save(p);
    }

    public AgreementPlan update(String id, AgreementPlanRequest r) {
        requireAdmin();
        validate(r);
        AgreementPlan p = get(id);
        apply(p, r);
        p.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        return repo.save(p);
    }

    public void archive(String id) {
        requireAdmin();
        AgreementPlan p = get(id);
        p.setActive(false);
        p.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        repo.save(p);
    }

    private void validate(AgreementPlanRequest r) {
        if (r.getAgreementType() == null
                || !(TYPE_ERP.equalsIgnoreCase(r.getAgreementType())
                || TYPE_DIGITAL_MARKETING.equalsIgnoreCase(
                        r.getAgreementType()))) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "agreementType must be ERP or DIGITAL_MARKETING");
        }
        if (r.getPlanName() == null || r.getPlanName().isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Plan name is required");
        }
        if (r.getFeeAmount() < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Fee amount cannot be negative");
        }
    }

    private void apply(AgreementPlan p, AgreementPlanRequest r) {
        p.setAgreementType(r.getAgreementType().trim().toUpperCase());
        p.setPlanName(r.getPlanName().trim());
        p.setDescription(r.getDescription());
        p.setFeeAmount(r.getFeeAmount());
        p.setDiscountAmount(Math.max(0, r.getDiscountAmount()));
        p.setGstPercent(r.getGstPercent() <= 0 ? 18.0 : r.getGstPercent());
        p.setMinStudentStrength(r.getMinStudentStrength());
        p.setMaxStudentStrength(r.getMaxStudentStrength());
        p.setDisplayOrder(r.getDisplayOrder());
    }

    /**
     * Seeds the default DM plan and the ERP tiers.
     * Called from onApplicationReady() — never from the constructor.
     */
    private void seedDefaultsIfEmpty() {
        if (repo.countByAgreementType(TYPE_DIGITAL_MARKETING) == 0) {
            AgreementPlan dm = new AgreementPlan();
            dm.setAgreementType(TYPE_DIGITAL_MARKETING);
            dm.setPlanName("Standard Digital Marketing Plan");
            dm.setDescription(
                    "Social media management, Meta Ads, admission "
                            + "campaigns, creatives, admission dashboard (no cost).");
            dm.setFeeAmount(23000);
            dm.setDiscountAmount(7000);
            dm.setGstPercent(18);
            dm.setDisplayOrder(1);
            dm.setSystemPlan(true);
            dm.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());
            dm.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
            repo.save(dm);
        }

        if (repo.countByAgreementType(TYPE_ERP) == 0) {
            int[][] tiers = {
                    { 1, 150, 10000 },
                    { 151, 250, 12000 },
                    { 251, 400, 16000 },
                    { 401, 600, 22000 },
                    { 601, -1, 30000 },
            };
            int order = 1;
            for (int[] tier : tiers) {
                AgreementPlan erp = new AgreementPlan();
                erp.setAgreementType(TYPE_ERP);
                String label = tier[1] == -1
                        ? (tier[0] + "+ Students")
                        : (tier[0] + "-" + tier[1] + " Students");
                erp.setPlanName("ERP Plan – " + label);
                erp.setDescription("School ERP / web dashboard subscription for "
                        + label.toLowerCase() + ".");
                erp.setFeeAmount(tier[2]);
                erp.setGstPercent(18);
                erp.setMinStudentStrength(tier[0]);
                erp.setMaxStudentStrength(tier[1] == -1 ? null : tier[1]);
                erp.setDisplayOrder(order++);
                erp.setSystemPlan(true);
                erp.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());
                erp.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
                repo.save(erp);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Changes from the original:
//  - apply() now requires a planId, resolves the AgreementPlan, validates it
//    against the template's agreementType, computes pricing (never
//    hard-coded), and builds the full merge-field map the two templates in
//    AgreementTemplateBootstrapService need (agreement date, client name/

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.text.NumberFormat;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;

import org.springframework.messaging.simp.SimpMessagingTemplate;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.AgreementRequest;
