@Service
public class AgreementService {

    private final AgreementRepository repo;
    private final LeadRepository leads;
    private final AgreementTemplateRepository templates;
    private final AgreementPlanRepository plans;
    private final AgreementPdfService pdfService;
    private final TelecallerAccessService access;
    private final SimpMessagingTemplate ws;

    private static final DateTimeFormatter ISO_DATE = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE;

    public AgreementService(
            AgreementRepository r,
            LeadRepository l,
            AgreementTemplateRepository t,
            AgreementPlanRepository p,
            AgreementPdfService pdfService,
            TelecallerAccessService a,
            SimpMessagingTemplate w
    ) {
        repo = r;
        leads = l;
        templates = t;
        plans = p;
        this.pdfService = pdfService;
        access = a;
        ws = w;
    }

    private String user() {
        return access.currentUsername();
    }

    private boolean admin() {
        return SecurityContextHolder
                .getContext()
                .getAuthentication()
                .getAuthorities()
                .stream()
                .anyMatch(a ->
                        a.getAuthority().equals("ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN")
                                || a.getAuthority().equals("ROLE_ADMIN")
                );
    }

    /** Lists agreements. */
    public List<Agreement> list(String status, String telecaller, String leadId) {
        List<Agreement> agreements = admin()
                ? repo.findAllByOrderByCreatedAtDesc()
                : repo.findByCreatedByOrderByCreatedAtDesc(user());

        return agreements.stream()
                .filter(a -> status == null || status.isBlank()
                        || a.getStatus().name().equalsIgnoreCase(status)
                        || a.getStatus().name().replace('_', ' ').equalsIgnoreCase(status))
                .filter(a -> telecaller == null || telecaller.isBlank() || telecaller.equals(a.getCreatedBy()))
                .filter(a -> leadId == null || leadId.isBlank() || leadId.equals(a.getLeadId()))
                .toList();
    }

    /** Gets one agreement with access control. */
    public Agreement get(String id) {
        Agreement a = repo.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Agreement not found"));
        if (!admin() && !user().equals(a.getCreatedBy())) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException("Agreement access denied");
        }
        return a;
    }

    /** Creates agreement. */
    public Agreement create(AgreementRequest r) {
        Lead l = admin() ? lead(r.getLeadId()) : access.requireLeadAccess(r.getLeadId());

        Agreement a = new Agreement();
        a.setCreatedBy(user());
        a.setCreatedByName(user());
        a.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());

        apply(a, l, r);
        history(a, "Created agreement", null);
        Agreement saved = save(a);
        regeneratePdfBestEffort(saved);
        return saved;
    }

    /** Updates agreement. */
    public Agreement update(String id, AgreementRequest r) {
        Agreement a = get(id);

        if (!admin() && !Set.of(AgreementStatus.DRAFT, AgreementStatus.REJECTED).contains(a.getStatus())) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Only Draft or Rejected agreements can be edited");
        }

        Lead l = admin() ? lead(r.getLeadId()) : access.requireLeadAccess(r.getLeadId());

        apply(a, l, r);

        if (a.getStatus() == AgreementStatus.REJECTED) {
            a.setStatus(AgreementStatus.DRAFT);
        }

        a.setVersion(a.getVersion() + 1);
        history(a, "Updated agreement", null);
        Agreement saved = save(a);
        regeneratePdfBestEffort(saved);
        return saved;
    }

    /**
     * Preview — runs the exact same merge/pricing logic as create(), but
     * persists nothing. Used by the "Preview Agreement" step so the
     * telecaller can review the filled-in agreement before committing it.
     */
    public Map<String, Object> preview(AgreementRequest r) {
        Lead l = admin() ? lead(r.getLeadId()) : access.requireLeadAccess(r.getLeadId());
        Agreement scratch = new Agreement();
        apply(scratch, l, r);

        Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        result.put("contentHtml", scratch.getContentHtml());
        result.put("agreementType", scratch.getAgreementType());
        result.put("planName", scratch.getPlanName());
        result.put("feeAmount", scratch.getFeeAmount());
        result.put("discountAmount", scratch.getDiscountAmount());
        result.put("gstPercent", scratch.getGstPercent());
        result.put("gstAmount", scratch.getGstAmount());
        result.put("netPayable", scratch.getNetPayable());
        result.put("totalPayable", scratch.getTotalPayable());
        result.put("studentStrength", scratch.getStudentStrength());
        return result;
    }

    /** Deletes agreement. Super Admin can delete any; Telecaller only own Draft/Rejected. */
    public void delete(String id) {
        Agreement a = repo.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Agreement not found"));

        if (!admin()) {
            if (!user().equals(a.getCreatedBy())) {
                throw new AccessDeniedException("Agreement access denied");
            }
            if (!Set.of(AgreementStatus.DRAFT, AgreementStatus.REJECTED).contains(a.getStatus())) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Only Draft or Rejected agreements can be deleted");
            }
        }

        repo.delete(a);
        pdfService.deleteQuietly(a.getGeneratedPdfPath());

        try {
            ws.convertAndSend("/topic/agreements", Map.of("event", "DELETED", "id", id));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    /** Submits agreement for Super Admin approval. */
    public Agreement submit(String id) {
        Agreement a = get(id);

        if (admin() || !user().equals(a.getCreatedBy())) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException("Only the Telecaller who created the agreement can submit it");
        }
        if (!Set.of(AgreementStatus.DRAFT, AgreementStatus.REJECTED).contains(a.getStatus())) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Only Draft or Rejected agreements can be submitted");
        }

        a.setStatus(a.getSubmittedAt() == null ? AgreementStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL : AgreementStatus.RESUBMITTED);
        a.setSubmittedAt(Instant.now());
        a.setRejectionReason(null);

        history(a, a.getStatus() == AgreementStatus.RESUBMITTED ? "Resubmitted for approval" : "Submitted for Super Admin approval", null);
        return save(a);
    }

    /** Approves agreement. */
    public Agreement approve(String id, String remark) {
        requireAdmin();
        Agreement a = repo.findById(id).orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Agreement not found"));

        if (!Set.of(AgreementStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL, AgreementStatus.RESUBMITTED).contains(a.getStatus())) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Agreement is not waiting for approval");
        }

        a.setStatus(AgreementStatus.APPROVED);
        a.setApprovedBy(user());
        a.setApprovedAt(Instant.now());
        a.setApprovalRemark(remark);

        history(a, "Approved", remark);
        return save(a);
    }

    /** Rejects agreement. */
    public Agreement reject(String id, String reason) {
        requireAdmin();
        if (reason == null || reason.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rejection reason is required");
        }

        Agreement a = repo.findById(id).orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Agreement not found"));

        if (!Set.of(AgreementStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL, AgreementStatus.RESUBMITTED).contains(a.getStatus())) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Agreement is not waiting for approval");
        }

        a.setStatus(AgreementStatus.REJECTED);
        a.setRejectedBy(user());
        a.setRejectedAt(Instant.now());
        a.setRejectionReason(reason);

        history(a, "Rejected", reason);
        return save(a);
    }

    /** Sends approved agreement to lead. */
    public Agreement send(String id, String channel) {
        Agreement a = get(id);

        if (admin() || !user().equals(a.getCreatedBy())) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException("Only the creating Telecaller can send this agreement");
        }
        if (a.getStatus() != AgreementStatus.APPROVED) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Super Admin approval is mandatory before sending");
        }

        a.setStatus(AgreementStatus.SENT);
        a.setSentBy(user());
        a.setSentAt(Instant.now());
        a.setSentChannel(channel == null ? "WhatsApp" : channel);
        a.setSentTo(a.getPhone());

        history(a, "Sent to lead via " + a.getSentChannel(), null);
        return save(a);
    }

   
    public java.io.File pdfFile(String id) {
        Agreement a = get(id);
        regeneratePdfBestEffort(a);
        a = repo.save(a);
        if (a.getGeneratedPdfPath() == null || !new java.io.File(a.getGeneratedPdfPath()).exists()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to generate PDF for this agreement");
        }
        return new java.io.File(a.getGeneratedPdfPath());
    }
    private void regeneratePdfBestEffort(Agreement a) {
        try {
            String path = pdfService.generate(a);
            a.setGeneratedPdfPath(path);
            a.setGeneratedPdfFileName("Agreement_" + a.getId() + ".pdf");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Never block create/update on PDF rendering failure — the HTML
            // content is already saved and previewable; the PDF can be
            // regenerated on next GET /{id}/pdf.
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies request data + selected plan pricing to the agreement, then
     * merges everything into the template's contentHtml.
     */
    private void apply(Agreement a, Lead l, AgreementRequest r) {

        // Built-in category agreements (Digital Marketing / Admin Dashboard / Pro / Pro Plus / Pro Max):
        // the editable document is built in the browser, so no DB template / plan is needed.
        if (r.getTemplateId() != null && r.getTemplateId().startsWith("builtin-")) {
            applyBuiltin(a, l, r);
            return;
        }

        if (r.getTemplateId() == null || r.getTemplateId().isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Please select an agreement template");
        }
        AgreementTemplate t = templates.findById(r.getTemplateId())
                .filter(AgreementTemplate::isActive)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Selected template not found"));

        if (r.getPlanId() == null || r.getPlanId().isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Please select a plan");
        }
        AgreementPlan plan = plans.findById(r.getPlanId())
                .filter(AgreementPlan::isActive)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Selected plan not found"));

        String agreementType = t.getAgreementType() != null ? t.getAgreementType() : plan.getAgreementType();
        if (agreementType != null && plan.getAgreementType() != null
                && !agreementType.equalsIgnoreCase(plan.getAgreementType())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "The selected plan (" + plan.getAgreementType() + ") does not match the selected template ("
                            + agreementType + ")");
        }

        boolean isErp = "ERP".equalsIgnoreCase(agreementType);

        // ---- client details (lead-derived, overridable by the form) ----
        String formClientName = r.getMergeValues() == null ? null : r.getMergeValues().get("client_name");
        String formClientAddress = r.getMergeValues() == null ? null : r.getMergeValues().get("client_address");

        a.setLeadId(l.getLeadId());
        a.setClientName(nonBlank(formClientName, l.getSchool(), l.getName()));
        a.setOrganization(nonBlank(l.getSchool(), l.getName()));
        a.setEmail(l.getEmail());
        a.setPhone(nonBlank(l.getMobile(), l.getPhoneNumber()));
        a.setAddress(nonBlank(formClientAddress, l.getSchoolAddress(), l.getArea()));
        a.setPincode(n(r.getPincode()));

        a.setTemplateId(t.getId());
        a.setAgreementType(agreementType);
        a.setTitle(blank(r.getTitle()) ? t.getName() : r.getTitle());

        String agreementDate = blank(r.getAgreementDate()) ? LocalDate.now().format(ISO_DATE) : r.getAgreementDate();
        a.setAgreementDate(agreementDate);
        a.setAuthorizedPersonName(n(r.getAuthorizedPersonName()));
        a.setAuthorizedPersonDesignation(n(r.getAuthorizedPersonDesignation()));

        // ---- pricing, resolved from the plan, never hard-coded ----
        a.setPlanId(plan.getId());
        a.setPlanName(plan.getPlanName());
        a.setGstPercent(plan.getGstPercent());

        Map<String, String> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (r.getMergeValues() != null) m.putAll(r.getMergeValues());

        m.put("agreement_date", displayDate(agreementDate));
        m.put("signature_date", displayDate(agreementDate));
        m.put("client_name", n(a.getClientName()));
        m.put("client_address", n(a.getAddress()));
        m.put("pincode", n(a.getPincode()));
        m.put("authorized_person_name", n(a.getAuthorizedPersonName()));
        m.put("authorized_person_designation", n(a.getAuthorizedPersonDesignation()));
        m.put("plan_name", n(plan.getPlanName()));
        m.put("gst_percent", trimNum(plan.getGstPercent()));

        if (isErp) {
            Integer strength = r.getStudentStrength();
            if (strength == null || strength <= 0) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Please enter the student strength");
            }
            if (plan.getMinStudentStrength() != null && strength < plan.getMinStudentStrength()
                    || plan.getMaxStudentStrength() != null && strength > plan.getMaxStudentStrength()) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Student strength (" + strength + ") is outside the range for plan \"" + plan.getPlanName() + "\"");
            }
            a.setStudentStrength(strength);

            double fee = plan.getFeeAmount();
            double gst = round2(fee * plan.getGstPercent() / 100.0);
            double total = round2(fee + gst);

            a.setFeeAmount(fee);
            a.setGstAmount(gst);
            a.setTotalPayable(total);

            m.put("student_strength", String.valueOf(strength));
            m.put("subscription_fee", money(fee));
            m.put("gst_amount", money(gst));
            m.put("total_payable", money(total));
        } else {
            double fee = plan.getFeeAmount();
            double discount = r.getDiscountOverride() != null ? Math.max(0, r.getDiscountOverride()) : plan.getDiscountAmount();
            double net = round2(Math.max(0, fee - discount));

            a.setFeeAmount(fee);
            a.setDiscountAmount(discount);
            a.setNetPayable(net);

            m.put("yearly_fee", money(fee));
            m.put("discount_amount", money(discount));
            m.put("net_payable", money(net));
        }

        String source = blank(r.getContentHtml()) ? t.getContentHtml() : r.getContentHtml();
        a.setContentHtml(merge(source, m));

        a.setHeaderHtml(r.getHeaderHtml());
        a.setFooterHtml(r.getFooterHtml());
        a.setLogoDataUrl(r.getLogoDataUrl());
        a.setLetterPadDataUrl(r.getLetterPadDataUrl());
        a.setMergeValues(m);
        a.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
    }


    /** Built-in (WYSIWYG-edited) agreement: stores the edited document exactly as sent. */
    private void applyBuiltin(Agreement a, Lead l, AgreementRequest r) {
        if (blank(r.getContentHtml())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Agreement content is empty");
        }
        Map<String, String> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (r.getMergeValues() != null) m.putAll(r.getMergeValues());

        a.setLeadId(l.getLeadId());
        a.setClientName(nonBlank(m.get("client_name"), l.getSchool(), l.getName()));
        a.setOrganization(nonBlank(l.getSchool(), l.getName()));
        a.setEmail(l.getEmail());
        a.setPhone(nonBlank(l.getMobile(), l.getPhoneNumber()));
        a.setAddress(nonBlank(m.get("client_address"), l.getSchoolAddress(), l.getArea()));
        a.setPincode(n(r.getPincode()));

        a.setTemplateId(r.getTemplateId());
        a.setAgreementType(nonBlank(r.getAgreementType(), "ERP"));
        a.setServiceType(n(r.getServiceType()));
        a.setPlanId(null);
        a.setPlanName(n(r.getServiceType()));
        a.setTitle(blank(r.getTitle()) ? n(r.getServiceType()) + " Agreement" : r.getTitle());

        String agreementDate = blank(r.getAgreementDate()) ? LocalDate.now().format(ISO_DATE) : r.getAgreementDate();
        a.setAgreementDate(agreementDate);
        a.setAuthorizedPersonName(n(r.getAuthorizedPersonName()));
        a.setAuthorizedPersonDesignation(n(r.getAuthorizedPersonDesignation()));

        m.put("agreement_date", displayDate(agreementDate));
        a.setContentHtml(r.getContentHtml());      // no {{merge}} - content is final
        a.setHeaderHtml(null);
        a.setFooterHtml(null);
        a.setMergeValues(m);
        a.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
    }

    private String displayDate(String isoDate) {
        try {
            return LocalDate.parse(isoDate, ISO_DATE).format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd-MM-yyyy"));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return isoDate;
        }
    }

    private static double round2(double v) {
        return Math.round(v * 100.0) / 100.0;
    }

    private String money(double v) {
        NumberFormat nf = NumberFormat.getIntegerInstance(new Locale("en", "IN"));
        return nf.format(Math.round(v));
    }

    private String trimNum(double v) {
        return v == Math.floor(v) ? String.valueOf((long) v) : String.valueOf(v);
    }

    /** Replaces {{variable}} with merge values. Values are HTML/XML-escaped
     * on the way in — they're plain data (client names, addresses, etc.),
     * never markup, and openhtmltopdf parses the final document as strict
     * XML, so an unescaped "&" or "<" in e.g. a school name like "R&D Public
     * School" would break PDF generation the same way the named entities in
     * the static template text did (see AgreementPdfService.normalizeEntities). */
    private String merge(String html, Map<String, String> values) {
        if (html == null) return "";
        Matcher m = Pattern.compile("\\{\\{\\s*([^{}\\s]+)\\s*\\}\\}").matcher(html);
        StringBuffer out = new StringBuffer();
        while (m.find()) {
            String value = escapeXml(values.getOrDefault(m.group(1), ""));
            m.appendReplacement(out, Matcher.quoteReplacement(value));
        }
        m.appendTail(out);
        return out.toString();
    }

    private String escapeXml(String v) {
        if (v == null) return "";
        return v.replace("&", "&amp;")
                .replace("<", "&lt;")
                .replace(">", "&gt;")
                .replace("\"", "&quot;");
    }

    private String nonBlank(String... values) {
        for (String value : values) {
            if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) return value;
        }
        return "";
    }

    private boolean blank(String value) {
        return value == null || value.isBlank();
    }

    private String n(String value) {
        return value == null ? "" : value;
    }

    private Lead lead(String id) {
        return leads.findByLeadId(id).orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Lead not found"));
    }

    private void requireAdmin() {
        if (!admin()) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException("Only Super Admin can approve or reject agreements");
        }
    }

    /** Adds agreement history. */
    private void history(Agreement a, String action, String remarks) {
        AgreementHistory h = new AgreementHistory();
        h.setAction(action);
        h.setActor(user());
        h.setActorRole(admin() ? "SUPER_ADMIN" : "TELECALLER");
        h.setRemarks(remarks);
        h.setStatus(a.getStatus().name());
        h.setAt(Instant.now());
        h.setVersion(a.getVersion());
        a.getHistory().add(h);
    }

    /** Saves agreement and broadcasts WebSocket update. */
    private Agreement save(Agreement a) {
        Agreement saved = repo.save(a);
        try {
            ws.convertAndSend("/topic/agreements", saved);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
        return saved;
    }
}

// Fixes:
//  1. Argument order bug (see AgreementTemplateService) that stored the
//     literal string "PDF" as contentHtml for both templates.

//     AgreementService can substitute the values entered on the Add
//     Agreement form / the values from the selected AgreementPlan.

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\service\AgreementTemplateService.java =====
// FILE: src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/service/AgreementTemplateService.java
// REPLACES existing file.
//
// FIX: the old createSystemTemplate(name, contentHtml, type) was being called
// by the bootstrap as createSystemTemplate(name, "PDF", <html>) — i.e. the
// literal string "PDF" was stored as contentHtml, and the real HTML template
// ended up in the "type" field. Every agreement generated from either system
// template therefore rendered as just the word "PDF". This version fixes the
// signature/call order AND makes system-template installs version-aware, so
// the corrected content actually reaches existing installs on next boot
// instead of being skipped by the old "never overwrite" guard.
package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.AgreementTemplate;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.AgreementTemplateRepository;

@Service
public class AgreementTemplateService {

    private final AgreementTemplateRepository repo;
    private final TelecallerAccessService access;

    public AgreementTemplateService(
            AgreementTemplateRepository r,
            TelecallerAccessService a
    ) {
        repo = r;
        access = a;
    }

    public List<AgreementTemplate> list() {
        return repo.findByActiveTrueOrderByCreatedAtDesc();
    }

    /** Templates for one agreement flow — "ERP" or "DIGITAL_MARKETING". */
    public List<AgreementTemplate> listByType(String agreementType) {
        if (agreementType == null || agreementType.isBlank()) return list();
        return repo.findByAgreementTypeAndActiveTrueOrderByCreatedAtDesc(agreementType.trim().toUpperCase());
    }

    public AgreementTemplate get(String id) {
        return repo.findById(id)
                .filter(AgreementTemplate::isActive)
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new IllegalArgumentException("Template not found"));
    }

    /**
     * Creates a normal HTML template manually.
     */
    public AgreementTemplate create(
            String name,
            String contentHtml
    ) {
        if (name == null || name.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Template name is required"
            );
        }

        if (contentHtml == null || contentHtml.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Template content is required"
            );
        }

        AgreementTemplate t = new AgreementTemplate();

        t.setName(name.trim());
        t.setContentHtml(contentHtml);
        t.setContentType("text/html");
        t.setSourceType("HTML");

        t.setCreatedBy(access.currentUsername());
        t.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());
        t.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());

        return repo.save(t);
    }

    /**
     * Creates (or version-upgrades) a system/default template.
     *
     * Used only by AgreementTemplateBootstrapService on startup.
     *
     * Behaviour:
     *  - No template with this name yet            -> create it fresh.
     *  - Template exists, is still a system template,
     *    and its stored templateVersion is OLDER
     *    than `version`                            -> overwrite contentHtml/
     *                                                  agreementType/version
     *                                                  (self-heals bad
     *                                                  installs like the
     *                                                  "PDF" bug above).
     *  - Template exists but an admin has edited it
     *    by hand (systemTemplate flipped to false,
     *    e.g. via the template editor UI)           -> left untouched.
     *  - Template exists and is already at/above
     *    `version`                                  -> left untouched.
     *
     * @param name          Template name (also the upsert key)
     * @param agreementType "ERP" or "DIGITAL_MARKETING"
     * @param version       Bump this whenever contentHtml below changes
     * @param contentHtml   The HTML content
     */
    public AgreementTemplate createSystemTemplate(
            String name,
            String agreementType,
            int version,
            String contentHtml
    ) {
        if (name == null || name.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("System template name is required");
        }
        if (contentHtml == null || contentHtml.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("System template content is required");
        }

        String templateName = name.trim();

        Optional<AgreementTemplate> existing = repo.findByNameIgnoreCase(templateName);

        if (existing.isPresent()) {
            AgreementTemplate t = existing.get();

            boolean handEdited = !t.isSystemTemplate();
            boolean upToDate = t.getTemplateVersion() >= version;

            if (handEdited || upToDate) {
                return t;
            }

            t.setContentHtml(contentHtml);
            t.setAgreementType(agreementType);
            t.setTemplateVersion(version);
            t.setContentType("text/html");
            t.setSourceType("SYSTEM");
            t.setActive(true);
            t.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
            return repo.save(t);
        }

        AgreementTemplate t = new AgreementTemplate();
        t.setName(templateName);
        t.setContentHtml(contentHtml);
        t.setContentType("text/html");
        t.setSourceType("SYSTEM");
        t.setAgreementType(agreementType);
        t.setTemplateVersion(version);
        t.setSystemTemplate(true);
        t.setCreatedBy("SYSTEM");
        t.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());
        t.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        return repo.save(t);
    }

    /**
     * Uploads a template file.
     */
    public AgreementTemplate upload(
            String name,
            String contentHtml,
            MultipartFile file
    ) throws Exception {

        if (file == null || file.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Template file is required"
            );
        }

        String fn = Optional
                .ofNullable(file.getOriginalFilename())
                .orElse("");

        String ext = fn.contains(".")
                ? fn.substring(fn.lastIndexOf('.')).toLowerCase()
                : "";

        if (!Set.of(
                ".doc",
                ".docx",
                ".pdf",
                ".jpg",
                ".jpeg",
                ".png"
        ).contains(ext)) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Only DOC, DOCX, PDF, JPG, JPEG and PNG templates are supported"
            );
        }

        if (file.getSize() > 10L * 1024 * 1024) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Template maximum size is 10 MB"
            );
        }

        AgreementTemplate t = new AgreementTemplate();

        t.setName(
                name == null || name.isBlank()
                        ? fn
                        : name.trim()
        );

        t.setFileName(fn);
        t.setContentType(file.getContentType());

        t.setSourceType(
                ext.substring(1).toUpperCase()
        );

        t.setContentHtml(
                contentHtml == null
                        ? ""
                        : contentHtml
        );

        t.setOriginalFile(file.getBytes());

        t.setCreatedBy(
                access.currentUsername()
        );

        t.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());
        t.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());

        return repo.save(t);
    }

    /**
     * Updates HTML content.
     */
    public AgreementTemplate updateHtml(
            String id,
            String html
    ) {

        if (html == null || html.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Template content is required"
            );
        }

        AgreementTemplate t = get(id);

        t.setContentHtml(html);
        // A manual edit means the bootstrap must never overwrite this again.
        t.setSystemTemplate(false);
        t.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());

        return repo.save(t);
    }

    /**
     * Renames a template.
     */
    public AgreementTemplate rename(
            String id,
            String name
    ) {

        if (name == null || name.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Template name is required"
            );
        }

        AgreementTemplate t = get(id);

        t.setName(name.trim());
        t.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());

        return repo.save(t);
    }

    /**
     * Soft delete / archive template.
     */
    public void archive(String id) {

        AgreementTemplate t = get(id);

        t.setActive(false);
        t.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());

        repo.save(t);
    }
}

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\service\AttendanceService.java =====
package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.time.*;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import org.springframework.dao.DuplicateKeyException;
import org.springframework.messaging.simp.SimpMessagingTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.*;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.*;

@Service
public class AttendanceService {
    public static final ZoneId ZONE = ZoneId.of("Asia/Kolkata");
    private static final LocalTime PRESENT_FROM = LocalTime.of(9, 30);
    private static final LocalTime LATE_AFTER = LocalTime.of(10, 30);
    private static final LocalTime HALF_DAY_SWITCH = LocalTime.of(13, 30);
    private static final Duration HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT = Duration.ofSeconds(50);
    private static final DateTimeFormatter DATE = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE;

    private final AttendanceRepository attendanceRepository;
    private final AttendanceSessionRepository sessionRepository;
    private final AttendanceAuditLogRepository auditRepository;
    private final LeavePermissionRequestRepository requestRepository;
    private final TelecallerRepository telecallerRepository;
    private final SimpMessagingTemplate messagingTemplate;

    public AttendanceService(AttendanceRepository attendanceRepository,
                             AttendanceSessionRepository sessionRepository,
                             AttendanceAuditLogRepository auditRepository,
                             LeavePermissionRequestRepository requestRepository,
                             TelecallerRepository telecallerRepository,
                             SimpMessagingTemplate messagingTemplate) {
        this.attendanceRepository = attendanceRepository;
        this.sessionRepository = sessionRepository;
        this.auditRepository = auditRepository;
        this.requestRepository = requestRepository;
        this.telecallerRepository = telecallerRepository;
        this.messagingTemplate = messagingTemplate;
    }

    public String currentUsername() {
        Authentication auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
        if (auth == null || !auth.isAuthenticated() || auth.getName() == null) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException("Authentication required");
        }
        return auth.getName();
    }

    public boolean isTelecaller(Authentication auth) {
        return auth != null && auth.getAuthorities().stream().anyMatch(a ->
            "ROLE_TELECALLER".equalsIgnoreCase(a.getAuthority()) ||
            "ROLE_TELE_CALLER".equalsIgnoreCase(a.getAuthority()));
    }

    private Telecaller currentTelecaller() {
        return telecallerRepository.findByUsername(currentUsername())
            .orElseThrow(() -> new AccessDeniedException("Telecaller account not found"));
    }

    @Transactional
    public Map<String,Object> login(String username, String deviceInfo, String ipAddress) {
        Telecaller tc = telecallerRepository.findByUsername(username)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new AccessDeniedException("Telecaller account not found"));
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        String date = LocalDate.now(ZONE).format(DATE);
        AttendanceRecord attendance = findOrCreate(tc, date, now);
        if (attendance.getFirstLoginAt() == null) attendance.setFirstLoginAt(now);
        attendance.setUpdatedAt(now);

        // Every explicit successful login creates a new session. The daily
        // attendance record is never recreated because its unique key is
        // employeeId + date. Network recovery uses /reconnect instead.
        AttendanceSession session = new AttendanceSession();
        session.setEmployeeId(tc.getEmployeeId());
        session.setUsername(username);
        session.setAttendanceId(attendance.getId());
        session.setLoginAt(now);
        session.setLastHeartbeatAt(now);
        session.setLastActiveAt(now);
        session.setConnected(true);
        session.setManuallyLoggedOut(false);
        session.setDeviceInfo(deviceInfo);
        session.setIpAddress(ipAddress);
        sessionRepository.save(session);
        attendance.setSessionCount(attendance.getSessionCount() + 1);
        attendance.setCurrentSessionId(session.getId());
        attendance.setOnline(true);
        attendance.setDisconnected(false);
        refreshAttendance(attendance, now);
        attendanceRepository.save(attendance);
        publish(attendance);
        return dashboard(attendance, now);
    }

    @Transactional
    public Map<String,Object> manualLogout(String username) {
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        String date = LocalDate.now(ZONE).format(DATE);
        AttendanceRecord attendance = findByUsernameDate(username, date).orElse(null);
        if (attendance == null) return Map.of("serverNow", now.toString(), "status", "Not Marked");
        AttendanceSession session = sessionRepository
            .findFirstByUsernameAndConnectedTrueAndManuallyLoggedOutFalseOrderByLoginAtDesc(username)
            .orElse(null);
        if (session != null) {
            accumulateSession(session, now);
            session.setLogoutAt(now);
            session.setConnected(false);
            session.setManuallyLoggedOut(true);
            sessionRepository.save(session);
            attendance.setLastLogoutAt(now);
        }
        attendance.setOnline(false);
        attendance.setDisconnected(false);
        attendance.setCurrentSessionId(null);
        refreshAttendance(attendance, now);
        attendanceRepository.save(attendance);
        publish(attendance);
        return dashboard(attendance, now);
    }

    @Transactional
    public Map<String,Object> heartbeat(String username) {
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        AttendanceSession session = sessionRepository
            .findFirstByUsernameAndConnectedTrueAndManuallyLoggedOutFalseOrderByLoginAtDesc(username)
            .orElse(null);
        if (session == null) return reconnect(username, null, null, true);
        accumulateSession(session, now);
        session.setLastHeartbeatAt(now);
        session.setLastActiveAt(now);
        session.setConnected(true);
        sessionRepository.save(session);
        AttendanceRecord attendance = attendanceRepository.findById(session.getAttendanceId()).orElse(null);
        if (attendance == null) return Map.of("serverNow", now.toString(), "status", "Not Marked");
        attendance.setOnline(true);
        attendance.setDisconnected(false);
        refreshAttendance(attendance, now);
        attendanceRepository.save(attendance);
        publish(attendance);
        return dashboard(attendance, now);
    }

    @Transactional
    public Map<String,Object> reconnect(String username, String deviceInfo, String ipAddress, boolean fromHeartbeat) {
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        String date = LocalDate.now(ZONE).format(DATE);
        AttendanceRecord attendance = findByUsernameDate(username, date).orElse(null);
        if (attendance == null) {
            Telecaller tc = telecallerRepository.findByUsername(username)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AccessDeniedException("Telecaller account not found"));
            attendance = findOrCreate(tc, date, now);
        }
        AttendanceSession session = sessionRepository
            .findByAttendanceIdOrderByLoginAtAsc(attendance.getId()).stream()
            .filter(s -> !s.isManuallyLoggedOut() && s.getLogoutAt() == null)
            .max(Comparator.comparing(AttendanceSession::getLoginAt))
            .orElse(null);
        if (session == null) {
            return login(username, deviceInfo, ipAddress);
        }
        if (session.getDisconnectAt() != null && (session.getReconnectAt() == null || session.getDisconnectAt().isAfter(session.getReconnectAt()))) { session.setDisconnectSeconds(session.getDisconnectSeconds() + Math.max(0, Duration.between(session.getDisconnectAt(), now).getSeconds())); }
        session.setConnected(true);
        session.setReconnectAt(now);
        session.setLastHeartbeatAt(now);
        session.setLastActiveAt(now);
        if (deviceInfo != null) session.setDeviceInfo(deviceInfo);
        if (ipAddress != null) session.setIpAddress(ipAddress);
        sessionRepository.save(session);
        attendance.setCurrentSessionId(session.getId());
        attendance.setOnline(true);
        attendance.setDisconnected(false);
        addNetworkEvent(attendance, "RECONNECT @ " + now);
        refreshAttendance(attendance, now);
        attendanceRepository.save(attendance);
        publish(attendance);
        return dashboard(attendance, now);
    }

    public Map<String,Object> today(String username) {
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        String date = LocalDate.now(ZONE).format(DATE);
        AttendanceRecord attendance = findByUsernameDate(username, date).orElse(null);
        if (attendance == null) return Map.of("serverNow", now.toString(), "date", date, "status", "Not Marked", "workingSeconds", 0L, "online", false, "sessions", List.of(), "audits", List.of());
        refreshAttendance(attendance, now);
        attendanceRepository.save(attendance);
        return dashboard(attendance, now);
    }

    public List<Map<String,Object>> mine(String username) {
        return attendanceRepository.findByEmployeeIdOrderByDateDesc(currentEmployeeId(username)).stream()
            .map(a -> dashboard(a, Instant.now())).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    public List<Map<String,Object>> admin(String date) {
        String targetDate = (date == null || date.isBlank()) ? LocalDate.now(ZONE).format(DATE) : date;
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        List<AttendanceRecord> records = attendanceRepository.findAllByDateOrderByFirstLoginAtAsc(targetDate);
        Map<String,AttendanceRecord> byEmployee = records.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(AttendanceRecord::getEmployeeId, a -> a, (a,b)->a, LinkedHashMap::new));
        List<Map<String,Object>> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Telecaller tc : telecallerRepository.findAll()) {
            AttendanceRecord a = byEmployee.get(tc.getEmployeeId());
            if (a == null) {
                Map<String,Object> empty = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                empty.put("employeeId", tc.getEmployeeId()); empty.put("username", tc.getUsername());
                empty.put("fullName", tc.getFullName()); empty.put("date", targetDate); empty.put("status", emptyStatus(tc.getUsername(), targetDate, now));
                empty.put("firstLoginAt", null); empty.put("lastLogoutAt", null); empty.put("workingSeconds", 0L);
                empty.put("online", false); empty.put("sessionCount", 0); empty.put("sessions", List.of()); empty.put("permission", null); empty.put("leave", null);
                result.add(empty);
            } else {
                refreshAttendance(a, now); attendanceRepository.save(a); result.add(dashboard(a, now));
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public Map<String,Object> adminDetail(String id) {
        AttendanceRecord a = attendanceRepository.findById(id).orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Attendance not found"));
        Instant now = Instant.now(); refreshAttendance(a, now); attendanceRepository.save(a);
        Map<String,Object> d = dashboard(a, now);
        d.put("audits", auditRepository.findByAttendanceIdOrderByChangedAtDesc(id));
        return d;
    }

    @Transactional
    public Map<String,Object> adminEdit(String id, Map<String,Object> body) {
        AttendanceRecord a = attendanceRepository.findById(id).orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Attendance not found"));
        String admin = currentUsername();
        String reason = Objects.toString(body.get("reason"), "Super Admin attendance correction");
        applyAudit(a, "status", body.get("status"), reason, admin);
        applyAudit(a, "firstLoginAt", body.get("firstLoginAt"), reason, admin);
        applyAudit(a, "lastLogoutAt", body.get("lastLogoutAt"), reason, admin);
        applyAudit(a, "remarks", body.get("remarks"), reason, admin);
        applyAudit(a, "totalWorkingSeconds", body.get("workingSeconds"), reason, admin);
        if (body.containsKey("status")) { String requested=Objects.toString(body.get("status"), null); if ("AUTO".equalsIgnoreCase(requested)) { a.setManuallyOverridden(false); a.setManualOverrideStatus(null); } else { a.setManuallyOverridden(true); a.setManualOverrideStatus(requested); a.setStatus(requested); } }
        if (body.containsKey("firstLoginAt")) a.setFirstLoginAt(parseInstant(body.get("firstLoginAt")));
        if (body.containsKey("lastLogoutAt")) a.setLastLogoutAt(parseInstant(body.get("lastLogoutAt")));
        if (body.containsKey("remarks")) a.setRemarks(Objects.toString(body.get("remarks"), ""));
        if (body.containsKey("workingSeconds")) a.setTotalWorkingSeconds(Long.parseLong(String.valueOf(body.get("workingSeconds"))));
        a.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now()); attendanceRepository.save(a); publish(a);
        return adminDetail(a.getId());
    }

    public List<AttendanceAuditLog> audits(String id) { return auditRepository.findByAttendanceIdOrderByChangedAtDesc(id); }
    public List<AttendanceSession> sessions(String id) { return sessionRepository.findByAttendanceIdOrderByLoginAtAsc(id); }

    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 15000)
    public void reconcile() {
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        for (AttendanceSession s : sessionRepository.findAll()) {
            if (s.isConnected() && !s.isManuallyLoggedOut() && s.getLastHeartbeatAt() != null && Duration.between(s.getLastHeartbeatAt(), now).compareTo(HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT) > 0) {
                accumulateSession(s, now);
                s.setConnected(false); s.setDisconnectAt(now); sessionRepository.save(s);
                attendanceRepository.findById(s.getAttendanceId()).ifPresent(a -> {
                    a.setOnline(false); a.setDisconnected(true); addNetworkEvent(a, "DISCONNECT @ " + now); refreshAttendance(a, now); attendanceRepository.save(a); publish(a);
                });
            }
        }
        attendanceRepository.findAllByDateOrderByFirstLoginAtAsc(LocalDate.now(ZONE).format(DATE)).forEach(a -> { refreshAttendance(a, now); attendanceRepository.save(a); publish(a); });
    }

    private AttendanceRecord findOrCreate(Telecaller tc, String date, Instant now) {
        try {
            return attendanceRepository.findByEmployeeIdAndDate(tc.getEmployeeId(), date).orElseGet(() -> {
                AttendanceRecord a = new AttendanceRecord(); a.setEmployeeId(tc.getEmployeeId()); a.setUsername(tc.getUsername());
                a.setFullName(tc.getFullName()); a.setDate(date); a.setStatus("Present"); a.setCreatedAt(now); a.setUpdatedAt(now); return attendanceRepository.save(a);
            });
        } catch (DuplicateKeyException ex) {
            return attendanceRepository.findByEmployeeIdAndDate(tc.getEmployeeId(), date).orElseThrow();
        }
    }

    private Optional<AttendanceRecord> findByUsernameDate(String username, String date) {
        return telecallerRepository.findByUsername(username).flatMap(tc -> attendanceRepository.findByEmployeeIdAndDate(tc.getEmployeeId(), date));
    }

    private String currentEmployeeId(String username) {
        return telecallerRepository.findByUsername(username).map(Telecaller::getEmployeeId).orElseThrow(() -> new AccessDeniedException("Telecaller account not found"));
    }

    private void accumulateSession(AttendanceSession s, Instant now) {
        if (s.getLastActiveAt() != null && s.isConnected()) {
            long sec = Math.max(0, Duration.between(s.getLastActiveAt(), now).getSeconds());
            s.setActiveSeconds(s.getActiveSeconds() + sec);
        }
        s.setLastActiveAt(now);
    }

    private void refreshAttendance(AttendanceRecord a, Instant now) {
        if (a.isManuallyOverridden() && a.getManualOverrideStatus() != null) { a.setStatus(a.getManualOverrideStatus()); return; }
        List<LeavePermissionRequest> approved = requestRepository.findByUsernameOrderBySubmittedAtDesc(a.getUsername()).stream()
            .filter(r -> "Approved".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getStatus()) && appliesToDate(r, a.getDate())).toList();
        LeavePermissionRequest leave = approved.stream().filter(r -> "Leave".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getType()) && leaveActive(r, now)).findFirst().orElse(null);
        LeavePermissionRequest permission = approved.stream().filter(r -> "Permission".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getType()) && permissionActive(r, now)).findFirst().orElse(null);
        if (leave != null) a.setStatus("Leave");
        else if (permission != null) a.setStatus("Permission");
        else if (a.getFirstLoginAt() == null) a.setStatus("Absent");
        else {
            LocalTime loginTime = a.getFirstLoginAt().atZone(ZONE).toLocalTime();
            boolean coveredAtLogin = approved.stream().filter(r -> "Permission".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getType())).anyMatch(r -> permissionCovers(r, a.getFirstLoginAt()));
            boolean leaveCoveredAtLogin = approved.stream().filter(r -> "Leave".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getType())).anyMatch(r -> leaveCovers(r, a.getFirstLoginAt()));
            a.setStatus((coveredAtLogin || leaveCoveredAtLogin) ? "Present" : (loginTime.isAfter(LATE_AFTER) ? "Late" : "Present"));
        }
        long work = calculateWorkingSeconds(a, now, approved);
        a.setTotalWorkingSeconds(work);
        a.setUpdatedAt(now);
    }

    private long calculateWorkingSeconds(AttendanceRecord a, Instant now, List<LeavePermissionRequest> requests) {
        long total = 0;
        for (AttendanceSession s : sessionRepository.findByAttendanceIdOrderByLoginAtAsc(a.getId())) {
            if (s.getLoginAt() == null) continue;
            Instant end = s.getLogoutAt() != null ? s.getLogoutAt() : (s.isConnected() ? now : s.getDisconnectAt());
            if (end == null || end.isBefore(s.getLoginAt())) continue;
            // Use elapsed connected time, then remove approved permission/leave overlap.
            total += netWorkingSeconds(s.getLoginAt(), end, requests);
            total = Math.max(0, total - s.getDisconnectSeconds());
        }
        return Math.max(0, total);
    }

    private long netWorkingSeconds(Instant start, Instant end, List<LeavePermissionRequest> requests) {
        List<Interval> exclusions = new ArrayList<>();
        for (LeavePermissionRequest r : requests) {
            if ("Permission".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getType())) { Interval i = permissionInterval(r); if (i != null) exclusions.add(i); }
            if ("Leave".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getType())) { Interval i = leaveInterval(r); if (i != null) exclusions.add(i); }
        }
        List<Interval> merged = merge(exclusions);
        long excluded = 0;
        for (Interval i : merged) {
            Instant s = start.isAfter(i.start) ? start : i.start;
            Instant e = end.isBefore(i.end) ? end : i.end;
            if (e.isAfter(s)) excluded += Duration.between(s,e).getSeconds();
        }
        return Math.max(0, Duration.between(start,end).getSeconds() - excluded);
    }

    private List<Interval> merge(List<Interval> items) {
        items.sort(Comparator.comparing(x -> x.start)); List<Interval> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Interval i : items) { if (out.isEmpty() || i.start.isAfter(out.get(out.size()-1).end)) out.add(i); else if (i.end.isAfter(out.get(out.size()-1).end)) out.get(out.size()-1).end=i.end; }
        return out;
    }
    private static class Interval { Instant start,end; Interval(Instant s, Instant e){start=s;end=e;} }

    private String emptyStatus(String username, String date, Instant now) {
        List<LeavePermissionRequest> approved=requestRepository.findByUsernameOrderBySubmittedAtDesc(username).stream().filter(r->"Approved".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getStatus())&&appliesToDate(r,date)).toList();
        if (approved.stream().anyMatch(r->"Leave".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getType())&&leaveActive(r,now))) return "Leave";
        if (approved.stream().anyMatch(r->"Permission".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getType())&&permissionActive(r,now))) return "Permission";
        return "Absent";
    }

    private boolean appliesToDate(LeavePermissionRequest r, String date) {
        if ("Permission".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getType())) return date.equals(r.getDate());
        if (r.getFromDate()==null || r.getToDate()==null) return false;
        try {
            LocalDate attendanceDate = LocalDate.parse(date);
            LocalDate fromDate = LocalDate.parse(r.getFromDate());
            LocalDate toDate = LocalDate.parse(r.getToDate());
            return !attendanceDate.isBefore(fromDate) && !attendanceDate.isAfter(toDate);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    private boolean permissionActive(LeavePermissionRequest r, Instant now) { Interval i=permissionInterval(r); return i!=null && !now.isBefore(i.start) && now.isBefore(i.end); }
    private boolean permissionCovers(LeavePermissionRequest r, Instant at) { Interval i=permissionInterval(r); return i!=null && !at.isBefore(i.start) && at.isBefore(i.end); }
    private Interval permissionInterval(LeavePermissionRequest r) { try { LocalDate d=LocalDate.parse(r.getDate()); return new Interval(d.atTime(LocalTime.parse(r.getFromTime())).atZone(ZONE).toInstant(), d.atTime(LocalTime.parse(r.getToTime())).atZone(ZONE).toInstant()); } catch(Exception e){return null;} }
    private boolean leaveActive(LeavePermissionRequest r, Instant now) { Interval i=leaveInterval(r); return i!=null && !now.isBefore(i.start) && now.isBefore(i.end); }
    private boolean leaveCovers(LeavePermissionRequest r, Instant at) { Interval i=leaveInterval(r); return i!=null && !at.isBefore(i.start) && at.isBefore(i.end); }
    private Interval leaveInterval(LeavePermissionRequest r) {
        try {
            LocalDate from=LocalDate.parse(r.getFromDate()), to=LocalDate.parse(r.getToDate());
            LocalTime st=LocalTime.MIDNIGHT, en=LocalTime.MAX;
            String type=(r.getLeaveType()==null?"":r.getLeaveType()).toLowerCase();
            if (type.contains("morning")) { st=LocalTime.MIDNIGHT; en=HALF_DAY_SWITCH; }
            else if (type.contains("afternoon")) { st=HALF_DAY_SWITCH; en=LocalTime.MAX; }
            else if (type.contains("half")) { st=HALF_DAY_SWITCH; en=LocalTime.MAX; }
            return new Interval(from.atTime(st).atZone(ZONE).toInstant(), to.atTime(en).atZone(ZONE).toInstant());
        } catch(Exception e){return null;}
    }

    private void applyAudit(AttendanceRecord a, String field, Object value, String reason, String admin) {
        if (value == null) return;
        String newValue = String.valueOf(value), oldValue = switch(field) {
            case "status" -> a.getStatus(); case "firstLoginAt" -> String.valueOf(a.getFirstLoginAt()); case "lastLogoutAt" -> String.valueOf(a.getLastLogoutAt());
            case "remarks" -> a.getRemarks(); case "totalWorkingSeconds" -> String.valueOf(a.getTotalWorkingSeconds()); default -> "";
        };
        if (Objects.equals(oldValue,newValue)) return;
        AttendanceAuditLog log=new AttendanceAuditLog(); log.setAttendanceId(a.getId()); log.setEmployeeId(a.getEmployeeId()); log.setUsername(a.getUsername()); log.setField(field); log.setPreviousValue(oldValue); log.setNewValue(newValue); log.setChangedBy(admin); log.setChangedAt(Instant.now()); log.setReason(reason); auditRepository.save(log);
    }

    private Instant parseInstant(Object value) { if(value==null) return null; return Instant.parse(String.valueOf(value)); }
    private void addNetworkEvent(AttendanceRecord a,String event){ if(a.getNetworkEvents()==null)a.setNetworkEvents(new ArrayList<>()); a.getNetworkEvents().add(event); if(a.getNetworkEvents().size()>100)a.setNetworkEvents(a.getNetworkEvents().subList(a.getNetworkEvents().size()-100,a.getNetworkEvents().size())); }

    private Map<String,Object> dashboard(AttendanceRecord a, Instant now) {
        Map<String,Object> m=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        m.put("id",a.getId());m.put("employeeId",a.getEmployeeId());m.put("username",a.getUsername());m.put("fullName",a.getFullName());m.put("date",a.getDate());m.put("status",a.getStatus());
        m.put("firstLoginAt",a.getFirstLoginAt());m.put("lastLogoutAt",a.getLastLogoutAt());m.put("workingSeconds",a.getTotalWorkingSeconds());m.put("online",a.isOnline());m.put("disconnected",a.isDisconnected());m.put("sessionCount",a.getSessionCount());m.put("remarks",a.getRemarks());m.put("serverNow",now);
        List<AttendanceSession> sessions=sessionRepository.findByAttendanceIdOrderByLoginAtAsc(a.getId()); m.put("sessions",sessions);m.put("networkEvents",a.getNetworkEvents());m.put("audits",auditRepository.findByAttendanceIdOrderByChangedAtDesc(a.getId()));
        List<LeavePermissionRequest> approved=requestRepository.findByUsernameOrderBySubmittedAtDesc(a.getUsername()).stream().filter(r->"Approved".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getStatus())&&appliesToDate(r,a.getDate())).toList();
        LeavePermissionRequest p=approved.stream().filter(r->"Permission".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getType())).findFirst().orElse(null); LeavePermissionRequest l=approved.stream().filter(r->"Leave".equalsIgnoreCase(r.getType())&&leaveActive(r,now)).findFirst().orElse(null);
        if(p!=null){m.put("permission", Map.of("id",p.getId(),"start",p.getDate()+"T"+p.getFromTime()+":00+05:30","end",p.getDate()+"T"+p.getToTime()+":00+05:30","status",permissionActive(p,now)?"Active":"Completed","duration",p.getDuration(),"reason",p.getReason()));}
        else m.put("permission",null);
        if(l!=null)m.put("leave",Map.of("id",l.getId(),"leaveType",l.getLeaveType()==null?"Full-day":l.getLeaveType(),"status","Active")); else m.put("leave",null);
        return m;
    }
    private void publish(AttendanceRecord a){ try { messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/attendance/"+a.getUsername(), dashboard(a,Instant.now())); messagingTemplate.convertAndSend("/topic/attendance/admin", dashboard(a,Instant.now())); } catch(Exception ignored){} }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.CalendarEvent;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Lead;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.CalendarEventRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.LeadRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.TelecallerRepository;

@Service
public class CalendarService {

    private final CalendarEventRepository events;
    private final LeadRepository leads;
    private final TelecallerRepository telecallers;

    public CalendarService(
            CalendarEventRepository events,
            LeadRepository leads,
            TelecallerRepository telecallers
    ) {
        this.events = events;
        this.leads = leads;
        this.telecallers = telecallers;
    }

    private boolean isAdmin(Authentication authentication) {
        if (authentication == null
                || authentication.getAuthorities() == null) {
            return false;
        }

        return authentication.getAuthorities()
                .stream()
                .anyMatch(authority ->
                        "ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN".equals(authority.getAuthority())
                                || "ROLE_ADMIN".equals(authority.getAuthority())
                );
    }

    private String currentUsername(Authentication authentication) {
        if (authentication == null) {
            return "";
        }

        return authentication.getName();
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getEvents(
            LocalDate from,
            LocalDate to,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        if (from == null || to == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "From date and to date are required"
            );
        }

        if (from.isAfter(to)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "From date cannot be after to date"
            );
        }

        String username = currentUsername(authentication);
        boolean admin = isAdmin(authentication);

        List<Map<String, Object>> result = new ArrayList<>();

        // ======================================================
        // NORMAL CALENDAR EVENTS
        // ======================================================

        
               List<CalendarEvent> calendarEvents =
        events.findActiveEventsBetweenDates(
                from,
                to
        );

        for (CalendarEvent event : calendarEvents) {

            // Super Admin / Admin can see all events
            if (admin) {
                result.add(toEventMap(event));
                continue;
            }

            // Telecaller can see events assigned to everyone
            if (event.getAssignedTo() == null
                    || event.getAssignedTo().isEmpty()) {

                result.add(toEventMap(event));
                continue;
            }

            // Telecaller can see events specifically assigned to them
            boolean assigned = event.getAssignedTo()
                    .stream()
                    .filter(value -> value != null)
                    .anyMatch(value ->
                            value.equalsIgnoreCase(username)
                    );

            if (assigned) {
                result.add(toEventMap(event));
            }
        }

        // ======================================================
        // FOLLOW-UP EVENTS FROM LEADS
        // ======================================================

        List<Lead> leadList;

        if (admin) {
            leadList = leads.findAll();
        } else {
            leadList = leads.findByAssignedTo(username);
        }

        for (Lead lead : leadList) {

            LocalDate followupDate =
                    parseFollowupDate(
                            lead.getTcNextRefollowupDate()
                    );

            if (followupDate == null) {
                continue;
            }

            if (followupDate.isBefore(from)
                    || followupDate.isAfter(to)) {
                continue;
            }

            Map<String, Object> followup =
                    new LinkedHashMap<>();

            followup.put(
                    "id",
                    "followup-" + lead.getId()
            );

            followup.put(
                    "date",
                    followupDate.toString()
            );

            followup.put(
                    "type",
                    "FOLLOWUP"
            );

            followup.put(
                    "title",
                    "Follow-up: " + getLeadName(lead)
            );

            followup.put(
                    "leadId",
                    lead.getId()
            );

            followup.put(
                    "link",
                    null
            );

            followup.put(
                    "assignedTo",
                    lead.getAssignedTo()
            );

            // Follow-up is automatically generated from Lead.
            followup.put(
                    "readOnly",
                    true
            );

            result.add(followup);
        }

        result.sort(
                Comparator.comparing(
                        item -> String.valueOf(
                                item.get("date")
                        )
                )
        );

        return result;
    }

    private Map<String, Object> toEventMap(
            CalendarEvent event
    ) {

        Map<String, Object> map =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        map.put("id", event.getId());

        map.put(
                "date",
                event.getDate() != null
                        ? event.getDate().toString()
                        : null
        );

        map.put("title", event.getTitle());
        map.put("link", event.getLink());
        map.put("type", event.getType());
        map.put("assignedTo", event.getAssignedTo());
        map.put("createdBy", event.getCreatedBy());

        map.put(
                "readOnly",
                false
        );

        return map;
    }

    private LocalDate parseFollowupDate(String value) {

        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        String dateValue = value.trim();

        List<DateTimeFormatter> formatters =
                List.of(
                        DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE,
                        DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd-MM-yyyy"),
                        DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd/MM/yyyy"),
                        DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy/MM/dd")
                );

        for (DateTimeFormatter formatter : formatters) {
            try {
                return LocalDate.parse(
                        dateValue,
                        formatter
                );
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private String getLeadName(Lead lead) {

        if (lead.getName() != null
                && !lead.getName().trim().isEmpty()) {
            return lead.getName();
        }

        if (lead.getSchool() != null
                && !lead.getSchool().trim().isEmpty()) {
            return lead.getSchool();
        }

        if (lead.getLeadId() != null
                && !lead.getLeadId().trim().isEmpty()) {
            return lead.getLeadId();
        }

        return "Lead";
    }

    public CalendarEvent create(
            CalendarEvent event,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        if (!isAdmin(authentication)) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException(
                    "Only Admin or Super Admin can create calendar events"
            );
        }

        if (event.getDate() == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Date is required"
            );
        }

        if (event.getTitle() == null
                || event.getTitle().trim().isEmpty()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Title is required"
            );
        }

        event.setTitle(
                event.getTitle().trim()
        );

        if (event.getType() == null
                || event.getType().trim().isEmpty()) {

            event.setType("MEETING");

        } else {

            event.setType(
                    event.getType()
                            .trim()
                            .toUpperCase()
            );
        }

        event.setCreatedBy(
                currentUsername(authentication)
        );

        event.setCreatedAt(
                new Date()
        );

        event.setUpdatedAt(
                new Date()
        );

        event.setActive(true);

        return events.save(event);
    }

    public CalendarEvent update(
            String id,
            CalendarEvent data,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        if (!isAdmin(authentication)) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException(
                    "Only Admin or Super Admin can update calendar events"
            );
        }

        CalendarEvent event =
                events.findById(id)
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () -> new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Calendar event not found"
                                )
                        );

        if (data.getDate() != null) {
            event.setDate(data.getDate());
        }

        if (data.getTitle() != null
                && !data.getTitle().trim().isEmpty()) {

            event.setTitle(
                    data.getTitle().trim()
            );
        }

        if (data.getLink() != null) {
            event.setLink(
                    data.getLink()
            );
        }

        if (data.getType() != null
                && !data.getType().trim().isEmpty()) {

            event.setType(
                    data.getType()
                            .trim()
                            .toUpperCase()
            );
        }

        if (data.getAssignedTo() != null) {
            event.setAssignedTo(
                    data.getAssignedTo()
            );
        }

        event.setUpdatedAt(
                new Date()
        );

        return events.save(event);
    }

    public void delete(
            String id,
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        if (!isAdmin(authentication)) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException(
                    "Only Admin or Super Admin can delete calendar events"
            );
        }

        CalendarEvent event =
                events.findById(id)
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () -> new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Calendar event not found"
                                )
                        );

        event.setActive(false);
        event.setUpdatedAt(new Date());

        events.save(event);
    }

    public List<Map<String, String>> telecallerOptions(
            Authentication authentication
    ) {

        if (!isAdmin(authentication)) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException(
                    "Only Admin or Super Admin can view telecallers"
            );
        }

        List<Map<String, String>> result =
                new ArrayList<>();

        telecallers.findAll()
                .stream()
                .filter(telecaller -> telecaller.isEnabled())
                .forEach(telecaller -> {

                    Map<String, String> item =
                            new LinkedHashMap<>();

                    item.put(
                            "username",
                            telecaller.getUsername()
                    );

                    item.put(
                            "fullName",
                            telecaller.getFullName()
                    );

                    item.put(
                            "employeeId",
                            telecaller.getEmployeeId()
                    );

                    result.add(item);
                });

        return result;
    }
}

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\service\CallBridgeService.java =====
// src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/service/CallBridgeService.java

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.BridgeCallStatus;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Call;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.CallAttempt;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.CallRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.LeadRepository;

@Service
public class CallBridgeService {

    @Autowired
    private CallRepository callRepository;

    @Autowired
    private LeadRepository leadRepository;

    private final Map<String, Map<String, Object>> activeDevices = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public void saveCallStatus(BridgeCallStatus status) {
        System.out.println("💾 Saving call status: " + status.getStatus());
        System.out.println("💾 Lead: " + status.getLeadName());
        System.out.println("💾 Phone: " + status.getPhoneNumber());
        System.out.println("💾 Duration: " + status.getDuration());
        System.out.println("💾 Audio Route: " + status.getAudioRoute());
        System.out.println("💾 Call Method: " + status.getCallMethod());
        
        // Update lead status when call ends
        if (status.getLeadId() != null && ("ended".equals(status.getStatus()) || "failed".equals(status.getStatus()))) {
            leadRepository.findById(status.getLeadId()).ifPresent(lead -> {
                lead.setLastContact(new Date().toString());
                if (status.getOutcome() != null) {
                    lead.setStatus(status.getOutcome());
                }
                lead.setUpdatedAt(new Date());
                leadRepository.save(lead);
                System.out.println("✅ Lead updated: " + lead.getName() + " -> " + status.getOutcome());
            });
        }

        // Save or update call record
        if (status.getCallId() != null) {
            callRepository.findById(status.getCallId()).ifPresentOrElse(
                call -> {
                    if (status.getDuration() != null && status.getDuration() > 0) {
                        call.setDuration(status.getDuration());
                    }
                    if ("connected".equals(status.getStatus()) && call.getStartedAt() == null) {
                        call.setStartedAt(new Date(status.getTimestamp()));
                    }
                    if ("ended".equals(status.getStatus())) {
                        call.setEndedAt(new Date(status.getTimestamp()));
                        call.setCallStatus("ended");
                    }
                    if (status.getOutcome() != null) {
                        call.setOutcome(status.getOutcome());
                    }
                    if (status.getNotes() != null) {
                        call.setNotes(status.getNotes());
                    }
                    call.setUpdatedAt(new Date());
                    callRepository.save(call);
                    System.out.println("✅ Call updated: " + call.getId());
                },
                () -> {
                    // Create new call
                    Call call = new Call();
                    call.setLeadId(status.getLeadId());
                    call.setLeadName(status.getLeadName());
                    call.setLeadMobile(status.getPhoneNumber());
                    call.setCalledNumber(status.getPhoneNumber());
                    call.setCallerNumber(status.getCallerNumber());
                    call.setCallMethod(status.getCallMethod() != null ? status.getCallMethod() : "android_sim_pc_headset");
                    call.setCallStatus(status.getStatus());
                    call.setOutcome(status.getOutcome());
                    call.setDuration(status.getDuration());
                    call.setNotes(status.getNotes());
                    call.setAgentUsername(status.getAgentUsername());
                    call.setAgentName(status.getAgentName());
                    call.setStartedAt(new Date(status.getTimestamp()));
                    call.setCreatedAt(new Date());
                    call.setUpdatedAt(new Date());
                    
                    if (status.getAttemptNumber() != null) {
                        CallAttempt attempt = new CallAttempt();
                        attempt.setNumber(status.getPhoneNumber());
                        attempt.setStatus(status.getStatus());
                        attempt.setTime(new Date(status.getTimestamp()).toString());
                        attempt.setDuration(status.getDuration());
                        call.setAttempts(Collections.singletonList(attempt));
                    }
                    
                    callRepository.save(call);
                    System.out.println("✅ New call created with method: " + call.getCallMethod());
                }
            );
        }
    }

    public Map<String, Object> registerDevice(String deviceId, String username, String deviceType) {
        Map<String, Object> deviceInfo = new HashMap<>();
        deviceInfo.put("deviceId", deviceId);
        deviceInfo.put("username", username);
        deviceInfo.put("deviceType", deviceType != null ? deviceType : "android_bridge");
        deviceInfo.put("registeredAt", new Date());
        deviceInfo.put("active", true);
        deviceInfo.put("audioRoute", "bluetooth_pc");
        
        activeDevices.put(deviceId, deviceInfo);
        System.out.println("✅ Device registered: " + deviceId + " (type: " + deviceType + ")");
        
        return Map.of(
            "success", true,
            "message", "Device registered successfully",
            "deviceId", deviceId,
            "deviceType", deviceType != null ? deviceType : "android_bridge"
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> getActiveDevices() {
        return Map.of(
            "devices", activeDevices,
            "count", activeDevices.size()
        );
    }
    
    public String getDeviceUsername(String deviceId) {
        Map<String, Object> info = activeDevices.get(deviceId);
        return info == null ? null : (String) info.get("username");
    }
    
    public String getDeviceType(String deviceId) {
        Map<String, Object> info = activeDevices.get(deviceId);
        return info == null ? null : (String) info.get("deviceType");
    }
    
    public Map<String, Object> getDeviceInfo(String deviceId) {
        return activeDevices.get(deviceId);
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.HashMap;

@Service
public class CallService {

    private final LeadService leadService;

        this.callRepository = callRepository;
        this.leadRepository = leadRepository;
        this.leadService = leadService;
