    @Transactional
    public CallResponse createCall(CallRequest request) {
        if (request.getLeadId() != null) leadService.assertLeadAccess(leadRepository.findByLeadId(request.getLeadId()).orElseThrow(() -> new RuntimeException("Lead not found")));
        Call call = new Call();
        
        call.setLeadId(request.getLeadId());
        call.setLeadName(request.getLeadName());
        call.setLeadMobile(request.getLeadMobile());
        call.setContactPerson(request.getContactPerson());
        call.setCategory(request.getCategory());
        
        call.setCalledNumber(request.getCalledNumber());
        call.setCallerNumber(request.getCallerNumber());
        call.setCallMethod(request.getCallMethod());
        call.setCallStatus(request.getCallStatus() != null ? request.getCallStatus() : "ringing");
        call.setOutcome(request.getOutcome());
        call.setDuration(request.getDuration());
        
        call.setNotes(request.getNotes());
        call.setRemarks(request.getRemarks());
        call.setSentiment(request.getSentiment());
        call.setInterestedIn(request.getInterestedIn());
        
        if (request.getContactNumbers() != null) {
            List<ContactNumber> contacts = request.getContactNumbers().stream()
                .map(dto -> {
                    ContactNumber cn = new ContactNumber();
                    cn.setId(dto.getId());
                    cn.setNumber(dto.getNumber());
                    cn.setLabel(dto.getLabel());
                    cn.setContactPerson(dto.getContactPerson());
                    cn.setPrimary(dto.isPrimary());
                    return cn;
                })
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
            call.setContactNumbers(contacts);
        }
        
        if (request.getAttempts() != null) {
            List<CallAttempt> attempts = request.getAttempts().stream()
                .map(dto -> new CallAttempt(dto.getNumber(), dto.getStatus(), dto.getTime()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
            call.setAttempts(attempts);
        }
        
        call.setAgentUsername(request.getAgentUsername());
        call.setAgentName(request.getAgentName());
        
        Date now = new Date();
        call.setStartedAt(request.getStartedAt() != null ? request.getStartedAt() : now);
        call.setEndedAt(request.getEndedAt());
        call.setCreatedAt(now);
        call.setUpdatedAt(now);
        
        Call saved = callRepository.save(call);
        
        if (request.getOutcome() != null && request.getLeadId() != null) {
            leadRepository.findById(request.getLeadId()).ifPresent(lead -> {
                String oldStatus = lead.getStatus();
                String oldLeadStatus = lead.getStatus();
                lead.setStatus(request.getOutcome());
                lead.setUpdatedAt(new Date());
                leadRepository.save(lead);
                leadService.recordActivity(lead, "CALL", "Call Panel", "Call updated", "status", oldLeadStatus, request.getOutcome(),
                        "Call outcome updated", call.getAgentUsername());
                leadRepository.save(lead);
                leadService.recordActivity(lead, "CALL", "Call Panel", "Call outcome", "status", oldStatus, request.getOutcome(),
                        "Call created: " + (request.getCallStatus() == null ? "ringing" : request.getCallStatus()), request.getAgentUsername());
                leadRepository.save(lead);
            });
        } else if (request.getLeadId() != null) {
            leadService.recordActivity(request.getLeadId(), "CALL", "Call Panel", "Call Made", null, null, null,
                    "Call initiated to " + request.getCalledNumber(), request.getAgentUsername());
        }
        
        return convertToResponse(saved);
    }

    @Transactional
    public CallResponse updateCall(String id, CallRequest request) {
        Call call = callRepository.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new RuntimeException("Call not found: " + id));
        if (call.getLeadId() != null) leadService.assertLeadAccess(leadRepository.findByLeadId(call.getLeadId()).orElseThrow(() -> new RuntimeException("Lead not found")));
        String oldOutcome = call.getOutcome();
        String oldStatus = call.getCallStatus();
        
        if (request.getCallStatus() != null) {
            call.setCallStatus(request.getCallStatus());
        }
        if (request.getOutcome() != null) {
            call.setOutcome(request.getOutcome());
        }
        if (request.getDuration() != null) {
            call.setDuration(request.getDuration());
        }
        if (request.getNotes() != null) {
            call.setNotes(request.getNotes());
        }
        if (request.getRemarks() != null) {
            call.setRemarks(request.getRemarks());
        }
        if (request.getSentiment() != null) {
            call.setSentiment(request.getSentiment());
        }
        if (request.getInterestedIn() != null) {
            call.setInterestedIn(request.getInterestedIn());
        }
        
        if (request.getAttempts() != null) {
            List<CallAttempt> attempts = request.getAttempts().stream()
                .map(dto -> new CallAttempt(dto.getNumber(), dto.getStatus(), dto.getTime()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
            call.setAttempts(attempts);
        }
        
        if (request.getStartedAt() != null && call.getStartedAt() == null) {
            call.setStartedAt(request.getStartedAt());
        }
        if (request.getEndedAt() != null) {
            call.setEndedAt(request.getEndedAt());
        } else if (request.getCallStatus() != null
                && ("ended".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getCallStatus())
                    || "completed".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getCallStatus()))) {
            if (call.getEndedAt() == null) call.setEndedAt(new Date());
        }
        
        call.setUpdatedAt(new Date());
        
        Call updated = callRepository.save(call);
        
        if (request.getOutcome() != null && 
            ("ended".equals(request.getCallStatus()) || "connected".equals(request.getCallStatus())) &&
            call.getLeadId() != null) {
            leadRepository.findById(call.getLeadId()).ifPresent(lead -> {
                lead.setStatus(request.getOutcome());
                lead.setUpdatedAt(new Date());
                leadRepository.save(lead);
            });
        }
        
        return convertToResponse(updated);
    }

                .orElseThrow(() -> new RuntimeException("Call not found: " + id));

    }

    public CallStatsResponse getCallStats(String agentUsername) {
        List<Call> calls;
        if (agentUsername != null && !agentUsername.isEmpty()) {
            calls = callRepository.findByAgentUsername(agentUsername);
        } else {
            calls = callRepository.findAll();
        }
        
        Calendar cal = Calendar.getInstance();
        cal.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0);
        cal.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
        cal.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
        cal.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
        Date todayStart = cal.getTime();
        Date todayEnd = new Date();
        
        List<Call> todayCalls = calls.stream()
                .filter(c -> c.getStartedAt() != null && 
                            c.getStartedAt().after(todayStart) && 
                            c.getStartedAt().before(todayEnd))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        
        CallStatsResponse stats = new CallStatsResponse();
        stats.setTotalCalls(todayCalls.size());
        
        Map<String, Integer> outcomeCounts = new HashMap<>();
        Map<String, Integer> statusCounts = new HashMap<>();
        
        int answered = 0;
        int notAnswered = 0;
        int interested = 0;
        int notInterested = 0;
        int callBack = 0;
        int talkSecs = 0;
        
        for (Call call : todayCalls) {
            String status = call.getCallStatus();
            statusCounts.merge(status != null ? status : "unknown", 1, Integer::sum);
            
            String outcome = call.getOutcome();
            if (outcome != null) {
                outcomeCounts.merge(outcome, 1, Integer::sum);
                
                if ("Interested".equals(outcome)) {
                    interested++;
                } else if ("Not Interested".equals(outcome)) {
                    notInterested++;
                } else if ("Call Back".equals(outcome)) {
                    callBack++;
                }
            }
            
            if ("connected".equals(status) || "ended".equals(status)) {
                answered++;
                if (call.getDuration() != null) {
                    talkSecs += call.getDuration();
                }
            } else {
                notAnswered++;
            }
        }
        
        stats.setAnswered(answered);
        stats.setNotAnswered(notAnswered);
        stats.setInterested(interested);
        stats.setNotInterested(notInterested);
        stats.setCallBack(callBack);
        stats.setTalkSecs(talkSecs);
        stats.setStatusCounts(statusCounts);
        stats.setOutcomeCounts(outcomeCounts);
        
        return stats;
    }

    public void deleteCall(String id) {
        callRepository.deleteById(id);
    }

    public void deleteCallsByLeadId(String leadId) {
        List<Call> calls = callRepository.findByLeadId(leadId);
        callRepository.deleteAll(calls);
    }

    private CallResponse convertToResponse(Call call) {
        CallResponse response = new CallResponse();
        response.setId(call.getId());
        response.setLeadId(call.getLeadId());
        response.setLeadName(call.getLeadName());
        response.setLeadMobile(call.getLeadMobile());
        response.setContactPerson(call.getContactPerson());
        response.setCategory(call.getCategory());
        response.setCalledNumber(call.getCalledNumber());
        response.setCallerNumber(call.getCallerNumber());
        response.setCallMethod(call.getCallMethod());
        response.setCallStatus(call.getCallStatus());
        response.setOutcome(call.getOutcome());
        response.setDuration(call.getDuration());
        response.setNotes(call.getNotes());
        response.setRemarks(call.getRemarks());
        response.setSentiment(call.getSentiment());
        response.setInterestedIn(call.getInterestedIn());
        response.setAgentUsername(call.getAgentUsername());
        response.setAgentName(call.getAgentName());
        response.setStartedAt(call.getStartedAt());
        response.setEndedAt(call.getEndedAt());
        response.setCreatedAt(call.getCreatedAt());
        response.setUpdatedAt(call.getUpdatedAt());
        
        if (call.getContactNumbers() != null) {
            List<ContactNumberDTO> contactDTOs = call.getContactNumbers().stream()
                .map(cn -> {
                    ContactNumberDTO dto = new ContactNumberDTO();
                    dto.setId(cn.getId());
                    dto.setNumber(cn.getNumber());
                    dto.setLabel(cn.getLabel());
                    dto.setContactPerson(cn.getContactPerson());
                    dto.setPrimary(cn.isPrimary());
                    return dto;
                })
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
            response.setContactNumbers(contactDTOs);
        }
        
        if (call.getAttempts() != null) {
            List<CallAttemptDTO> attemptDTOs = call.getAttempts().stream()
                .map(a -> {
                    CallAttemptDTO dto = new CallAttemptDTO();
                    dto.setNumber(a.getNumber());
                    dto.setStatus(a.getStatus());
                    dto.setTime(a.getTime());
                    dto.setDuration(a.getDuration());
                    return dto;
                })
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
            response.setAttempts(attemptDTOs);
        }
        
        return response;
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import org.bson.Document;
import org.bson.types.ObjectId;

import org.springframework.core.io.Resource;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query.Criteria;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query.Query;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.gridfs.GridFsResource;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.gridfs.GridFsTemplate;
import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import com.mongodb.client.gridfs.model.GridFSFile;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.CommunicationMessage;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Employee;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Telecaller;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.User;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.CommunicationMessageRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.EmployeeRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.TelecallerRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.UserRepository;

@Service
public class CommunicationService {

    private static final String GROUP_ALL = "GROUP-ALL";

    // Participant cache: 10 s — the poll loop hits this every 5–30 s, so it
    // collapses N unread queries + N user lookups into 1 DB roundtrip.
    private static final long PARTICIPANT_CACHE_TTL_MS = 10_000L;
    private final Map<String, CachedParticipants> participantCache = new HashMap<>();

    private final CommunicationMessageRepository messageRepository;
    private final TelecallerRepository telecallerRepository;
    private final UserRepository userRepository;
    private final EmployeeRepository employeeRepository;
    private final GridFsTemplate gridFsTemplate;

    public CommunicationService(
            CommunicationMessageRepository messageRepository,
            TelecallerRepository telecallerRepository,
            UserRepository userRepository,
            EmployeeRepository employeeRepository,
            GridFsTemplate gridFsTemplate) {
        this.messageRepository = messageRepository;
        this.telecallerRepository = telecallerRepository;
        this.userRepository = userRepository;
        this.employeeRepository = employeeRepository;
        this.gridFsTemplate = gridFsTemplate;
    }

    private static class CachedParticipants {
        final long at;
        final List<Map<String, Object>> data;
        CachedParticipants(long at, List<Map<String, Object>> data) {
            this.at = at;
            this.data = data;
        }
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Auth / roles (unchanged)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    private Authentication authentication() {
        Authentication a = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
        if (a == null || !a.isAuthenticated() || a.getName() == null) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException("Authentication required");
        }
        return a;
    }

    public String currentUsername() {
        return authentication().getName();
    }

    private boolean isAdmin() {
        return authentication().getAuthorities().stream().anyMatch(a -> {
            String r = a.getAuthority();
            return "ROLE_ADMIN".equals(r) || "ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN".equals(r);
        });
    }

    private boolean isTelecaller() {
        return authentication().getAuthorities().stream()
                .anyMatch(a -> "ROLE_TELECALLER".equals(a.getAuthority()));
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // PARTICIPANTS — cached 10 s
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getParticipants() {
        String username = currentUsername();
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();

        synchronized (participantCache) {
            CachedParticipants cp = participantCache.get(username);
            if (cp != null && now - cp.at < PARTICIPANT_CACHE_TTL_MS) {
                return cp.data;
            }
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> result = buildParticipants(username);

        synchronized (participantCache) {
            participantCache.put(username, new CachedParticipants(now, result));
            // Drop expired entries
            participantCache.entrySet().removeIf(e -> now - e.getValue().at > PARTICIPANT_CACHE_TTL_MS * 5);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private List<Map<String, Object>> buildParticipants(String username) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> result = new ArrayList<>();

        Map<String, Object> group = new HashMap<>();
        group.put("id", GROUP_ALL);
        group.put("username", GROUP_ALL);
        group.put("name", "All Telecallers + Super Admin");
        group.put("role", "GROUP");
        group.put("group", true);
        group.put("chatCategory", "GROUP");
        group.put("unreadCount", unreadGroupCount(username));
        result.add(group);

        if (isAdmin()) {
            for (Telecaller tc : telecallerRepository.findAll()) {
                if (!tc.isEnabled()) continue;
                if (tc.getStatus() != null && !"Active".equalsIgnoreCase(tc.getStatus())) continue;
                if (tc.getUsername() == null || tc.getUsername().isBlank()) continue;

                Map<String, Object> item = new HashMap<>();
                item.put("id", tc.getUsername());
                item.put("username", tc.getUsername());
                item.put("name", tc.getFullName() != null ? tc.getFullName() : tc.getUsername());
                item.put("role", "Telecaller");
                item.put("group", false);
                item.put("unreadCount", unreadDirectCount(tc.getUsername(), username));
                result.add(item);
            }
            return result;
        }

        // TELECALLER: show other telecallers
        for (Telecaller tc : telecallerRepository.findAll()) {
            if (!tc.isEnabled()) continue;
            if (tc.getStatus() != null && !"Active".equalsIgnoreCase(tc.getStatus())) continue;
            if (tc.getUsername() == null || tc.getUsername().isBlank()
                    || username.equals(tc.getUsername())) continue;

            Map<String, Object> item = new HashMap<>();
            item.put("id", tc.getUsername());
            item.put("username", tc.getUsername());
            item.put("name", tc.getFullName() != null ? tc.getFullName() : tc.getUsername());
            item.put("role", "Telecaller");
            item.put("group", false);
            item.put("chatCategory", "TELECALLER");
            item.put("unreadCount", unreadDirectCount(tc.getUsername(), username));
            result.add(item);
        }

        // Admins
        Set<String> added = new HashSet<>();
        for (User user : userRepository.findAll()) {
            if (!user.isEnabled() || !isAdminRole(user.getRole())) continue;
            if (user.getUsername() == null || user.getUsername().isBlank()) continue;
            if (!added.add(user.getUsername())) continue;

            Map<String, Object> item = new HashMap<>();
            item.put("id", user.getUsername());
            item.put("username", user.getUsername());
            item.put("name", user.getFullName() != null ? user.getFullName() : user.getUsername());
            item.put("role", normalizeRole(user.getRole()));
            item.put("group", false);
            item.put("chatCategory", "SUPER_ADMIN");
            item.put("unreadCount", unreadDirectCount(user.getUsername(), username));
            result.add(item);
        }

        for (Employee employee : employeeRepository.findAll()) {
            if (!employee.isEnabled() || !isAdminRole(employee.getRole())) continue;
            if (employee.getUsername() == null || employee.getUsername().isBlank()) continue;
            if (!added.add(employee.getUsername())) continue;

            Map<String, Object> item = new HashMap<>();
            item.put("id", employee.getUsername());
            item.put("username", employee.getUsername());
            item.put("name", employee.getFullName() != null ? employee.getFullName() : employee.getUsername());
            item.put("role", normalizeRole(employee.getRole()));
            item.put("group", false);
            item.put("chatCategory", "SUPER_ADMIN");
            item.put("unreadCount", unreadDirectCount(employee.getUsername(), username));
            result.add(item);
        }

        return result;
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Messages
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    public List<CommunicationMessage> getMessages(String chatId) {
        if (chatId == null || chatId.isBlank()) chatId = GROUP_ALL;
        String current = currentUsername();

        List<CommunicationMessage> messages;
        if (GROUP_ALL.equals(chatId)) {
            messages = messageRepository.findByRecipientTypeOrderByCreatedAtAsc("GROUP");
        } else {
            validateDirectChatAccess(chatId);
            messages = messageRepository.findDirectConversation(current, chatId);
            messages.sort(Comparator.comparing(CommunicationMessage::getCreatedAt,
                    Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder())));
        }
        return messages;
    }

    public CommunicationMessage send(String recipientType, String recipientUsername,
                                     String text, String type, String attachmentId,
                                     String attachmentName, String attachmentContentType,
                                     Integer durationSeconds, Long attachmentSizeBytes) {

        String current = currentUsername();
        boolean group = "GROUP".equalsIgnoreCase(recipientType);
        if (type == null || type.isBlank()) type = "CHAT";

        if (group) {
            if ("ANNOUNCEMENT".equalsIgnoreCase(type) && !isAdmin()) {
                throw new AccessDeniedException("Only Super Admin/Admin can send announcements");
            }
        } else {
            recipientType = "DIRECT";
            if (recipientUsername == null || recipientUsername.isBlank()) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Recipient is required");
            }
            validateDirectChatAccess(recipientUsername);
        }

        boolean hasText = text != null && !text.trim().isEmpty();
        boolean hasAttachment = attachmentId != null && !attachmentId.isBlank();
        if (!hasText && !hasAttachment) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Message or attachment is required");
        }

        CommunicationMessage m = new CommunicationMessage();
        m.setSenderUsername(current);
        m.setSenderName(getDisplayName(current));
        m.setSenderRole(getCurrentRole());
        m.setRecipientType(group ? "GROUP" : "DIRECT");
        m.setRecipientUsername(group ? null : recipientUsername);
        m.setType(type.toUpperCase());
        m.setText(hasText ? text.trim() : "");
        m.setAttachmentId(attachmentId);
        m.setAttachmentName(attachmentName);
        m.setAttachmentContentType(attachmentContentType);
        m.setDurationSeconds(durationSeconds);
        m.setAttachmentSizeBytes(attachmentSizeBytes);
        m.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());
        m.setReadBy(new ArrayList<>(List.of(current)));

        CommunicationMessage saved = messageRepository.save(m);
        invalidateParticipantCache();
        return saved;
    }

    public CommunicationMessage announcement(String text) {
        if (!isAdmin()) throw new AccessDeniedException("Only Super Admin/Admin can send announcements");
        return send("GROUP", null, text, "ANNOUNCEMENT", null, null, null, null, null);
    }

    public CommunicationMessage markRead(String messageId) {
        String current = currentUsername();
        CommunicationMessage m = messageRepository.findById(messageId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Message not found"));
        assertMessageAccess(m);
        List<String> readBy = m.getReadBy();
        if (readBy == null) { readBy = new ArrayList<>(); m.setReadBy(readBy); }
        if (!readBy.contains(current)) {
            readBy.add(current);
            CommunicationMessage saved = messageRepository.save(m);
            invalidateParticipantCache();
            return saved;
        }
        return m;
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // File upload / download (unchanged)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    public Map<String, Object> upload(MultipartFile file) throws IOException {
        if (file == null || file.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("File is required");
        if (file.getSize() > 50L * 1024L * 1024L) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Maximum file size is 50 MB");
        }
        String contentType = file.getContentType();
        if (contentType == null) contentType = "application/octet-stream";
        if (!isAllowedFileType(contentType, file.getOriginalFilename())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported file type");
        }
        String filename = file.getOriginalFilename();
        if (filename == null || filename.isBlank()) filename = "attachment";

        Document metadata = new Document();
        metadata.put("uploader", currentUsername());
        metadata.put("contentType", contentType);

        ObjectId id = gridFsTemplate.store(file.getInputStream(), filename, contentType, metadata);

        GridFSFile storedFile = gridFsTemplate.findOne(Query.query(Criteria.where("_id").is(id)));
        if (storedFile == null || storedFile.getLength() != file.getSize()) {
            try { gridFsTemplate.delete(Query.query(Criteria.where("_id").is(id))); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw new IllegalStateException("Attachment upload incomplete");
        }

        Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
        result.put("attachmentId", id.toHexString());
        result.put("fileName", filename);
        result.put("contentType", contentType);
        result.put("sizeBytes", file.getSize());
        return result;
    }

    public AttachmentData getAttachment(String attachmentId) {
        if (attachmentId == null || attachmentId.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Attachment ID is required");
        }
        CommunicationMessage message = messageRepository.findByAttachmentId(attachmentId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new AccessDeniedException("Attachment not found"));
        assertMessageAccess(message);

        ObjectId objectId;
        try { objectId = new ObjectId(attachmentId); }
        catch (Exception e) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid attachment ID"); }

        GridFSFile file = gridFsTemplate.findOne(Query.query(Criteria.where("_id").is(objectId)));
        if (file == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Attachment file not found");

        Long expectedSize = message.getAttachmentSizeBytes();
        if (expectedSize != null && expectedSize > 0 && file.getLength() != expectedSize) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Stored attachment is incomplete");
        }

        GridFsResource resource = gridFsTemplate.getResource(file);
        String contentType = "application/octet-stream";
        if (file.getMetadata() != null) {
            String m = file.getMetadata().getString("contentType");
            if (m != null && !m.isBlank()) contentType = m;
        }
        return new AttachmentData(resource, message.getAttachmentName(), contentType, file.getLength());
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Unread counters — single-query, index-backed
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    private long unreadGroupCount(String username) {
        try {
            return messageRepository.countUnreadGroup(username);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return 0L;
        }
    }

    private long unreadDirectCount(String sender, String reader) {
        try {
            return messageRepository.countUnreadDirect(sender, reader);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return 0L;
        }
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Super Admin monitoring
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getMonitorConversations() {
        if (!isAdmin()) throw new AccessDeniedException("Admin only");
        Map<String, Map<String, Object>> grouped = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        List<CommunicationMessage> directMessages =
                messageRepository.findByRecipientTypeOrderByCreatedAtAsc("DIRECT");
        for (CommunicationMessage m : directMessages) {
            String first = m.getSenderUsername();
            String second = m.getRecipientUsername();
            if (first == null || second == null) continue;
            if (telecallerRepository.findByUsername(first).isEmpty()) continue;
            if (telecallerRepository.findByUsername(second).isEmpty()) continue;

            String a = first.compareToIgnoreCase(second) <= 0 ? first : second;
            String b = first.compareToIgnoreCase(second) <= 0 ? second : first;
            String key = a + "::" + b;

            Map<String, Object> item = grouped.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> {
                Map<String, Object> map = new HashMap<>();
                map.put("id", key);
                map.put("firstUsername", a);
                map.put("secondUsername", b);
                map.put("firstName", getDisplayName(a));
                map.put("secondName", getDisplayName(b));
                return map;
            });
            item.put("lastMessageId", m.getId());
            item.put("lastMessageType", m.getType());
            item.put("lastMessageText", m.getText());
            item.put("lastMessageAt", m.getCreatedAt());
            item.put("lastSender", m.getSenderUsername());
        }
        return new ArrayList<>(grouped.values());
    }

    public List<CommunicationMessage> getMonitorMessages(String a, String b) {
        if (!isAdmin()) throw new AccessDeniedException("Admin only");
        if (a == null || b == null || a.isBlank() || b.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Both usernames are required");
        }
        return messageRepository.findDirectConversation(a, b);
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Access / role helpers (unchanged)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    private void validateDirectChatAccess(String otherUsername) {
        if (otherUsername == null || otherUsername.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Recipient is required");
        }
        String current = currentUsername();
        if (current.equals(otherUsername)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot send a message to yourself");
        }
        boolean known =
                telecallerRepository.findByUsername(otherUsername).isPresent()
                        || userRepository.findByUsername(otherUsername).isPresent()
                        || employeeRepository.findByUsername(otherUsername).isPresent();
        if (!known) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Recipient not found");
    }

    private void assertMessageAccess(CommunicationMessage m) {
        String current = currentUsername();
        if (isAdmin()) return;
        if ("GROUP".equalsIgnoreCase(m.getRecipientType())) return;
        if (current.equals(m.getSenderUsername())) return;
        if (current.equals(m.getRecipientUsername())) return;
        throw new AccessDeniedException("You do not have access to this message");
    }

    private String getDisplayName(String username) {
        return userRepository.findByUsername(username)
                .map(User::getFullName)
                .filter(n -> n != null && !n.isBlank())
                .orElseGet(() -> telecallerRepository.findByUsername(username)
                        .map(Telecaller::getFullName)
                        .filter(n -> n != null && !n.isBlank())
                        .orElse(username));
    }

    private String getCurrentRole() {
        String role = authentication().getAuthorities().stream()
                .findFirst().map(a -> a.getAuthority()).orElse("ROLE_USER");
        if (role.startsWith("ROLE_")) role = role.substring(5);
        return role;
    }

    private boolean isAdminRole(String role) {
        if (role == null) return false;
        String n = normalizeRole(role);
        return "ADMIN".equals(n) || "SUPER_ADMIN".equals(n);
    }

    private String normalizeRole(String role) {
        if (role == null || role.isBlank()) return "USER";
        String n = role.trim().toUpperCase().replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_");
        if (n.startsWith("ROLE_")) n = n.substring(5);
        return n;
    }

    private boolean isAllowedFileType(String contentType, String filename) {
        return contentType != null && !contentType.isBlank();
    }

    private void invalidateParticipantCache() {
        synchronized (participantCache) {
            participantCache.clear();
        }
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Attachment DTO
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    public static class AttachmentData {
        private final Resource resource;
        private final String fileName;
        private final String contentType;
        private final long sizeBytes;

        public AttachmentData(Resource resource, String fileName, String contentType, long sizeBytes) {
            this.resource = resource;
            this.fileName = fileName;
            this.contentType = contentType;
            this.sizeBytes = sizeBytes;
        }

        public Resource getResource() { return resource; }
        public String getFileName() { return fileName; }
        public String getContentType() { return contentType; }
        public long getSizeBytes() { return sizeBytes; }
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UsernameNotFoundException;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.EmployeeRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.TelecallerRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.UserRepository;

/**
 * Lookup order:  users (super admin / admin)  ->  telecallers  ->  employees.
 *
 * IMPORTANT CHANGE: telecallers are now looked up BEFORE employees.
 *
 * Creating a telecaller also writes a mirror row in "employees". Before, the mirror
 * was checked first, so whenever the mirror was stale (an older employee with the same
 * username, a failed/skipped mirror write, a password changed on only one of the two
 * rows) the telecaller's NEW password was compared against the OLD employee password
 * and login failed. The telecaller document is the source of truth, so it wins.
 */
@Service
public class CustomUserDetailsService implements UserDetailsService {

    @Autowired
    private UserRepository userRepository;

    @Autowired
    private EmployeeRepository employeeRepository;

    @Autowired
    private TelecallerRepository telecallerRepository;

    @Override
    public UserDetails loadUserByUsername(String username) throws UsernameNotFoundException {

        String name = username == null ? "" : username.trim();

        return userRepository.findByUsername(name)
                .map(u -> (UserDetails) u)
                .or(() -> telecallerRepository.findByUsername(name).map(t -> (UserDetails) t))
                .or(() -> employeeRepository.findByUsername(name).map(e -> (UserDetails) e))
                .orElseThrow(() -> new UsernameNotFoundException("User not found: " + name));
    }
}

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\service\DashboardService.java =====
package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import java.time.DayOfWeek;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.time.temporal.TemporalAdjusters;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import org.bson.Document;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.MongoTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation.Aggregation;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation.AggregationOperation;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation.AggregationResults;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query.Criteria;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query.Query;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Call;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Lead;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Telecaller;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.CallRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.LeadRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.TelecallerRepository;

/**
 * PERFORMANCE FIX
 * ---------------
 * The old DashboardService did leadRepository.findAll() + callRepository.findAll()
 * (whole collections, including the heavy excelData / activityHistory fields) and then
 * counted everything in Java using reflection. The first dashboard load after every
 * cache expiry therefore took many seconds.
 *
 * This version asks MongoDB to do the counting (count queries + one aggregation) and only
 * loads small projected documents for the last-7-days chart and "recent calls".
 *
 * It also fixes the telecaller scope: a telecaller's leads are the leads of his ASSIGNED
 * DISTRICTS (same rule as My Leads / Call Panel), not Lead.assignedTo == username, which
 * is why "My Leads" on the dashboard showed 0.
 *
 * The JSON shape is unchanged (+ the extra "today" keys Dashboard.jsx already reads).
 */
@Service
public class DashboardService {

    private static final ZoneId ZONE = ZoneId.systemDefault();
    private static final DateTimeFormatter DATE_FORMAT = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd MMM", Locale.ENGLISH);

    private static final long RESPONSE_TTL_MS = 20_000L;

    private final LeadRepository leadRepository;
    private final CallRepository callRepository;
    private final TelecallerRepository telecallerRepository;
    private final MongoTemplate mongo;

    private final Map<String, CachedResponse> responseCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public DashboardService(LeadRepository leadRepository,
                            CallRepository callRepository,
                            TelecallerRepository telecallerRepository,
                            MongoTemplate mongo) {
        this.leadRepository = leadRepository;
        this.callRepository = callRepository;
        this.telecallerRepository = telecallerRepository;
        this.mongo = mongo;
    }

    private static class CachedResponse {
        final long at;
        final Map<String, Object> data;
        CachedResponse(long at, Map<String, Object> data) { this.at = at; this.data = data; }
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── public API
    public Map<String, Object> getDashboard() {
        String username = getCurrentUsername();
        String role = getCurrentRole();
        String cacheKey = (username == null ? "anon" : username) + "|" + (role == null ? "" : role);

        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        CachedResponse cached = responseCache.get(cacheKey);
        if (cached != null && now - cached.at < RESPONSE_TTL_MS) return cached.data;

        Map<String, Object> fresh = buildDashboard(username, role);
        responseCache.put(cacheKey, new CachedResponse(now, fresh));
        responseCache.entrySet().removeIf(e -> now - e.getValue().at > RESPONSE_TTL_MS * 3);
        return fresh;
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── admin dashboard (real data for AdminDashboard.jsx)
    private static final String[] DAYS = {"Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"};

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public Map<String, Object> getAdminDashboard() {
        String cacheKey = "admin-page|" + getCurrentUsername();
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        CachedResponse cached = responseCache.get(cacheKey);
        if (cached != null && now - cached.at < RESPONSE_TTL_MS) return cached.data;

        Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>(getDashboard());
        Map<String, Object> summary = new LinkedHashMap<>((Map<String, Object>) out.get("summary"));

        // ---- telecallers ----
        long totalTc = 0, activeTc = 0;
        for (Telecaller tc : telecallerRepository.findAll()) {
            String role = tc.getRole() == null ? "" : tc.getRole().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (role.contains("ADMIN")) continue;
            totalTc++;
            String st = tc.getStatus() == null ? "" : tc.getStatus().trim();
            if (st.isEmpty() || st.equalsIgnoreCase("Active")) activeTc++;
        }
        summary.put("totalTelecallers", totalTc);
        summary.put("activeTelecallers", activeTc);
        summary.put("inactiveTelecallers", totalTc - activeTc);

        // ---- agreements signed (approved / sent to client) ----
        summary.put("agreementsSigned", mongo.count(new Query(Criteria.where("status").in("APPROVED", "SENT")), "agreements"));

        // ---- verified payments: revenue + monthly sales + district revenue ----
        Query pq = new Query(verifiedPaymentCriteria());
        pq.fields().include("amountPaid").include("totalAmount").include("paymentDate")
                .include("verifiedAt").include("createdAt").include("leadId");
        List<Document> payments = mongo.find(pq, Document.class, "payments");

        double revenue = 0;
        Map<String, Double> monthly = new java.util.TreeMap<>();       // yyyy-MM -> collected
        Map<String, Double> byLead = new HashMap<>();
        for (Document p : payments) {
            double paid = num(p.get("amountPaid"));
            double total = num(p.get("totalAmount"));
            revenue += total > 0 ? total : paid;
            String ym = paymentMonth(p);
            if (ym != null) monthly.merge(ym, paid, Double::sum);
            Object lid = p.get("leadId");
            if (lid != null) byLead.merge(String.valueOf(lid), paid, Double::sum);
        }
        summary.put("revenue", revenue);
        List<Map<String, Object>> monthlySales = new ArrayList<>();
        monthly.forEach((ym, v) -> {
            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            m.put("year", Integer.parseInt(ym.substring(0, 4)));
            m.put("month", Integer.parseInt(ym.substring(5, 7)));
            m.put("sales", v);
            monthlySales.add(m);
        });
        out.put("monthlySales", monthlySales);

        // ---- this week's calls (Mon..Sun) ----
        LocalDate monday = LocalDate.now(ZONE).with(TemporalAdjusters.previousOrSame(DayOfWeek.MONDAY));
        long[] byDay = new long[7];
        for (Call c : fetchCallsSince(null, Date.from(monday.atStartOfDay(ZONE).toInstant()))) {
            Date d = callDate(c);
            if (d == null) continue;
            long idx = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(monday, d.toInstant().atZone(ZONE).toLocalDate());
            if (idx >= 0 && idx < 7) byDay[(int) idx]++;
        }
        List<Map<String, Object>> daily = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            m.put("day", DAYS[i]);
            m.put("calls", byDay[i]);
            daily.add(m);
        }
        out.put("dailyCalls", daily);

        // ---- district + category performance (leads grouped by field + status) ----
        Map<String, Object> districtRevenueByName = new HashMap<>();
        if (!byLead.isEmpty()) {
            Query lq = new Query(Criteria.where("leadId").in(byLead.keySet()));
            lq.fields().include("leadId").include("district");
            Map<String, Double> rev = new HashMap<>();
            for (Lead l : mongo.find(lq, Lead.class)) {
                Double v = byLead.get(l.getLeadId());
                if (v == null) continue;
                rev.merge(blankTo(l.getDistrict(), "Unassigned"), v, Double::sum);
            }
            rev.forEach(districtRevenueByName::put);
        }
        out.put("districtPerformance", groupPerformance("district", "Unassigned", districtRevenueByName));
        out.put("categoryPerformance", groupPerformance("category", "Other", null));

        out.put("summary", summary);
        responseCache.put(cacheKey, new CachedResponse(now, out));
        return out;
    }

    private List<Map<String, Object>> groupPerformance(String field, String fallback, Map<String, Object> revenue) {
        AggregationResults<Document> res = mongo.aggregate(
                Aggregation.newAggregation(Aggregation.group(field, "status").count().as("count")),
                "leads", Document.class);
        Map<String, long[]> rows = new LinkedHashMap<>();    // [leads, converted]
        for (Document d : res.getMappedResults()) {
            Document id = (Document) d.get("_id");
            String name = blankTo(id == null || id.get(field) == null ? null : String.valueOf(id.get(field)), fallback);
            String st = id == null || id.get("status") == null ? "" : String.valueOf(id.get("status")).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            long c = ((Number) d.get("count")).longValue();
            long[] row = rows.computeIfAbsent(name, k -> new long[2]);
            row[0] += c;
            if (st.contains("converted") || st.contains("client") || st.contains("closed won")) row[1] += c;
        }
        List<Map<String, Object>> list = new ArrayList<>();
        rows.forEach((name, r) -> {
            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            m.put(field, name);
            m.put("leads", r[0]);
            m.put("converted", r[1]);
            m.put("rate", r[0] == 0 ? 0 : round(r[1] * 100.0 / r[0]));
            if (revenue != null) m.put("revenue", revenue.get(name) == null ? 0.0 : revenue.get(name));
            list.add(m);
        });
        list.sort((a, b) -> Long.compare((Long) b.get("leads"), (Long) a.get("leads")));
        return list;
    }

    private static String blankTo(String v, String fallback) { return v == null || v.isBlank() ? fallback : v.trim(); }

    private static double num(Object o) { return o instanceof Number n ? n.doubleValue() : 0.0; }

    /** yyyy-MM of the payment: paymentDate (yyyy-MM-dd) first, else verifiedAt, else createdAt. */
    private String paymentMonth(Document p) {
        Object pd = p.get("paymentDate");
        if (pd != null && String.valueOf(pd).matches("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}.*")) return String.valueOf(pd).substring(0, 7);
        Object d = p.get("verifiedAt") != null ? p.get("verifiedAt") : p.get("createdAt");
        if (d instanceof Date dt) {
            LocalDate ld = dt.toInstant().atZone(ZONE).toLocalDate();
            return String.format("%04d-%02d", ld.getYear(), ld.getMonthValue());
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── builder
    private Map<String, Object> buildDashboard(String username, String role) {
        boolean admin = isAdmin(role);
        Criteria leadScope = leadScope(username, role, admin);   // null = everything (admin)
        Criteria callScope = admin ? null : Criteria.where("agentUsername").is(username == null ? "" : username);

        Date todayStart = Date.from(LocalDate.now(ZONE).atStartOfDay(ZONE).toInstant());
        Date weekStart = Date.from(LocalDate.now(ZONE).minusDays(6).atStartOfDay(ZONE).toInstant());

        // ---- lead status counts (ONE aggregation) ----
        Map<String, Long> statusCounts = groupCount("leads", leadScope, "status");

        long totalLeads = 0, newLeads = 0, interestedLeads = 0, convertedLeads = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<String, Long> e : statusCounts.entrySet()) {
            String s = e.getKey() == null ? "" : e.getKey().trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            long c = e.getValue();
            totalLeads += c;
            if (s.isEmpty() || s.contains("new")) newLeads += c;
            if (s.equals("interested")) interestedLeads += c;
            if (s.contains("converted") || s.contains("client") || s.contains("closed won")) convertedLeads += c;
        }

        long followUps = countLeads(leadScope, followUpCriteria());

        // ---- calls (count queries, no documents loaded) ----
        long callsMade = countCalls(callScope, null);
        long connectedCalls = countCalls(callScope, connectedCriteria());
        long missedCalls = countCalls(callScope, missedCriteria());

        double conversionRate = totalLeads == 0 ? 0 : round((convertedLeads * 100.0) / totalLeads);

        Map<String, Object> summary = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        summary.put("totalLeads", totalLeads);
        summary.put("assignedLeads", totalLeads);
        summary.put("newLeads", newLeads);
        summary.put("interestedLeads", interestedLeads);
        summary.put("clientsConverted", convertedLeads);
        summary.put("followUps", followUps);
        summary.put("callsMade", callsMade);
        summary.put("connectedCalls", connectedCalls);
        summary.put("missedCalls", missedCalls);
        summary.put("conversionRate", conversionRate);
        summary.put("paymentsCollected", sumVerifiedPayments(username, admin, null));
        summary.put("quotations", countOwned("quotations", username, admin, Criteria.where("status").ne("Draft")));
        summary.put("agreements", countOwned("agreements", username, admin, Criteria.where("status").ne("DRAFT")));
        if (admin) {
            summary.put("totalTelecallers", telecallerRepository.count());
            summary.put("overallLeads", leadRepository.count());
            summary.put("overallCalls", callRepository.count());
        }

        // ---- last 7 days of calls / leads (small projected docs) ----
        List<Call> weekCalls = fetchCallsSince(callScope, weekStart);
        List<Lead> weekLeads = fetchLeadDatesSince(leadScope, weekStart);

        // ---- today ----
        long todayCalls = 0, todayConnected = 0, todayMissed = 0;
        for (Call c : weekCalls) {
            if (!isToday(callDate(c))) continue;
            todayCalls++;
            if (isConnected(c)) todayConnected++;
            else if (isMissed(c)) todayMissed++;
        }
        long todayNewLeads = countLeads(leadScope, Criteria.where("createdAt").gte(todayStart));
        String todayIso = LocalDate.now(ZONE).toString();
        long todayFollowUps = countLeads(leadScope,
                Criteria.where("tcNextRefollowupDate").regex("^" + Pattern.quote(todayIso)));
        long todayInterested = countLeads(leadScope, new Criteria().andOperator(
                Criteria.where("status").regex("^interested$", "i"),
                Criteria.where("updatedAt").gte(todayStart)));
        long todayConverted = countLeads(leadScope, new Criteria().andOperator(
                Criteria.where("status").regex("converted|client|closed won", "i"),
                Criteria.where("updatedAt").gte(todayStart)));

        Map<String, Object> today = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        today.put("date", todayIso);
        today.put("callsMade", todayCalls);
        today.put("connectedCalls", todayConnected);
        today.put("missedCalls", todayMissed);
        today.put("newLeads", todayNewLeads);
        today.put("newLeadsContacted", todayNewLeads);
        today.put("followUps", todayFollowUps);
        today.put("followUpsCompleted", todayFollowUps);
        today.put("interestedLeads", todayInterested);
        today.put("clientsConverted", todayConverted);
        today.put("quotations", countOwned("quotations", username, admin, Criteria.where("createdAt").gte(todayStart)));
        today.put("agreements", countOwned("agreements", username, admin, Criteria.where("createdAt").gte(todayStart)));
        today.put("paymentsCollected", sumVerifiedPayments(username, admin, todayStart));

        Map<String, Object> response = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        response.put("role", role);
        response.put("username", username);
        response.put("summary", summary);
        response.put("today", today);
        response.put("recentCalls", buildRecentCalls(callScope));
        response.put("performanceTrend", buildPerformanceTrend(weekCalls, weekLeads));
        response.put("leadStatus", buildLeadStatus(statusCounts));
        response.put("telecallerPerformance", admin ? buildTelecallerPerformance(todayStart) : new ArrayList<>());
        return response;
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── scopes
    /** Telecaller -> leads of assigned districts. Others -> leads assigned to the username. Admin -> null. */
    private Criteria leadScope(String username, String role, boolean admin) {
        if (admin) return null;
        if (username == null || username.isBlank()) return Criteria.where("_id").is("__none__");

        if (role != null && role.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("TELECALLER")) {
            Telecaller tc = telecallerRepository.findByUsername(username).orElse(null);
            if (tc != null && tc.getDistricts() != null) {
                List<Object> matchers = new ArrayList<>();
                for (String d : tc.getDistricts()) {
                    if (d != null && !d.trim().isEmpty()) {
                        matchers.add(Pattern.compile("^" + Pattern.quote(d.trim()) + "$", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE));
                    }
                }
                if (!matchers.isEmpty()) return Criteria.where("district").in(matchers);
            }
        }
        return Criteria.where("assignedTo").regex("^" + Pattern.quote(username) + "$", "i");
    }

    private Criteria followUpCriteria() {
        return new Criteria().orOperator(
                Criteria.where("status").regex("follow|call back", "i"),
                Criteria.where("tcNextRefollowupDate").nin(Arrays.asList(null, "")));
    }

    private Criteria connectedCriteria() {
        return new Criteria().orOperator(
                Criteria.where("callStatus").in("connected", "ended", "completed", "COMPLETED", "CONNECTED"),
                Criteria.where("outcome").regex("connected|answered", "i"));
    }

    private Criteria missedCriteria() {
        return new Criteria().orOperator(
                Criteria.where("callStatus").regex("no[ _-]?answer|missed|busy|reject|fail", "i"),
                Criteria.where("outcome").regex("no answer|not answered|missed", "i"));
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── mongo helpers
    private Query query(Criteria scope, Criteria extra) {
        if (scope != null && extra != null) return new Query(new Criteria().andOperator(scope, extra));
        if (scope != null) return new Query(scope);
        if (extra != null) return new Query(extra);
        return new Query();
    }

    private long countLeads(Criteria scope, Criteria extra) {
        return mongo.count(query(scope, extra), Lead.class);
    }

    private long countCalls(Criteria scope, Criteria extra) {
        return mongo.count(query(scope, extra), Call.class);
    }

    private Map<String, Long> groupCount(String collection, Criteria scope, String field) {
        List<AggregationOperation> ops = new ArrayList<>();
        if (scope != null) ops.add(Aggregation.match(scope));
        ops.add(Aggregation.group(field).count().as("count"));
        AggregationResults<Document> res = mongo.aggregate(Aggregation.newAggregation(ops), collection, Document.class);
        Map<String, Long> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Document d : res.getMappedResults()) {
            Object id = d.get("_id");
            Object cnt = d.get("count");
            out.put(id == null ? null : String.valueOf(id), cnt instanceof Number n ? n.longValue() : 0L);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private List<Call> fetchCallsSince(Criteria scope, Date since) {
        Criteria dateCrit = new Criteria().orOperator(
                Criteria.where("startedAt").gte(since),
                Criteria.where("createdAt").gte(since));
        Query q = query(scope, dateCrit);
        q.fields().include("startedAt").include("createdAt").include("callStatus").include("outcome");
        return mongo.find(q, Call.class);
    }

    private List<Lead> fetchLeadDatesSince(Criteria scope, Date since) {
        Query q = query(scope, Criteria.where("createdAt").gte(since));
        q.fields().include("createdAt");
        return mongo.find(q, Lead.class);
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── sections
    private List<Map<String, Object>> buildRecentCalls(Criteria callScope) {
        Query q = query(callScope, null);
        q.with(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.DESC, "createdAt"));
        q.limit(10);
        q.fields().include("leadName").include("leadMobile").include("outcome")
                .include("callStatus").include("createdAt").include("startedAt")
                .include("agentUsername").include("agentName");

        List<Map<String, Object>> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Call c : mongo.find(q, Call.class)) {
            Date d = callDate(c);
            Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            item.put("id", c.getId());
            item.put("leadName", c.getLeadName());
            item.put("phoneNumber", c.getLeadMobile());
            item.put("outcome", c.getOutcome() != null ? c.getOutcome() : c.getCallStatus());
            item.put("status", c.getCallStatus() != null ? c.getCallStatus() : c.getOutcome());
            item.put("agentUsername", c.getAgentUsername());
            item.put("agentName", c.getAgentName());
            item.put("date", d == null ? null : d.toInstant().atZone(ZONE).toLocalDateTime().toString());
            result.add(item);
        }
        return result;
    }

    private List<Map<String, Object>> buildPerformanceTrend(List<Call> calls, List<Lead> leads) {
        Map<LocalDate, Long> callCounts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<LocalDate, Long> leadCounts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<LocalDate, Long> connectedCounts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        LocalDate today = LocalDate.now(ZONE);
        for (int i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
            LocalDate date = today.minusDays(i);
            callCounts.put(date, 0L);
            leadCounts.put(date, 0L);
            connectedCounts.put(date, 0L);
        }
        for (Call c : calls) {
            Date dv = callDate(c);
            if (dv == null) continue;
            LocalDate d = dv.toInstant().atZone(ZONE).toLocalDate();
            if (callCounts.containsKey(d)) {
                callCounts.put(d, callCounts.get(d) + 1);
                if (isConnected(c)) connectedCounts.put(d, connectedCounts.get(d) + 1);
            }
        }
        for (Lead l : leads) {
            Date dv = l.getCreatedAt();
            if (dv == null) continue;
            LocalDate d = dv.toInstant().atZone(ZONE).toLocalDate();
            if (leadCounts.containsKey(d)) leadCounts.put(d, leadCounts.get(d) + 1);
        }
        List<Map<String, Object>> trend = new ArrayList<>();
        for (LocalDate date : callCounts.keySet()) {
            Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            item.put("date", date.format(DATE_FORMAT));
            item.put("calls", callCounts.get(date));
            item.put("connected", connectedCounts.get(date));
            item.put("leads", leadCounts.get(date));
            trend.add(item);
        }
        return trend;
    }

    private List<Map<String, Object>> buildLeadStatus(Map<String, Long> statusCounts) {
        Map<String, Long> merged = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        statusCounts.forEach((status, count) -> {
            String key = (status == null || status.isBlank()) ? "New" : status;
            merged.merge(key, count, Long::sum);
        });
        List<Map<String, Object>> result = new ArrayList<>();
        merged.forEach((status, count) -> {
            Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            item.put("status", status);
            item.put("count", count);
            result.add(item);
        });
        return result;
    }

    /** Admin only: per-telecaller numbers, using the SAME rules as the summary cards. */
    private List<Map<String, Object>> buildTelecallerPerformance(Date todayStart) {
        // [0]=leads [1]=converted [2]=calls [3]=connected [4]=today calls
        Map<String, long[]> perUser = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<String, Double> paid = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        AggregationResults<Document> leadRes = mongo.aggregate(
                Aggregation.newAggregation(
                        Aggregation.match(Criteria.where("assignedTo").nin(Arrays.asList(null, ""))),
                        Aggregation.group("assignedTo", "status").count().as("count")),
                "leads", Document.class);
        for (Document d : leadRes.getMappedResults()) {
            Document id = (Document) d.get("_id");
            if (id == null || id.get("assignedTo") == null) continue;
            String u = key(String.valueOf(id.get("assignedTo")));
            String st = id.get("status") == null ? "" : String.valueOf(id.get("status")).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            long c = ((Number) d.get("count")).longValue();
            long[] row = perUser.computeIfAbsent(u, k -> new long[5]);
            row[0] += c;
            if (st.contains("converted") || st.contains("client") || st.contains("closed won")) row[1] += c;
        }

        // calls: same connected rule as the summary (callStatus OR outcome)
        AggregationResults<Document> callRes = mongo.aggregate(
                Aggregation.newAggregation(
                        Aggregation.match(Criteria.where("agentUsername").nin(Arrays.asList(null, ""))),
                        Aggregation.group("agentUsername", "callStatus", "outcome").count().as("count")),
                "calls", Document.class);
        for (Document d : callRes.getMappedResults()) {
            Document id = (Document) d.get("_id");
            if (id == null || id.get("agentUsername") == null) continue;
            String u = key(String.valueOf(id.get("agentUsername")));
            String s = id.get("callStatus") == null ? "" : String.valueOf(id.get("callStatus")).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            String o = id.get("outcome") == null ? "" : String.valueOf(id.get("outcome")).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            long c = ((Number) d.get("count")).longValue();
            long[] row = perUser.computeIfAbsent(u, k -> new long[5]);
            row[2] += c;
            if (s.equals("connected") || s.equals("ended") || s.equals("completed")
                    || o.contains("connected") || o.contains("answered")) row[3] += c;
        }

        // today's calls per telecaller
        Criteria todayCrit = new Criteria().andOperator(
                Criteria.where("agentUsername").nin(Arrays.asList(null, "")),
                new Criteria().orOperator(Criteria.where("createdAt").gte(todayStart), Criteria.where("startedAt").gte(todayStart)));
        AggregationResults<Document> todayRes = mongo.aggregate(
                Aggregation.newAggregation(Aggregation.match(todayCrit), Aggregation.group("agentUsername").count().as("count")),
                "calls", Document.class);
        for (Document d : todayRes.getMappedResults()) {
            if (d.get("_id") == null) continue;
            perUser.computeIfAbsent(key(String.valueOf(d.get("_id"))), k -> new long[5])[4] += ((Number) d.get("count")).longValue();
        }

        // collected (verified) payments per telecaller
        AggregationResults<Document> payRes = mongo.aggregate(
                Aggregation.newAggregation(
                        Aggregation.match(new Criteria().andOperator(verifiedPaymentCriteria(),
                                Criteria.where("createdBy").nin(Arrays.asList(null, "")))),
                        Aggregation.group("createdBy").sum("amountPaid").as("total")),
                "payments", Document.class);
        for (Document d : payRes.getMappedResults()) {
            if (d.get("_id") == null) continue;
            Object t = d.get("total");
            paid.put(key(String.valueOf(d.get("_id"))), t instanceof Number n ? n.doubleValue() : 0.0);
        }

        // every telecaller is listed (even with no activity yet) with the real full name
        List<Map<String, Object>> result = new ArrayList<>();
        Map<String, Boolean> seen = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Telecaller tc : telecallerRepository.findAll()) {
            if (tc.getUsername() == null) continue;
            String u = key(tc.getUsername());
            seen.put(u, true);
            result.add(perfRow(tc.getId(), tc.getUsername(), tc.getFullName(), perUser.get(u), paid.get(u)));
        }
        perUser.forEach((u, row) -> {
            if (!seen.containsKey(u)) result.add(perfRow(u, u, u, row, paid.get(u)));
        });
        return result;
    }

    private Map<String, Object> perfRow(String id, String username, String fullName, long[] row, Double paid) {
        long[] r = row == null ? new long[5] : row;
        Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        item.put("id", id);
        item.put("username", username);
        item.put("fullName", fullName == null || fullName.isBlank() ? username : fullName);
        item.put("totalLeads", r[0]);
        item.put("assignedLeads", r[0]);
        item.put("callsMade", r[2]);
        item.put("todayCalls", r[4]);
        item.put("connectedCalls", r[3]);
        item.put("clientsConverted", r[1]);
        item.put("converted", r[1]);
        item.put("conversionRate", r[0] == 0 ? 0 : round(r[1] * 100.0 / r[0]));
        item.put("paymentsCollected", paid == null ? 0.0 : paid);
        return item;
    }

    private static String key(String username) { return username == null ? "" : username.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT); }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── payments / quotations / agreements
    /** A payment counts as "collected" once the Super Admin has verified it (or it is further along the workflow). */
    private Criteria verifiedPaymentCriteria() {
        return new Criteria().orOperator(
                Criteria.where("verificationStatus").regex("^verified$", "i"),
                Criteria.where("status").regex("^(verified|invoice generated|invoice sent to telecaller|completed|fully paid)$", "i"));
    }

    private double sumVerifiedPayments(String username, boolean admin, Date since) {
        List<Criteria> all = new ArrayList<>();
        all.add(verifiedPaymentCriteria());
        if (!admin) all.add(Criteria.where("createdBy").is(username == null ? "" : username));
        if (since != null) {
            all.add(new Criteria().orOperator(
                    Criteria.where("verifiedAt").gte(since),
                    new Criteria().andOperator(Criteria.where("verifiedAt").exists(false), Criteria.where("updatedAt").gte(since))));
        }
        AggregationResults<Document> res = mongo.aggregate(
                Aggregation.newAggregation(
                        Aggregation.match(new Criteria().andOperator(all.toArray(new Criteria[0]))),
                        Aggregation.group().sum("amountPaid").as("total")),
                "payments", Document.class);
        for (Document d : res.getMappedResults()) {
            Object t = d.get("total");
            if (t instanceof Number n) return n.doubleValue();
        }
        return 0.0;
    }

    /** Count documents of a module owned by the user (admins see everything). */
    private long countOwned(String collection, String username, boolean admin, Criteria extra) {
        List<Criteria> all = new ArrayList<>();
        if (extra != null) all.add(extra);
        if (!admin) all.add(Criteria.where("createdBy").is(username == null ? "" : username));
        Query q = all.isEmpty() ? new Query() : new Query(new Criteria().andOperator(all.toArray(new Criteria[0])));
        return mongo.count(q, collection);
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── small helpers
    private boolean isConnected(Call c) {
        String s = c.getCallStatus() == null ? "" : c.getCallStatus().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String o = c.getOutcome() == null ? "" : c.getOutcome().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return s.equals("connected") || s.equals("ended") || s.equals("completed")
                || o.contains("connected") || o.contains("answered");
    }

    private boolean isMissed(Call c) {
        String s = c.getCallStatus() == null ? "" : c.getCallStatus().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String o = c.getOutcome() == null ? "" : c.getOutcome().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return s.matches(".*(no[ _-]?answer|missed|busy|reject|fail).*")
                || o.contains("no answer") || o.contains("not answered") || o.contains("missed");
    }

    private Date callDate(Call c) {
        if (c.getCreatedAt() != null) return c.getCreatedAt();
        return c.getStartedAt();
    }

    private boolean isToday(Date date) {
        if (date == null) return false;
        return date.toInstant().atZone(ZONE).toLocalDate().equals(LocalDate.now(ZONE));
    }

    private String getCurrentUsername() {
        try {
            var auth = org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
            return auth == null ? null : auth.getName();
        } catch (Exception e) { return null; }
    }

    private String getCurrentRole() {
        try {
            var auth = org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
            if (auth == null) return "";
            return auth.getAuthorities().stream().map(a -> a.getAuthority()).findFirst().orElse("");
        } catch (Exception e) { return ""; }
    }

    private boolean isAdmin(String role) {
        if (role == null) return false;
        return role.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("ADMIN");
    }

    private double round(double value) {
        return Math.round(value * 100.0) / 100.0;
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.DemoRequest;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Demo;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Lead;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.DemoRepository;

@Service
public class DemoService {
    private final DemoRepository demoRepo;
    private final TelecallerAccessService access;
    private final GoogleMeetService googleMeet;

    public DemoService(DemoRepository demoRepo, TelecallerAccessService access, GoogleMeetService googleMeet){this.demoRepo=demoRepo;this.access=access;this.googleMeet=googleMeet;}

    public List<Demo> list(){ return demoRepo.findByCreatedByOrderByCreatedAtDesc(access.currentUsername()); }
    public Demo get(String id){ Demo d=demoRepo.findById(id).orElseThrow(()->new IllegalArgumentException("Demo not found")); checkOwner(d); return d; }

    public Demo create(DemoRequest r) throws Exception {
        String username=access.currentUsername(); Lead lead=access.requireLeadAccess(r.getLeadId());
        Demo d=new Demo(); d.setId("DM-"+UUID.randomUUID().toString().substring(0,8).toUpperCase()); d.setCreatedBy(username); apply(d,r,lead);
        d.setCreatedAt(Instant.now()); d.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        List<Demo.TimelineEntry> timeline=new ArrayList<>(); timeline.add(new Demo.TimelineEntry("Demo Scheduled",Instant.now().toString(),"📅","#dbeafe","#1d4ed8"));
        if("meet".equalsIgnoreCase(d.getMeetType()) && (d.getMeetLink()==null || d.getMeetLink().isBlank())) { d.setMeetLink(googleMeet.createMeeting(username)); timeline.add(new Demo.TimelineEntry("Meet link generated",Instant.now().toString(),"🔗","#e0e7ff","#4338ca")); }
        d.setTimeline(timeline); return demoRepo.save(d);
    }

    public Demo update(String id, DemoRequest r) throws Exception { Demo d=get(id); Lead lead=access.requireLeadAccess(r.getLeadId()); apply(d,r,lead); d.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now()); if("meet".equalsIgnoreCase(d.getMeetType()) && (d.getMeetLink()==null||d.getMeetLink().isBlank())) d.setMeetLink(googleMeet.createMeeting(access.currentUsername())); return demoRepo.save(d); }
    public void delete(String id){ demoRepo.delete(get(id)); }
    public Demo cancel(String id){ Demo d=get(id); d.setStatus("Cancelled"); d.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now()); if(d.getTimeline()==null)d.setTimeline(new ArrayList<>()); d.getTimeline().add(new Demo.TimelineEntry("Demo Cancelled",Instant.now().toString(),"❌","#fee2e2","#dc2626")); return demoRepo.save(d); }
    private void checkOwner(Demo d){ if(!access.currentUsername().equals(d.getCreatedBy())) throw new org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException("Demo access denied"); }
    private void apply(Demo d,DemoRequest r,Lead l){ d.setLeadId(l.getLeadId()); d.setOrganization(l.getSchool()!=null&&!l.getSchool().isBlank()?l.getSchool():l.getName()); d.setContactPerson(l.getName()); d.setEmail(l.getEmail()); d.setPhone(l.getMobile()!=null&&!l.getMobile().isBlank()?l.getMobile():l.getPhoneNumber()); d.setTopic(r.getTopic()); d.setDate(r.getDate()); d.setTime(r.getTime()); d.setDuration(r.getDuration()); d.setMeetType(r.getMeetType()==null?"meet":r.getMeetType()); d.setMeetLink(r.getMeetLink()); d.setStatus(r.getStatus()==null?"Scheduled":r.getStatus()); d.setNotes(r.getNotes()); }
}

// FILE: src/main/java/com/indocrm/indocrm/service/ExotelService.java
//
// Replaces the old TwilioService / Android-SIM-Bridge call-initiation logic.
//
// HOW EXOTEL CLICK-TO-CALL WORKS (Connect API):
//   1. We call Exotel's /Calls/connect.json with From=agent's mobile, To=customer's mobile
//   2. Exotel FIRST rings the agent's own mobile (the "From" number)
//   3. When the agent picks up, Exotel automatically dials the customer and BRIDGES the two legs
//   4. The customer sees your Exophone (masked virtual number) as caller ID, never the agent's real number
//   5. Exotel posts call progress to our StatusCallback webhook as the call progresses

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Base64;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.http.HttpEntity;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.util.LinkedMultiValueMap;
import org.springframework.util.MultiValueMap;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.config.ExotelProperties;

@Service
public class ExotelService {

    private final ExotelProperties props;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate = new RestTemplate();
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper = new ObjectMapper();

    @Autowired
    public ExotelService(ExotelProperties props) {
        this.props = props;
    }

    /**
     * Initiates a click-to-call: rings the telecaller's mobile first, then bridges to the customer.
     *
     * @param agentMobile    Telecaller's own mobile number (Telecaller.mobile), e.g. "9876543210"
     * @param customerMobile Lead/customer's mobile number to call, e.g. "9123456789"
     * @param leadId         Used only to pass through as a custom field in the callback URL, for correlation
     * @return the Exotel Call Sid (Exotel's unique call ID) - store this against your Call record
     */
    public String initiateClickToCall(String agentMobile, String customerMobile, String leadId) {
        String url = props.getApiBaseUrl() + "/v1/Accounts/" + props.getSid() + "/Calls/connect.json";

        MultiValueMap<String, String> form = new LinkedMultiValueMap<>();
        form.add("From", normalize(agentMobile));
        form.add("To", normalize(customerMobile));
        form.add("CallerId", props.getExophone());
        form.add("CallType", "trans"); // transactional call, no IVR menu
        form.add("TimeLimit", "3600"); // hard cap 60 min per call, tune as needed
        form.add("TimeOut", "30");     // seconds to wait for agent to pick up before giving up
        form.add("Record", props.isRecordCalls() ? "true" : "false");

        if (props.getCallbackBaseUrl() != null && !props.getCallbackBaseUrl().isBlank()) {
            String callback = props.getCallbackBaseUrl() + "/api/exotel/webhook/status?leadId=" + leadId;
            form.add("StatusCallback", callback);
            form.add("StatusCallbackEvents[0]", "terminal"); // call ended (completed/failed/busy/no-answer)
            form.add("StatusCallbackEvents[1]", "answered");  // agent or customer answered
        }

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_FORM_URLENCODED);
        headers.set("Authorization", basicAuthHeader());

        HttpEntity<MultiValueMap<String, String>> request = new HttpEntity<>(form, headers);

        try {
            ResponseEntity<String> response = restTemplate.exchange(url, HttpMethod.POST, request, String.class);
            JsonNode body = objectMapper.readTree(response.getBody());
            // Exotel wraps the call object under "Call"
            JsonNode callNode = body.has("Call") ? body.get("Call") : body;
            return callNode.has("Sid") ? callNode.get("Sid").asText() : null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Exotel call initiation failed: " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    private String basicAuthHeader() {
        String creds = props.getApiKey() + ":" + props.getApiToken();
        return "Basic " + Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(creds.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

    // Exotel generally expects 10-digit Indian numbers or +91XXXXXXXXXX - strip spaces/dashes
    private String normalize(String number) {
        if (number == null) return null;
        String cleaned = number.replaceAll("[\\s\\-()]", "");
        if (cleaned.startsWith("0") && cleaned.length() == 11) {
            cleaned = cleaned.substring(1);
        }
        return cleaned;
    }
}
