        result.put(
            "approvedToday",
            approvedToday
        );

        result.put(
            "rejectedToday",
            rejectedToday
        );

        result.put(
            "approvedLeaveRequests",
            approvedLeave
        );

        result.put(
            "approvedPermissionRequests",
            approvedPermission
        );

        return result;
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * VALIDATION
     * ============================================================
     */

    private void validateRequest(
            LeavePermissionRequest request) {

        if (request == null ||
            request.getType() == null) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Request type is required"
            );
        }

        /*
         * LEAVE
         */
        if ("Leave".equalsIgnoreCase(
                request.getType())) {

            if (blank(request.getFromDate()) ||
                blank(request.getToDate())) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "From and To dates are required"
                );
            }

            LocalDate from =
                LocalDate.parse(
                    request.getFromDate(),
                    DATE
                );

            LocalDate to =
                LocalDate.parse(
                    request.getToDate(),
                    DATE
                );

            if (to.isBefore(from)) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "To date must be on or after From date"
                );
            }

            if (from.isBefore(
                    LocalDate.now(ZoneId.of("Asia/Kolkata")))) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Leave cannot start in the past"
                );
            }

            long days =
                ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(
                    from,
                    to
                ) + 1;

            request.setDuration(days + " Days");
            request.setDurationMinutes((int) (days * 8 * 60));
        }

        /*
         * PERMISSION
         */
        else if ("Permission".equalsIgnoreCase(
                    request.getType())) {

            if (blank(request.getDate())) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Date, From time and To time are required"
                );
            }

            LocalDate date =
                LocalDate.parse(
                    request.getDate(),
                    DATE
                );

            if (date.isBefore(
                    LocalDate.now(ZoneId.of("Asia/Kolkata")))) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Permission date cannot be in the past"
                );
            }

            if ("HALF_DAY".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getPermissionType()) && blank(request.getFromTime())) {
                request.setFromTime("09:30");
                request.setToTime("13:30");
            }
            if (blank(request.getFromTime()) || blank(request.getToTime())) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("From time and To time are required");
            }

            LocalTime from = LocalTime.parse(request.getFromTime());
            LocalTime to = LocalTime.parse(request.getToTime());

            if (!to.isAfter(from)) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "To time must be after From time"
                );
            }

            long minutes =
                ChronoUnit.MINUTES.between(
                    from,
                    to
                );

            String duration =
                (minutes / 60) +
                "h " +
                (minutes % 60 == 0
                    ? ""
                    : (minutes % 60) + "m");

            request.setDuration(duration.trim());
            request.setDurationMinutes((int) minutes);
        }

        else {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Type must be Leave or Permission"
            );
        }

        if (blank(request.getReason())) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Reason is required"
            );
        }
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * OVERLAP CHECK
     * ============================================================
     */

    private void preventOverlap(
            LeavePermissionRequest request,
            String username,
            String ignoreId) {

        List<LeavePermissionRequest> mine =
            repository
                .findByUsernameOrderBySubmittedAtDesc(
                    username
                );

        if ("Leave".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getType())) {
            LocalDate from = LocalDate.parse(request.getFromDate());
            LocalDate to = LocalDate.parse(request.getToDate());
            for (LeavePermissionRequest other : mine) {
                if (ignoreId != null && ignoreId.equals(other.getId())) continue;
                if (!("Pending".equalsIgnoreCase(other.getStatus()) || "Approved".equalsIgnoreCase(other.getStatus()))) continue;
                if (!"Leave".equalsIgnoreCase(other.getType()) || blank(other.getFromDate()) || blank(other.getToDate())) continue;
                LocalDate otherFrom=LocalDate.parse(other.getFromDate()), otherTo=LocalDate.parse(other.getToDate());
                if (!to.isBefore(otherFrom) && !from.isAfter(otherTo)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("This leave overlaps an existing pending/approved leave");
            }
            return;
        }

        if ("Permission".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getType())) {
            if (blank(request.getDate()) || blank(request.getFromTime()) || blank(request.getToTime())) return;
            LocalDate date=LocalDate.parse(request.getDate()); LocalTime from=LocalTime.parse(request.getFromTime()); LocalTime to=LocalTime.parse(request.getToTime());
            for (LeavePermissionRequest other : mine) {
                if (ignoreId != null && ignoreId.equals(other.getId())) continue;
                if (!("Pending".equalsIgnoreCase(other.getStatus()) || "Approved".equalsIgnoreCase(other.getStatus()))) continue;
                if (!"Permission".equalsIgnoreCase(other.getType()) || !request.getDate().equals(other.getDate())) continue;
                try { LocalTime of=LocalTime.parse(other.getFromTime()), ot=LocalTime.parse(other.getToTime()); if (from.isBefore(ot) && to.isAfter(of)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("This permission overlaps an existing pending/approved permission"); } catch (DateTimeException ignored) {}
            }
        }
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * HELPERS
     * ============================================================
     */

    private int parseDays(
            LeavePermissionRequest request) {

        try {

            if (request.getDuration() == null) {
                return 0;
            }

            String value =
                request.getDuration()
                    .replaceAll(
                        "[^0-9].*",
                        ""
                    );

            return Integer.parseInt(value);

        } catch (Exception e) {

            return 0;
        }
    }

    private boolean sameDay(
            Instant instant) {

        if (instant == null) {
            return false;
        }

        return instant
            .atZone(
                ZoneId.of("Asia/Kolkata")
            )
            .toLocalDate()
            .equals(
                LocalDate.now(ZoneId.of("Asia/Kolkata"))
            );
    }

    private boolean blank(String value) {

        return value == null ||
               value.isBlank();
    }

    private String capitalize(String value) {

        return value.substring(0, 1)
            .toUpperCase() +
            value.substring(1)
                .toLowerCase();
    }
}

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\service\LocalSimCallService.java =====
package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider;
import org.springframework.messaging.simp.SimpMessagingTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

@Service
public class LocalSimCallService {

    private static final Set<String> ALLOWED_ACTIONS = Set.of(
            "DIAL", "ANSWER", "REJECT", "HANGUP", "HOLD", "RESUME", "MUTE", "UNMUTE");

    /** In-call controls: only valid while the call is CONNECTED or ON_HOLD. */
    private static final Set<String> CONTROL_ACTIONS = Set.of("HOLD", "RESUME", "MUTE", "UNMUTE");

    private static final Set<String> ALLOWED_STATUSES = Set.of(
            "PENDING", "DISPATCHED", "RINGING", "CONNECTED", "ON_HOLD",
            "COMPLETED", "REJECTED", "FAILED", "BUSY",
            "NO_ANSWER", "CANCELLED");

    private static final Set<String> TERMINAL = Set.of(
            "COMPLETED", "REJECTED", "FAILED", "BUSY", "NO_ANSWER", "CANCELLED");

    private static final long PENDING_TTL_SECONDS = 90;
    private static final long DISPATCHED_TTL_SECONDS = 60;
    private static final long COMPANION_ONLINE_SECONDS = 20;
    private static final long BT_STICKY_SECONDS = 30;
    private static final long FINISHED_RETENTION_SECONDS = 3600;
    private static final long DUPLICATE_WINDOW_SECONDS = 15;

    private final Map<String, Map<String, Object>> commands = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, Companion> companions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final ObjectProvider<SimpMessagingTemplate> messagingProvider;

    private static final class Companion {
        volatile String deviceId = "";
        volatile long lastSeenMs = 0;
        volatile boolean btConnected = false;
        volatile long lastBtTrueMs = 0;
    }

    public LocalSimCallService(ObjectProvider<SimpMessagingTemplate> messagingProvider) {
        this.messagingProvider = messagingProvider;
    }

    public Map<String, Object> createCommand(Map<String, Object> request) {
        return createCommand(request, null, true);
    }

    public Map<String, Object> createCommand(Map<String, Object> request, String actingUser, boolean admin) {
        if (request == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Request body is required.");
        }

        String action = normalize(request.get("action"));
        if (action.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("action is required.");
        if (!ALLOWED_ACTIONS.contains(action)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported action: " + action);

        if ("DIAL".equals(action)) return createDial(request);
        return createFollowUp(action, request, actingUser, admin);
    }

    private Map<String, Object> createDial(Map<String, Object> request) {
        String mobile = stringValue(request.get("leadMobile"));
        if (mobile.isBlank()) mobile = stringValue(request.get("phoneNumber"));
        if (mobile.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("leadMobile is required for DIAL.");

        String agent = stringValue(request.get("agentUsername"));
        if (agent.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("agentUsername is required.");

        long nowMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        expireStale(nowMs);

        Map<String, Object> health = companionStatus(agent);
        String state = String.valueOf(health.get("state"));
        if ("OFFLINE".equals(state)) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(String.valueOf(health.get("message")));
        }

        synchronized (commands) {
            for (Map<String, Object> c : commands.values()) {
                synchronized (c) {
                    if ("DIAL".equals(read(c, "action"))
                            && agent.equalsIgnoreCase(read(c, "agentUsername"))
                            && mobile.equals(read(c, "leadMobile"))
                            && isActive(read(c, "status"))
                            && nowMs - readLong(c, "createdAtMs") < DUPLICATE_WINDOW_SECONDS * 1000) {
                        return snapshot(c);
                    }
                }
            }

            for (Map<String, Object> c : commands.values()) {
                synchronized (c) {
                    if ("DIAL".equals(read(c, "action"))
                            && agent.equalsIgnoreCase(read(c, "agentUsername"))
                            && isActive(read(c, "status"))) {
                        finish(c, "PENDING".equals(read(c, "status")) ? "CANCELLED" : "COMPLETED",
                                "Replaced by a newer call request.", null);
                    }
                }
            }

            String requestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
            Instant now = Instant.ofEpochMilli(nowMs);

            Map<String, Object> cmd = Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>());
            cmd.put("requestId", requestId);
            cmd.put("parentRequestId", "");
            cmd.put("action", "DIAL");
            cmd.put("status", "PENDING");
            cmd.put("leadId", stringValue(request.get("leadId")));
            cmd.put("leadName", stringValue(request.get("leadName")));
            cmd.put("leadMobile", mobile);
            cmd.put("agentUsername", agent);
            cmd.put("message", "Call queued. Waiting for your Windows companion to pick it up.");
            cmd.put("createdAt", now.toString());
            cmd.put("updatedAt", now.toString());
            cmd.put("createdAtMs", nowMs);
            cmd.put("updatedAtMs", nowMs);
            commands.put(requestId, cmd);
            return snapshot(cmd);
        }
    }

    private Map<String, Object> createFollowUp(String action, Map<String, Object> request,
                                               String actingUser, boolean admin) {
        String parentId = stringValue(request.get("parentRequestId"));
        if (parentId.isBlank()) parentId = stringValue(request.get("requestId"));
        if (parentId.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("parentRequestId is required for " + action + ".");

        Map<String, Object> parent = commands.get(parentId);
        if (parent == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Call not found (it may have expired).");

        long nowMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        expireStale(nowMs);

        synchronized (commands) {
            String owner;
            String parentStatus;
            synchronized (parent) {
                owner = read(parent, "agentUsername");
                parentStatus = read(parent, "status");
            }

            if (!admin && actingUser != null && !actingUser.equalsIgnoreCase(owner)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Call not found (it may have expired).");
            }

            if (TERMINAL.contains(parentStatus)) return snapshot(parent);

            if (CONTROL_ACTIONS.contains(action)) {
                if (!"CONNECTED".equals(parentStatus) && !"ON_HOLD".equals(parentStatus)) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            action + " is only possible while the call is connected.");
                }
                // Already in the requested state -> nothing to send to the phone.
                if (("HOLD".equals(action) && "ON_HOLD".equals(parentStatus))
                        || ("RESUME".equals(action) && "CONNECTED".equals(parentStatus))) {
                    return snapshot(parent);
                }
            }

            if ("PENDING".equals(parentStatus) && "HANGUP".equals(action)) {
                synchronized (parent) {
                    if ("PENDING".equals(read(parent, "status"))) {
                        finish(parent, "CANCELLED", "Cancelled before dialing.", null);
                    }
                }
                return snapshot(parent);
            }

            for (Map<String, Object> c : commands.values()) {
                synchronized (c) {
                    if (action.equals(read(c, "action"))
                            && parentId.equals(read(c, "parentRequestId"))
                            && isActive(read(c, "status"))) {
                        Map<String, Object> out = snapshot(parent);
                        out.put("followUpRequestId", read(c, "requestId"));
                        return out;
                    }
                }
            }

            String requestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
            Instant now = Instant.ofEpochMilli(nowMs);
            Map<String, Object> cmd = Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>());
            cmd.put("requestId", requestId);
            cmd.put("parentRequestId", parentId);
            cmd.put("action", action);
            cmd.put("status", "PENDING");
            cmd.put("leadId", read(parent, "leadId"));
            cmd.put("leadName", read(parent, "leadName"));
            cmd.put("leadMobile", read(parent, "leadMobile"));
            cmd.put("agentUsername", owner);
            cmd.put("message", action + " queued for the phone.");
            cmd.put("createdAt", now.toString());
            cmd.put("updatedAt", now.toString());
            cmd.put("createdAtMs", nowMs);
            cmd.put("updatedAtMs", nowMs);
            commands.put(requestId, cmd);

            Map<String, Object> out = snapshot(parent);
            out.put("followUpRequestId", requestId);
            return out;
        }
    }

    public Map<String, Object> getCommand(String requestId) {
        if (requestId == null || requestId.isBlank()) return Collections.emptyMap();
        Map<String, Object> command = commands.get(requestId);
        if (command == null) return Collections.emptyMap();
        expireStale(System.currentTimeMillis());
        return snapshot(command);
    }

    public Map<String, Object> claimNextPendingCommand(String deviceId) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("agentUsername is required.");
    }

    public Map<String, Object> claimNextPendingCommand(String deviceId, String agentUsername) {
        return claimNextPendingCommand(deviceId, agentUsername, true);
    }

    public Map<String, Object> claimNextPendingCommand(String deviceId, String agentUsername, boolean btConnected) {
        if (deviceId == null || deviceId.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("deviceId is required.");
        String wantedUser = agentUsername == null ? "" : agentUsername.trim();
        if (wantedUser.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("agentUsername is required.");

        long nowMs = System.currentTimeMillis();

        Companion companion = companions.computeIfAbsent(wantedUser.toLowerCase(), k -> new Companion());
        companion.deviceId = deviceId.trim();
        companion.btConnected = btConnected;
        companion.lastSeenMs = nowMs;
        if (btConnected) companion.lastBtTrueMs = nowMs;

        synchronized (commands) {
            expireStale(nowMs);

            Map<String, Object> next = commands.values().stream()
                    .filter(c -> "PENDING".equals(read(c, "status")))
                    .filter(c -> wantedUser.equalsIgnoreCase(read(c, "agentUsername")))
                    .min((l, r) -> {
                        int lp = "HANGUP".equals(read(l, "action")) ? 0 : 1;
                        int rp = "HANGUP".equals(read(r, "action")) ? 0 : 1;
                        if (lp != rp) return Integer.compare(lp, rp);
                        return Long.compare(readLong(l, "createdAtMs"), readLong(r, "createdAtMs"));
                    })
                    .orElse(null);

            if (next == null) return Map.of("available", false);

            synchronized (next) {
                long t = System.currentTimeMillis();
                next.put("status", "DISPATCHED");
                next.put("deviceId", deviceId.trim());
                next.put("message", "Picked up by your Windows companion. Dialing...");
                next.put("updatedAt", Instant.ofEpochMilli(t).toString());
                next.put("updatedAtMs", t);
                Map<String, Object> result = snapshot(next);
                result.put("available", true);
                publish(next);
                return result;
            }
        }
    }

    public Map<String, Object> companionStatus(String agentUsername) {
        String user = agentUsername == null ? "" : agentUsername.trim();
        Map<String, Object> r = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        r.put("agentUsername", user);

        Companion c = user.isEmpty() ? null : companions.get(user.toLowerCase());
        long nowMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long ageSec = c == null ? Long.MAX_VALUE : (nowMs - c.lastSeenMs) / 1000;
        boolean btLive = c != null && (c.btConnected || (nowMs - c.lastBtTrueMs) < BT_STICKY_SECONDS * 1000);

        if (c == null || ageSec > COMPANION_ONLINE_SECONDS) {
            r.put("state", "OFFLINE");
            r.put("online", false);
            r.put("bluetoothConnected", false);
            r.put("message", "Your Windows companion is offline. Open IndoCRM Companion on your PC and make sure "
                    + "its Telecaller Username is exactly \"" + user + "\".");
            return r;
        }

        r.put("online", true);
        r.put("deviceId", c.deviceId);
        r.put("lastSeenSecondsAgo", ageSec);
        r.put("bluetoothConnected", btLive);

        if (!btLive) {
            r.put("state", "PHONE_NOT_CONNECTED");
            r.put("message", "Companion is online. Windows Bluetooth pairing is not enough — keep the IndoCRM Bridge app open on the phone so the command link can open.");
        } else {
            r.put("state", "READY");
            r.put("message", "Phone bridge is ready.");
        }
        return r;
    }

    public Map<String, Object> updateStatus(String requestId, String status, String message) {
        return updateStatus(requestId, status, message, null);
    }

    public Map<String, Object> updateStatus(String requestId, String status, String message, Integer duration) {
        if (requestId == null || requestId.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("requestId is required.");

        String normalizedStatus = normalize(status);
        if (normalizedStatus.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("status is required.");
        if (!ALLOWED_STATUSES.contains(normalizedStatus)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported status: " + normalizedStatus);
        }

        Map<String, Object> command = commands.get(requestId);
        if (command == null) return Collections.emptyMap();

        String cleanMessage = message == null || message.isBlank() ? "" : message.trim();
        String action;
        String parentId;

        synchronized (command) {
            String current = read(command, "status");

            if (TERMINAL.contains(current)) return snapshot(command);
            // Ignore stale regressions, but allow CONNECTED <-> ON_HOLD transitions.
            if (rank(normalizedStatus) < rank(current)) return snapshot(command);

            if (TERMINAL.contains(normalizedStatus)) {
                finish(command, normalizedStatus, cleanMessage, duration);
            } else {
                long t = System.currentTimeMillis();
                command.put("status", normalizedStatus);
                if (!cleanMessage.isEmpty()) command.put("message", cleanMessage);
                if ("CONNECTED".equals(normalizedStatus)) {
                    if (readLong(command, "connectedAtMs") == 0) command.put("connectedAtMs", t);
                    if (readLong(command, "talkSegmentStartedAtMs") == 0) command.put("talkSegmentStartedAtMs", t);
                } else if ("ON_HOLD".equals(normalizedStatus)) {
                    long segmentStart = readLong(command, "talkSegmentStartedAtMs");
                    if (segmentStart > 0) {
                        command.put("talkAccumulatedMs", readLong(command, "talkAccumulatedMs") + Math.max(0L, t - segmentStart));
                        command.put("talkSegmentStartedAtMs", 0L);
                    }
                }
                command.put("updatedAt", Instant.ofEpochMilli(t).toString());
                command.put("updatedAtMs", t);
                publish(command);
            }
            action = read(command, "action");
            parentId = read(command, "parentRequestId");
        }

        if (CONTROL_ACTIONS.contains(action) && !parentId.isEmpty() && "COMPLETED".equals(normalizedStatus)) {
            applyControlResultToParent(action, parentId);
        }

        if ("HANGUP".equals(action) && !parentId.isEmpty()) {
            Map<String, Object> parent = commands.get(parentId);
            if (parent != null) {
                synchronized (parent) {
                    if (!TERMINAL.contains(read(parent, "status"))) {
                        if ("COMPLETED".equals(normalizedStatus)) {
                            finish(parent, "COMPLETED", "Call ended.", duration);
                        } else if ("FAILED".equals(normalizedStatus)) {
                            parent.put("message", "Could not end the call from the CRM: "
                                    + (cleanMessage.isEmpty() ? "phone did not respond." : cleanMessage)
                                    + " End it on the phone.");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return snapshot(command);
    }

    /**
     * The phone confirmed a HOLD / RESUME / MUTE / UNMUTE. Reflect it on the parent call so the
     * CRM page (which polls the parent call) shows the real state and the talk timer pauses/resumes.
     */
    private void applyControlResultToParent(String action, String parentId) {
        Map<String, Object> parent = commands.get(parentId);
        if (parent == null) return;

        switch (action) {
            case "MUTE":
            case "UNMUTE":
                synchronized (parent) {
                    if (TERMINAL.contains(read(parent, "status"))) return;
                    long t = System.currentTimeMillis();
                    parent.put("muted", "MUTE".equals(action));
                    parent.put("updatedAt", Instant.ofEpochMilli(t).toString());
                    parent.put("updatedAtMs", t);
                }
                break;
            case "HOLD":
                updateStatus(parentId, "ON_HOLD", "Call on hold", null);
                break;
            case "RESUME":
                updateStatus(parentId, "CONNECTED", "Call resumed", null);
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }
    }

    private void finish(Map<String, Object> c, String status, String message, Integer duration) {
        long t = System.currentTimeMillis();
        c.put("status", status);
        if (message != null && !message.isEmpty()) c.put("message", message);
        long segmentStart = readLong(c, "talkSegmentStartedAtMs");
        long accumulated = readLong(c, "talkAccumulatedMs");
        if (segmentStart > 0) accumulated += Math.max(0L, t - segmentStart);
        int secs = (int) (accumulated / 1000L);
        c.put("talkAccumulatedMs", accumulated);
        c.put("talkSegmentStartedAtMs", 0L);
        c.put("duration", secs);
        c.put("updatedAt", Instant.ofEpochMilli(t).toString());
        c.put("updatedAtMs", t);
        publish(c);
    }

    private void expireStale(long nowMs) {
        for (Map<String, Object> c : commands.values()) {
            synchronized (c) {
                String status = read(c, "status");
                long age = (nowMs - readLong(c, "updatedAtMs")) / 1000;
                long createdAge = (nowMs - readLong(c, "createdAtMs")) / 1000;

                if ("PENDING".equals(status) && createdAge > PENDING_TTL_SECONDS) {
                    String agent = read(c, "agentUsername");
                    Companion companion = agent.isEmpty() ? null : companions.get(agent.toLowerCase());
                    boolean online = companion != null
                            && (nowMs - companion.lastSeenMs) / 1000 <= COMPANION_ONLINE_SECONDS;
                    if (online) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    finish(c, "CANCELLED",
                            "Your Windows companion did not pick this up in time. Check that it is running, "
                          + "the IndoCRM Bridge app is open on the phone, and the Telecaller Username matches your CRM login.",
                            null);
                } else if ("DISPATCHED".equals(status) && age > DISPATCHED_TTL_SECONDS) {
                    finish(c, "FAILED", "The phone did not confirm the call. Keep the IndoCRM Bridge app open and wait until Companion shows Bluetooth Connected.", null);
                } else if (TERMINAL.contains(status) && age > FINISHED_RETENTION_SECONDS) {
                    commands.remove(read(c, "requestId"));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void publish(Map<String, Object> c) {
        try {
            SimpMessagingTemplate template = messagingProvider.getIfAvailable();
            if (template == null) return;
            String raw = read(c, "status");
            Map<String, Object> msg = new HashMap<>();
            msg.put("requestId", read(c, "requestId"));
            msg.put("parentRequestId", read(c, "parentRequestId"));
            msg.put("callMethod", "local_sim");
            msg.put("status", crmStatus(raw));
            msg.put("localStatus", raw);
            msg.put("leadId", read(c, "leadId"));
            msg.put("agentUsername", read(c, "agentUsername"));
            msg.put("message", read(c, "message"));
            Object d = c.get("duration");
            long accumulated = readLong(c, "talkAccumulatedMs");
            long segmentStart = readLong(c, "talkSegmentStartedAtMs");
            if (segmentStart > 0) accumulated += Math.max(0L, System.currentTimeMillis() - segmentStart);
            msg.put("duration", (int) (accumulated / 1000L));
            msg.put("timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis());
            template.convertAndSend("/topic/call-status", msg);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    private static String crmStatus(String s) {
        switch (s) {
            case "PENDING":
            case "DISPATCHED": return "initiating";
            case "RINGING": return "ringing";
            case "CONNECTED": return "connected";
            case "ON_HOLD": return "on_hold";
            case "COMPLETED": return "completed";
            case "NO_ANSWER": return "no_answer";
            case "BUSY": return "busy";
            case "REJECTED": return "rejected";
            default: return "failed";
        }
    }

    private static int rank(String status) {
        switch (status) {
            case "PENDING": return 0;
            case "DISPATCHED": return 1;
            case "RINGING": return 2;
            case "CONNECTED":
            case "ON_HOLD": return 3;
            default: return 4;
        }
    }

    private static boolean isActive(String status) { return !TERMINAL.contains(status); }

    private static String normalize(Object value) {
        return value == null ? "" : String.valueOf(value).trim().toUpperCase();
    }

    private static String stringValue(Object value) {
        return value == null ? "" : String.valueOf(value).trim();
    }

    private static String read(Map<String, Object> map, String key) {
        synchronized (map) {
            Object value = map.get(key);
            return value == null ? "" : String.valueOf(value);
        }
    }

    private static long readLong(Map<String, Object> map, String key) {
        synchronized (map) {
            Object value = map.get(key);
            return value instanceof Number ? ((Number) value).longValue() : 0L;
        }
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> snapshot(Map<String, Object> source) {
        synchronized (source) {
            return new LinkedHashMap<>(source);
        }
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.InvoiceUpdateRequest;

    private static final String VERIFICATION_PENDING = "Pending";
    private static final String VERIFICATION_VERIFIED = "Verified";

    private static final String INVOICE_NOT_GENERATED = "Not Generated";
    private static final String INVOICE_GENERATED = "Generated";
    private static final String INVOICE_SENT_TO_TELECALLER =
            "Sent to Telecaller";
    private static final String INVOICE_SENT_TO_CLIENT =
            "Sent to Client";

    private static final DateTimeFormatter TS_FMT =
            DateTimeFormatter
                    .ofPattern("dd MMM yyyy · hh:mm a")
                    .withZone(ZoneId.systemDefault());

    public PaymentService(
            PaymentRepository paymentRepo,
            InvoiceRepository invoiceRepo,
            TelecallerAccessService accessService,
            InvoicePdfService pdfService,
            InvoiceExcelService excelService,
            PaymentQrCodeRepository qrRepo,

    ) {

        this.invoiceRepo = invoiceRepo;
        this.accessService = accessService;

    /*

    public List<Payment> listForCurrentTelecaller() {
        return paymentRepo.findByCreatedBy(
                accessService.currentUsername()
        );
    }

    public Payment get(String id) {

        Payment payment = paymentRepo.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(
                        () -> new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Payment not found: " + id
                        )
                );

        if (accessService.isTelecaller()) {

            if (payment.getCreatedBy() == null
                    || !payment.getCreatedBy().equals(
                            accessService.currentUsername()
                    )) {

                throw new AccessDeniedException(
                        "You do not have access to this payment record"
                );
            }
        }

        return payment;
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * CREATE PAYMENT
     * ============================================================
     */

    public Payment create(PaymentRequest request) {

        if (request.getLeadId() == null
                || request.getLeadId().isBlank()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "leadId is required"
            );
        }

        Lead lead = accessService.requireLeadAccess(
                request.getLeadId()
        );

        Telecaller telecaller =
                accessService.currentTelecaller();

        Payment payment = new Payment();

        payment.setLeadId(request.getLeadId());

        payment.setOrganizationName(
                firstNonBlank(
                        request.getOrganizationName(),
                        lead.getSchool(),
                        lead.getName()
                )
        );

        payment.setAddress(
                firstNonBlank(
                        request.getAddress(),
                        lead.getSchoolAddress()
                )
        );

        payment.setPhone(
                firstNonBlank(
                        request.getPhone(),
                        lead.getPhoneNumber(),
                        lead.getMobile()
                )
        );

        payment.setEmail(
                firstNonBlank(
                        request.getEmail(),
                        lead.getEmail()
                )
        );

        payment.setPaymentType(
                request.getPaymentType() != null
                        ? request.getPaymentType()
                        : Payment.TYPE_FULL
        );

        payment.setTotalAmount(
                request.getTotalAmount() != null
                        ? request.getTotalAmount()
                        : 0.0
        );

        payment.setAmountPaid(0.0);

        payment.setBalanceAmount(
                n(payment.getTotalAmount())
        );

        payment.setPaymentDate(
                request.getPaymentDate()
        );

        payment.setNotes(
                request.getNotes()
        );

        payment.setStatus(
                Payment.STATUS_RECORDED
        );

        payment.setVerificationStatus(
                VERIFICATION_PENDING
        );

        payment.setInvoiceStatus(
                INVOICE_NOT_GENERATED
        );

        payment.setCreatedBy(
                accessService.currentUsername()
        );

        /*
         * Initial payment record.
         */
        if (request.getAmountPaid() != null
                && request.getAmountPaid() > 0) {

            double amount =
                    request.getAmountPaid();

            if (amount > n(payment.getTotalAmount())) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Payment amount cannot exceed total amount"
                );
            }

            Payment.PaymentRecord record =
                    toRecord(
                            request,
                            accessService.currentUsername()
                    );

            payment.getPaymentHistory().add(
                    record
            );
        }

        recalculate(payment);

        payment.setTelecallerName(
                telecaller.getFullName() != null
                        ? telecaller.getFullName()
                        : telecaller.getUsername()
        );

        addTimeline(
                payment,
                payment.getPaymentType()
                        + " payment of "
                        + fmt(payment.getAmountPaid())
                        + " recorded",
                "check",
                "#dcfce7",
                "#15803d"
        );

        return paymentRepo.save(payment);
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * UPDATE PAYMENT
     * ============================================================
     */

    public Payment update(
            String id,
            PaymentRequest request
    ) {

        Payment payment = get(id);

        if (request.getOrganizationName() != null) {
            payment.setOrganizationName(
                    request.getOrganizationName()
            );
        }

        if (request.getAddress() != null) {
            payment.setAddress(
                    request.getAddress()
            );
        }

        if (request.getPhone() != null) {
            payment.setPhone(
                    request.getPhone()
            );
        }

        if (request.getEmail() != null) {
            payment.setEmail(
                    request.getEmail()
            );
        }

        boolean locked =
                isLockedForTelecallerAmountEdits(
                        payment.getStatus()
                );

        boolean changingAmount =
                request.getTotalAmount() != null
                        && Double.compare(
                                n(request.getTotalAmount()),
                                n(payment.getTotalAmount())
                        ) != 0;

        boolean changingType =
                request.getPaymentType() != null
                        && !request.getPaymentType().equals(
                                payment.getPaymentType()
                        );

        if (locked
                && (changingAmount || changingType)
                && accessService.isTelecaller()) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "This payment has already been verified. "
                            + "Only the Super Admin can change "
                            + "the total amount or payment type."
            );
        }

        if (request.getPaymentType() != null) {
            payment.setPaymentType(
                    request.getPaymentType()
            );
        }

        if (request.getTotalAmount() != null) {

            if (request.getTotalAmount()
                    < n(payment.getAmountPaid())) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Total amount cannot be less than "
                                + "the amount already paid"
                );
            }

            payment.setTotalAmount(
                    request.getTotalAmount()
            );
        }

        if (request.getPaymentDate() != null) {
            payment.setPaymentDate(
                    request.getPaymentDate()
            );
        }

        if (request.getNotes() != null) {
            payment.setNotes(
                    request.getNotes()
            );
        }

        recalculate(payment);

        addTimeline(
                payment,
                "Payment details updated",
                "edit",
                "#dbeafe",
                "#1d4ed8"
        );

        return paymentRepo.save(payment);
    }

    private boolean isLockedForTelecallerAmountEdits(
            String status
    ) {

        return Payment.STATUS_VERIFIED.equals(status)
                || Payment.STATUS_INVOICE_GENERATED.equals(status)
                || Payment.STATUS_INVOICE_SENT_TO_TELECALLER.equals(status)
                || Payment.STATUS_COMPLETED.equals(status)
                || Payment.STATUS_FULLY_PAID.equals(status);
    }

     * ============================================================

     */

    public Payment recordPaymentDetailsSent(
            String id,
            String channel
    ) {

        Payment payment = get(id);

        payment.setLastSentChannel(channel);

        payment.setLastSentAt(
                Instant.now()
        );

        addTimeline(
                payment,
                "Payment details sent to client via " + channel,
                "WhatsApp".equalsIgnoreCase(channel)
                        ? "message"
                        : "mail",
                "#dcfce7",
                "#15803d"
        );

        return paymentRepo.save(payment);
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * TELECALLER SENDS INVOICE TO CLIENT
     * ============================================================
     */

    public Payment sendInvoiceToClient(
            String id,
            String channel
    ) {

        Payment payment = get(id);

        if (payment.getInvoiceId() == null
                || payment.getInvoiceId().isBlank()) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "No invoice has been generated yet."
            );
        }

        if (!Payment.STATUS_INVOICE_SENT_TO_TELECALLER.equals(
                payment.getStatus()
        )
                && !Payment.STATUS_COMPLETED.equals(
                        payment.getStatus()
                )) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Waiting for the Super Admin "
                            + "to send the invoice to you first."
            );
        }

        Invoice invoice = invoiceRepo
                .findById(payment.getInvoiceId())
                .orElseThrow(
                        () -> new IllegalStateException(
                                "Invoice record missing"
                        )
                );

        invoice.setSentToClientAt(
                Instant.now()
        );

        invoice.setSentToClientChannel(
                channel
        );

        invoiceRepo.save(invoice);

        payment.setInvoiceStatus(
                INVOICE_SENT_TO_CLIENT
        );

        /*
         * Keep Fully Paid status if the balance is already zero.
         * Otherwise workflow becomes Completed.
         */
        if (n(payment.getBalanceAmount()) <= 0
                && n(payment.getTotalAmount()) > 0) {

            payment.setStatus(
                    Payment.STATUS_FULLY_PAID
            );

        } else {

            payment.setStatus(
                    Payment.STATUS_COMPLETED
            );
        }

        addTimeline(
                payment,
                "Invoice sent to client via " + channel,
                "WhatsApp".equalsIgnoreCase(channel)
                        ? "message"
                        : "mail",
                "#dcfce7",
                "#15803d"
        );

        return paymentRepo.save(payment);
    }

    public File invoicePdfFileForTelecaller(
            String id
    ) {

        Payment payment = get(id);

        return invoiceFile(payment);
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * SUPER ADMIN
     * ============================================================
     */

    public List<Payment> adminList() {
        return paymentRepo.findAll();
    }

    public Payment adminGet(String id) {

        return paymentRepo.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(
                        () -> new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Payment not found: " + id
                        )
                );
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * SUPER ADMIN UPDATE PAYMENT
     * ============================================================
     */

    public Payment adminUpdate(
            String id,
            PaymentRequest request
    ) {

        Payment payment = adminGet(id);

        if (request.getOrganizationName() != null) {
            payment.setOrganizationName(
                    request.getOrganizationName()
            );
        }

        if (request.getAddress() != null) {
            payment.setAddress(
                    request.getAddress()
            );
        }

        if (request.getPhone() != null) {
            payment.setPhone(
                    request.getPhone()
            );
        }

        if (request.getEmail() != null) {
            payment.setEmail(
                    request.getEmail()
            );
        }

        if (request.getPaymentType() != null) {
            payment.setPaymentType(
                    request.getPaymentType()
            );
        }

        if (request.getTotalAmount() != null) {

            if (request.getTotalAmount()
                    < n(payment.getAmountPaid())) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Total amount cannot be less than "
                                + "the amount already paid"
                );
            }

            payment.setTotalAmount(
                    request.getTotalAmount()
            );
        }

        if (request.getPaymentDate() != null) {
            payment.setPaymentDate(
                    request.getPaymentDate()
            );
        }

        if (request.getNotes() != null) {
            payment.setNotes(
                    request.getNotes()
            );
        }

        recalculate(payment);

        addTimeline(
                payment,
                "Payment details updated by Super Admin",
                "edit",
                "#dbeafe",
                "#1d4ed8"
        );

        return paymentRepo.save(payment);
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * VERIFY PAYMENT - SUPER ADMIN
     * ============================================================
     */

    public Payment verify(String id) {

        Payment payment = adminGet(id);

        recalculate(payment);

        if (n(payment.getAmountPaid()) <= 0) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Add at least one payment record "
                            + "before verification."
            );
        }

        payment.setVerificationStatus(
                VERIFICATION_VERIFIED
        );

        payment.setVerifiedBy(
                accessService.currentUsername()
        );

        payment.setVerifiedAt(
                Instant.now()
        );

        /*
         * Fully paid and verification are different concepts.
         *
         * A payment can be:
         * Fully Paid + Verified
         */
        if (n(payment.getBalanceAmount()) <= 0
                && n(payment.getTotalAmount()) > 0) {

            payment.setStatus(
                    Payment.STATUS_FULLY_PAID
            );

        } else {

            payment.setStatus(
                    Payment.STATUS_VERIFIED
            );
        }

        addTimeline(
                payment,
                "Payment verified by Super Admin",
                "check",
                "#dbeafe",
                "#1d4ed8"
        );

        paymentRepo.save(payment);

        /*
         * Verification now hands the invoice straight to the telecaller / admin dashboard:
         * generate the invoice and send it, so it shows up there immediately.
         * If this fails, verification still stands and the Super Admin can do both steps manually.
         */
        try {
            generateInvoice(id);
            sendInvoiceToTelecaller(id);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            org.slf4j.LoggerFactory.getLogger(PaymentService.class)
                    .warn("Verified payment {} but auto invoice hand-off failed: {}",
                            id, e.getMessage());
        }

        return adminGet(id);
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * GENERATE INVOICE - SUPER ADMIN
     * ============================================================
     */

    public Payment generateInvoice(String id) {

        Payment payment = adminGet(id);

        /*
         * Always recalculate before invoice generation.
         */
        recalculate(payment);

        /*
         * IMPORTANT:
         * Do not check only payment.getStatus() here.
         *
         * Fully Paid payment can still be Verified.
         */
        if (!VERIFICATION_VERIFIED.equalsIgnoreCase(
                payment.getVerificationStatus()
        )) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Verify the payment before generating "
                            + "an invoice."
            );
        }

        Invoice invoice;

        if (payment.getInvoiceId() != null
                && !payment.getInvoiceId().isBlank()) {

            invoice = invoiceRepo
                    .findById(payment.getInvoiceId())
                    .orElseGet(Invoice::new);

        } else {

            invoice = new Invoice();
        }

        /*
         * ========================================================
         * PAYMENT / CLIENT DETAILS
         * ========================================================
         */

        invoice.setPaymentId(
                payment.getId()
        );

        invoice.setLeadId(
                payment.getLeadId()
        );

        if (invoice.getInvoiceNumber() == null
                || invoice.getInvoiceNumber().isBlank()) {

            invoice.setInvoiceNumber(
                    nextInvoiceNumber()
            );
        }

        invoice.setOrganizationName(firstNonBlank(invoice.getOrganizationName(), payment.getOrganizationName()));

        invoice.setAddress(firstNonBlank(invoice.getAddress(), payment.getAddress()));

        invoice.setPhone(firstNonBlank(invoice.getPhone(), payment.getPhone()));

        invoice.setEmail(firstNonBlank(invoice.getEmail(), payment.getEmail()));

        if (invoice.getInvoiceDate() == null
                || invoice.getInvoiceDate().isBlank()) {
            invoice.setInvoiceDate(
                    firstNonBlank(
                            payment.getPaymentDate(),
                            java.time.LocalDate.now().toString()
                    )
            );
        }

        if (invoice.getDescription() == null
                || invoice.getDescription().isBlank()) {
            invoice.setDescription(
                    firstNonBlank(
                            payment.getNotes(),
                            payment.getPaymentType() + " payment"
                    )
            );
        }

        /*
         * ========================================================
         * PAYMENT AMOUNTS
         * ========================================================
         */

        invoice.setTotalAmount(
                n(payment.getTotalAmount())
        );

        invoice.setAmountPaid(
                n(payment.getAmountPaid())
        );

        invoice.setBalanceAmount(
                n(payment.getBalanceAmount())
        );

        /*
         * Re-generating re-syncs the invoice with the payment records, so
         * manual line items are dropped (text edits are kept).
         */
        invoice.setItems(null);
        if (n(invoice.getDiscountAmount()) > n(payment.getTotalAmount())) {
            invoice.setDiscountAmount(0.0);
        }

        invoice.setPaymentType(
                payment.getPaymentType()
        );

        invoice.setPaymentDate(
                payment.getPaymentDate()
        );

        /*
         * Payment Status for Invoice:
         *
         * Fully Paid if balance = 0
         * Otherwise payment is Verified
         */
        String invoicePaymentStatus;

        if (n(payment.getBalanceAmount()) <= 0
                && n(payment.getTotalAmount()) > 0) {

            invoicePaymentStatus =
                    Payment.STATUS_FULLY_PAID;

        } else {

            invoicePaymentStatus =
                    payment.getVerificationStatus() != null
                            ? payment.getVerificationStatus()
                            : payment.getStatus();
        }

        invoice.setPaymentStatus(
                invoicePaymentStatus
        );

        /*
         * ========================================================
         * PAYMENT HISTORY SNAPSHOT
         * ========================================================
         */

        invoice.setPaymentHistory(
                payment.getPaymentHistory() == null
                        ? new ArrayList<>()
                        : new ArrayList<>(
                                payment.getPaymentHistory()
                        )
        );

        /*
         * ========================================================
         * GENERATION AUDIT
         * ========================================================
         */

        invoice.setGeneratedBy(
                accessService.currentUsername()
        );

        invoice.setGeneratedAt(
                Instant.now()
        );

        /*
         * Save first so the invoice has a database record.
         */
        invoice = invoiceRepo.save(invoice);

        /*
         * ========================================================
         * GENERATE EXACT EXCEL TEMPLATE INVOICE
         * ========================================================
         */

        try {

            String excelPath =
                    excelService.generate(
                            invoice,
                            payment
                    );

            invoice.setExcelPath(
                    excelPath
            );

            invoice.setExcelFileName(
                    invoice.getInvoiceNumber()
                            + ".xlsx"
            );

        } catch (Exception e) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Unable to generate Excel invoice: "
                            + e.getMessage(),
                    e
            );
        }

        /*
         * ========================================================
         * GENERATE PDF
         * ========================================================
         */

        try {

            String pdfPath =
                    pdfService.generate(
                            invoice
                    );

            invoice.setPdfPath(
                    pdfPath
            );

            invoice.setPdfFileName(
                    invoice.getInvoiceNumber()
                            + ".pdf"
            );

        } catch (Exception e) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Unable to generate PDF invoice: "
                            + e.getMessage(),
                    e
            );
        }

        /*
         * Save generated paths.
         */
        invoice = invoiceRepo.save(invoice);

        /*
         * ========================================================
         * UPDATE PAYMENT
         * ========================================================
         */

        payment.setInvoiceId(
                invoice.getId()
        );

        payment.setInvoiceStatus(
                INVOICE_GENERATED
        );

        /*
         * Preserve Fully Paid.
         */
        if (n(payment.getBalanceAmount()) <= 0
                && n(payment.getTotalAmount()) > 0) {

            payment.setStatus(
                    Payment.STATUS_FULLY_PAID
            );

        } else {

            payment.setStatus(
                    Payment.STATUS_INVOICE_GENERATED
            );
        }

        addTimeline(
                payment,
                "Invoice "
                        + invoice.getInvoiceNumber()
                        + " generated by Super Admin",
                "document",
                "#dbeafe",
                "#1d4ed8"
        );

        return paymentRepo.save(payment);
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * SEND INVOICE TO TELECALLER
     * ============================================================
     */

    public Payment sendInvoiceToTelecaller(
            String id
    ) {

        Payment payment = adminGet(id);

        if (payment.getInvoiceId() == null
                || payment.getInvoiceId().isBlank()) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Generate the invoice before sending "
                            + "it to the telecaller."
            );
        }

        Invoice invoice = invoiceRepo
                .findById(payment.getInvoiceId())
                .orElseThrow(
                        () -> new IllegalStateException(
                                "Invoice record missing"
                        )
                );

        invoice.setSentToTelecallerAt(
                Instant.now()
        );

        invoiceRepo.save(invoice);

        payment.setInvoiceStatus(
                INVOICE_SENT_TO_TELECALLER
        );

        /*
         * This workflow status indicates the invoice
         * is now available to the Telecaller.
         */
        payment.setStatus(
                Payment.STATUS_INVOICE_SENT_TO_TELECALLER
        );

        addTimeline(
                payment,
                "Invoice sent to telecaller "
                        + nz(payment.getTelecallerName()),
                "send",
                "#e0e7ff",
                "#4338ca"
        );

        return paymentRepo.save(payment);
    }
