    public Invoice getInvoice(
            String paymentId
    ) {

        Payment payment =
                adminGet(paymentId);

        if (payment.getInvoiceId() == null
                || payment.getInvoiceId().isBlank()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "No invoice generated yet"
            );
        }

        return invoiceRepo
                .findById(payment.getInvoiceId())
                .orElseThrow(
                        () -> new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Invoice record missing"
                        )
                );
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * TELECALLER READS THE INVOICE THE SUPER ADMIN GENERATED / EDITED
     * ============================================================
     */

    public Invoice invoiceForTelecaller(String paymentId) {
        Payment payment = get(paymentId); // also checks the payment belongs to this telecaller

        if (payment.getInvoiceId() == null
                || payment.getInvoiceId().isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "No invoice has been generated yet"
            );
        }

        return invoiceRepo
                .findById(payment.getInvoiceId())
                .orElseThrow(
                        () -> new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Invoice record missing"
                        )
                );
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * EDIT GENERATED INVOICE - SUPER ADMIN
     * ============================================================
     */

    private static final Pattern INVOICE_NO =
            Pattern.compile("^INV-IC/\\d{5,}$");

    /** Super Admin edits any invoice. */
    public Invoice updateInvoice(
            String paymentId,
            InvoiceUpdateRequest r
    ) {
        return applyInvoiceUpdate(
                adminGet(paymentId),
                getInvoice(paymentId),
                r,
                "Super Admin"
        );
    }

    /** Telecaller edits the invoice of one of THEIR OWN payments. */
    public Invoice updateInvoiceForTelecaller(
            String paymentId,
            InvoiceUpdateRequest r
    ) {
        Payment payment = get(paymentId); // ownership check
        return applyInvoiceUpdate(
                payment,
                invoiceForTelecaller(paymentId),
                r,
                "Telecaller"
        );
    }

    private Invoice applyInvoiceUpdate(
            Payment payment,
            Invoice invoice,
            InvoiceUpdateRequest r,
            String editedByRole
    ) {

        /* ---------- invoice number (format + unique) ---------- */
        if (r.getInvoiceNumber() != null
                && !r.getInvoiceNumber().isBlank()) {

            String number = r.getInvoiceNumber().trim();

            if (!INVOICE_NO.matcher(number).matches()) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Invoice number format must be INV-IC/00760"
                );
            }

            if (!number.equals(invoice.getInvoiceNumber())) {
                final String currentId = invoice.getId();
                invoiceRepo.findByInvoiceNumber(number)
                        .filter(other -> !other.getId().equals(currentId))
                        .ifPresent(other -> {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Invoice number " + number
                                            + " is already used"
                            );
                        });
                invoice.setInvoiceNumber(number);
            }
        }

        if (r.getInvoiceDate() != null && !r.getInvoiceDate().isBlank())
            invoice.setInvoiceDate(r.getInvoiceDate().trim());
        if (r.getPaymentStatus() != null && !r.getPaymentStatus().isBlank())
            invoice.setPaymentStatus(r.getPaymentStatus().trim());

        /* ---------- plain text fields (client, company, bank, signature...) ---------- */
        if (r.getOrganizationName() != null) invoice.setOrganizationName(r.getOrganizationName().trim());
        if (r.getAddress() != null) invoice.setAddress(r.getAddress().trim());
        if (r.getPhone() != null) invoice.setPhone(r.getPhone().trim());
        if (r.getCustomerGstin() != null) {
            String gstin = r.getCustomerGstin().trim().toUpperCase();
            if (!gstin.isEmpty()
                    && !gstin.matches("^\\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\\d{4}[A-Z][A-Z\\d]Z[A-Z\\d]$"))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "GSTIN must be a valid 15-character GST number");
            invoice.setCustomerGstin(gstin);
        }
        if (r.getEmail() != null) invoice.setEmail(r.getEmail().trim());
        if (r.getPaymentType() != null) invoice.setPaymentType(r.getPaymentType().trim());
        if (r.getShippingName() != null) invoice.setShippingName(r.getShippingName().trim());
        if (r.getShippingAddress() != null) invoice.setShippingAddress(r.getShippingAddress().trim());
        if (r.getCompanyName() != null) invoice.setCompanyName(r.getCompanyName().trim());
        if (r.getCompanyAddress() != null) invoice.setCompanyAddress(r.getCompanyAddress().trim());
        if (r.getCompanyEmail() != null) invoice.setCompanyEmail(r.getCompanyEmail().trim());
        if (r.getCompanyMobile() != null) invoice.setCompanyMobile(r.getCompanyMobile().trim());
        if (r.getCompanyWebsite() != null) invoice.setCompanyWebsite(r.getCompanyWebsite().trim());
        if (r.getBankName() != null) invoice.setBankName(r.getBankName().trim());
        if (r.getBankBranch() != null) invoice.setBankBranch(r.getBankBranch().trim());
        if (r.getBankIfsc() != null) invoice.setBankIfsc(r.getBankIfsc().trim());
        if (r.getBankAccountNo() != null) invoice.setBankAccountNo(r.getBankAccountNo().trim());
        if (r.getDeclaration() != null) invoice.setDeclaration(r.getDeclaration().trim());
        if (r.getSignatoryFor() != null) invoice.setSignatoryFor(r.getSignatoryFor().trim());
        if (r.getSignatoryName() != null) invoice.setSignatoryName(r.getSignatoryName().trim());
        if (r.getSignatoryTitle() != null) invoice.setSignatoryTitle(r.getSignatoryTitle().trim());

        /* ---------- line items -> subtotal ---------- */
        if (r.getItems() != null) {
            if (r.getItems().isEmpty())
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Add at least one invoice item");
            if (r.getItems().size() > 50)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("An invoice can have at most 50 items");

            List<Invoice.Item> clean = new ArrayList<>();
            double sum = 0;
            for (Invoice.Item in : r.getItems()) {
                if (in.getDescription() == null || in.getDescription().isBlank())
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Every item needs a description");
                if (in.getQuantity() == null || in.getQuantity() <= 0)
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Item quantity must be greater than zero");
                if (in.getRate() == null || in.getRate() < 0)
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Item rate cannot be negative");
                Invoice.Item item = new Invoice.Item();
                item.setDescription(in.getDescription().trim());
                item.setQuantity(in.getQuantity());
                item.setRate(in.getRate());
                clean.add(item);
                sum += in.getQuantity() * in.getRate();
            }
            invoice.setItems(clean);
            invoice.setTotalAmount(Math.round(sum * 100.0) / 100.0);
            invoice.setDescription(clean.get(0).getDescription());
        }

        /* ---------- discount / tax / paid ---------- */
        double total = n(invoice.getTotalAmount());

        if (r.getDiscountAmount() != null) {
            if (r.getDiscountAmount() < 0)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Discount cannot be negative");
            invoice.setDiscountAmount(r.getDiscountAmount());
        }
        if (n(invoice.getDiscountAmount()) > total)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Discount cannot be more than the subtotal");

        if (r.getTaxRate() != null) {
            if (r.getTaxRate() < 0 || r.getTaxRate() > 100)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Tax rate must be between 0 and 100");
            invoice.setTaxRate(r.getTaxRate());
        }

        if (r.getAmountPaid() != null) {
            if (r.getAmountPaid() < 0)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Paid amount cannot be negative");
            invoice.setAmountPaid(r.getAmountPaid());
        }

        double taxable = Math.max(0, total - n(invoice.getDiscountAmount()));
        double grand = taxable + (taxable * n(invoice.getTaxRate())) / 100.0;
        if (n(invoice.getAmountPaid()) > grand + 0.005)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Paid amount cannot be more than the invoice total");
        invoice.setBalanceAmount(Math.max(0, Math.round((grand - n(invoice.getAmountPaid())) * 100.0) / 100.0));

        invoice.setEditedBy(accessService.currentUsername());
        invoice.setEditedAt(Instant.now());
        invoice = invoiceRepo.save(invoice);

        /* keep Telecaller PDF / Excel downloads in sync with the edit */
        try {
            invoice.setExcelPath(excelService.generate(invoice, payment));
            invoice.setPdfPath(pdfService.generate(invoice));
            invoice = invoiceRepo.save(invoice);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // The edit is already saved. PDF / Excel are rebuilt in the browser from the saved data,
            // so a failed server-side file must not make the whole Save look failed.
            org.slf4j.LoggerFactory.getLogger(PaymentService.class)
                    .warn("Invoice {} saved, but PDF/Excel regeneration failed: {}",
                            invoice.getInvoiceNumber(), e.getMessage());
        }

        addTimeline(
                payment,
                "Invoice " + invoice.getInvoiceNumber()
                        + " edited by " + editedByRole,
                "edit",
                "#dbeafe",
                "#1d4ed8"
        );
        paymentRepo.save(payment);

        return invoice;
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * ADD PAYMENT RECORD
     * ============================================================
     */

    public Payment addPaymentRecord(
            String id,
            PaymentRecordRequest request
    ) {

        Payment payment = get(id);

        return addRecordInternal(
                payment,
                request
        );
    }

    public Payment adminAddPaymentRecord(
            String id,
            PaymentRecordRequest request
    ) {

        Payment payment = adminGet(id);

        return addRecordInternal(
                payment,
                request
        );
    }

    private Payment addRecordInternal(
            Payment payment,
            PaymentRecordRequest request
    ) {

        recalculate(payment);

        if (n(payment.getBalanceAmount()) <= 0
                || Payment.STATUS_FULLY_PAID.equals(
                        payment.getStatus()
                )) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "The client is already fully paid. "
                            + "No more payment records can be added "
                            + "unless the Super Admin increases "
                            + "the total amount."
            );
        }

        double amount =
                n(request.getPaymentAmount());

        if (amount <= 0) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Payment amount must be greater than zero"
            );
        }

        if (amount > n(payment.getBalanceAmount())) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Payment amount cannot exceed "
                            + "remaining balance"
            );
        }

        Payment.PaymentRecord record =
                new Payment.PaymentRecord();

        record.setId(
                UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        );

        record.setAmount(
                amount
        );

        record.setPaymentType(
                request.getPaymentType()
        );

        record.setPaymentDate(
                request.getPaymentDate()
        );

        record.setPaymentMethod(
                request.getPaymentMethod()
        );

        record.setTransactionReferenceNumber(
                request.getTransactionReferenceNumber()
        );

        record.setNotes(
                request.getNotes()
        );

        record.setStatus(
                firstNonBlank(
                        request.getStatus(),
                        "Paid"
                )
        );

        record.setRecordedBy(
                accessService.currentUsername()
        );

        record.setRecordedAt(
                Instant.now()
        );

        if (payment.getPaymentHistory() == null) {

            payment.setPaymentHistory(
                    new ArrayList<>()
            );
        }

        payment.getPaymentHistory().add(
                record
        );

        recalculate(payment);

        /*
         * Payment changed after verification.
         * It must be verified again.
         */
        resetVerificationAndInvoiceAfterPaymentChange(
                payment
        );

        addTimeline(
                payment,
                "Payment record added: "
                        + fmt(amount),
                "plus",
                "#dcfce7",
                "#15803d"
        );

        return paymentRepo.save(payment);
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * UPDATE PAYMENT HISTORY RECORD
     * ============================================================
     */

    public Payment adminUpdatePaymentRecord(
            String id,
            String recordId,
            PaymentRecordRequest request
    ) {

        Payment payment = adminGet(id);

        if (payment.getPaymentHistory() == null) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Payment history record not found"
            );
        }

        Payment.PaymentRecord record =
                payment.getPaymentHistory()
                        .stream()
                        .filter(
                                item -> recordId.equals(
                                        item.getId()
                                )
                        )
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () -> new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Payment history record not found"
                                )
                        );

        if (request.getPaymentAmount() != null) {

            if (request.getPaymentAmount() <= 0) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Payment amount must be greater than zero"
                );
            }

            record.setAmount(
                    request.getPaymentAmount()
            );
        }

        if (request.getPaymentType() != null) {
            record.setPaymentType(
                    request.getPaymentType()
            );
        }

        if (request.getPaymentDate() != null) {
            record.setPaymentDate(
                    request.getPaymentDate()
            );
        }

        if (request.getPaymentMethod() != null) {
            record.setPaymentMethod(
                    request.getPaymentMethod()
            );
        }

        if (request.getTransactionReferenceNumber() != null) {
            record.setTransactionReferenceNumber(
                    request.getTransactionReferenceNumber()
            );
        }

        if (request.getNotes() != null) {
            record.setNotes(
                    request.getNotes()
            );
        }

        if (request.getStatus() != null) {
            record.setStatus(
                    request.getStatus()
            );
        }

        recalculate(payment);

        if (n(payment.getAmountPaid())
                > n(payment.getTotalAmount())) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Total paid cannot exceed total amount"
            );
        }

        /*
         * Record changed.
         * Old verification and invoice are no longer valid.
         */
        resetVerificationAndInvoiceAfterPaymentChange(
                payment
        );

        addTimeline(
                payment,
                "Payment history record updated "
                        + "by Super Admin",
                "edit",
                "#dbeafe",
                "#1d4ed8"
        );

        return paymentRepo.save(payment);
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * RESET AFTER PAYMENT CHANGE
     * ============================================================
     */

    private void resetVerificationAndInvoiceAfterPaymentChange(
            Payment payment
    ) {

        payment.setVerificationStatus(
                VERIFICATION_PENDING
        );

        payment.setVerifiedBy(null);

        payment.setVerifiedAt(null);

        payment.setInvoiceStatus(
                INVOICE_NOT_GENERATED
        );

        /*
         * Keep invoiceId if historical invoice exists,
         * but current payment must be re-verified.
         */
        if (n(payment.getBalanceAmount()) <= 0
                && n(payment.getTotalAmount()) > 0) {

            payment.setStatus(
                    Payment.STATUS_FULLY_PAID
            );

        } else {

            payment.setStatus(
                    Payment.STATUS_RECORDED
            );
        }
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * INITIAL PAYMENT REQUEST -> PAYMENT HISTORY RECORD
     * ============================================================
     */

    private Payment.PaymentRecord toRecord(
            PaymentRequest request,
            String user
    ) {

        Payment.PaymentRecord record =
                new Payment.PaymentRecord();

        record.setId(
                UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        );

        record.setAmount(
                n(request.getAmountPaid())
        );

        record.setPaymentType(
                request.getPaymentType()
        );

        record.setPaymentDate(
                request.getPaymentDate()
        );

        record.setPaymentMethod(
                request.getPaymentMethod()
        );

        record.setTransactionReferenceNumber(
                request.getTransactionReferenceNumber()
        );

        record.setNotes(
                request.getNotes()
        );

        record.setStatus(
                firstNonBlank(
                        request.getPaymentStatus(),
                        "Paid"
                )
        );

        record.setRecordedBy(
                user
        );

        record.setRecordedAt(
                Instant.now()
        );

        return record;
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * BALANCE CALCULATION
     * ============================================================
     */

    private void recalculate(
            Payment payment
    ) {

        double totalPaid = 0.0;

        if (payment.getPaymentHistory() != null) {

            totalPaid =
                    payment.getPaymentHistory()
                            .stream()
                            .filter(
                                    record ->
                                            !"Pending".equalsIgnoreCase(
                                                    record.getStatus()
                                            )
                                                    && !"Remaining".equalsIgnoreCase(
                                                            record.getStatus()
                                                    )
                            )
                            .map(
                                    Payment.PaymentRecord::getAmount
                            )
                            .filter(
                                    java.util.Objects::nonNull
                            )
                            .mapToDouble(
                                    Double::doubleValue
                            )
                            .sum();
        }

        payment.setAmountPaid(
                totalPaid
        );

        double balance =
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        n(payment.getTotalAmount())
                                - totalPaid
                );

        payment.setBalanceAmount(
                balance
        );

        /*
         * Only derive collection status here.
         * Do not overwrite workflow statuses unnecessarily.
         */
        if (balance <= 0
                && n(payment.getTotalAmount()) > 0) {

            payment.setStatus(
                    Payment.STATUS_FULLY_PAID
            );

        } else if (Payment.STATUS_FULLY_PAID.equals(
                payment.getStatus()
        )) {

            if (VERIFICATION_VERIFIED.equalsIgnoreCase(
                    payment.getVerificationStatus()
            )) {

                payment.setStatus(
                        Payment.STATUS_VERIFIED
                );

            } else {

                payment.setStatus(
                        Payment.STATUS_RECORDED
                );
            }
        }
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * SUPER ADMIN QR CODE
     * ============================================================
     */

    public PaymentQrCode uploadQr(
            MultipartFile file
    ) throws Exception {

        if (file == null || file.isEmpty()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "QR code image is required"
            );
        }

        String contentType =
                file.getContentType();

        if (contentType == null
                || !contentType.startsWith(
                        "image/"
                )) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Only image QR files are allowed"
            );
        }

        /*
         * Only one active Super Admin QR.
         */
        qrRepo.deleteAll();

        PaymentQrCode qr =
                new PaymentQrCode();

        qr.setFileName(
                file.getOriginalFilename()
        );

        qr.setContentType(
                contentType
        );

        qr.setData(
                file.getBytes()
        );

        qr.setUploadedAt(
                Instant.now()
        );

        qr.setUploadedBy(
                accessService.currentUsername()
        );

        return qrRepo.save(qr);
    }

    public PaymentQrCode currentQr() {

        return qrRepo.findAll()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * INVOICE FILE HELPERS
     * ============================================================
     */

    private File invoiceFile(
            Payment payment
    ) {

        if (payment.getInvoiceId() == null
                || payment.getInvoiceId().isBlank()) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "No invoice generated for this payment yet."
            );
        }

        Invoice invoice =
                invoiceRepo
                        .findById(
                                payment.getInvoiceId()
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () -> new IllegalStateException(
                                        "Invoice record missing"
                                )
                        );

        if (invoice.getPdfPath() == null
                || invoice.getPdfPath().isBlank()) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "PDF invoice file is not available."
            );
        }

        return new File(
                invoice.getPdfPath()
        );
    }

    private File invoiceExcelFile(
            Payment payment
    ) {

        if (payment.getInvoiceId() == null
                || payment.getInvoiceId().isBlank()) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "No invoice generated for this payment yet."
            );
        }

        Invoice invoice =
                invoiceRepo
                        .findById(
                                payment.getInvoiceId()
                        )
                        .orElseThrow(
                                () -> new IllegalStateException(
                                        "Invoice record missing"
                                )
                        );

        if (invoice.getExcelPath() == null
                || invoice.getExcelPath().isBlank()) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Exact Excel invoice file "
                            + "is not available."
            );
        }

        return new File(
                invoice.getExcelPath()
        );
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * HELPERS
     * ============================================================
     */

    private String nextInvoiceNumber() {
        // INV-IC/00760, INV-IC/00761, ... (atomic counter, never duplicates)
        return invoiceNumberService.next();
    }

    private void addTimeline(
            Payment payment,
            String action,
            String icon,
            String bg,
            String color
    ) {

        if (payment.getTimeline() == null) {

            payment.setTimeline(
                    new ArrayList<>()
            );
        }

        payment.getTimeline()
                .add(
                        new Payment.TimelineEntry(
                                action,
                                TS_FMT.format(
                                        Instant.now()
                                ),
                                icon,
                                bg,
                                color
                        )
                );
    }

    private String fmt(
            Double value
    ) {

        return "₹"
                + String.format(
                        "%,.0f",
                        value == null
                                ? 0
                                : value
                );
    }

    private double n(
            Double value
    ) {

        return value == null
                ? 0.0
                : value;
    }

    private String nz(
            String value
    ) {

        return value == null
                ? "-"
                : value;
    }

    private String firstNonBlank(
            String... values
    ) {

        for (String value : values) {

            if (value != null
                    && !value.isBlank()) {

                return value;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.awt.RenderingHints;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Properties;

import javax.imageio.IIOImage;
import javax.imageio.ImageIO;
import javax.imageio.ImageWriteParam;
import javax.imageio.ImageWriter;
import javax.imageio.stream.ImageOutputStream;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.DesignBlock;

/**
 * Letterhead used by every built-in quotation PDF:
 *   - letterpad : full-page A4 background.
 *   - logo      : uploaded by the Super Admin.
 *   - footer    : phone / website / address.
 */
@Service
public class QuotationBrandingService {

    private static final double PW = 595.28, PH = 841.89;
    private static final long MAX_BYTES = 10L * 1024 * 1024;

    static final String DEF_PHONE = "8925811993 / 8925811994";
    static final String DEF_WEB = "www.indocampas.com";
    static final String DEF_ADDRESS =
            "TIDEL NEO - Thiruchitrambalam\nKoot Road, Tamil Nadu 605111";

    @Value("${quotation.storage.dir:./storage/quotations}")
    private String storageDirProp;

    // ───────────────────────── storage ─────────────────────────

    private Path dir() throws IOException {
        Path p = Paths.get(storageDirProp)
                .toAbsolutePath()
                .normalize()
                .resolve("branding");

        Files.createDirectories(p);
        return p;
    }

    private Path logoFile() throws IOException {
        return dir().resolve("logo.png");
    }

    private Path letterpadFile() throws IOException {
        return dir().resolve("letterpad.jpg");
    }

    private Path settingsFile() throws IOException {
        return dir().resolve("branding.properties");
    }

    private Properties settings() {
        Properties p = new Properties();

        try {
            Path f = settingsFile();

            if (Files.isRegularFile(f)) {
                try (InputStream in = Files.newInputStream(f)) {
                    p.load(new java.io.InputStreamReader(in, "UTF-8"));
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }

        return p;
    }

    // ───────────────────────── public API ─────────────────────────

    public synchronized Map<String, Object> save(
            String type, MultipartFile file) throws IOException {

        if (file == null || file.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Please choose an image file.");
        }

        if (file.getSize() > MAX_BYTES) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Image must be smaller than 10 MB.");
        }

        BufferedImage img = ImageIO.read(
                new ByteArrayInputStream(file.getBytes()));

        if (img == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Unsupported image. Please upload a PNG or JPG file.");
        }

        if ("logo".equalsIgnoreCase(type)) {

            BufferedImage out = scaleDown(
                    img,
                    1400,
                    700,
                    BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB,
                    null
            );

            ImageIO.write(out, "png", logoFile().toFile());

        } else if ("letterpad".equalsIgnoreCase(type)) {

            double ratio = img.getHeight() / (double) img.getWidth();

            if (ratio < 1.30 || ratio > 1.52) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Letterpad must be an A4 portrait image "
                        + "(for example 2480 x 3508 px). "
                        + "The uploaded image is "
                        + img.getWidth() + " x " + img.getHeight() + ".");
            }

            BufferedImage out = scaleDown(
                    img,
                    1654,
                    2339,
                    BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB,
                    Color.WHITE
            );

            writeJpeg(out, letterpadFile(), 0.9f);

        } else {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Unknown branding type: " + type);
        }

        return status();
    }

    public synchronized Map<String, Object> delete(
            String type) throws IOException {

        if ("logo".equalsIgnoreCase(type)) {
            Files.deleteIfExists(logoFile());

        } else if ("letterpad".equalsIgnoreCase(type)) {
            Files.deleteIfExists(letterpadFile());

        } else {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Unknown branding type: " + type);
        }

        return status();
    }

    public synchronized Map<String, Object> saveSettings(
            Map<String, Object> in) throws IOException {

        Properties p = settings();

        if (in.containsKey("showBrandText")) {
            p.setProperty(
                    "showBrandText",
                    String.valueOf(
                            Boolean.parseBoolean(
                                    String.valueOf(in.get("showBrandText"))
                            )
                    )
            );
        }

        for (String k : new String[]{"phone", "website", "address"}) {
            if (in.containsKey(k)) {
                p.setProperty(
                        k,
                        String.valueOf(
                                in.get(k) == null ? "" : in.get(k)
                        ).trim()
                );
            }
        }

        try (java.io.Writer w =
                new java.io.OutputStreamWriter(
                        Files.newOutputStream(settingsFile()), "UTF-8")) {

            p.store(w, "quotation branding");
        }

        return status();
    }

    public Map<String, Object> status() throws IOException {

        Properties p = settings();

        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        boolean hasLogo = Files.isRegularFile(logoFile());
        boolean hasPad = Files.isRegularFile(letterpadFile());

        m.put("hasLogo", hasLogo);
        m.put("hasLetterpad", hasPad);
        m.put("usingDefaultLetterpad", !hasPad);

        m.put(
                "showBrandText",
                Boolean.parseBoolean(
                        p.getProperty("showBrandText", "false")
                )
        );

        m.put("phone", p.getProperty("phone", DEF_PHONE));
        m.put("website", p.getProperty("website", DEF_WEB));
        m.put("address", p.getProperty("address", DEF_ADDRESS));

        m.put(
                "logoDataUrl",
                hasLogo
                        ? dataUrl("image/png", Files.readAllBytes(logoFile()))
                        : ""
        );

        byte[] pad = letterpadBytes();

        m.put(
                "letterpadDataUrl",
                pad == null
                        ? ""
                        : dataUrl("image/jpeg", thumbnailJpeg(pad, 520))
        );

        return m;
    }

    /**
     * Logo (PNG) uploaded by the Super Admin,
     * or null when none was uploaded.
     */
    public byte[] logoBytes() {
        try {
            return Files.isRegularFile(logoFile())
                    ? Files.readAllBytes(logoFile())
                    : null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Footer text + brand-text switch
     * (phone, website, address, showBrandText)
     * with defaults applied.
     */
    public Map<String, Object> footerSettings() {

        Properties p = settings();

        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        m.put(
                "showBrandText",
                Boolean.parseBoolean(
                        p.getProperty("showBrandText", "false")
                )
        );

        m.put("phone", p.getProperty("phone", DEF_PHONE));
        m.put("website", p.getProperty("website", DEF_WEB));
        m.put("address", p.getProperty("address", DEF_ADDRESS));

        return m;
    }

    /** All blocks of the letterhead (background, logo, brand text, footer). */
    public List<DesignBlock> buildLetterhead() {

        List<DesignBlock> b = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            Properties s = settings();

            byte[] pad = letterpadBytes();

            if (pad != null) {
                b.add(image(
                        "letterpad",
                        0, 0, 1, 1,
                        dataUrl("image/jpeg", pad)
                ));
            }

            double textX = 0.094;

            if (Files.isRegularFile(logoFile())) {

                byte[] logoBytes = Files.readAllBytes(logoFile());

                BufferedImage li = ImageIO.read(
                        new ByteArrayInputStream(logoBytes));

                if (li != null) {

                    double boxW = 0.46 * PW;
                    double boxH = 0.105 * PH;

                    double scale = Math.min(
                            boxW / li.getWidth(),
                            boxH / li.getHeight()
                    );

                    double fw = li.getWidth() * scale / PW;
                    double fh = li.getHeight() * scale / PH;

                    b.add(image(
                            "logo",
                            0.094,
                            0.028 + (0.105 - fh) / 2,
                            fw,
                            fh,
                            dataUrl("image/png", logoBytes)
                    ));

                    textX = 0.094 + fw + 0.02;
                }
            }

            if (Boolean.parseBoolean(
                    s.getProperty("showBrandText", "false"))) {

                double w = Math.max(0.2, 0.84 - textX);

                b.add(text(
                        "brandName",
                        textX, 0.045, w, 0.05,
                        "CAMPAS TECH",
                        24, "Helvetica", false, "#7B1113"
                ));

                b.add(text(
                        "brandSub",
                        textX, 0.098, w, 0.035,
                        "Private Limited",
                        14, "Times", false, "#7B1113"
                ));
            }

            // Footer — round icons + text

            String phone = s.getProperty("phone", DEF_PHONE);
            String web = s.getProperty("website", DEF_WEB);
            String address = s.getProperty("address", DEF_ADDRESS);

            double iw = 19 / PW;
            double ih = 19 / PH;
            double ix = 0.14;
            double tx = 0.185;
            double tw = 0.62;

            b.add(image(
                    "phoneIcon",
                    ix, 0.842, iw, ih,
                    QuotationIcons.dataUrl("phone")
            ));

            b.add(text(
                    "phoneText",
                    tx, 0.838, tw, 0.028,
                    phone,
                    10, "Helvetica", false, "#111827"
            ));

            b.add(image(
                    "globeIcon",
                    ix, 0.880, iw, ih,
                    QuotationIcons.dataUrl("globe")
            ));

            b.add(text(
                    "webText",
                    tx, 0.876, tw, 0.028,
                    web,
                    10, "Helvetica", false, "#1D4ED8"
            ));

            b.add(image(
                    "pinIcon",
                    ix, 0.914, iw, ih,
                    QuotationIcons.dataUrl("pin")
            ));

            DesignBlock addr = text(
                    "addrText",
                    tx, 0.910, tw, 0.05,
                    address,
                    10, "Helvetica", false, "#C8102E"
            );

            addr.setVerticalAlign("top");
            b.add(addr);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Never block a quotation because of a letterhead problem.
        }

        return b;
    }

    // ───────────────────────── helpers ─────────────────────────

    /**
     * Uploaded letterpad, else classpath letterpad-default.jpg.
     */
    public byte[] letterpadBytes() {

        try {
            if (Files.isRegularFile(letterpadFile())) {
                return Files.readAllBytes(letterpadFile());
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }

        try (InputStream in = getClass().getResourceAsStream(
                "/quotation-templates/letterpad-default.jpg")) {

            return in == null ? null : in.readAllBytes();

        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static String dataUrl(String mime, byte[] bytes) {
        return "data:" + mime + ";base64,"
                + Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(bytes);
    }

    private static BufferedImage scaleDown(
            BufferedImage src,
            int maxW,
            int maxH,
            int type,
            Color fill) {

        double f = Math.min(
                1.0,
                Math.min(
                        maxW / (double) src.getWidth(),
                        maxH / (double) src.getHeight()
                )
        );

        int w = Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(src.getWidth() * f));
        int h = Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(src.getHeight() * f));

        BufferedImage out = new BufferedImage(w, h, type);

        Graphics2D g = out.createGraphics();

        g.setRenderingHint(
                RenderingHints.KEY_INTERPOLATION,
                RenderingHints.VALUE_INTERPOLATION_BICUBIC
        );

        g.setRenderingHint(
                RenderingHints.KEY_RENDERING,
                RenderingHints.VALUE_RENDER_QUALITY
        );

        if (fill != null) {
            g.setColor(fill);
            g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
        }

        g.drawImage(src, 0, 0, w, h, null);
        g.dispose();

        return out;
    }

    private static void writeJpeg(
            BufferedImage img,
            Path file,
            float quality) throws IOException {

        ImageWriter writer =
                ImageIO.getImageWritersByFormatName("jpeg").next();

        ImageWriteParam param = writer.getDefaultWriteParam();

        param.setCompressionMode(ImageWriteParam.MODE_EXPLICIT);
        param.setCompressionQuality(quality);

        try (
                OutputStream os = Files.newOutputStream(file);
                ImageOutputStream ios =
                        ImageIO.createImageOutputStream(os)
        ) {
            writer.setOutput(ios);
            writer.write(null, new IIOImage(img, null, null), param);

        } finally {
            writer.dispose();
        }
    }

    private static byte[] thumbnailJpeg(byte[] src, int maxW) {

        try {
            BufferedImage im = ImageIO.read(
                    new ByteArrayInputStream(src));

            if (im == null) {
                return src;
            }

            BufferedImage t = scaleDown(
                    im,
                    maxW,
                    maxW * 2,
                    BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB,
                    Color.WHITE
            );

            ByteArrayOutputStream bo = new ByteArrayOutputStream();

            ImageIO.write(t, "jpg", bo);

            return bo.toByteArray();

        } catch (Exception e) {
            return src;
        }
    }

    private DesignBlock image(
            String id,
            double x,
            double y,
            double w,
            double h,
            String dataUrl) {

        DesignBlock b = new DesignBlock();

        b.setId(id);
        b.setType("image");

        b.setX(x);
        b.setY(y);
        b.setWidth(w);
        b.setHeight(h);

        b.setImageDataUrl(dataUrl);

        return b;
    }

    private DesignBlock text(
            String id,
            double x,
            double y,
            double w,
            double h,
            String text,
            double size,
            String family,
            boolean bold,
            String color) {

        DesignBlock d = new DesignBlock();

        d.setId(id);
        d.setType("text");

        d.setX(x);
        d.setY(y);
        d.setWidth(w);
        d.setHeight(h);

        d.setText(text);
        d.setMapsTo("");

        d.setFontSize(size);
        d.setFontFamily(family);
        d.setBold(bold);
        d.setColor(color);

        d.setBackgroundColor("transparent");
        d.setAlign("left");
        d.setVerticalAlign("middle");
        d.setPadding(1);

        return d;
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.geom.*;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import javax.imageio.ImageIO;

/** Draws the three small round footer icons (phone / website / location) of the IndoCampas letterhead. */
final class QuotationIcons {
    private QuotationIcons() {}

    private static final int S = 160;

    static byte[] png(String kind) {
        BufferedImage im = new BufferedImage(S, S, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
        Graphics2D g = im.createGraphics();
        g.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
        g.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_STROKE_CONTROL, RenderingHints.VALUE_STROKE_PURE);
        Color red = new Color(0xC8102E), navy = new Color(0x0F1A2E);
        Color bg = "globe".equals(kind) ? navy : red;
        g.setColor(bg);
        g.fill(new Ellipse2D.Double(3, 3, S - 6, S - 6));
        g.setColor(Color.WHITE);
        switch (kind) {
            case "phone": phone(g, bg); break;
            case "globe": globe(g); break;
            default: pin(g, bg); break;
        }
        g.dispose();
        try (ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
            ImageIO.write(im, "png", out);
            return out.toByteArray();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new byte[0];
        }
    }

    private static void phone(Graphics2D g, Color bg) {
        // handset: quarter-circle bar bulging to the bottom-left with a rounded pad at each end
        double cx = 98, cy = 62, r = 50;
        g.setStroke(new BasicStroke(17f, BasicStroke.CAP_ROUND, BasicStroke.JOIN_ROUND));
        g.draw(new Arc2D.Double(cx - r, cy - r, 2 * r, 2 * r, 172, 106, Arc2D.OPEN));
        for (double ang : new double[]{172, 278}) {
            double x = cx + r * Math.cos(Math.toRadians(ang));
            double y = cy - r * Math.sin(Math.toRadians(ang));
            AffineTransform old = g.getTransform();
            g.rotate(Math.toRadians(-(ang - 90)), x, y);
            g.fill(new RoundRectangle2D.Double(x - 15, y - 12, 30, 24, 10, 10));
            g.setTransform(old);
        }
    }

    private static void globe(Graphics2D g) {
        double c = S / 2.0, r = 40;
        g.setStroke(new BasicStroke(8f, BasicStroke.CAP_ROUND, BasicStroke.JOIN_ROUND));
        g.draw(new Ellipse2D.Double(c - r, c - r, 2 * r, 2 * r));
        g.draw(new Ellipse2D.Double(c - r * 0.45, c - r, r * 0.9, 2 * r));
        g.draw(new Line2D.Double(c - r, c, c + r, c));
        g.draw(new Arc2D.Double(c - r, c - r * 0.55 - r * 0.45, 2 * r, r * 0.9, 200, 140, Arc2D.OPEN));
        g.draw(new Arc2D.Double(c - r, c + r * 0.55 - r * 0.45, 2 * r, r * 0.9, 20, 140, Arc2D.OPEN));
    }

    private static void pin(Graphics2D g, Color bg) {
        double c = S / 2.0;
        Path2D.Double p = new Path2D.Double();
        p.moveTo(c, 124);
        p.curveTo(c - 6, 106, c - 38, 82, c - 38, 62);
        p.curveTo(c - 38, 40, c - 22, 28, c, 28);
        p.curveTo(c + 22, 28, c + 38, 40, c + 38, 62);
        p.curveTo(c + 38, 82, c + 6, 106, c, 124);
        p.closePath();
        g.fill(p);
        g.setColor(bg);
        g.fill(new Ellipse2D.Double(c - 14, 48, 28, 28));
    }

    static String dataUrl(String kind) {
        return "data:image/png;base64," + java.util.Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(png(kind));
    }

    public static void main(String[] a) throws Exception {
        for (String k : new String[]{"phone", "globe", "pin"})
            java.nio.file.Files.write(java.nio.file.Path.of("/tmp/jt/" + k + ".png"), png(k));
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ArrayNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Quotation;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.DesignBlock;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.DesignPage;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.TemplateDesign;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.TemplateField;

/**
 * Built-in quotation layouts that reproduce the three approved IndoCampas PDFs:
 *   1. ERP quotation            (Shanthi Rani Matric school sample)
 *   2. Digital Marketing quote  (Selva Infotech + Kids Kingdom samples)
 *
 * Nothing here reads a template file from disk, so the
 * "The system cannot find the path specified" error can no longer happen.
 * The layouts are drawn with the existing PDFBox "BUILDER" renderer.
 */
@Component
public class QuotationLayouts {

    public static final String ERP_ID = "builtin-erp";
    public static final String DM_ID  = "builtin-digital-marketing";
    public static final String CDM_ID = "builtin-commercial-digital-marketing";
    private static final String MODE_ERP = "BUILTIN_ERP";
    private static final String MODE_DM  = "BUILTIN_DM";

    private static final BigDecimal GST_RATE = new BigDecimal("0.18");
    private static final String BORDER = "#111827";
    private static final double A4_W = 595.28;
    private static final double A4_H = 841.89;
    private static final ZoneId IST = ZoneId.of("Asia/Kolkata");

    // ───────────────────────── public API ─────────────────────────

    public static boolean isBuiltIn(String id) { return id != null && id.startsWith("builtin-"); }

    public static boolean isBuiltInDesign(TemplateDesign d) {
        return d != null && d.getMode() != null && d.getMode().toUpperCase().startsWith("BUILTIN_");
    }

    public List<QuotationTemplate> builtInTemplates() {
        List<QuotationTemplate> list = new ArrayList<>();
        list.add(erpTemplate());
        list.add(digitalMarketingTemplate());
        list.add(commercialDigitalMarketingTemplate());
        return list;
    }

    public QuotationTemplate byId(String id) {
        if (ERP_ID.equals(id)) return erpTemplate();
        if (DM_ID.equals(id)) return digitalMarketingTemplate();
        if (CDM_ID.equals(id)) return commercialDigitalMarketingTemplate();
        throw new RuntimeException("Template not found: " + id);
    }

    public QuotationTemplate forServiceType(String serviceType) {
        String s = serviceType == null ? "" : serviceType.toLowerCase();
        return s.contains("marketing") ? digitalMarketingTemplate() : erpTemplate();
    }

    /** Turns a built-in template + the quotation's data into a concrete BUILDER template that
     *  QuotationPdfService.generateBuilderTemplate() can draw. */
    public QuotationTemplate materialize(Quotation q, QuotationTemplate src, List<DesignBlock> letterhead) {
        boolean dm = MODE_DM.equalsIgnoreCase(src.getDesign().getMode());

        List<DesignBlock> blocks = new ArrayList<>(letterhead);
        if (dm) dmBlocks(blocks, q); else erpBlocks(blocks, q);

        TemplateDesign d = brandDesign();
        d.setMode("BUILDER");
        DesignPage page = new DesignPage();
        page.setId("page_1");
        page.setName("Page 1");
        page.setBackgroundColor("#FFFFFF");
        page.setHeaderEnabled(false);
        page.setFooterEnabled(false);
        page.setBlocks(blocks);
        List<DesignPage> pages = new ArrayList<>();
        pages.add(page);
        d.setPages(pages);
        d.setBlocks(blocks);

        QuotationTemplate out = new QuotationTemplate();
        out.setId(src.getId());
        out.setName(src.getName());
        out.setPdfSource(false);
        out.setPageWidthPt(A4_W);
        out.setPageHeightPt(A4_H);
        out.setFields(src.getFields());
        out.setDesign(d);
        return out;
    }

    // ───────────────────── template definitions ─────────────────────

    private QuotationTemplate erpTemplate() {
        QuotationTemplate t = base(ERP_ID, "IndoCampas ERP Quotation", "ERP", MODE_ERP);
        List<TemplateField> f = new ArrayList<>();

        f.add(field("attn", "Addressed To", "The Principal"));
        f.add(field("ratePro", "ERP PRO - rate per student (default 60)", "60"));
        f.add(field("ratePlus", "ERP PRO PLUS - rate per student (default 120)", "120"));
        f.add(field("rateMax", "ERP PRO MAX - rate per student (default 200)", "200"));
        f.add(field("freeDashboardText", "Admission Dashboard line", "Online Dashboard absolutely FREE"));
        f.add(field("freeMarketingText", "Digital Marketing line", "Digital Marketing: 2 Videos absolutely FREE"));
        f.add(field("admissionCharge", "Admission charge per admitted student (default 2000)", "2000"));
        f.add(field("specialOffer", "Special Offer text (type - to hide)",
                "ERP PRO free with the combined Admission Dashboard and Digital Marketing package, subject to confirmation."));
        t.setFields(f);
        return t;
    }

    private QuotationTemplate digitalMarketingTemplate() {
        QuotationTemplate t = base(DM_ID, "IndoCampas Digital Marketing Quotation", "Digital Marketing", MODE_DM);
        List<TemplateField> f = new ArrayList<>();
        f.add(field("attn", "Attn (e.g. The Principal / Mr. Selva raj)", "The Principal"));
        f.add(field("videosQty", "Promotional Videos (qty)", "4"));
        f.add(field("postersQty", "Social Media Posters (qty)", "4"));
        f.add(field("duration", "Duration", "1 Month"));
        f.add(field("packageAmount", "Package Amount (Rs, before GST) *", ""));
        f.add(field("discount", "Package Discount (Rs, optional)", ""));
        f.add(field("paymentTerms", "Payment", "100% Advance."));
        f.add(field("gstNote", "Extra note (e.g. GST Applicable.)", ""));
        t.setFields(f);

    }

    /** Same layout as Digital Marketing, offered under the "Commercial Digital Marketing" service type. */
    private QuotationTemplate commercialDigitalMarketingTemplate() {
        QuotationTemplate t = digitalMarketingTemplate();
        t.setId(CDM_ID);

    }

    private QuotationTemplate base(String id, String name, String serviceType, String mode) {
        QuotationTemplate t = new QuotationTemplate();
        t.setId(id);
        t.setName(name);
        t.setServiceType(serviceType);
        t.setCreatedBy("system");
        t.setPdfSource(false);
        t.setPageWidthPt(A4_W);
        t.setPageHeightPt(A4_H);
        TemplateDesign d = brandDesign();
        d.setMode(mode);
        t.setDesign(d);
        return t;
    }

    private TemplateDesign brandDesign() {
        TemplateDesign d = new TemplateDesign();
        d.setCompanyName("INDO CAMPAS TECH");
        d.setCompanySubtitle("Private Limited");
        d.setCompanyPhone("8925811993 / 8925811994");
        d.setCompanyWebsite("www.indocampas.com");
        d.setCompanyAddress("TIDEL NEO - Thiruchitrambalam\nKoot Road, Tamil Nadu 605111");
        d.setPrimaryColor("#7B1113");
        d.setBackgroundColor("#FFFFFF");
        d.setFontFamily("Times");
        d.setHeaderEnabled(false);
        d.setFooterEnabled(false);
        return d;
    }

    private TemplateField field(String id, String label, String def) {
        TemplateField f = new TemplateField();
        f.setId(id);
        f.setLabel(label);
        f.setMapsTo(id);
        f.setDefaultValue(def);
        return f;
    }

    // ───────────────────────── document data ─────────────────────────
    // The New Quotation screen sends the whole editable document as JSON in fieldValues["doc"].
    // Quotations created before that (simple template fields) are converted to the same shape.

    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    private JsonNode docFor(Quotation q, boolean dm) {
        String raw = q.getFieldValues() == null ? null : q.getFieldValues().get("doc");
        if (raw != null && !raw.isBlank()) {
            try {
                JsonNode n = MAPPER.readTree(raw);
                if (n != null && n.isObject()) return n;
            } catch (Exception ignored) { /* fall through to legacy */ }
        }
        return legacyDoc(q, dm);
    }

    private ObjectNode legacyDoc(Quotation q, boolean dm) {
        ObjectNode d = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
        d.put("_legacy", true);
        d.put("attn", val(q, "attn", "The Principal"));
        d.put("gstPercent", "18");
        if (!dm) {
            d.put("strength", val(q, "studentStrength", ""));
            ArrayNode plans = d.putArray("plans");
            plans.addObject().put("name", "ERP PRO - Per Student/Year").put("rate", val(q, "ratePro", "60"));
            plans.addObject().put("name", "ERP PRO PLUS - Per Student/Year").put("rate", val(q, "ratePlus", "120"));
            plans.addObject().put("name", "ERP PRO MAX - Per Student/Year").put("rate", val(q, "rateMax", "200"));
            ArrayNode free = d.putArray("freeRows");
            free.addObject().put("label", "Admission Dashboard").put("text", val(q, "freeDashboardText", "Online Dashboard absolutely FREE"));
            free.addObject().put("label", "Digital Marketing").put("text", val(q, "freeMarketingText", "Digital Marketing: 2 Videos absolutely FREE"));
            ArrayNode notes = d.putArray("notes");
            notes.addObject().put("label", "Admission Dashboard:").put("text", "Online admissions, student data management and reports.");
            notes.addObject().put("label", "Digital Marketing:").put("text", "Social media promotions and admission lead generation.");
            notes.addObject().put("label", "Admission Charges:")
                    .put("text", inr(num(val(q, "admissionCharge", "2000"), new BigDecimal("2000"))) + " per student admitted through our platform.");
            String offer = val(q, "specialOffer",
                    "ERP PRO free with the combined Admission Dashboard and Digital Marketing package, subject to confirmation.");
            if (!offer.trim().equals("-")) notes.addObject().put("label", "Special Offer:").put("text", offer);
        } else {
            ArrayNode svc = d.putArray("services");
            svc.addObject().put("name", "Promotional Videos").put("qty", val(q, "videosQty", "-"));
            svc.addObject().put("name", "Social Media Posters").put("qty", val(q, "postersQty", "-"));
            svc.addObject().put("name", "Duration").put("qty", val(q, "duration", "1 Month"));
            d.put("package", val(q, "packageAmount", ""));
            d.put("discount", val(q, "discount", ""));
            d.putArray("extras");
            d.put("payment", val(q, "paymentTerms", "100% Advance."));
            ArrayNode notes = d.putArray("notes");
            String note = val(q, "gstNote", "");
            if (!note.isBlank()) notes.addObject().put("text", note);
        }
        return d;
    }

    private String s(JsonNode n, String key, String def) {
        JsonNode v = n == null ? null : n.get(key);
        if (v == null || v.isNull()) return def;
        String t = v.asText();
        return t == null || t.isBlank() ? def : t.trim();
    }

    private BigDecimal pct(JsonNode d) {
        return num(s(d, "gstPercent", "18"), new BigDecimal("18")).divide(new BigDecimal("100"));
    }

    private String pctLabel(JsonNode d) {
        return num(s(d, "gstPercent", "18"), new BigDecimal("18")).stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString();
    }

    /** Rough number of text lines a paragraph needs (for block height). */
    private int linesFor(String text, int charsPerLine) {
        int lines = 0;
        for (String part : nvl(text).split("\n", -1)) lines += Math.max(1, (int) Math.ceil(part.length() / (double) charsPerLine));
        return lines;
    }

    // ───────────────────────── layout (all measurements in PDF points) ─────────────────────────
    // A4 = 595 x 842 pt. Content area: x 56..539. Letterpad ribbons: top-right (y < 120) and
    // bottom-left (y > 645, x < 70); the footer sits at y 705..800, x 83..400.

    private static final double ML = 56, CW = 483;          // left margin, content width
    private static final double BODY = 11, TBL = 10.5;      // font sizes
    private static final double LINE = 18;                  // height of one info line
    private static final double CONTENT_MAX_Y = 650;        // content must end above the bottom ribbon

    private double fx(double pt) { return pt / A4_W; }
    private double fy(double pt) { return pt / A4_H; }

    private DesignBlock tp(List<DesignBlock> b, String id, double x, double y, double w, double h,
                           String text, double size, boolean bold, String align) {
        return text(b, id, fx(x), fy(y), fx(w), fy(h), text, size, bold, align);
    }

    private void cp(List<DesignBlock> b, String id, double x, double y, double w, double h,
                    String text, boolean bold, String align) {
        cell(b, id, fx(x), fy(y), fx(w), fy(h), text, bold, align);
    }

    /** bold label + normal value on one line */
    private void lv(List<DesignBlock> b, String id, double x, double y, double labelW, String label,
                    double valueW, String value) {
        tp(b, id + "L", x, y, labelW, LINE, label, BODY, true, "left");
        tp(b, id + "V", x + labelW, y, valueW, LINE, value, BODY, false, "left");
    }

    /** height of a table row whose first-column text may wrap */
    private double rowH(String text, double colW, double min) {
        int lines = Math.max(1, (int) Math.ceil(nvl(text).length() * 5.6 / Math.max(20, colW - 10)));
        return Math.max(min, lines * 13 + 12);
    }

    private void title(List<DesignBlock> b, String t) {
        tp(b, "title", ML, 138, CW, 24, t, 14, true, "center");
    }

    private void signature(List<DesignBlock> b, double y, JsonNode d) {
        double x = 330, w = 209;
        tp(b, "sig1", x, y, w, LINE, s(d, "signCompany", "For INDOCAMPAS TECH PRIVATE LIMITED"), 9.5, true, "left");
        tp(b, "sig2", x, y + 26, w, LINE, s(d, "signName", "R. Aravinda Raj"), BODY, false, "left");
        tp(b, "sig3", x, y + 44, w, LINE, s(d, "signTitle", "Chief Executive Officer"), BODY, false, "left");
    }

    private void checkFits(double y) {
        if (y > CONTENT_MAX_Y) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Too many rows to fit on one page - please remove a few rows or shorten the notes.");
        }
    }

    // ───────────────────────── ERP layout ─────────────────────────

    private void erpBlocks(List<DesignBlock> b, Quotation q) {
        JsonNode d = docFor(q, false);
        BigDecimal strength = num(s(d, "strength", ""), BigDecimal.ZERO).setScale(0, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
        if (strength.signum() <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Student Strength is required for an ERP quotation.");
        }
        BigDecimal gstRate = pct(d);
        String subject = nvl(q.getSubject()).trim();
        if (subject.isEmpty()) subject = "ERP, Student Strength ( " + strength.toPlainString() + " )";
        else if (d.path("_legacy").asBoolean(false) && !subject.toLowerCase().contains("strength"))
            subject += ", Student Strength ( " + strength.toPlainString() + " )";

        title(b, s(d, "title", "QUOTATION"));

        double y = 174;
        lv(b, "qno", ML, y, 92, "Quotation No.:", 230, nvl(q.getQuotationNo()));
        lv(b, "date", 399, y, 38, "Date:", 102, s(d, "date", dateText(q)));
        y += LINE + 8;
        lv(b, "to", ML, y, 28, "To:", 440, s(d, "attn", "The Principal") + ",");
        y += LINE;
        tp(b, "org", ML, y, CW, LINE, nvl(q.getOrganization()).toUpperCase(), 11.5, true, "left");
        y += LINE;
        lv(b, "subj", ML, y, 52, "Subject:", 430, subject);
        y += LINE + 12;

        // ── pricing table ──
        double[] cw = {190, 70, 78, 70, 75};
        String[] hdr = {"Service", "Per Student", "Amount", "GST", "Total"};
        double x = ML;
        for (int c = 0; c < 5; c++) { cp(b, "h" + c, x, y, cw[c], 28, hdr[c], true, "center"); x += cw[c]; }
        y += 28;

        JsonNode plans = d.path("plans");
        if (!plans.isArray() || plans.size() == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Add at least one ERP plan row.");
        int r = 0;
        for (JsonNode p : plans) {
            BigDecimal rate = num(s(p, "rate", ""), BigDecimal.ZERO);
            BigDecimal amount = rate.multiply(strength);
            BigDecimal gst = amount.multiply(gstRate);
            String name = s(p, "name", "-");
            double h = rowH(name, cw[0], 26);
            String[] vals = {name, inr(rate), inr(amount), inr(gst), inr(amount.add(gst))};
            x = ML;
            for (int c = 0; c < 5; c++) {
                cp(b, "r" + r + "c" + c, x, y, cw[c], h, vals[c], c <= 1, c == 0 ? "left" : "center");
                x += cw[c];
            }
            y += h; r++;
        }
        int f = 0;
        for (JsonNode fr : d.path("freeRows")) {
            String txt = s(fr, "text", "-");
            double h = rowH(txt, CW - cw[0], 26);
            cp(b, "f" + f + "a", ML, y, cw[0], h, s(fr, "label", "-"), true, "left");
            cp(b, "f" + f + "b", ML + cw[0], y, CW - cw[0], h, txt, true, "left");
            y += h; f++;
        }
        y += 16;

        // ── notes ──
        double labelW = 118;
        int n = 0;
        for (JsonNode note : d.path("notes")) {
            String label = nvl(note.path("label").asText()).trim();
            String txt = nvl(note.path("text").asText()).trim();
            if (label.isEmpty() && txt.isEmpty()) continue;
            double valueX = label.isEmpty() ? ML : ML + labelW;
            double valueW = label.isEmpty() ? CW : CW - labelW;
            int lines = linesFor(txt, (int) (valueW / 5.3));
            double h = lines * 14 + 4;
            if (!label.isEmpty()) tp(b, "n" + n + "L", ML, y, labelW, 16, label, BODY, true, "left").setVerticalAlign("top");
            tp(b, "n" + n + "V", valueX, y, valueW, h, txt, BODY, false, "left").setVerticalAlign("top");
            y += h + 5; n++;
        }
        y += 14;
        checkFits(y);
        signature(b, y, d);
    }

    // ───────────────────── Digital Marketing layout ─────────────────────

    private void dmBlocks(List<DesignBlock> b, Quotation q) {
        JsonNode d = docFor(q, true);
        BigDecimal pkg = num(s(d, "package", ""), BigDecimal.ZERO);
        if (pkg.signum() <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Package Amount is required for a Digital Marketing quotation.");
        BigDecimal discount = num(s(d, "discount", ""), BigDecimal.ZERO);
        BigDecimal gst = pkg.multiply(pct(d));
        BigDecimal total = pkg.add(gst).subtract(discount);
        String subject = nvl(q.getSubject()).trim();
        if (subject.isEmpty()) subject = "Digital Marketing Services";

        title(b, s(d, "title", "DIGITAL MARKETING QUOTATION"));

        double y = 174;
        lv(b, "qno", ML, y, 92, "Quotation No.:", 230, nvl(q.getQuotationNo()));
        lv(b, "date", 399, y, 38, "Date:", 102, s(d, "date", dateText(q)));
        y += LINE + 8;
        lv(b, "to", ML, y, 28, "To:", 440, nvl(q.getOrganization()));
        y += LINE;
        lv(b, "attn", ML, y, 38, "Attn:", 430, s(d, "attn", "The Principal"));
        y += LINE;
        if (!nvl(q.getAddress()).isBlank()) {
            tp(b, "addr", ML, y, CW, LINE, nvl(q.getAddress()).replace("\n", ", "), BODY, false, "left");
            y += LINE;
        }
        lv(b, "subj", ML, y, 52, "Subject:", 430, subject);
        y += LINE + 14;

        double c0 = 280, c1 = 130, hdrH = 28, rowH = 26;
        cp(b, "sh0", ML, y, c0, hdrH, "Service", true, "center");
        cp(b, "sh1", ML + c0, y, c1, hdrH, "Qty", true, "center");
        y += hdrH;
        int i = 0;
        for (JsonNode sv : d.path("services")) {
            cp(b, "s" + i + "a", ML, y, c0, rowH, s(sv, "name", "-"), false, "left");
            cp(b, "s" + i + "b", ML + c0, y, c1, rowH, s(sv, "qty", "-"), false, "center");
            y += rowH; i++;
        }

        y += 14;
        tp(b, "qamt", ML, y, 250, LINE, "Quotation Amount", 11.5, true, "left");
        y += LINE + 4;
        cp(b, "ah0", ML, y, c0, hdrH, "Particulars", true, "center");
        cp(b, "ah1", ML + c0, y, c1, hdrH, "Amount", true, "center");
        y += hdrH;

        List<String[]> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        rows.add(new String[]{"Package Amount", inr(pkg), "n"});
        rows.add(new String[]{"GST @ " + pctLabel(d) + "%", inr(gst), "n"});
        if (discount.signum() > 0) rows.add(new String[]{"Package Discount", "-" + inr(discount), "n"});
        for (JsonNode ex : d.path("extras")) {
            String label = s(ex, "label", "");
            BigDecimal amt = num(s(ex, "amount", ""), BigDecimal.ZERO);
            if (label.isEmpty() && amt.signum() == 0) continue;
            total = total.add(amt);
            rows.add(new String[]{label.isEmpty() ? "-" : label, inr(amt), "n"});
        }
        rows.add(new String[]{"Final Amount", inr(total), "b"});
        for (int k = 0; k < rows.size(); k++) {
            boolean bold = "b".equals(rows.get(k)[2]);
            cp(b, "a" + k + "a", ML, y, c0, rowH, rows.get(k)[0], bold, "left");
            cp(b, "a" + k + "b", ML + c0, y, c1, rowH, rows.get(k)[1], bold, "center");
            y += rowH;
        }

        y += 14;
        lv(b, "pay", ML, y, 52, "Payment:", 430, s(d, "payment", "100% Advance."));
        y += LINE + 2;
        int n = 0;
        for (JsonNode note : d.path("notes")) {
            String t = nvl(note.path("text").asText()).trim();
            if (t.isEmpty()) continue;
            tp(b, "note" + n, ML, y, CW, LINE, t, BODY, true, "left");
            y += LINE; n++;
        }
        y += 18;
        checkFits(y);
        signature(b, y, d);
    }

    // ───────────────────────── block helpers ─────────────────────────

    private void labelValue(List<DesignBlock> b, String id, double x, double y,
                            double labelW, String label, double valueW, String value, double size) {
        text(b, id + "L", x, y, labelW, 0.028, label, size, true, "left");
        text(b, id + "V", x + labelW, y, valueW, 0.028, value, size, false, "left");
    }

    private void paragraph(List<DesignBlock> b, String id, double lx, double lw, double vx, double vw,
                           double y, double h, String label, String value) {
        DesignBlock l = text(b, id + "L", lx, y, lw, h, label, 10.5, true, "left");
        DesignBlock v = text(b, id + "V", vx, y, vw, h, value, 10.5, false, "left");
        l.setVerticalAlign("top");
        v.setVerticalAlign("top");
    }

    private void cell(List<DesignBlock> b, String id, double x, double y, double w, double h,
                      String text, boolean bold, String align) {
        DesignBlock c = text(b, id, x, y, w, h, (text == null || text.isBlank()) ? " " : text, 10, bold, align);
        c.setBackgroundColor("#FFFFFF");
        c.setBorderWidth(0.8);
        c.setBorderColor(BORDER);
        c.setVerticalAlign("middle");
        c.setPadding(5);
    }

    private DesignBlock text(List<DesignBlock> b, String id, double x, double y, double w, double h,
                             String text, double size, boolean bold, String align) {
        DesignBlock d = new DesignBlock();
        d.setId(id);
        d.setType("text");
        d.setX(x); d.setY(y); d.setWidth(w); d.setHeight(h);
        d.setText(text);
        d.setMapsTo("");
        d.setFontSize(size);
        d.setFontFamily("Times");
        d.setBold(bold);
        d.setColor("#111827");
        d.setBackgroundColor("transparent");
        d.setAlign(align);
        d.setVerticalAlign("middle");
        d.setPadding(2);
        b.add(d);
        return d;
    }

    // ───────────────────────── value helpers ─────────────────────────

    private String val(Quotation q, String key, String def) {
        Map<String, String> m = q.getFieldValues();
        String v = m == null ? null : m.get(key);
        return v == null || v.isBlank() ? def : v.trim();
    }

    private BigDecimal num(String s, BigDecimal def) {
        if (s == null) return def;
        String cleaned = s.replaceAll("[^0-9.\\-]", "");
        if (cleaned.isEmpty() || cleaned.equals("-") || cleaned.equals(".")) return def;
        try { return new BigDecimal(cleaned); } catch (NumberFormatException e) { return def; }
    }

    private String nvl(String s) { return s == null ? "" : s; }

    private String dateText(Quotation q) {
        Instant at = q.getCreatedAt() != null ? q.getCreatedAt() : Instant.now();
        return DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd-MM-yyyy").withZone(IST).format(at);
    }

    /** Rupee amount with Indian digit grouping (1,08,000). QuotationPdfService.safePdfText turns the
     *  rupee sign into "Rs." because the built-in PDF fonts have no rupee glyph. */
    static String inr(BigDecimal v) {
        v = v.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
        boolean neg = v.signum() < 0;
        String[] parts = v.abs().toPlainString().split("\\.");
        String ip = parts[0];
        String grouped;
        if (ip.length() <= 3) {
            grouped = ip;
        } else {
            String last3 = ip.substring(ip.length() - 3);
            String rest = ip.substring(0, ip.length() - 3);
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < rest.length(); i++) {
                if (i > 0 && (rest.length() - i) % 2 == 0) sb.append(',');
                sb.append(rest.charAt(i));
            }
            grouped = sb + "," + last3;
        }
        String out = "\u20B9" + grouped + ("00".equals(parts[1]) ? "" : "." + parts[1]);
        return neg ? "-" + out : out;
    }
}
