package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.awt.Color;
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPage;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPageContentStream;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.common.PDRectangle;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.font.PDFont;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.font.PDType1Font;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.graphics.image.PDImageXObject;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Quotation;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.DesignBlock;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.DesignPage;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.TemplateDesign;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.TemplateField;

@Service
public class QuotationPdfService {

    @Value("${quotation.storage.dir:./storage/quotations}")
    private String storageDirProp;

    private final QuotationLayouts layouts;
    private final QuotationBrandingService branding;

    public QuotationPdfService(QuotationLayouts layouts, QuotationBrandingService branding) {
        this.layouts = layouts;
        this.branding = branding;
    }

    private Path outputDir() throws Exception {
        Path dir = Paths.get(storageDirProp, "generated");
        Files.createDirectories(dir);
        return dir;
    }

    public String generate(Quotation quotation, QuotationTemplate template) throws Exception {
        Path outPath = outputDir().resolve(safeName(quotation.getId()) + ".pdf");
        TemplateDesign design = template.getDesign();

        // Built-in IndoCampas layouts (ERP / Digital Marketing) - drawn fully in code,
        // no template file on disk is needed.
        if (QuotationLayouts.isBuiltInDesign(design)) {
            QuotationTemplate concrete = layouts.materialize(quotation, template, branding.buildLetterhead());
            generateBuilderTemplate(quotation, concrete, outPath);
            return outPath.toAbsolutePath().toString();
        }

        if (design == null || "BACKGROUND".equalsIgnoreCase(design.getMode())) {
            generateBackgroundTemplate(quotation, template, outPath);
        } else {
            generateBuilderTemplate(quotation, template, outPath);
        }
        return outPath.toAbsolutePath().toString();
    }

    private void generateBackgroundTemplate(Quotation quotation, QuotationTemplate template, Path outPath) throws Exception {
        String renderSource = template.getStoredRenderPdfPath() != null && !template.getStoredRenderPdfPath().isBlank()
                ? template.getStoredRenderPdfPath()
                : template.getStoredOriginalPath();
        if (renderSource != null && !renderSource.isBlank() && !new File(renderSource).isFile()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("The template file is missing on the server (" + renderSource
                    + "). Please choose one of the built-in IndoCampas templates.");
        }
        if (template.isPdfSource() && renderSource != null) {
            try (PDDocument doc = PDDocument.load(new File(renderSource))) {
                int pages = doc.getNumberOfPages();
                for (int pageIndex = 0; pageIndex < pages; pageIndex++) {
                    PDPage page = doc.getPage(pageIndex);
                    // Existing fields are defined against page 1 in the current editor.
                    // Render them only on the first page to preserve old template behavior.
                    if (pageIndex == 0) drawFields(doc, page, template, quotation);
                }
                doc.save(outPath.toFile());
            }
            return;
        }

        try (PDDocument doc = new PDDocument()) {
            PDPage page = new PDPage(new PDRectangle((float) template.getPageWidthPt(), (float) template.getPageHeightPt()));
            doc.addPage(page);
            if (template.getStoredOriginalPath() != null) {
                PDImageXObject image = PDImageXObject.createFromFile(template.getStoredOriginalPath(), doc);
                try (PDPageContentStream cs = new PDPageContentStream(doc, page)) {
                    cs.drawImage(image, 0, 0, (float) template.getPageWidthPt(), (float) template.getPageHeightPt());
                }
            }
            drawFields(doc, page, template, quotation);
            doc.save(outPath.toFile());
        }
    }

    private void drawFields(PDDocument doc, PDPage page, QuotationTemplate template, Quotation quotation) throws Exception {
        Map<String, String> values = quotation.getFieldValues() == null ? new HashMap<>() : quotation.getFieldValues();
        for (TemplateField field : template.getFields()) {
            String text = values.get(field.getId());
            if (text == null || text.isBlank()) continue;
            renderTextBox(doc, page, field.getX(), field.getY(), field.getWidth(), field.getHeight(),
                    text, field.getFontSize(), field.getFontFamily(), field.isBold() || "bold".equalsIgnoreCase(field.getFontWeight()),
                    field.isItalic(), field.getColor(), field.getAlign(), field.getVerticalAlign(), field.getPadding());
        }
    }

    private void generateBuilderTemplate(Quotation quotation, QuotationTemplate template, Path outPath) throws Exception {
        TemplateDesign d = template.getDesign();
        double width = template.getPageWidthPt() > 0 ? template.getPageWidthPt() : 595.28;
        double height = template.getPageHeightPt() > 0 ? template.getPageHeightPt() : 841.89;

        if ("LANDSCAPE".equalsIgnoreCase(d.getOrientation())) {
            double tmp = width; width = height; height = tmp;
        }

        List<DesignPage> pages = d.getPages();
        if (pages == null || pages.isEmpty()) {
            DesignPage legacy = new DesignPage();
            legacy.setId("page_1");
            legacy.setName("Page 1");
            legacy.setBackgroundColor(d.getBackgroundColor());
            legacy.setHeaderEnabled(d.isHeaderEnabled());
            legacy.setHeaderHeight(d.getHeaderHeight());
            legacy.setHeaderLayout(d.getHeaderLayout());
            legacy.setFooterEnabled(d.isFooterEnabled());
            legacy.setFooterHeight(d.getFooterHeight());
            legacy.setFooterLayout(d.getFooterLayout());
            legacy.setBlocks(safeBlocks(d.getBlocks()));
            pages = List.of(legacy);
        }

        try (PDDocument doc = new PDDocument()) {
            for (DesignPage pageDesign : pages) {
                PDPage page = new PDPage(new PDRectangle((float) width, (float) height));
                doc.addPage(page);

                String pageBackground = pageDesign.getBackgroundColor();
                if (pageBackground == null || pageBackground.isBlank()) pageBackground = d.getBackgroundColor();
                try (PDPageContentStream cs = new PDPageContentStream(doc, page)) {
                    cs.setNonStrokingColor(parseColor(pageBackground, Color.WHITE));
                    cs.addRect(0, 0, (float) width, (float) height);
                    cs.fill();
                }

                if (pageDesign.isHeaderEnabled()) renderHeader(doc, page, d, pageDesign, width, height);
                if (pageDesign.isFooterEnabled()) renderFooter(doc, page, d, pageDesign, width, height);

                for (DesignBlock block : safeBlocks(pageDesign.getBlocks())) {
                    renderBlock(doc, page, block, quotation, d, width, height);
                }
            }
            doc.save(outPath.toFile());
        }
    }

    private void renderHeader(PDDocument doc, PDPage page, TemplateDesign d, DesignPage p,
                              double pageW, double pageH) throws Exception {
        double h = clamp(p.getHeaderHeight(), 0.05, 0.35) * pageH;
        String layout = p.getHeaderLayout() == null ? "logo-left" : p.getHeaderLayout();
        boolean hasLogo = d.getLogoDataUrl() != null && !d.getLogoDataUrl().isBlank();

        try (PDPageContentStream cs = new PDPageContentStream(doc, page, PDPageContentStream.AppendMode.APPEND, true, true)) {
            cs.setNonStrokingColor(parseColor(d.getSecondaryColor(), Color.DARK_GRAY));
            cs.addRect(
        0f,
        (float) (pageH - h),
        (float) pageW,
        (float) h
);
            cs.fill();

            if (hasLogo) {
                try {
                    PDImageXObject logo = imageFromDataUrl(doc, d.getLogoDataUrl());
                    if (logo != null) {
                        double logoSize = Math.min(h * 0.72, pageW * 0.16);
                        double logoX;
                        if ("logo-center".equalsIgnoreCase(layout)) logoX = (pageW - logoSize) / 2;
                        else if ("logo-right".equalsIgnoreCase(layout)) logoX = pageW - logoSize - 28;
                        else logoX = 28;
                        double logoY = pageH - h + (h - logoSize) / 2;
                        cs.drawImage(logo, (float) logoX, (float) logoY, (float) logoSize, (float) logoSize);
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }

        double textWidth = pageW * 0.70;
        double textX;
        String textAlign;
        if ("logo-center".equalsIgnoreCase(layout)) {
            textX = pageW * 0.15; textAlign = "center";
        } else if ("logo-right".equalsIgnoreCase(layout)) {
            textX = 32; textAlign = "left";
        } else {
            textX = hasLogo ? pageW * 0.19 : 32; textAlign = "left";
        }

        renderTextBox(doc, page, textX / pageW, (pageH - h + h * 0.16) / pageH,
                textWidth / pageW, 0.08, d.getCompanyName(), 18, d.getFontFamily(), true, false,
                "#FFFFFF", textAlign, "middle", 0, "transparent", 0, "#FFFFFF", d.getFontDataUrl());

        if (d.getCompanySubtitle() != null && !d.getCompanySubtitle().isBlank()) {
            renderTextBox(doc, page, textX / pageW, (pageH - h + h * 0.52) / pageH,
                    textWidth / pageW, 0.05, d.getCompanySubtitle(), 10, d.getFontFamily(), false, false,
                    "#F3F4F6", textAlign, "middle", 0, "transparent", 0, "#FFFFFF", d.getFontDataUrl());
        }
    }

    private void renderFooter(PDDocument doc, PDPage page, TemplateDesign d, DesignPage p,
                              double pageW, double pageH) throws Exception {
        double h = clamp(p.getFooterHeight(), 0.05, 0.25) * pageH;
        String layout = p.getFooterLayout() == null ? "contact-center" : p.getFooterLayout();
        String contact = joinNonBlank(" • ", d.getCompanyPhone(), d.getCompanyEmail(), d.getCompanyWebsite());
        String address = d.getCompanyAddress();
        String gst = d.getCompanyGstNumber();
        String align = "center";
        if ("contact-left".equalsIgnoreCase(layout)) align = "left";
        if ("contact-right".equalsIgnoreCase(layout)) align = "right";

        try (PDPageContentStream cs = new PDPageContentStream(doc, page, PDPageContentStream.AppendMode.APPEND, true, true)) {
            cs.setNonStrokingColor(parseColor(d.getPrimaryColor(), Color.DARK_GRAY));
            cs.addRect(0, 0, (float) pageW, (float) h);
            cs.fill();
        }

        if (!contact.isBlank()) {
            renderTextBox(doc, page, 0.06, 0.025, 0.88, 0.045, contact, 9, d.getFontFamily(), false, false,
                    "#FFFFFF", align, "middle", 0, "transparent", 0, "#FFFFFF", d.getFontDataUrl());
        }
        if (!address.isBlank()) {
            renderTextBox(doc, page, 0.06, 0.07, 0.88, 0.045, address, 8.5, d.getFontFamily(), false, false,
                    "#FFFFFF", align, "middle", 0, "transparent", 0, "#FFFFFF", d.getFontDataUrl());
        }
        if (!gst.isBlank()) {
            renderTextBox(doc, page, 0.06, 0.105, 0.88, 0.035, "GST: " + gst, 7.5, d.getFontFamily(), false, false,
                    "#F3F4F6", align, "middle", 0, "transparent", 0, "#FFFFFF", d.getFontDataUrl());
        }
    }

    private void renderBlock(PDDocument doc, PDPage page, DesignBlock b, Quotation q, TemplateDesign d,
                             double pageW, double pageH) throws Exception {
        double x = clamp(b.getX(), 0, 1) * pageW;
        double top = clamp(b.getY(), 0, 1) * pageH;
        double w = clamp(b.getWidth(), 0, 1) * pageW;
        double h = clamp(b.getHeight(), 0, 1) * pageH;
        String text = resolve(b.getText(), q, d);
        String type = b.getType() == null ? "text" : b.getType();

        if ("image".equalsIgnoreCase(type)) {
            if (b.getImageDataUrl() != null && !b.getImageDataUrl().isBlank()) {
                try (PDPageContentStream cs = new PDPageContentStream(doc, page, PDPageContentStream.AppendMode.APPEND, true, true)) {
                    PDImageXObject image = imageFromDataUrl(doc, b.getImageDataUrl());
                    if (image != null) {
                        double pdfY = pageH - top - h;
                        cs.drawImage(image, (float) x, (float) pdfY, (float) w, (float) h);
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        if ("divider".equalsIgnoreCase(type)) {
            try (PDPageContentStream cs = new PDPageContentStream(doc, page, PDPageContentStream.AppendMode.APPEND, true, true)) {
                cs.setStrokingColor(parseColor(b.getColor(), parseColor(d.getPrimaryColor(), Color.DARK_GRAY)));
                cs.setLineWidth((float) Math.max(0.5, b.getBorderWidth() <= 0 ? 1 : b.getBorderWidth()));
                double pdfY = pageH - top - h / 2;
                cs.moveTo((float) x, (float) pdfY);
                cs.lineTo((float) (x + w), (float) pdfY);
                cs.stroke();
            }
            return;
        }

        if ("table".equalsIgnoreCase(type)) {
            renderTable(doc, page, b, q, d, pageW, pageH);
            return;
        }

        String effectiveText = text;
        if ((effectiveText == null || effectiveText.isBlank()) && b.getMapsTo() != null && !b.getMapsTo().isBlank()) effectiveText = "{{" + b.getMapsTo() + "}}";
        if ("signature".equalsIgnoreCase(type) && (effectiveText == null || effectiveText.isBlank())) {
            effectiveText = "Warm regards,\n" + d.getCompanyName();
        }
        if ("spacer".equalsIgnoreCase(type)) return;

        renderTextBox(doc, page, b.getX(), b.getY(), b.getWidth(), b.getHeight(), effectiveText,
                b.getFontSize(), b.getFontFamily() == null || b.getFontFamily().isBlank() ? d.getFontFamily() : b.getFontFamily(),
                b.isBold() || "bold".equalsIgnoreCase(b.getFontWeight()), b.isItalic(),
                b.getColor(), b.getAlign(), b.getVerticalAlign(), b.getPadding(),
                b.getBackgroundColor(), b.getBorderWidth(), b.getBorderColor(),
                b.getFontDataUrl() == null || b.getFontDataUrl().isBlank() ? d.getFontDataUrl() : b.getFontDataUrl());
    }

    private void renderTable(PDDocument doc, PDPage page, DesignBlock b, Quotation q, TemplateDesign d,
                             double pageW, double pageH) throws Exception {
        double x = b.getX() * pageW;
        double top = b.getY() * pageH;
        double w = b.getWidth() * pageW;
        double h = b.getHeight() * pageH;
        List<List<String>> rows = b.getTableRows() == null ? new ArrayList<>() : b.getTableRows();
        if (rows.isEmpty()) rows = List.of(List.of("Description", "Amount"), List.of("{{subject}}", "{{amount}}"));
        int cols = rows.stream().mapToInt(List::size).max().orElse(1);
        double rowH = h / rows.size();
        double colW = w / cols;

        for (int r = 0; r < rows.size(); r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
                String cell = c < rows.get(r).size() ? resolve(rows.get(r).get(c), q, d) : "";
                double cx = x + c * colW;
                double cyTop = top + r * rowH;
                String bg = r == 0 ? d.getPrimaryColor() : "#FFFFFF";
                String color = r == 0 ? "#FFFFFF" : b.getColor();
                renderTextBox(doc, page, cx / pageW, cyTop / pageH, colW / pageW, rowH / pageH,
                        cell, r == 0 ? Math.max(9, b.getFontSize()) : b.getFontSize(), b.getFontFamily(), r == 0 || b.isBold(), false,
                        color, b.getAlign(), "middle", b.getPadding(), bg, Math.max(0.5, b.getBorderWidth() == 0 ? 0.6 : b.getBorderWidth()), b.getBorderColor());
            }
        }
    }

    private void renderTextBox(PDDocument doc, PDPage page, double xFrac, double yFrac, double wFrac, double hFrac,
                               String text, double fontSize, String family, boolean bold, boolean italic,
                               String color, String align, String verticalAlign, double padding) throws Exception {
        renderTextBox(doc, page, xFrac, yFrac, wFrac, hFrac, text, fontSize, family, bold, italic, color,
                align, verticalAlign, padding, "transparent", 0, "#D1D5DB");
    }

    private void renderTextBox(PDDocument doc, PDPage page, double xFrac, double yFrac, double wFrac, double hFrac,
                               String text, double fontSize, String family, boolean bold, boolean italic,
                               String color, String align, String verticalAlign, double padding,
                               String backgroundColor, double borderWidth, String borderColor) throws Exception {
        renderTextBox(doc, page, xFrac, yFrac, wFrac, hFrac, text, fontSize, family, bold, italic,
                color, align, verticalAlign, padding, backgroundColor, borderWidth, borderColor, null);
    }

    private void renderTextBox(PDDocument doc, PDPage page, double xFrac, double yFrac, double wFrac, double hFrac,
                               String text, double fontSize, String family, boolean bold, boolean italic,
                               String color, String align, String verticalAlign, double padding,
                               String backgroundColor, double borderWidth, String borderColor, String fontDataUrl) throws Exception {
        if (text == null || text.isBlank()) return;
        double pageW = page.getMediaBox().getWidth();
        double pageH = page.getMediaBox().getHeight();
        double x = xFrac * pageW;
        double top = yFrac * pageH;
        double w = wFrac * pageW;
        double h = hFrac * pageH;
        double pdfBottom = pageH - top - h;
        double pad = Math.max(0, padding);

        try (PDPageContentStream cs = new PDPageContentStream(doc, page, PDPageContentStream.AppendMode.APPEND, true, true)) {
            if (backgroundColor != null && !backgroundColor.isBlank() && !"transparent".equalsIgnoreCase(backgroundColor)) {
                cs.setNonStrokingColor(parseColor(backgroundColor, Color.WHITE));
                cs.addRect((float)x, (float)pdfBottom, (float)w, (float)h);
                cs.fill();
            }
            if (borderWidth > 0) {
                cs.setStrokingColor(parseColor(borderColor, Color.LIGHT_GRAY));
                cs.setLineWidth((float)borderWidth);
                cs.addRect((float)x, (float)pdfBottom, (float)w, (float)h);
                cs.stroke();
            }

            PDFont font = selectFont(doc, family, bold, italic, fontDataUrl);
            float size = (float)Math.max(5, Math.min(72, fontSize));
            // Replace rupee sign etc. BEFORE measuring/wrapping - the standard fonts cannot encode them.
            String cleanText = safePdfText(text);
            if (!(font instanceof org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.font.PDType0Font)) {
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                for (char ch : cleanText.toCharArray()) sb.append(ch > 255 ? '?' : ch);
                cleanText = sb.toString();
            }
            List<String> lines = wrapText(cleanText, font, size, (float)Math.max(1, w - 2 * pad));
            float lineHeight = size * 1.22f;
            float textHeight = lines.size() * lineHeight;
            float startY;
            if ("middle".equalsIgnoreCase(verticalAlign) || "center".equalsIgnoreCase(verticalAlign)) {
                startY = (float)(pdfBottom + (h + textHeight) / 2 - lineHeight + 2);
            } else if ("bottom".equalsIgnoreCase(verticalAlign)) {
                startY = (float)(pdfBottom + h - pad - size);
            } else {
                startY = (float)(pdfBottom + h - pad - size);
            }

            for (String line : lines) {
                float lineWidth = font.getStringWidth(line) / 1000f * size;
                float tx;
                if ("center".equalsIgnoreCase(align)) tx = (float)(x + (w - lineWidth) / 2);
                else if ("right".equalsIgnoreCase(align)) tx = (float)(x + w - pad - lineWidth);
                else tx = (float)(x + pad);
                tx = Math.max((float)x, Math.min(tx, (float)(x + w - lineWidth)));

                cs.beginText();
                cs.setNonStrokingColor(parseColor(color, Color.DARK_GRAY));
                cs.setFont(font, size);
                cs.newLineAtOffset(tx, startY);
                cs.showText(safePdfText(line));
                cs.endText();
                startY -= lineHeight;
                if (startY < pdfBottom - 1) break;
            }
        }
    }

    private PDFont selectFont(PDDocument doc, String family, boolean bold, boolean italic, String fontDataUrl) throws Exception {
        if (fontDataUrl != null && !fontDataUrl.isBlank()) {
            int comma = fontDataUrl.indexOf(',');
            if (comma > 0) {
                try {
                    byte[] bytes = Base64.getDecoder().decode(fontDataUrl.substring(comma + 1));
                    return org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.font.PDType0Font.load(doc, new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes), true);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {
                    // Fall back to a built-in font if an uploaded font cannot be read.
                }
            }
        }
        String f = family == null ? "Helvetica" : family.toLowerCase();
        if (f.contains("times")) {
            if (bold && italic) return PDType1Font.TIMES_BOLD_ITALIC;
            if (bold) return PDType1Font.TIMES_BOLD;
            if (italic) return PDType1Font.TIMES_ITALIC;
            return PDType1Font.TIMES_ROMAN;
        }
        if (f.contains("courier")) {
            if (bold && italic) return PDType1Font.COURIER_BOLD_OBLIQUE;
            if (bold) return PDType1Font.COURIER_BOLD;
            if (italic) return PDType1Font.COURIER_OBLIQUE;
            return PDType1Font.COURIER;
        }
        if (bold && italic) return PDType1Font.HELVETICA_BOLD_OBLIQUE;
        if (bold) return PDType1Font.HELVETICA_BOLD;
        if (italic) return PDType1Font.HELVETICA_OBLIQUE;
        return PDType1Font.HELVETICA;
    }

    private List<String> wrapText(String text, PDFont font, float fontSize, float maxWidth) throws Exception {
        List<String> lines = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String paragraph : text.replace("\r", "").split("\\n", -1)) {
            if (paragraph.isEmpty()) { lines.add(""); continue; }
            StringBuilder current = new StringBuilder();
            for (String word : paragraph.split(" ")) {
                if (word.isEmpty()) continue;
                String candidate = current.length() == 0 ? word : current + " " + word;
                float width = font.getStringWidth(candidate) / 1000f * fontSize;
                if (width > maxWidth && current.length() > 0) {
                    lines.add(current.toString());
                    current = new StringBuilder(word);
                } else if (width > maxWidth) {
                    lines.add(word);
                    current.setLength(0);
                } else {
                    current = new StringBuilder(candidate);
                }
            }
            if (current.length() > 0) lines.add(current.toString());
        }
        return lines.isEmpty() ? List.of("") : lines;
    }

    private String resolve(String text, Quotation q, TemplateDesign d) {
        if (text == null) return "";
        Map<String, String> v = new HashMap<>();
        v.put("clientName", nvl(q.getClientName()));
        v.put("organization", nvl(q.getOrganization()));
        v.put("email", nvl(q.getEmail()));
        v.put("phone", nvl(q.getPhone()));
        v.put("subject", nvl(q.getSubject()));
        v.put("amount", q.getAmount() == null ? "" : nvl(q.getCurrency()) + " " + q.getAmount());
        v.put("validTill", nvl(q.getValidTill()));
        v.put("notes", nvl(q.getNotes()));
        v.put("leadId", nvl(q.getLeadId()));
        v.put("quotationId", nvl(q.getId()));
        v.put("companyName", nvl(d.getCompanyName()));
        v.put("companySubtitle", nvl(d.getCompanySubtitle()));
        v.put("companyAddress", nvl(d.getCompanyAddress()));
        v.put("companyPhone", nvl(d.getCompanyPhone()));
        v.put("companyEmail", nvl(d.getCompanyEmail()));
        v.put("companyWebsite", nvl(d.getCompanyWebsite()));
        v.put("companyGstNumber", nvl(d.getCompanyGstNumber()));
        if (q.getFieldValues() != null) v.putAll(q.getFieldValues());
        String out = text;
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> e : v.entrySet()) out = out.replace("{{" + e.getKey() + "}}", e.getValue());
        return out;
    }

    private PDImageXObject imageFromDataUrl(PDDocument doc, String dataUrl) throws Exception {
        int comma = dataUrl.indexOf(',');
        if (comma < 0) return null;
        byte[] bytes = Base64.getDecoder().decode(dataUrl.substring(comma + 1));
        return PDImageXObject.createFromByteArray(doc, bytes, "template-image");
    }

    private Color parseColor(String hex, Color fallback) {
        try {
            if (hex == null || hex.isBlank() || "transparent".equalsIgnoreCase(hex)) return fallback;
            String s = hex.trim().replace("#", "");
            if (s.length() == 3) s = "" + s.charAt(0)+s.charAt(0)+s.charAt(1)+s.charAt(1)+s.charAt(2)+s.charAt(2);
            return new Color(Integer.parseInt(s, 16));
        } catch (Exception e) { return fallback; }
    }

    private String safePdfText(String text) {
        return text.replace("₹", "Rs.").replace("–", "-").replace("—", "-").replace("•", "-").replace("’", "'").replace("“", "\"").replace("”", "\"");
    }

    private String joinNonBlank(String sep, String... values) {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        for (String v : values) if (v != null && !v.isBlank()) { if (b.length() > 0) b.append(sep); b.append(v); }
        return b.toString();
    }

    private String nvl(String s) { return s == null ? "" : s; }
    private double clamp(double v, double min, double max) { return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }
    private List<DesignBlock> safeBlocks(List<DesignBlock> b) { return b == null ? new ArrayList<>() : b; }
    private String safeName(String id) { return id == null ? java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString() : id.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]", "_"); }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import org.bson.Document;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.dao.DuplicateKeyException;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.FindAndModifyOptions;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.MongoTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query.Criteria;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query.Query;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query.Update;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.dto.QuotationRequest;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Lead;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Quotation;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.TemplateField;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Telecaller;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.QuotationRepository;

@Service
public class QuotationService {

    // Canonical approval-workflow status values.
    public static final String STATUS_DRAFT = "Draft";
    public static final String STATUS_PENDING_APPROVAL = "Pending Approval";
    public static final String STATUS_APPROVED = "Approved";
    public static final String STATUS_REJECTED = "Rejected";
    public static final String STATUS_REVISION_REQUIRED = "Revision Required";
    public static final String STATUS_SENT = "Sent";

    private final QuotationRepository repo;
    private final QuotationTemplateService templateService;
    private final QuotationPdfService pdfService;
    private final TelecallerAccessService access;
    private final MongoTemplate mongo;

    // First number handed out in a new year. The latest hand-made PDF was ...072, so continue from 073.
    @Value("${quotation.number.start:73}")
    private int numberStart;

    public QuotationService(QuotationRepository repo, QuotationTemplateService templateService,
                             QuotationPdfService pdfService, TelecallerAccessService access,
                             MongoTemplate mongo) {
        this.mongo = mongo;
        this.repo = repo;
        this.templateService = templateService;
        this.pdfService = pdfService;
        this.access = access;
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * TELECALLER — own quotations only
     * ============================================================
     */

    public List<Quotation> list() {
        return repo.findByCreatedByOrderByCreatedAtDesc(access.currentUsername());
    }

    public Quotation get(String id) {
        Quotation q = repo.findById(id).orElseThrow(() -> new RuntimeException("Quotation not found: " + id));
        checkOwner(q);
        return q;
    }

    public Quotation create(QuotationRequest r) throws Exception {
        String username = access.currentUsername();
        Lead lead = access.requireLeadAccess(r.getLeadId());
        QuotationTemplate template = templateService.resolveForQuotation(r.getTemplateId(), r.getServiceType());

        Quotation q = new Quotation();
        q.setQuotationNo(nextQuotationNo());
        q.setCreatedBy(username);
        q.setTelecallerName(currentTelecallerDisplayName(username));
        q.setStatus(STATUS_DRAFT);
        applyFromLeadAndRequest(q, lead, template, r);
        // A telecaller cannot skip the approval workflow by posting a status directly.
        q.setStatus(STATUS_DRAFT);
        q = repo.save(q);

        String pdfPath;
        try {
            pdfPath = pdfService.generate(q, template);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Do not leave a half-created quotation (no PDF) behind when generation fails.
            repo.deleteById(q.getId());
            throw e;
        }
        q.setGeneratedPdfPath(pdfPath);
        q.setGeneratedPdfFileName("Quotation_" + (q.getQuotationNo() != null
                ? q.getQuotationNo().replace('/', '-') : q.getId()) + ".pdf");
        addTimeline(q, "Quotation created", "document", "#dbeafe", "#1d4ed8");
        return repo.save(q);
    }

    public Quotation update(String id, QuotationRequest r) throws Exception {
        Quotation q = get(id);
        requireEditable(q);
        Lead lead = access.requireLeadAccess(r.getLeadId());
        QuotationTemplate template = templateService.resolveForQuotation(r.getTemplateId(), r.getServiceType());
        String statusBefore = q.getStatus();
        applyFromLeadAndRequest(q, lead, template, r);
        // Editing never jumps the workflow forward — only the submit/review/send
        // actions change status. A Rejected or Revision Required quotation drops
        // back to Draft so the telecaller can resubmit it deliberately, and every
        // resubmission goes through the Super Admin confirmation process again.
        boolean wasRejectedOrRevision = STATUS_REJECTED.equalsIgnoreCase(statusBefore)
                || STATUS_REVISION_REQUIRED.equalsIgnoreCase(statusBefore);
        q.setStatus(wasRejectedOrRevision ? STATUS_DRAFT : statusBefore);
        if (wasRejectedOrRevision) {
            // Clear the previous remarks now that the telecaller has actioned them;
            // they remain visible in the timeline history below.
            q.setRejectionReason(null);
            q.setRevisionNotes(null);
        }

        String pdfPath = pdfService.generate(q, template);
        q.setGeneratedPdfPath(pdfPath);
        addTimeline(q, "Quotation updated & PDF regenerated", "refresh", "#fef3c7", "#b45309");
        return repo.save(q);
    }

    /** Generic status patch — kept for lightweight, non-workflow states (e.g. "Viewed").
     *  The approval-pipeline transitions (Pending Approval / Approved / Rejected / Sent)
     *  must go through submitForApproval() / review() / markSent() so the audit fields
     *  (submittedAt, reviewedBy, sentAt, ...) stay correct. */
    public Quotation updateStatus(String id, String status) {
        if (STATUS_PENDING_APPROVAL.equalsIgnoreCase(status) || STATUS_APPROVED.equalsIgnoreCase(status)
                || STATUS_REJECTED.equalsIgnoreCase(status) || STATUS_REVISION_REQUIRED.equalsIgnoreCase(status)
                || STATUS_SENT.equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Use the submit/review/send actions to change to " + status + ".");
        }
        Quotation q = get(id);
        q.setStatus(status);
        addTimeline(q, "Status changed to " + status, statusIcon(status), "#e0e7ff", "#4338ca");
        return repo.save(q);
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * TELECALLER — submit for approval
     * ============================================================
     */
    public Quotation submitForApproval(String id) {
        Quotation q = get(id);
        if (!STATUS_DRAFT.equalsIgnoreCase(q.getStatus())) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Only a Draft quotation can be submitted for approval.");
        }
        q.setStatus(STATUS_PENDING_APPROVAL);
        q.setSubmittedAt(Instant.now());
        q.setTelecallerName(currentTelecallerDisplayName(access.currentUsername()));
        q.setReviewedAt(null);
        q.setReviewedBy(null);
        q.setRejectionReason(null);
        q.setRevisionNotes(null);
        addTimeline(q, "Submitted for Super Admin approval", "send", "#e0e7ff", "#4338ca");
        return repo.save(q);
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * TELECALLER — send the approved quotation to the lead
     * ============================================================
     */
    public Quotation markSent(String id, String channel) {
        Quotation q = get(id);

        // A quotation remains eligible for future delivery after its first send.
        // "Sent" is a delivery state, not a terminal state, so Approved and Sent
        // quotations can both be sent/resend through WhatsApp or Email.
        boolean approved = STATUS_APPROVED.equalsIgnoreCase(q.getStatus());
        boolean alreadySent = STATUS_SENT.equalsIgnoreCase(q.getStatus());
        if (!approved && !alreadySent) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Only an Approved or previously Sent quotation can be delivered to the lead.");
        }

        q.setStatus(STATUS_SENT);
        q.setSentAt(Instant.now());
        q.setSentChannel(channel);

        String action = alreadySent ? "Resent via " + channel : "Sent via " + channel;
        addTimeline(q, action,
                "WhatsApp".equalsIgnoreCase(channel) ? "message" : "mail",
                "#dcfce7", "#15803d");
        return repo.save(q);
    }

    public void delete(String id) {
        Quotation q = get(id);
        try {
            if (q.getGeneratedPdfPath() != null) java.nio.file.Files.deleteIfExists(java.nio.file.Paths.get(q.getGeneratedPdfPath()));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        repo.deleteById(id);
    }

    public java.io.File pdfFile(String id) {
        return freshPdf(get(id));
    }

    /** Always draws the PDF again from the saved quotation data, so the current letterpad / logo / footer
     *  and layout are used - old PDFs created before a letterhead change never show up stale.
     *  Falls back to the stored file only if generating fails. */
    private java.io.File freshPdf(Quotation q) {
        try {
            QuotationTemplate t = templateService.resolveForQuotation(q.getTemplateId(), q.getServiceType());
            String path = pdfService.generate(q, t);
            if (!path.equals(q.getGeneratedPdfPath())) {
                q.setGeneratedPdfPath(path);
                repo.save(q);
            }
            return new java.io.File(path);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            if (q.getGeneratedPdfPath() != null && new java.io.File(q.getGeneratedPdfPath()).isFile()) {
                return new java.io.File(q.getGeneratedPdfPath());
            }
            throw new RuntimeException("Unable to generate the quotation PDF: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * SUPER ADMIN — visibility across all telecallers
     * ============================================================
     */

    public List<Quotation> adminList(String status) {
        if (status == null || status.isBlank() || "All".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
            return repo.findAllByOrderByCreatedAtDesc();
        }
        return repo.findByStatusOrderByCreatedAtDesc(status);
    }

    public Map<String, Object> adminSummary() {
        List<Quotation> all = repo.findAllByOrderByCreatedAtDesc();
        Map<String, Object> summary = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        summary.put("total", all.size());
        summary.put("draft", all.stream().filter(q -> STATUS_DRAFT.equalsIgnoreCase(q.getStatus())).count());
        summary.put("pendingApproval", all.stream().filter(q -> STATUS_PENDING_APPROVAL.equalsIgnoreCase(q.getStatus())).count());
        summary.put("approved", all.stream().filter(q -> STATUS_APPROVED.equalsIgnoreCase(q.getStatus())).count());
        summary.put("rejected", all.stream().filter(q -> STATUS_REJECTED.equalsIgnoreCase(q.getStatus())).count());
        summary.put("revisionRequired", all.stream().filter(q -> STATUS_REVISION_REQUIRED.equalsIgnoreCase(q.getStatus())).count());
        summary.put("sent", all.stream().filter(q -> STATUS_SENT.equalsIgnoreCase(q.getStatus())).count());
        return summary;
    }

    /** Fetch without ownership restriction — for Super Admin review/PDF access only. */
    public Quotation getForAdmin(String id) {
        return repo.findById(id).orElseThrow(() -> new RuntimeException("Quotation not found: " + id));
    }

    public java.io.File pdfFileForAdmin(String id) {
        return freshPdf(getForAdmin(id));
    }

    /*
     * ============================================================
     * SUPER ADMIN — approve / reject / request changes
     * ============================================================
     */
    /**
     * @param status  "Approved" | "Rejected" | "Revision Required"
     * @param remarks required for Rejected (rejection reason) and for
     *                Revision Required (what needs to change); ignored for Approved.
     */
    public Quotation review(String id, String status, String remarks) {
        boolean isApprove = STATUS_APPROVED.equalsIgnoreCase(status);
        boolean isReject = STATUS_REJECTED.equalsIgnoreCase(status);
        boolean isRevision = STATUS_REVISION_REQUIRED.equalsIgnoreCase(status);
        if (!isApprove && !isReject && !isRevision) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Status must be Approved, Rejected or Revision Required");
        }
        if ((isReject || isRevision) && (remarks == null || remarks.isBlank())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(isReject
                    ? "A rejection reason is required."
                    : "Please describe the changes you'd like the telecaller to make.");
        }
        Quotation q = getForAdmin(id);
        if (!STATUS_PENDING_APPROVAL.equalsIgnoreCase(q.getStatus())) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Only quotations Pending Confirmation can be reviewed.");
        }

        String finalStatus = isApprove ? STATUS_APPROVED : isReject ? STATUS_REJECTED : STATUS_REVISION_REQUIRED;
        q.setStatus(finalStatus);
        q.setReviewedAt(Instant.now());
        q.setReviewedBy(currentUsernameOrNull());
        q.setRejectionReason(isReject ? remarks : null);
        q.setRevisionNotes(isRevision ? remarks : null);

        String action = isApprove ? "Approved by Super Admin"
                : isReject ? ("Rejected by Super Admin" + (remarks != null && !remarks.isBlank() ? (": " + remarks) : ""))
                : ("Revision requested by Super Admin" + (remarks != null && !remarks.isBlank() ? (": " + remarks) : ""));
        String bg = isApprove ? "#dcfce7" : isReject ? "#fee2e2" : "#fef9c3";
        String color = isApprove ? "#15803d" : isReject ? "#dc2626" : "#92400e";
        addTimeline(q, action, statusIcon(finalStatus), bg, color);
        return repo.save(q);
    }

    private void applyFromLeadAndRequest(Quotation q, Lead lead, QuotationTemplate template, QuotationRequest r) {
        q.setLeadId(lead.getLeadId());
        q.setTemplateId(template.getId());
        q.setClientName(firstNonBlank(r.getClientName(), lead.getName()));
        q.setOrganization(firstNonBlank(r.getOrganization(), lead.getSchool(), lead.getName()));
        q.setEmail(firstNonBlank(r.getEmail(), lead.getEmail()));
        q.setPhone(firstNonBlank(r.getPhone(), lead.getMobile(), lead.getPhoneNumber()));
        q.setAddress(firstNonBlank(r.getAddress(), lead.getSchoolAddress(), lead.getArea()));
        q.setServiceType(firstNonBlank(r.getServiceType(), q.getServiceType(), "ERP"));
        q.setSubject(r.getSubject());
        // Amount/currency remain backward-compatible in the API but are optional and are no longer required by the UI.
        if (r.getAmount() != null) q.setAmount(r.getAmount());
        if (r.getCurrency() != null && !r.getCurrency().isBlank()) q.setCurrency(r.getCurrency());
        q.setValidTill(r.getValidTill());
        if (r.getStatus() != null && !r.getStatus().isBlank()) q.setStatus(r.getStatus());
        q.setNotes(r.getNotes());

        // Merge: start from auto-mapped values (lead + quotation fields),
        // then let anything explicitly supplied in the request win — this is
        // what lets the telecaller manually edit an auto-filled value.
        Map<String, String> autoMapped = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (TemplateField field : template.getFields()) {
            String mapsTo = field.getMapsTo();
            if (mapsTo == null) continue;
            String value = switch (mapsTo) {
                case "clientName" -> q.getClientName();
                case "organization" -> q.getOrganization();
                case "email" -> q.getEmail();
                case "phone" -> q.getPhone();
                case "subject" -> r.getSubject();
                case "serviceType" -> q.getServiceType();
                case "address" -> q.getAddress();
                case "amount" -> r.getAmount() != null ? (q.getCurrency() + " " + r.getAmount()) : null;
                case "validTill" -> r.getValidTill();
                case "notes" -> r.getNotes();
                case "leadId" -> lead.getLeadId();
                case "date" -> DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd MMM yyyy").withZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).format(Instant.now());
                default -> null;
            };
            if (value != null) autoMapped.put(field.getId(), value);
        }
        if (r.getFieldValues() != null) autoMapped.putAll(r.getFieldValues());
        q.setFieldValues(autoMapped);
    }

    /** ICTPL/QTN/<year>/<3-digit running number>, unique even under concurrent requests or deletes. */
    private String nextQuotationNo() {
        int year = LocalDate.now(java.time.ZoneId.of("Asia/Kolkata")).getYear();
        String key = "quotation-" + year;
        Query byKey = Query.query(Criteria.where("_id").is(key));
        try {
            mongo.upsert(byKey, new Update().setOnInsert("seq", numberStart - 1), "counters");
        } catch (DuplicateKeyException ignored) {
            // another request created the counter first - fine
        }
        Document doc = mongo.findAndModify(byKey, new Update().inc("seq", 1),
                FindAndModifyOptions.options().returnNew(true), Document.class, "counters");
        int seq = doc == null ? numberStart : ((Number) doc.get("seq")).intValue();
        return String.format("ICTPL/QTN/%d/%03d", year, seq);
    }

    private String firstNonBlank(String... values) {
        if (values == null) return null;
        for (String value : values) {
            if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) return value;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private void addTimeline(Quotation q, String action, String icon, String bg, String color) {
        String time = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd MMM yyyy \u00b7 h:mm a").withZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).format(Instant.now());
        q.getTimeline().add(new Quotation.TimelineEntry(action, time, icon, bg, color));
    }

    private String statusIcon(String status) {
        return switch (status) {
            case "Approved" -> "check";
            case "Rejected" -> "x";
            case "Revision Required" -> "edit";
            case "Viewed" -> "eye";
            case "Pending Approval" -> "clock";
            case "Sent" -> "send";
            default -> "info";
        };
    }

    private void checkOwner(Quotation q) {
        if (!access.currentUsername().equals(q.getCreatedBy())) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException("Quotation access denied");
        }
    }

    /** Draft, Rejected and Revision Required quotations may be edited; anything
     *  already in the approval pipeline (Pending Approval, Approved, Sent) is
     *  locked so a telecaller can't silently change what the Super Admin
     *  already reviewed. */
    private void requireEditable(Quotation q) {
        String status = q.getStatus();
        if (STATUS_PENDING_APPROVAL.equalsIgnoreCase(status) || STATUS_APPROVED.equalsIgnoreCase(status)
                || STATUS_SENT.equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("This quotation is " + status + " and can no longer be edited.");
        }
    }

    private String currentTelecallerDisplayName(String username) {
        try {
            Telecaller tc = access.currentTelecaller();
            return tc.getFullName() != null && !tc.getFullName().isBlank() ? tc.getFullName() : username;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return username;
        }
    }

    private String currentUsernameOrNull() {
        Authentication auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
        return auth != null ? auth.getName() : null;
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;

import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.DesignBlock;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.DesignPage;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.TemplateDesign;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate.TemplateField;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.QuotationTemplateRepository;

@Service
public class QuotationTemplateService {

    private final QuotationTemplateRepository repo;
    private final QuotationLayouts layouts;

    // true  -> only the built-in IndoCampas templates are offered (default)
    // false -> previously uploaded / designed templates are listed as well (only if their files still exist)
    @Value("${quotation.templates.builtin-only:true}")
    private boolean builtinOnly;

    @Value("${quotation.storage.dir:./storage/quotations}")
    private String storageDirProp;

    private static final double A4_W = 595.28;
    private static final double A4_H = 841.89;
    private static final int PREVIEW_RENDER_DPI = 150;

    // ── IndoCampas Tech branded letterhead assets ─────────────────────────
    // Logo, ribbon corner graphics and contact icons extracted from the
    // company's approved letterhead (template_bb.docx) and embedded as
    // base64 data URLs so every new quotation template starts pre-branded
    // and fully editable in the drag-and-drop designer (nothing here is
    // baked into the PDF as a flat image — each element is its own movable,
    // resizable, restylable block/field).
    private static volatile Map<String, String> BRAND_ASSETS;

    private static Map<String, String> brandAssets() {
        if (BRAND_ASSETS != null) return BRAND_ASSETS;
        synchronized (QuotationTemplateService.class) {
            if (BRAND_ASSETS != null) return BRAND_ASSETS;
            Map<String, String> assets = new HashMap<>();
            try (InputStream in = QuotationTemplateService.class
                    .getResourceAsStream("/quotation-templates/indocampas-assets.json")) {
                if (in != null) {
                    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                    Map<String, String> parsed = new ObjectMapper().readValue(in, Map.class);
                    assets = parsed;
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // Missing/unreadable asset bundle just means the default template
                // falls back to plain text blocks with no logo/ribbon graphics.
            }
            BRAND_ASSETS = assets;
            return BRAND_ASSETS;
        }
    }

    private static String asset(String key) {
        return brandAssets().getOrDefault(key, "");
    }

    public QuotationTemplateService(QuotationTemplateRepository repo, QuotationLayouts layouts) {
        this.repo = repo;
        this.layouts = layouts;
    }

    /** Letterhead (logo, ribbons, contact strip) used by the built-in layouts. */
    public List<DesignBlock> letterheadBlocks() {
        return indoCampasLetterheadBlocks();
    }

    /** A stored template is usable only if every file it needs is still on disk. */
    private boolean isUsable(QuotationTemplate t) {
        if (t == null) return false;
        String mode = t.getDesign() == null ? null : t.getDesign().getMode();
        boolean background = mode == null || "BACKGROUND".equalsIgnoreCase(mode);
        if (!background) return true;
        String path = t.getStoredRenderPdfPath() != null && !t.getStoredRenderPdfPath().isBlank()
                ? t.getStoredRenderPdfPath() : t.getStoredOriginalPath();
        return path != null && new File(path).isFile();
    }

    /** Template to use when generating a quotation PDF. Never fails because of a missing file:
     *  anything unknown or broken falls back to the built-in layout for the service type. */
    public QuotationTemplate resolveForQuotation(String templateId, String serviceType) {
        if (QuotationLayouts.isBuiltIn(templateId)) return layouts.byId(templateId);
        if (!builtinOnly && templateId != null && !templateId.isBlank()) {
            QuotationTemplate t = repo.findById(templateId).orElse(null);
            if (isUsable(t)) return t;
        }
        return layouts.forServiceType(serviceType);
    }

    private Path storageDir() throws Exception {
        Path dir = Paths.get(storageDirProp, "templates");
        Files.createDirectories(dir);
        return dir;
    }

    public List<QuotationTemplate> list(String username) {
        List<QuotationTemplate> out = new ArrayList<>(layouts.builtInTemplates());
        if (!builtinOnly) {
            for (QuotationTemplate t : repo.findByCreatedByOrderByCreatedAtDesc(username)) {
                if (isUsable(t)) out.add(t);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    public QuotationTemplate get(String id) {
        if (QuotationLayouts.isBuiltIn(id)) return layouts.byId(id);
        QuotationTemplate t = repo.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new RuntimeException("Template not found: " + id));
        return t;
    }

    public QuotationTemplate createBlank(String name, String username) throws Exception {
        QuotationTemplate t = new QuotationTemplate();
        t.setName(name == null || name.isBlank() ? "New Quotation Template" : name.trim());
        t.setCreatedBy(username);
        t.setPdfSource(false);
        t.setPageWidthPt(A4_W);
        t.setPageHeightPt(A4_H);
        t.setFields(new ArrayList<>());
        t.setDesign(defaultDesign());
        return repo.save(t);
    }

    public QuotationTemplate upload(MultipartFile file, String name, String username) throws Exception {
        if (file == null || file.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("No file uploaded.");
        String contentType = file.getContentType() == null ? "" : file.getContentType();
        boolean isPdf = contentType.equalsIgnoreCase("application/pdf")
                || (file.getOriginalFilename() != null && file.getOriginalFilename().toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf"));

        Path dir = storageDir();
        String uid = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        String safeOriginalName = (file.getOriginalFilename() == null ? "template" : file.getOriginalFilename())
                .replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]", "_");
        Path originalPath = dir.resolve(uid + "_" + safeOriginalName);
        Path previewPath = dir.resolve(uid + "_preview.png");

        QuotationTemplate template = new QuotationTemplate();
        template.setName(name != null && !name.isBlank() ? name : safeOriginalName);
        template.setOriginalFileName(safeOriginalName);
        template.setOriginalContentType(contentType);
        template.setCreatedBy(username);
        template.setPdfSource(isPdf);
        template.setDesign(defaultBackgroundDesign());

        Files.write(originalPath, file.getBytes());

        if (isPdf) {
            try (PDDocument doc = PDDocument.load(originalPath.toFile())) {
                PDPage page = doc.getPage(0);
                double widthPt = page.getMediaBox().getWidth();
                double heightPt = page.getMediaBox().getHeight();
                PDFRenderer renderer = new PDFRenderer(doc);
                BufferedImage preview = renderer.renderImageWithDPI(0, PREVIEW_RENDER_DPI);
                ImageIO.write(preview, "png", previewPath.toFile());
                template.setPageWidthPt(widthPt);
                template.setPageHeightPt(heightPt);
                template.setPreviewWidthPx(preview.getWidth());
                template.setPreviewHeightPx(preview.getHeight());
            }
        } else {
            BufferedImage img = ImageIO.read(originalPath.toFile());
            if (img == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Uploaded file is not a readable image or PDF.");
            ImageIO.write(img, "png", previewPath.toFile());
            double widthPt = A4_W;
            double heightPt = widthPt * ((double) img.getHeight() / (double) img.getWidth());
            template.setPageWidthPt(widthPt);
            template.setPageHeightPt(heightPt);
            template.setPreviewWidthPx(img.getWidth());
            template.setPreviewHeightPx(img.getHeight());
        }

        template.setStoredOriginalPath(originalPath.toAbsolutePath().toString());
        template.setStoredPreviewPath(previewPath.toAbsolutePath().toString());
        return repo.save(template);
    }

    public QuotationTemplate saveFields(String id, List<TemplateField> fields) {
        QuotationTemplate template = get(id);
        template.setFields(fields == null ? new ArrayList<>() : fields);
        return repo.save(template);
    }

    public QuotationTemplate saveDesign(String id, String name, TemplateDesign design, List<TemplateField> fields) {
        QuotationTemplate template = get(id);
        if (name != null && !name.isBlank()) template.setName(name.trim());
        template.setDesign(design == null ? defaultDesign() : design);
        if (template.getDesign().getPages() != null && !template.getDesign().getPages().isEmpty()) {
            template.getDesign().setBlocks(template.getDesign().getPages().get(0).getBlocks());
        }
        if (fields != null) template.setFields(fields);

        if ("BUILDER".equalsIgnoreCase(template.getDesign().getMode())) {
            template.setPdfSource(false);
            if (template.getPageWidthPt() <= 0) template.setPageWidthPt(A4_W);
            if (template.getPageHeightPt() <= 0) template.setPageHeightPt(A4_H);
        }
        return repo.save(template);
    }

    public File previewFile(String id) {
        QuotationTemplate template = get(id);
        if (template.getStoredPreviewPath() == null) return new File("__missing_preview__");
        return new File(template.getStoredPreviewPath());
    }

    public void delete(String id, String username) {
        QuotationTemplate template = get(id);
        if (!username.equals(template.getCreatedBy())) {
            throw new org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException("Template access denied");
        }
        try {
            if (template.getStoredOriginalPath() != null) Files.deleteIfExists(Paths.get(template.getStoredOriginalPath()));
            if (template.getStoredPreviewPath() != null) Files.deleteIfExists(Paths.get(template.getStoredPreviewPath()));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        repo.deleteById(id);
    }

        // Contact strip (icon + text rows) sitting above the bottom ribbon

        blocks.add(block("phoneText", "text", 0.17, 0.845, 0.55, 0.028,

    private DesignBlock image(String id, double x, double y, double w, double h, String imageDataUrl) {
        DesignBlock b = new DesignBlock();
        b.setId(id);
        b.setType("image");
        b.setX(x); b.setY(y); b.setWidth(w); b.setHeight(h);
        b.setImageDataUrl(imageDataUrl == null ? "" : imageDataUrl);
        return b;
    }


    private TemplateDesign defaultBackgroundDesign() {
        TemplateDesign d = defaultDesign();
        d.setMode("BACKGROUND");
        d.setHeaderEnabled(false);
        d.setFooterEnabled(false);
        d.setBlocks(new ArrayList<>());
        return d;
    }

    private DesignBlock block(String id, String type, double x, double y, double w, double h,
                              String text, String mapsTo, double fontSize, String color,
                              String bg, String align, boolean bold) {
        DesignBlock b = new DesignBlock();
        b.setId(id);
        b.setType(type);
        b.setX(x); b.setY(y); b.setWidth(w); b.setHeight(h);
        b.setText(text); b.setMapsTo(mapsTo); b.setFontSize(fontSize);
        b.setColor(color); b.setBackgroundColor(bg); b.setAlign(align); b.setBold(bold);
        b.setFontFamily("Helvetica");
        b.setPadding(4);
        return b;
    }

===== D:\CRM Main\indocrm (1)\indocrm (1)\indocrm\src\main\java\com\indocrm\indocrm\service\QuotationWhatsAppService.java =====
package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.io.File;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Quotation;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.QuotationTemplate;

@Service
public class QuotationWhatsAppService {
    private final QuotationPdfService pdfService;
    private final QuotationTemplateService templateService;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;
    private final HttpClient http = HttpClient.newHttpClient();

    @Value("${whatsapp.cloud-api.phone-number-id:}")
    private String phoneNumberId;

    @Value("${whatsapp.cloud-api.access-token:}")
    private String accessToken;

    @Value("${whatsapp.cloud-api.version:v23.0}")
    private String graphVersion;

    public QuotationWhatsAppService(QuotationPdfService pdfService,
                                    QuotationTemplateService templateService,
                                    ObjectMapper objectMapper) {
        this.pdfService = pdfService;
        this.templateService = templateService;
        this.objectMapper = objectMapper;
    }

    public void send(Quotation quotation, String recipient, String message) {
        if (phoneNumberId == null || phoneNumberId.isBlank() || accessToken == null || accessToken.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("WhatsApp PDF sending is not configured. Add whatsapp.cloud-api.phone-number-id and whatsapp.cloud-api.access-token to the backend configuration.");
        }

        String to = normalizeIndianOrInternationalPhone(recipient);
        if (quotation.getTemplateId() == null || quotation.getTemplateId().isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Quotation does not have a templateId.");
        }

        QuotationTemplate template = templateService.resolveForQuotation(quotation.getTemplateId(), quotation.getServiceType());
        String pdfPath;
        try {
            pdfPath = pdfService.generate(quotation, template);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to generate quotation PDF: " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }

        File pdfFile = new File(pdfPath);
        if (!pdfFile.exists() || !pdfFile.isFile()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Generated quotation PDF does not exist: " + pdfPath);
        }

        try {
            byte[] pdfBytes = Files.readAllBytes(pdfFile.toPath());
            String fileName = quotation.getGeneratedPdfFileName();
            if (fileName == null || fileName.isBlank()) fileName = "Quotation_" + quotation.getId() + ".pdf";
            String mediaId = uploadPdf(pdfBytes, fileName);
            sendDocument(to, mediaId, fileName, message);
        } catch (IllegalStateException e) {
            throw e;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to send quotation PDF through WhatsApp: " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    private String uploadPdf(byte[] pdfBytes, String fileName) throws Exception {
        String boundary = "----IndoCrm" + UUID.randomUUID();
        byte[] body = multipartBody(boundary, pdfBytes, fileName);

        HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder()
                .uri(URI.create("https://graph.facebook.com/" + graphVersion + "/" + phoneNumberId + "/media"))
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + accessToken)
                .header("Content-Type", "multipart/form-data; boundary=" + boundary)
                .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofByteArray(body))
                .build();

        HttpResponse<String> response = http.send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        if (response.statusCode() / 100 != 2) throw new IllegalStateException("WhatsApp media upload failed: " + response.body());
        Matcher matcher = Pattern.compile("\"id\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]+)\"").matcher(response.body());
        if (!matcher.find()) throw new IllegalStateException("WhatsApp did not return a media id. Response: " + response.body());
        return matcher.group(1);
    }

    private void sendDocument(String to, String mediaId, String fileName, String message) throws Exception {
        ObjectNode root = objectMapper.createObjectNode();
        root.put("messaging_product", "whatsapp");
        root.put("to", to);
        root.put("type", "document");
        ObjectNode document = root.putObject("document");
        document.put("id", mediaId);
        document.put("filename", fileName);
        if (message != null && !message.isBlank()) document.put("caption", message);

        HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder()
                .uri(URI.create("https://graph.facebook.com/" + graphVersion + "/" + phoneNumberId + "/messages"))
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + accessToken)
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(root), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
                .build();

        HttpResponse<String> response = http.send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        if (response.statusCode() / 100 != 2) throw new IllegalStateException("WhatsApp document send failed: " + response.body());
    }

    private byte[] multipartBody(String boundary, byte[] pdfBytes, String fileName) {
        String head = "--" + boundary + "\r\n"
                + "Content-Disposition: form-data; name=\"messaging_product\"\r\n\r\n"
                + "whatsapp\r\n"
                + "--" + boundary + "\r\n"
                + "Content-Disposition: form-data; name=\"type\"\r\n\r\n"
                + "application/pdf\r\n"
                + "--" + boundary + "\r\n"
                + "Content-Disposition: form-data; name=\"file\"; filename=\"" + fileName + "\"\r\n"
                + "Content-Type: application/pdf\r\n\r\n";
        String tail = "\r\n--" + boundary + "--\r\n";
        byte[] a = head.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        byte[] c = tail.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        byte[] result = new byte[a.length + pdfBytes.length + c.length];
        System.arraycopy(a, 0, result, 0, a.length);
        System.arraycopy(pdfBytes, 0, result, a.length, pdfBytes.length);
        System.arraycopy(c, 0, result, a.length + pdfBytes.length, c.length);
        return result;
    }

    private String normalizeIndianOrInternationalPhone(String input) {
        String digits = input == null ? "" : input.replaceAll("\\D", "");
        if (digits.startsWith("00")) digits = digits.substring(2);
        if (digits.startsWith("0")) digits = digits.substring(1);
        if (digits.length() == 10) digits = "91" + digits;
        if (digits.length() < 10) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Enter a valid WhatsApp phone number including country code.");
        return digits;
    }
}

package com.indocrm.indocrm.service;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.time.ZonedDateTime;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Call;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Lead;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.model.Telecaller;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.CallRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.LeadRepository;
import com.indocrm.indocrm.repository.TelecallerRepository;

@Service
public class ReportService {

    private final LeadRepository leadRepository;
    private final CallRepository callRepository;
    private final TelecallerRepository telecallerRepository;

    public ReportService(
            LeadRepository leadRepository,
            CallRepository callRepository,
            TelecallerRepository telecallerRepository) {
        this.leadRepository = leadRepository;
        this.callRepository = callRepository;
        this.telecallerRepository = telecallerRepository;
